Arabski upor (arabsko: al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), znan tudi kot veliki arabski upor (al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), je bila oborožena vstaja Arabcev iz Hedžasa pod hašemitskim vodstvom proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne.

Na podlagi dopisovanja med Henryjem McMahonom iz Združenega kraljestva in Huseinom bin Alijem iz Kraljevine Hedžas se je upor proti vladajočim Turkom uradno začel 10. junija 1916 v Meki. Glavni cilj arabskih upornikov je bila neodvisna in enotna arabska država od Alepa do Adna, ki jo je britanska vlada obljubila priznati.

Šarifska vojska pod vodstvom Huseina in Hašemitov je ob podpori britanskih egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil uspešno pregnala osmansko vojsko iz večjega dela Hedžasa in Transjordanije. Do leta 1918 so uporniki zavzeli Damask in razglasili Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija, kratkotrajno monarhijo, ki jo je vodil Huseinov sin Fejsal I.

source.title: Arab Revolt
paragraphs: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), also known as the Great Arab Revolt (الثورة العربية الكبرى al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), was an armed uprising by the Hashemite-led Arabs of the Hejaz against the Ottoman Empire amidst the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I.

On the basis of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence, exchanged between Henry McMahon of the United Kingdom and Hussein bin Ali of the Kingdom of Hejaz, the rebellion against the ruling Turks was officially initiated at Mecca on 10 June 1916. The primary goal of the Arab rebels was to establish an independent and unified Arab state stretching from Aleppo to Aden, which the British government had promised to recognize.

The Sharifian Army, led by Hussein and the Hashemites with backing from the British military's Egyptian Expeditionary Force, successfully fought and expelled the Ottoman military presence from much of the Hejaz and Transjordan. By 1918, the rebels had captured Damascus and proclaimed the Arab Kingdom of Syria, a short-lived monarchy that was led by Hussein's son Faisal I.

Arabska socialistična stranka Baath – regija Sirija (arabsko: Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), uradno sirska regionalna veja, je bila baatistična organizacija, ki so jo 7. aprila 1947 ustanovili Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in privrženci Zakija al Arsuzija. Stranka je Sirijo vodila od državnega udara leta 1963, ki je baatiste pripeljal na oblast, do 8. decembra 2024, ko je Bašar al Asad pred uporniško ofenzivo, ki je končala sirsko državljansko vojno, pobegnil iz Damaska. Formalno so jo razpustili januarja 2025.

source.title: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region
paragraphs: The Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region (Arabic: حزب البعث العربي الاشتراكي – قطر سوريا Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), officially the Syrian Regional Branch (Arabic: الفرع القطري السوري), was a Ba'athist organisation founded on 7 April 1947 by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar and followers of Zaki al-Arsuzi. The party ruled Syria from the 1963 coup d'état, which brought the Ba'athists to power, until 8 December 2024, when Bashar al-Assad fled Damascus in the face of a rebel offensive which concluded the Syrian civil war. It was formally disbanded in January 2025.

Ararat rebellion.headline: Upor na Araratu
paragraphs: Upor na Araratu, znan tudi kot upor v Ağrıju (turško: Ağrı ayaklanmaları ali Ağrı isyanı), je bil upor Kurdov v provinci Ağrı na vzhodu Turčije proti turški vladi leta 1930. Gverilske sile je med uporom vodil Ihsan Nuri iz veje Džibran plemena Džalali.

source.title: Ararat rebellion
paragraphs: The Ararat rebellion, also known as the Ağrı rebellion (Turkish: Ağrı ayaklanmaları or Ağrı isyanı), was a 1930 uprising by the Kurds of Ağrı Province, in eastern Turkey, against the Turkish government. The leader of the guerrilla forces during the rebellion was Ihsan Nuri of the Jibran branch of the Jalali tribe.

Armistice of Erzincan.headline: Premirje v Erzincanu
paragraphs: Premirje v Erzincanu (zapisano tudi Erzindžan) je bil sporazum o prekinitvi sovražnosti med prvo svetovno vojno, ki sta ga Osmansko cesarstvo in Zakavkaški komisariat podpisala v Erzincanu 18. decembra 1917 (5. decembra po starem koledarju). Premirje je na kavkaškem in perzijskem bojišču prineslo začasen mir do 12. februarja, ko so se boji znova začeli.

source.title: Armistice of Erzincan
paragraphs: The Armistice of Erzincan (also spelled Erzindzhan or Erzinjan) was an agreement to suspend hostilities during World War I signed by the Ottoman Empire and Transcaucasian Commissariat in Erzincan on 18 December 1917 (5 December O.S.). The armistice brought temporary peace to the Caucasian and Persian Fronts until 12 February, when the fighting was resumed.

Armistice of Mudanya.headline: Premirje v Mudanyi
paragraphs: Premirje v Mudanyi (turško: Mudanya Mütarekesi) je bil sporazum med Turčijo (Veliko narodno skupščino Turčije) ter Italijo, Francijo in Veliko Britanijo, podpisan 11. oktobra 1922 v mestu Mudanya v provinci Bursa. Kraljevina Grčija je k premirju pristopila 14. oktobra 1922.

source.title: Armistice of Mudanya
paragraphs: The Armistice of Mudanya (Turkish: Mudanya Mütarekesi) was an agreement between Turkey (the Grand National Assembly of Turkey) and Italy, France, and Britain, signed in the town of Mudanya, in the province of Bursa, on 11 October 1922. The Kingdom of Greece acceded to the armistice on 14 October 1922.

Assassination of Uthman.headline: Umor kalifa Osmana
paragraphs: Osman ibn Afan, tretji pravoverni kalif, ki je vladal od leta 644 do 656, je bil leta 656 umorjen ob koncu obleganja svoje hiše. Sprva je šlo za protest, ki pa je po smrti enega od protestnikov prerasel v obleganje. Protestniki, ki so postali uporniki, so zahtevali novega kalifa, kar je Osman zavrnil. Protestniki so 17. junija 656 (35 po hidžri) hišo zažgali, vdrli vanjo in ga ubili.

Osmanov umor je tedanjo umo razklal. Odprl je vprašanja ne le o njegovem značaju in politiki, temveč tudi o odnosu med muslimani in državo, o verskih pogledih na upor in vladanje ter o pogojih za vladanje v islamu.

source.title: Assassination of Uthman
paragraphs: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Rashidun caliph, who ruled from 644 to 656, was assassinated at the end of a siege upon his house in 656. This was initially a protest but escalated into a siege following the death of a protester. The protesters-turned-rebels had demanded a new caliph, which Uthman refused. On 17 June 656 (35 AH) protestors set the house on fire, made their way inside, and killed him.

The assassination of Uthman had a polarizing effect on the Ummah at the time. Questions were raised not only regarding his character and policies but also the relationship between Muslims and the state, religious beliefs regarding rebellion and governance, and the qualifications of rulership in Islam.

Assyrian conquest of Egypt.headline: Asirska osvojitev Egipta
paragraphs: Asirska osvojitev Egipta je zajela razmeroma kratko obdobje Novoasirskega cesarstva, od leta 673 do 663 pr. n. št. Asirci si niso le podredili dežele z velikim kulturnim ugledom, temveč so z osvojitvijo Egipta cesarstvu dali tudi največji obseg.

source.title: Assyrian conquest of Egypt
paragraphs: The Assyrian conquest of Egypt covered a relatively short period of the Neo-Assyrian Empire from 673 to 663 BCE. The conquest of Egypt not only placed a land of great cultural prestige under Assyrian rule but also brought the Neo-Assyrian Empire to its greatest extent.

Asirsko obleganje Jeruzalema (ok. 701 pr. n. št.) je bilo prekinjeno obleganje Jeruzalema, tedanje prestolnice Kraljestva Juda, ki ga je izvedel Senaherib, kralj Novoasirskega cesarstva. Obleganje je sklenilo Senaheribov pohod v Levant, v katerem je v pohodu podjarmljanja napadal judovska utrjena mesta in pustošil podeželje. Senaherib je Jeruzalem oblegal, a ga ni zavzel.

Senaheribovi anali opisujejo, kako je kralj judovskega kralja Ezekija zaprl v Jeruzalem »kakor ptico v kletko« in se pozneje, ko je od Jude prejel davek, vrnil v Asirijo. Po hebrejski Bibliji je Ezekija Asiriji plačal 300 talentov srebra in 30 talentov zlata. Svetopisemska zgodba trdi, da je Senaherib z vojsko krenil nad Jeruzalem, a jo je pred mestnimi vrati pokončal angel, zato se je umaknil v Ninive.
Po teoriji svetopisemske arheologije je Ezekija v pripravah na grozeče obleganje zgradil predor Siloam in široki zid v Jeruzalemu.

source.title: Assyrian siege of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Assyrian siege of Jerusalem (c. 701 BC) was an aborted siege of Jerusalem, then capital of the Kingdom of Judah, carried out by Sennacherib, king of the Neo-Assyrian Empire. The siege concluded Sennacharib's campaign in the Levant, in which he attacked the fortified cities and devastated the countryside of Judah in a campaign of subjugation. Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem, but did not capture it.

Sennacherib's Annals describe how the king trapped Hezekiah of Judah in Jerusalem "like a caged bird" and later returned to Assyria when he received tribute from Judah. In the Hebrew Bible, Hezekiah is described as paying 300 talents of silver and 30 talents of gold to Assyria. The biblical story claims that Sennacherib marched on Jerusalem with his army only to have it struck down near the gates of Jerusalem by an angel, prompting his retreat to Nineveh.
According to biblical archaeological theory, Siloam tunnel and the Broad Wall in Jerusalem were built by Hezekiah in preparation for the impending siege.

Napad na Mers-el-Kébir (bitka pri Mers-el-Kébirju) 3. julija 1940, med drugo svetovno vojno, je bil britanski pomorski napad na ladje francoske vojne mornarice v pomorskem oporišču Mers El Kébir pri Oranu na obali francoske Alžirije. Napad je bil glavni del operacije Katapult, britanskega načrta, da bi francoske ladje onesposobili ali uničili, preden bi po porazu zaveznikov v bitki za Francijo padle v nemške roke. Britansko obstreljevanje oporišča je ubilo 1297 francoskih vojakov, potopilo bojno ladjo in poškodovalo pet drugih ladij, Britanci pa so izgubili pet sestreljenih letal in dva člana posadke. Napad z zraka in morja je izvedla britanska kraljeva vojna mornarica, potem ko je Francija podpisala premirji z Nemčijo in Italijo, ki sta začeli veljati 25. junija.

source.title: Attack on Mers-el-Kébir
paragraphs: The attack on Mers-el-Kébir (Battle of Mers-el-Kébir) on 3 July 1940, during the Second World War, was a British naval attack on French Navy ships at the naval base at Mers El Kébir, near Oran, on the coast of French Algeria. The attack was the main part of Operation Catapult, a British plan to neutralise or destroy French ships to prevent them from falling into German hands after the Allied defeat in the Battle of France. The British bombardment of the base killed 1,297 French servicemen, sank a battleship and damaged five other ships, for a British loss of five aircraft shot down and two crewmen killed. The attack by air and sea was conducted by the Royal Navy, after France had signed armistices with Germany and Italy, coming into effect on 25 June.

Balkan Pact (1953).headline: Balkanski pakt (1953)
paragraphs: Balkanski pakt (grško: Βαλκανικό Σύμφωνο; makedonsko: Балкански пакт; srbohrvaško: Balkanski pakt / Балкански пакт; turško: Balkan Paktı) iz leta 1953, uradno Sporazum o prijateljstvu in sodelovanju, je bila pogodba, ki so jo 28. februarja 1953 podpisale Grčija, Turčija in Jugoslavija. Podpisali so jo v Ankari. Pogodba je bila namenjena odvračanju sovjetskega širjenja na Balkanu in je predvidevala, da bodo tri države sčasoma ustanovile skupni vojaški štab. Ko so pakt sklenili in podpisali, sta bili Turčija in Grčija že leto dni članici Organizacije Severnoatlantske pogodbe (Nato), saj sta se ji obe pridružili 18. februarja 1952, Jugoslavija pa je bila socialistična neuvrščena država, ki je pozneje postala ustanovna članica Gibanja neuvrščenih. Balkanski pakt je Jugoslaviji omogočil, da se je v geopolitičnih zadevah dejansko povezala z Natom, uradno pa ostala nevtralna. Oktobra 1954 je izraelska vlada izrazila zanimanje za pristop k zavezništvu, saj je pričakovala, da bi Jugoslavija lahko posredovala pri razvoju egiptovsko-izraelskih odnosov; jugoslovanske oblasti so bile predlogu naklonjene. Izrael pa se zavezništvu nazadnje ni pridružil.
notes: The Slovene name in the list of names (Balkanski pakt) is dropped, since the text itself is Slovenian.

source.title: Balkan Pact (1953)
paragraphs: The Balkan Pact (Greek: Βαλκανικό Σύμφωνο, Macedonian: Балкански пакт, Serbo-Croatian: Balkanski pakt / Балкански пакт, Slovene: Balkanski pakt, Turkish: Balkan Paktı) of 1953, officially known as the Agreement of Friendship and Cooperation, was a treaty signed by Greece, Turkey and Yugoslavia on 28 February 1953. It was signed in Ankara. The treaty was to act as a deterrence against Soviet expansion in the Balkans and provided for the eventual creation of a joint military staff for the three countries. When the pact was created and signed, Turkey and Greece had been members of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) for a year, having both joined on 18 February 1952, while Yugoslavia was a socialist non-aligned state that later became a founding member of the Non-Aligned Movement. The Balkan Pact allowed Yugoslavia to de facto associate itself with NATO on geopolitical affairs while remaining officially neutral. In October 1954, Israeli government expressed their interest in joining the alliance in expectation that Yugoslavia would act as a mediator in development of the Egypt–Israel relations; Yugoslav authorities were open to the proposal. However, Israel never ended up joining the alliance.

Barbary Crusade.headline: Berberska križarska vojna
paragraphs: Berberska križarska vojna, imenovana tudi križarska vojna proti Mahdiji, je bila francosko-genovska vojaška odprava leta 1390, ki je pripeljala do obleganja Mahdije, tedaj oporišča berberskih piratov v hafsidski Ifrikiji (zemljepisno ustreza današnji Tuniziji). Glavni opis te ene zadnjih križarskih vojn so Froissartove Kronike.

source.title: Barbary Crusade
paragraphs: The Barbary Crusade, also called the Mahdia Crusade, was a Franco-Genoese military expedition in 1390 that led to the siege of Mahdia, then a stronghold of the Barbary pirates in Hafsidi Ifriqiya (geographically corresponding to modern Tunisia). Froissart's Chronicles is the chief account of what was one of the last crusades.

Basus War.headline: Vojna Basus
paragraphs: Vojna Basus (pogosto pisano vojna al Basus; arabsko: ḥarb al-basūs) je slavna pripoved o spopadu iz zbirke ajjām al-ʿarab (»dnevi Arabcev«), po izročilu datirana v pozno predislamsko Arabijo, ki prikazuje rivalstvo plemen Taglib in Bakr. Arabsko zgodovinsko in literarno izročilo jo opisuje kot štiridesetletno plemensko vojno, ki jo je sprožil uboj kamele, ki je pripadala ženski po imenu Basus. Zgodba ima pomembno mesto v arabski literarni kulturi kot slaven svarilni rek pred krvnim maščevanjem, nasiljem med sorodniki in stopnjevanjem spora.

source.title: Basus War
paragraphs: The Basus War (often written al-Basus War; Arabic: حرب البسوس ḥarb al-basūs) is a famous conflict narrative from the corpus of the ayyām al-ʿarab (Days of the Arabs), traditionally dated to late pre-Islamic Arabia and showcasing the rivalry of the tribes of Taghlib and Bakr. In Arabic historical and literary tradition, it is portrayed as a forty-year tribal war triggered by the killing of a camel belonging to a woman named Basus. The story occupies an important place in Arabic literary culture as a famous aphorism warning against vendetta, kin-violence, and escalation.

Battle for Jerusalem.headline: Bitka za Jeruzalem
paragraphs: Bitka za Jeruzalem je potekala v fazi državljanske vojne v letih 1947–1948, med palestinsko vojno v letih 1947–1949. Judovske in arabske milice v mandatni Palestini, pozneje pa vojski Izraela in Transjordanije, so se bojevale za nadzor nad Jeruzalemom. Po načrtu Združenih narodov za razdelitev Palestine iz leta 1947 naj bi bil Jeruzalem corpus separatum (»ločeno telo«), ki bi ga upravljal mednarodni organ. Kljub temu so v mestu takoj izbruhnili boji med judovskimi in arabskimi milicami, obe strani pa sta izvajali bombne in druge napade.

source.title: Battle for Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Battle for Jerusalem took place during the 1947–1948 civil war phase of the 1947–1949 Palestine war. It saw Jewish and Arab militias in Mandatory Palestine, and later the militaries of Israel and Transjordan, fight for control over the city of Jerusalem. Under the 1947 United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine, Jerusalem was to be a corpus separatum (lit. 'separated body') administered by an international body. Fighting nevertheless immediately broke out in the city between Jewish and Arab militias, with bombings and other attacks being carried out by both sides.

Battle of 73 Easting.headline: Bitka pri 73 Eastingu
paragraphs: Bitka pri 73 Eastingu je 26. februarja 1991, med zalivsko vojno, potekala med koalicijskimi oklepnimi silami (VII. korpus ZDA in britanska 1. oklepna divizija) in iraškimi oklepnimi silami (republikanska garda in divizija Tavakalna). Ime je dobila po koordinatni črti UTM v smeri sever–jug (»easting«, merjen v kilometrih in berljiv na sprejemnikih GPS), ki so jo koalicijske sile uporabljale kot črto faze za merjenje napredovanja po puščavi. Udeleženec bitke poročnik John Mecca jo je pozneje opisal kot »zadnjo veliko tankovsko bitko 20. stoletja«. Potekala je nekaj ur po drugi, manjši tankovski bitki pri Al Busajji.

source.title: Battle of 73 Easting
paragraphs: The Battle of 73 Easting was fought on 26 February 1991, during the Gulf War, between Coalition armored forces (US VII Corps and UK 1st Armoured Division) and Iraqi armored forces (Republican Guard and Tawakalna Division). It was named for a UTM north–south coordinate line (an "Easting", measured in kilometers and readable on GPS receivers) that was used as a phase line by Coalition forces to measure their progress through the desert. The battle was later described by Lt. John Mecca, a participant, as "the last great tank battle of the 20th century." This battle took place several hours after another, smaller, tank battle at Al Busayyah.

Battle of Abydos.headline: Bitka pri Abidosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Abidosu je bila atenska pomorska zmaga v peloponeški vojni. Špartansko ladjevje pod Mindarjevim poveljstvom je v bitki skušalo rešiti manjše zavezniško ladjevje, ki so ga pregnali na obalo pri Dardanu, a ga je napadlo atensko ladjevje pod Trasibulovim poveljstvom. Boj je bil dolgo izenačen, proti večeru pa je prihod Alkibiada z atenskimi okrepitvami prevesil tehtnico v prid Atencem in Peloponežani so morali pobegniti nazaj v svoje oporišče v Abidosu, pri čemer so med potjo utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Abydos
paragraphs: The Battle of Abydos was an Athenian naval victory in the Peloponnesian War. In the battle, the Spartan fleet, under Mindarus, attempted to rescue a small allied fleet that had been driven ashore at Dardanus, but was attacked by the Athenian fleet, under Thrasybulus. The fighting was evenly contested for a great length of time, but towards evening, the arrival of Alcibiades with Athenian reinforcements tipped the balance in favor of the Athenians, and the Peloponnesians were forced to flee back to their base at Abydos, suffering heavy losses along the way.

Battle of Ad Decimum.headline: Bitka pri Ad Decimum
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ad Decimum je potekala 13. septembra 533 med vojskama Vandalov pod poveljstvom kralja Gelimerja in Bizantinskega cesarstva pod poveljstvom vojskovodje Belizarja.

Vandalsko kraljestvo je pod kraljem Hilderikom ohranjalo tesne vezi s cesarjem Justinijanom I., ker pa je Hilderik namesto arijanstva sprejel kalcedonsko krščanstvo, ga je leta 531 strmoglavil bratranec Gelimer. Justinijan Gelimerjeve oblasti ni hotel priznati in je leta 533 pod Belizarjevim poveljstvom poslal odpravo, da bi obnovil cesarski nadzor nad severno Afriko. Ko se je bizantinska vojska izkrcala pri Caputvadi, je napredovala proti Kartagini, Gelimer pa je v soteski pri Ad Decimum pripravil zasedo z usklajenimi napadi svojega brata Amatasa, nečaka Gibamunda in lastnih sil.

source.title: Battle of Ad Decimum
paragraphs: The Battle of Ad Decimum took place on 13 September 533 between the armies of the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, and the Byzantine Empire, under the command of General Belisarius.

The Vandal Kingdom under King Hilderic maintained close ties with Emperor Justinian I, but Hilderic's acceptance of Chalcedonian Christianity over Arianism led to his overthrow by his cousin Gelimer in 531. Refusing to recognize Gelimer's rule, Justinian launched an expedition in 533 under the command of Belisarius to restore imperial control over North Africa. After landing at Caputvada, the Byzantine army advanced toward Carthage, while Gelimer prepared an ambush at the narrows of Ad Decimum using coordinated attacks by his brother Ammatas, his nephew Gibamundus, and his own forces.

Battle of Adrianople (1205).headline: Bitka pri Odrinu (1205)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Odrinu je potekala 14. aprila 1205 v okolici Odrina med Bolgari, Kumani in Vlahi pod poveljstvom bolgarskega carja Kalojana ter križarji pod Balduinom I., ki so ga le nekaj mesecev prej kronali za carigrajskega cesarja, in njihovimi zavezniki Benečani pod dožem Enricom Dandolom. Bitko je po uspešni zasedi dobilo Bolgarsko cesarstvo.

source.title: Battle of Adrianople (1205)
paragraphs: The Battle of Adrianople occurred around Adrianople on April 14, 1205, between Bulgarians, Cumans and Vlachs under the command of Tsar Kaloyan of Bulgaria, and Crusaders under Baldwin I, who only months before had been crowned Emperor of Constantinople, allied with Venetians under Doge Enrico Dandolo. The battle was won by the Bulgarian Empire after a successful ambush.

Battle of Adys.headline: Bitka pri Adisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Adisu je potekala konec leta 256 pr. n. št. med prvo punsko vojno med kartažansko vojsko, ki so ji skupaj poveljevali Bostar, Hamilkar in Hasdrubal, ter rimsko vojsko pod vodstvom Marka Atilija Regula. Prej tistega leta si je nova rimska vojna mornarica zagotovila premoč na morju in jo izkoristila za vdor v kartažansko domovino, ki je približno ustrezala današnji Tuniziji v severni Afriki. Ko se je ladjevje izkrcalo na polotoku Cap Bon in izvedlo uspešen pohod, se je vrnilo na Sicilijo, Regulu pa je pustilo 15.500 mož, da bi čez zimo obdržal mostišče v Afriki.

source.title: Battle of Adys
paragraphs: The battle of Adys (or Adis) took place in late 256 BC during the First Punic War between a Carthaginian army jointly commanded by Bostar, Hamilcar and Hasdrubal and a Roman army led by Marcus Atilius Regulus. Earlier in the year, the new Roman navy had established naval superiority and used this advantage to invade the Carthaginian homeland, which roughly aligned with modern Tunisia in North Africa. After landing on the Cape Bon Peninsula and conducting a successful campaign, the fleet returned to Sicily, leaving Regulus with 15,500 men to hold the lodgement in Africa over the winter.

Battle of Ajnadayn.headline: Bitka pri Adžnadajnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Adžnadajnu (arabsko: معركة أجنادين) je potekala julija ali avgusta 634 (džumada I ali II leta 13 po hidžri) blizu kraja Bajt Džibrin; bila je prva velika bitka med Bizantinskim (Rimskim) cesarstvom in vojsko arabskega pravovernega kalifata. Končala se je z odločilno muslimansko zmago. Podrobnosti bitke so znane predvsem iz muslimanskih virov, kot je zgodovinar al Vakidi iz 9. stoletja.

source.title: Battle of Ajnadayn
paragraphs: The Battle of Ajnadayn (Arabic: معركة أجنادين) was fought in July or August 634 (Jumada I or II, 13 AH), in a location close to Bayt Jibrin; it was the first major pitched battle between the Byzantine (Roman) Empire and the army of the Arab Rashidun Caliphate. The result of the battle was a decisive Muslim victory. The details of this battle are mostly known through Muslim sources, such as the ninth-century historian al-Waqidi.

Battle of Akroinon.headline: Bitka pri Akroinonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Akroinonu je potekala leta 740 pri Akroinonu ali Akroinosu (blizu današnjega Afyona) v Frigiji, na zahodnem robu anatolske planote, med omajadsko arabsko vojsko in bizantinskimi silami. Arabci so že stoletje redno vpadali v Anatolijo, pohod leta 740 pa je bil največji v zadnjih desetletjih in je obsegal tri ločene divizije. Eni od njih, ki je štela 20.000 mož pod poveljstvom Abdulaha al Batala in Al Malika ibn Šuajba, so se pri Akroinonu postavili po robu Bizantinci pod poveljstvom cesarja Leona III. Izavrijca (vladal 717–741) in njegovega sina, poznejšega Konstantina V. (vladal 741–775). Bitka se je končala z odločilno bizantinsko zmago. Skupaj s težavami Omajadskega kalifata na drugih bojiščih in notranjo nestabilnostjo pred abasidskim uporom in po njem je to za tri desetletja končalo večje arabske vpade v Anatolijo.

source.title: Battle of Akroinon
paragraphs: The Battle of Akroinon was fought at Akroinon or Akroinos (near modern Afyon) in Phrygia, on the western edge of the Anatolian plateau, in 740 between an Umayyad Arab army and the Byzantine forces. The Arabs had been conducting regular raids into Anatolia for the past century, and the 740 expedition was the largest in recent decades, consisting of three separate divisions. One division, 20,000 strong under Abdallah al-Battal and al-Malik ibn Shu'aib, was confronted at Akroinon by the Byzantines under the command of Emperor Leo III the Isaurian (r. 717–741) and his son, the future Constantine V (r. 741–775). The battle resulted in a decisive Byzantine victory. Coupled with the Umayyad Caliphate's troubles on other fronts and the internal instability before and after the Abbasid Revolt, this put an end to major Arab incursions into Anatolia for three decades.

Battle of Al Faw (2003).headline: Bitka pri Al Favu (2003)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Favu se je začela 20. marca 2003 in je trajala štiri dni, v okviru invazije na Irak leta 2003.

Eden prvih ciljev koalicije je bil zavzeti vse plinske in naftne ploščadi (GOPLAT) na polotoku Al Fav, preden bi jih iraška vojska sabotirala ali uničila. S tem bi Iraku tudi preprečili, da bi povzročil novo ekološko katastrofo, kot jo je leta 1991 s požari kuvajtskih naftnih vrelcev in razlitjem nafte v Perzijskem zalivu. Z zavzetjem obale bi koalicija zagotovila tudi hitrejši prevzem iraške naftne proizvodnje.

Britanska 3. brigada komandosov naj bi hkrati zavzela Um Kasr, da bi pristanišče Um Kasr – edino globokovodno pristanišče v Iraku – lahko uporabili za dovoz težke vojaške opreme, ko bi skupina za protiminske ukrepe počistila Hor Abd Alah. 15. ekspedicijska enota ameriških marincev je bila podrejena 3. brigadi komandosov, da bi zagotovila sile, potrebne za zavzetje obeh ciljev.

source.title: Battle of Al Faw (2003)
paragraphs: The Battle of Al Faw began on 20 March 2003 and continued for four days, as part of the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

One of the initial objectives of the Coalition was to capture every GOPLAT (gas and oil platform) in the Al-Faw Peninsula before they could be sabotaged or destroyed by the Iraqi military. Doing so would also deny Iraq the ability to cause another ecological disaster, as it had done with the Kuwait oil fires and the Persian Gulf oil spill in 1991. By seizing the country's coast, the Coalition would also ensure a quicker takeover of Iraqi oil production.

The 3 Commando Brigade of the British Armed Forces would also capture Umm Qasr at the same time, so that Umm Qasr Port—the only deep water port in Iraq—could be used to bring in heavy military supplies once Khawr Abd Allah was cleared by the Mine Counter Measures Task Group. The 15th Marine Expeditionary Unit of the United States Marine Corps was placed under the command of the 3 Commando Brigade in order to provide the necessary force for capturing both targets.

Battle of al-Anbar.headline: Bitka pri Al Anbarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Anbarju (arabsko: معركة الأنبار) je potekala med muslimansko arabsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida in Sasanidskim imperijem. Bojevali so se pri Anbarju, ki leži približno 80 milj od starodavnega mesta Babilon. Halid je sasanidske Perzijce oblegal v mestni trdnjavi z močnim obzidjem, pri obleganju pa je sodelovalo veliko muslimanskih lokostrelcev. Perzijski guverner Širzad se je nazadnje vdal in smel oditi. Bitko se pogosto spominjajo kot »boj za oči«, saj so muslimanskim lokostrelcem naročili, naj merijo v »oči« perzijske posadke.

source.title: Battle of al-Anbar
paragraphs: The Battle of Al-Anbar (Arabic: معركة الأنبار) was between the Muslim Arab army under the command of Khalid ibn al-Walid and the Sasanian Empire. The battle took place at Anbar which is located approximately 80 miles from the ancient city of Babylon. Khalid besieged the Sassanian Persians in the city fortress, which had strong walls. Scores of Muslim archers were used in the siege. The Persian governor, Shirzad, eventually surrendered and was allowed to retire. The Battle of Al-Anbar is often remembered as the "Action of the Eye" since Muslim archers used in the battle were told to aim at the "eyes" of the Persian garrison.

Battle of al-Bab.headline: Bitka za Al Bab
paragraphs: Bitka za Al Bab je bila bitka za mesto Al Bab v guvernoratu Alep, ki je obsegala vojaško ofenzivo sirskih uporniških skupin (med njimi skupin, povezanih s Svobodno sirsko vojsko) in turških oboroženih sil severno od Al Baba, ločeno ofenzivo Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF) vzhodno in zahodno od mesta ter še ofenzivo sirske vojske z juga. Severne sile pod turškim vodstvom so hotele Al Bab v okviru turške vojaške intervencije v Siriji iztrgati Islamski državi Iraka in Levanta (ISIL). Do konca bitke so sile pod turškim vodstvom zavzele Al Bab, Kabasin in Bizaa, sirska vojska je zavzela Tadef in druga območja južneje, SDF pa je napredovala vzhodneje in zahodneje.

source.title: Battle of al-Bab
paragraphs: The Battle of al-Bab was a battle for the city of al-Bab in the Aleppo Governorate that included a military offensive launched by Syrian rebel groups (including groups affiliated with the Free Syrian Army) and the Turkish Armed Forces north of al-Bab, a separate Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) offensive east and west of the city, and another Syrian Army offensive from the south of the city. The northern Turkish-led forces intended to capture al-Bab from the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL), as part of the Turkish military intervention in Syria. By the end of the battle, the Turkish-led forces had captured al-Bab, Qabasin, and Bizaah, while the Syrian Army captured Tadef and other areas further south, with the SDF making gains further to the east and the west.

Battle of al-Buqaia.headline: Bitka pri Al Bukaji
paragraphs: V bitki pri Al Bukaji leta 1163 so križarji in njihovi zavezniki redko porazili Nur ad Dina Zengija, emirja Alepa in Damaska. Kralj Amalrik I. je vodil vojsko Jeruzalemskega kraljestva skupaj z odredi iz severnih latinskih držav, velikim številom romarjev, ki so ravno prispeli iz Francije, in silami, ki jih je pripeljal bizantinski guverner Kilikije. Kristjanom je zmaga prinesla le kratek predah pred vztrajno muslimansko ofenzivo.

source.title: Battle of al-Buqaia
paragraphs: In the Battle of al-Buqaia in 1163, the Crusaders and their allies inflicted a rare defeat on Nur ad-Din Zangi, the Emir of Aleppo and Damascus. King Amalric I led the army of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, together with contingents from the northern Latin states, a substantial body of pilgrims who had just arrived from France, and a force brought by the Byzantine governor of Cilicia. For the Christian forces, this victory only gave a brief respite from the sustained Muslim offensive.

Battle of al-Fule.headline: Bitka pri Al Fuli
paragraphs: V pohodu in bitki pri Al Fuli (v križarskem izrazju La Fève, latinsko Castrum Fabe) so se križarske sile pod vodstvom Guya Lusignanskega septembra in oktobra 1183 več kot teden dni spopadale s Saladinovo ajubidsko vojsko. Boji so se končali 6. oktobra, ko se je moral Saladin umakniti.

source.title: Battle of al-Fule
paragraphs: In the campaign and Battle of al-Fule (in Crusader terms La Fève, Latin Castrum Fabe), a Crusader force led by Guy of Lusignan skirmished with Saladin's Ayyubid army for more than a week in September and October 1183. The fighting ended on 6 October with Saladin being forced to withdraw.

Battle of al-Harra.headline: Bitka pri Al Hari
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Hari (arabsko: Yawm al-Ḥarra, dobesedno »dan Al Hare«) je potekala med omajadsko vojsko kalifa Jazida I. (vladal 680–683) pod vodstvom Muslima ibn Ukbe in branilci Medine iz frakcij ansarjev in muhadžirov, ki so se uprli kalifu. Bitka je potekala na lavinem polju Harat Vakim na severovzhodnem obrobju Medine 26. avgusta 683 in je trajala manj kot dan.

source.title: Battle of al-Harra
paragraphs: The Battle of al-Harra (Arabic: يوم الحرة, romanized: Yawm al-Ḥarra, lit. 'Day of al-Harra') was fought between the Umayyad army of the caliph Yazid I (r. 680–683) led by Muslim ibn Uqba and the defenders of Medina from the Ansar and Muhajirun factions, who had rebelled against the caliph. The battle took place at the lava field of Harrat Waqim in the northeastern outskirts of Medina on 26 August 683 and lasted less than a day.

Battle of al-Qaryatayn.headline: Bitka pri Al Karjatajnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Karjatajnu je bila manjša bitka med krščanskimi arabskimi Gasanidi, zavezniki Bizantinskega cesarstva, in vojsko pravovernega kalifata. Bojevali so se, potem ko je Halid ibn al Valid osvojil Tadmur v Siriji. Njegova vojska je krenila proti Al Karjatajnu, katerega prebivalci so se muslimanski vojski uprli. Premagali so jih in izropali, muslimanske sile pa so Al Karjatajn osvojile.

source.title: Battle of al-Qaryatayn
paragraphs: Battle of al-Qaryatayn was a minor battle between the Christian Ghassanid Arab allies of the Byzantine Empire, and the Rashidun Caliphate army. It was fought after Khalid ibn al-Walid had conquered Tadmur in Syria. His army marched to al-Qaryatayn, the inhabitants of which resisted the Muslim army. They were fought, defeated and plundered. This resulted in the conquest of Al-Qaryatayn by the Muslim forces.

Battle of al-Yamama.headline: Bitka pri Al Jamami
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Jamami je potekala decembra 632 v okviru vojn Ride proti uporu v pravovernem kalifatu v pokrajini Al Jamama (v današnji Savdski Arabiji, južno od Rijada) med silami Abu Bakra in Musajlime, samozvanega preroka. Bila je del večkrat podaljšanega spopada na ravnini Akrama in v mestu Al Hadikat.

source.title: Battle of al-Yamama
paragraphs: The Battle of al-Yamama was fought in December 632 as part of the Ridda Wars against a rebellion within the Rashidun Caliphate in the region of al-Yamama (in present-day Saudi Arabia, south of Riyadh) between the forces of Abu Bakr and Musaylima, a self-proclaimed prophet. This battle was a part of a multi-prolonged engagement in the plains of Aqrama and the city of Al-Hadiqat.

Battle of Aladzha.headline: Bitka pri Aladži
paragraphs: Bitka pri Aladži (turško: Alacadağ Muharebesi, dobesedno »bitka pri Alacadağu«; rusko: Авлияр-Аладжинское сражение, dobesedno »bitka pri Avliyarju in Aladži«) je bila ključna bitka kavkaške kampanje rusko-turške vojne v letih 1877–1878. Ruske enote so prebile obrambo turških enot na aladžinskih višinah, kar jim je omogočilo, da so prevzele pobudo in začele oblegati Kars.

source.title: Battle of Aladzha
paragraphs: The Battle of Aladzha (Turkish: Alacadağ Muharebesi, lit. 'Battle of Alacadağ'; Russian: Авлияр-Аладжинское сражение, lit. 'Battle of Avliyar–Aladzha') was a key battle of the Caucasian campaign of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–78. Russian troops broke through the defenses of the Turkish troops on the Aladzhin heights, which allowed them to seize the initiative and begin the siege of Kars.

Battle of Alam el Halfa.headline: Bitka pri Alam el Halfi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Alam el Halfi je potekala med 30. avgustom in 5. septembrom 1942 južno od El Alameina med kampanjo v Zahodni puščavi v drugi svetovni vojni. Panzerarmee Afrika (generalfeldmaršal Erwin Rommel) je skušala obkoliti britansko osmo armado (generalpodpolkovnik Bernard Montgomery). Z operacijo Brandung (Unternehmen Brandung, »operacija Valovanje«), zadnjo veliko ofenzivo sil osi v kampanji v Zahodni puščavi, je Rommel hotel premagati osmo armado, preden bi prispele zavezniške okrepitve.

source.title: Battle of Alam el Halfa
paragraphs: The Battle of Alam el Halfa took place between 30 August and 5 September 1942 south of El Alamein during the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War. Panzerarmee Afrika (Generalfeldmarschall Erwin Rommel), attempted an envelopment of the British Eighth Army (Lieutenant-General Bernard Montgomery). In Unternehmen Brandung (Operation Surf), the last big Axis offensive of the Western Desert Campaign, Rommel intended to defeat the Eighth Army before Allied reinforcements arrived.

Bitka pri Alkazarkibirju (v Maroku znana tudi kot »bitka treh kraljev« (arabsko: معركة الملوك الثلاثة) ali »bitka pri Vadi al Mahazinu« (arabsko: معركة وادي المخازن)) je potekala 4. avgusta 1578 na severu Maroka, blizu mesta Ksar-el-Kebir (tudi Ksar El Kebir, Alcácer-Quivir, Alcazarquivir, Alcassar in drugače) in Larače.

Bitka, ki se je končala z maroško zmago, velja za »največjo vojaško katastrofo, ki so jo Portugalci kdaj doživeli med svojo čezmorsko širitvijo«. Z njo so se končali portugalski poskusi, da bi znova osvojili ozemlja, ki so jih izgubili v Maroku.

V bitki sta se spopadli vojska odstavljenega maroškega sultana Abu Abdulaha Mohameda II. in njegovega zaveznika, portugalskega kralja Sebastijana I., ter velika maroška vojska pod novim maroškim sultanom (in stricem Abu Abdulaha Mohameda II.) Abd al Malikom I.

source.title: Battle of Alcácer Quibir
paragraphs: The Battle of Alcácer Quibir (also known as "Battle of Three Kings" (Arabic: معركة الملوك الثلاثة) or "Battle of Wadi al-Makhazin" (Arabic: معركة وادي المخازن) in Morocco) was fought in northern Morocco, near the town of Ksar-el-Kebir (variant spellings: Ksar El Kebir, Alcácer-Quivir, Alcazarquivir, Alcassar, etc.) and Larache, on 4 August 1578.

A Moroccan victory, the battle has been described as "the greatest military disaster the Portuguese ever suffered in the course of their overseas expansion." It marked an end to Portuguese attempts to reconquer territories it had lost in Morocco.

The combatants were the army of the deposed Moroccan Sultan Abu Abdallah Mohammed II, with his ally, the King of Portugal Sebastian I, against a large Moroccan army under the new Sultan of Morocco (and uncle of Abu Abdallah Mohammed II) Abd Al-Malik I.

Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016).headline: Bitka za Alep (2012–2016)
paragraphs: Bitka za Alep (arabsko: Maʿrakat Ḥalab) je bil velik vojaški spopad v Alepu, po mestni površini največjem sirskem mestu, med sirskimi opozicijskimi milicami (kot so Svobodna sirska vojska, Levantska fronta in Fronta al Nusra) na eni strani ter baatistično sirsko vlado in vojsko, ki so jo podpirali Rusija, Iran, Hezbolah in druge šiitske borbene skupine pod okriljem iranske revolucionarne garde ter druge provladne sirske in palestinske milice, na drugi, pa tudi proti kurdskim Enotam za zaščito ljudstva (YPG). Bitka se je začela 19. julija 2012 in je bila del sirske državljanske vojne. Pat, ki je trajal štiri leta, se je končal julija 2016, ko so baatistične vladne čete ob podpori ruskih letalskih napadov zaprle zadnjo oskrbovalno pot upornikov v Alep. Uporniki so septembra in oktobra sprožili neuspešne protiofenzive, ki niso prebile vladnega obleganja vzhodne polovice mesta, ki so jo držali uporniki; novembra pa so vladne sile, zavezniške Rusiji in okrepljene z enotami YPG, začele odločilni pohod, s katerim so do decembra 2016 znova zavzele ves Alep. Zmaga sirske vlade je splošno veljala za prelomnico državljanske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016)
paragraphs: The Battle of Aleppo (Arabic: مَعْرَكَةُ حَلَبَ, romanized: Maʿrakat Ḥalab) was a major military confrontation in Aleppo, the largest city in Syria by urban area, between the Syrian opposition militias (such as the Free Syrian Army (FSA), the Levant Front and Al-Nusra Front) against the Ba'athist Syrian government and army, supported by Russia, Iran, Hezbollah and other Shia militant groups backed by the IRGC, and other pro-government Syrian and Palestinian militias, and against the Kurdish-majority People's Protection Units (YPG). The battle began on 19 July 2012 and was part of the Syrian civil war. A stalemate that had been in place for four years finally ended in July 2016, when Ba'athist government troops closed the rebels' last supply line into Aleppo with the support of Russian airstrikes. In response, rebel forces launched unsuccessful counteroffensives in September and October that failed to break the government's siege of the rebel-held eastern half of the city; in November, government forces, allied with Russia and bolstered by YPG forces, embarked on a decisive campaign that resulted in the recapture of all of Aleppo by December 2016. The Syrian government victory was widely seen as a turning point in the civil war.

Battle of Aleppo (2024).headline: Bitka za Alep (2024)
paragraphs: Bitka za Alep (2024), znana tudi kot druga bitka za Alep ali padec Alepa, se je začela, ko je sirska opozicijska skupina Hajat Tahrir al Šam skupaj z zavezniškimi skupinami pod turškim okriljem v poveljstvu vojaških operacij vstopila v Alep, ki ga je držala sirska vlada. Bitka se je začela tretji dan obsežne uporniške ofenzive. V mestu se je takrat boj vnel prvič po prejšnji bitki, ki se je začela leta 2012 in končala leta 2016, ko je Asadova oblast upornike pregnala iz mesta.

Opozicijske skupine so 30. novembra 2024 ob razpadu provladnih sil zavzele večji del mesta. Hkrati z bliskovitim zavzetjem Alepa so uporniki prodrli na podeželje severne Hame, celotno mesto Hama pa je uporniškim silam padlo 5. decembra.

source.title: Battle of Aleppo (2024)
paragraphs: The Battle of Aleppo (2024), also known as the Second Battle of Aleppo or the Fall of Aleppo began when the Syrian opposition group Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham, along with allied Turkish-backed groups in the Military Operations Command, entered the Syrian government-held city of Aleppo. The battle began on the third day of a large-scale rebel offensive. It was the first time fighting had broken out in the city since the earlier battle, which began in 2012 and ended in 2016 when the Assad administration pushed rebels out of the city.

On 30 November 2024, opposition groups captured most of the city amidst the collapse of pro-government forces. Coinciding with the lightning-speed takeover of Aleppo, the rebels pushed into the countryside of northern Hama; the whole city of Hama eventually fell to the rebels on 5 December.

Battle of Alexandretta.headline: Bitka pri Aleksandreti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Aleksandreti je bil prvi spopad med silami Bizantinskega cesarstva in Fatimidskega kalifata v Siriji. Potekala je v začetku leta 971 blizu Aleksandrete, medtem ko je glavnina fatimidske vojske oblegala Antiohijo, ki so jo Bizantinci zavzeli dve leti prej. Bizantinci pod vodstvom enega od dvornih evnuhov cesarja Ivana I. Cimiska so fatimidski odred s 4000 možmi zvabili v napad na svoj prazni tabor, nato pa so ga napadli z vseh strani in uničili. Poraz pri Aleksandreti je skupaj z vdorom karmatov v južno Sirijo Fatimide prisilil, da so opustili obleganje, Bizantincem pa je zagotovil nadzor nad Antiohijo in severno Sirijo.

source.title: Battle of Alexandretta
paragraphs: The Battle of Alexandretta was the first clash between the forces of the Byzantine Empire and the Fatimid Caliphate in Syria. It was fought in early 971 near Alexandretta, while the main Fatimid army was besieging Antioch, which the Byzantines had captured two years previously. The Byzantines, led by one of Emperor John I Tzimiskes' household eunuchs, lured a 4,000-strong Fatimid detachment to attack their empty encampment and then attacked them from all sides, destroying the Fatimid force. The defeat at Alexandretta, coupled with the invasion of southern Syria by the Qarmatians, forced the Fatimids to lift the siege and secured Byzantine control of Antioch and northern Syria.

Battle of Alexandria (1801).headline: Bitka pri Aleksandriji (1801)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Aleksandriji (znana tudi kot bitka pri Kanopu) je potekala 21. marca 1801, ko so britanska vojska in mornarica med francosko invazijo na Egipt in Sirijo odbile napad francoske vojske. Britanska vojska, ki se je pod vodstvom generala sira Ralpha Abercrombyja utrdila v okopih, se je spopadla s francoskimi silami divizijskega generala Jacques-Françoisa Menouja blizu ruševin Nikopolisa, na ozkem pasu kopnega med Sredozemskim morjem in Abukirjem. Britanci so Menoujevo vojsko po več urah silovitih bojev pognali v beg, Abercromby pa je bil smrtno ranjen. Del francoskih izgub pri Aleksandriji je povzročila britanska mornarica pod poveljstvom Fredericka Maitlanda, ki je imela pomembno vlogo tudi pri odbijanju francoskih napadov. John Hely-Hutchinson, ki je nasledil Abercrombyja, je britansko vojsko povedel do Aleksandrije in oblegal mesto, ki se je septembra vdalo.

source.title: Battle of Alexandria (1801)
paragraphs: The Battle of Alexandria (also known as the Battle of Canope/Canopus) was fought on 21 March 1801, where the British army and naval forces repelled an assault by the French army as part of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. Led by General Sir Ralph Abercromby, the British entrenched army engaged a French force under Divisional-general Jacques-François Menou near the ruins of Nicopolis, on the narrow spit of land between the Mediterranean Sea and Abukir. The British routed Menou's army after several hours of fierce fighting, though Abercromby was mortally wounded. Part of the French casualties at Alexandria was caused by British naval force under Frederick Maitland, whose role was also important in suppressing the French attacks. John Hely-Hutchinson, who replaced Abercromby, led the British army to Alexandria and laid siege to the city, which surrendered in September.

Bitka za Alžir leta 1541 se je zgodila, ko je Karel V., cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva in španski kralj, skušal voditi napad z morja na Alžirsko regentstvo. Ker je bila odprava slabo načrtovana, zlasti glede neugodnega vremena, ni uspela.

source.title: Battle of Algiers (1541)
paragraphs: The 1541 battle of Algiers occurred when Charles V of the Holy Roman Empire and king of Spain attempted to lead an amphibious attack against the Regency of Algiers. Inadequate planning, particularly against unfavourable weather, led to the failure of the expedition.

Battle of Algiers (1956–1957).headline: Bitka za Alžir (1956–1957)
paragraphs: Bitka za Alžir, imenovana tudi veliko zatiranje v Alžiru, je bila kampanja med alžirsko vojno. Sestavljali so jo mestno gverilsko bojevanje in teroristični napadi, ki jih je Fronta narodne osvoboditve (FLN) izvajala proti francoskim oblastem v Alžiru, francoske oblasti, vojska in francoske teroristične organizacije pa proti FLN.

Obe strani sta med bitko napadali civiliste. Spopad se je začel z napadi FLN na francoske sile in pieds-noirs (evropske naseljence), nato pa je skupina naseljencev iz teroristične skupine »La Main Rouge« ob pomoči policije izvedla teroristični napad na alžirske civiliste v Alžiru. Sledila so maščevanja in nasilje se je stopnjevalo, zato je francoski generalni guverner v Alžir poslal francosko vojsko, da bi zatrla FLN. Civilne oblasti so podelile vsa pooblastila generalu Jacquesu Massuju, ki je med januarjem in septembrom 1957 zunaj zakonskih okvirov izkoreninil FLN iz Alžira. Francosko mučenje, prisilna izginotja in nezakonite usmrtitve so pozneje v Franciji sprožili spor.

source.title: Battle of Algiers (1956–1957)
paragraphs: The Battle of Algiers, also called the great repression of Algiers, was a campaign fought during the Algerian War. It consisted of urban guerrilla warfare and terrorist attacks carried out by the National Liberation Front (FLN) against the French authorities in Algiers, and by the French authorities, army, and French terrorist organizations against the FLN.

Both sides targeted civilians throughout the battle. The conflict began with attacks by the FLN against the French forces and Pieds-Noirs (European settlers) followed by a terrorist attack on Algerian civilians in Algiers by a group of settlers, part of the terrorist group "La Main Rouge", aided by the police. Reprisals followed and the violence escalated, leading the French Governor-General to deploy the French Army in Algiers to suppress the FLN. Civilian authorities gave full powers to General Jacques Massu who, operating outside legal frameworks between January and September 1957, eliminated the FLN from Algiers. The use of torture, forced disappearances and illegal executions by the French later caused controversy in France.

Battle of Andrassos.headline: Bitka pri Andrasu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Andrasu ali Adrasu je potekala 8. novembra 960 med Bizantinci pod vodstvom Leona Fokasa mlajšega in silami hamdanidskega Alepskega emirata pod emirjem Sajfom ad Davlo. Potekala je v neznanem gorskem prelazu v gorovju Taurus.

Sajf ad Davla je leta 945 ustanovil emirat s središčem v Alepu in kmalu postal glavni muslimanski nasprotnik Bizantinskega cesarstva na njegovi vzhodni meji. Obe strani sta z menjajočim se uspehom izvajali vpade in protivpade: Hamdanidi so vdirali v bizantinske province v Mali Aziji, Bizantinci pa so plenili po hamdanidskih posestih v gornji Mezopotamiji in severni Siriji.

Sredi leta 960 je hamdanidski knez izkoristil, da je bil velik del bizantinske vojske na pohodu proti Kretskemu emiratu, in znova vdrl v Malo Azijo. Daleč in na široko je plenil po pokrajini Kapadokiji. Ob vrnitvi pa je njegovo vojsko na prelazu Andrasos iz zasede napadel Leon Fokas. Sajf ad Davla je komaj ušel, njegova vojska pa je bila uničena.

source.title: Battle of Andrassos
paragraphs: The Battle of Andrassos or Adrassos was fought on 8 November 960 between the Byzantines, led by Leo Phokas the Younger, and the forces of the Hamdanid Emirate of Aleppo under the emir Sayf al-Dawla. It was fought in an unidentified mountain pass in the Taurus Mountains.

Sayf al-Dawla had established an emirate based in Aleppo in 945 and quickly emerged as the leading Muslim antagonist of the Byzantine Empire on its eastern frontier. Both sides launched raids and counter-raids with alternating success: the Hamdanids invading the Byzantine provinces of Asia Minor, and the Byzantines raiding Hamdanid possessions in Upper Mesopotamia and northern Syria.

In mid-960, taking advantage of the absence of much of the Byzantine army on a campaign against the Emirate of Crete, the Hamdanid prince launched another invasion of Asia Minor. He raided deeply and widely into the region of Cappadocia. On his return, however, his army was ambushed by Leo Phokas at the pass of Andrassos. Sayf al-Dawla himself barely escaped, but his army was annihilated.

Bitka pri Anualu je potekala 22. julija 1921 pri Anualu na severovzhodu Maroka med špansko vojsko in rifskimi Berberi med rifsko vojno. Španci so doživeli hud vojaški poraz, ki ga skoraj vedno imenujejo katastrofa pri Anualu (špansko: Desastre de Annual) in velja za najhujši poraz sodobne španske vojske. Sledile so velike politične krize, padec več vlad, vojaška diktatura Miguela Prima de Rivere, odstop kralja Alfonza XIII. in korenita presoja španske kolonialne politike do Rifa, saj je bilo nekaj časa ogroženo celotno špansko kolonialno podjetje.

source.title: Battle of Annual
paragraphs: The Battle of Annual was fought on 22 July 1921 at Annual, in northeastern Morocco, between the Spanish Army and Riffian Berbers during the Rif War. The Spanish suffered a major military defeat, which is almost always referred to by the Spanish as the Disaster of Annual (Spanish: Desastre de Annual) which is widely considered to be the worst defeat ever suffered by the modern Spanish Army. It resulted in major political crises, the fall of several governments, a military dictatorship led by Miguel Primo de Rivera, the abdication of King Alfonso XIII and a complete reassessment of the Spanish colonial policy toward the Rif as the entire Spanish colonial enterprise was at one point threatened.

Battle of Antioch (218).headline: Bitka pri Antiohiji (218)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Antiohiji (8. junija 218) je potekala med rimsko vojsko cesarja Makrina in njegovim tekmecem Elagabalom, katerega enotam je poveljeval general Ganis, verjetno nedaleč od Antiohije. Ganisova zmaga je pripeljala do Makrinovega padca in do tega, da ga je na cesarskem prestolu nadomestil Elagabal.

Makrin je prišel na prestol s podporo rimske vojske, potem ko je nezadovoljen vojak 8. aprila 217 med pohodom proti Partiji umoril njegovega predhodnika Karakalo. Makrin je morda sodeloval pri pripravi umora. Podedoval je vse težave, ki jih je Rimu zapustila Karakalova vladavina: vojno s Partijo, grožnje iz Armenije in Dakije ter visoke državne izdatke. Makrin je s Partijo uspešno sklenil mir, a za Rim z velikimi stroški, in uvedel ukrepe za zmanjšanje izdatkov, ki so v vojski podžgali nezadovoljstvo.

source.title: Battle of Antioch (218)
paragraphs: The Battle of Antioch (8 June 218) was fought between the Roman army of the Emperor Macrinus and his rival Elagabalus, whose troops were commanded by General Gannys, probably a short distance from Antioch. Gannys's victory led to Macrinus's downfall as emperor and his replacement by Elagabalus.

Macrinus was elevated to the throne with the support of the Roman army following the assassination of his predecessor, Caracalla, by a disaffected soldier whilst on campaign against Parthia on 8 April 217. Macrinus may have played a role in orchestrating the assassination. He inherited all of the problems that Caracalla's reign had left for Rome: war against Parthia, threats from Armenia and Dacia, and extensive fiscal expenditures. Macrinus successfully concluded a peace with Parthia, but at considerable cost to Rome and implemented policies to reduce monetary expenditures which stoked discontent within the military.

Battle of Antioch on the Meander.headline: Bitka pri Antiohiji ob Majandru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Antiohiji ob Majandru (znana tudi kot bitka pri Alaşehirju) je bil vojaški spopad blizu Antiohije ob Majandru med silami Nikejskega cesarstva in Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov. Turški poraz je Nikejcem zagotovil nadaljnjo prevlado na egejski obali Male Azije. Seldžuški sultan Kajhosrav I. je padel na bojišču. Bitka je potekala blizu današnjega kraja Yamalak v okrožju Kuyucak v provinci Aydın.

source.title: Battle of Antioch on the Meander
paragraphs: The Battle of Antioch on the Meander (also known as the Battle of Alaşehir) was a military engagement near Antioch-on-the-Meander between the forces of the Empire of Nicaea and the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm. The Turkish defeat ensured continued Nicaean hegemony of the Aegean coast of Asia Minor. The Seljuk sultan, Kaykhusraw I, was killed on the field of battle. The battle took place near the modern town of Yamalak in Kuyucak district in Aydın Province.

Battle of Anzen.headline: Bitka pri Anzenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Anzenu ali Dazimonu je potekala 22. julija 838 pri Anzenu ali Dazimonu (danes Dazmana (Akçatarla) v Turčiji) med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in silami Abasidskega kalifata. Abasidi so v povračilo za uspehe bizantinskega cesarja Teofila v prejšnjem letu sprožili obsežen pohod z dvema ločenima vojskama, njihov cilj pa je bil izropati Amorij, eno največjih bizantinskih mest. Teofil se je s svojo vojsko pri Dazimonu spopadel z manjšo muslimansko vojsko pod iranskim vazalnim knezom Afšinom.

Številčno močnejša bizantinska vojska je bila sprva uspešna, ko pa se je Teofil odločil, da bo napad vodil osebno, je njegova odsotnost z običajnega mesta med bizantinskimi enotami sprožila preplah, saj so se bale, da je padel. Ko je hkrati udaril še protinapad Afšinovih turških konjeniških lokostrelcev, se je bizantinska vojska razbežala. Teofila in njegovo stražo so obkolili na griču, a jim je uspelo pobegniti. Poraz je nekaj tednov pozneje odprl pot plenjenju Amorija, enemu najhujših udarcev, ki jih je Bizanc utrpel v stoletja dolgih arabsko-bizantinskih vojnah.

source.title: Battle of Anzen
paragraphs: The Battle of Anzen or Dazimon was fought on 22 July 838 at Anzen or Dazimon (now Dazmana (Akçatarla), Turkey) between the Byzantine Empire and the forces of the Abbasid Caliphate. The Abbasids had launched a massive expedition with two separate armies in retaliation for the Byzantine emperor Theophilos's successes the previous year, and aimed to sack Amorion, one of Byzantium's largest cities. Theophilos with his army confronted the smaller Muslim army, under the Iranian vassal prince Afshin, at Dazimon.

The numerically superior Byzantine army was initially successful, but when Theophilos resolved to lead an attack in person, his absence from his usual post caused panic among the Byzantine troops, who feared that he had been killed. Coupled with a counterattack by Afshin's Turkish horse-archers, the Byzantine army broke and fled. Theophilos and his guard were surrounded on a hill, but managed to escape. The defeat opened the way for the sack of Amorion a few weeks later, one of the most serious blows Byzantium suffered in the centuries-long Arab–Byzantine wars.

Bitka pri Akabi je med arabskim uporom v prvi svetovni vojni potekala za pristanišče Akaba ob Rdečem morju (danes v Jordaniji). Napadalne sile pod vodstvom šerifa Nasirja in Aude abu Tajija, ki jim je svetoval T. E. Lawrence (»Lawrence Arabski«), so premagale branilce Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Battle of Aqaba
paragraphs: The Battle of Aqaba was fought for the Red Sea port of Aqaba (now in Jordan) during the Arab Revolt of World War I. The attacking forces, led by Sherif Nasir and Auda abu Tayi and advised by T. E. Lawrence ("Lawrence of Arabia"), were victorious over the Ottoman Empire defenders.

Battle of Arcadiopolis (970).headline: Bitka pri Arkadiopolisu (970)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arkadiopolisu je potekala leta 970 med bizantinsko vojsko pod Bardasom Sklerom in vojsko Rusov, v kateri so bili tudi zavezniški bolgarski, pečeneški in madžarski oddelki. Ruski vladar Svjatoslav je v prejšnjih letih osvojil severno Bolgarijo in zdaj ogrožal tudi Bizanc. Ruske sile so prek Trakije prodirale proti Carigradu, ko so naletele na Sklerove sile. Skler je imel manj mož kot Rusi, zato je pripravil zasedo in rusko vojsko napadel z delom svojih sil. Bizantinci so se nato navidezno umaknili in v zasedo uspeli zvabiti pečeneški oddelek ter ga pognali v beg. Preostanek ruske vojske je nato utrpel hude izgube pred zasledujočimi Bizantinci. Bitka je bila pomembna, saj je bizantinskemu cesarju Ivanu I. Cimisku dala čas, da je uredil notranje težave in zbral veliko odpravo, ki je naslednje leto nazadnje premagala Svjatoslava.

source.title: Battle of Arcadiopolis (970)
paragraphs: The Battle of Arcadiopolis was fought in 970 between a Byzantine army under Bardas Skleros and a Rus' army, the latter also including allied Bulgarian, Pecheneg, and Hungarian (Magyar) contingents. In the preceding years, the Rus' ruler Sviatoslav had conquered northern Bulgaria, and was now menacing Byzantium as well. The Rus' force had been advancing through Thrace towards Constantinople when it was met by Skleros' force. Having fewer men than the Rus', Skleros prepared an ambush and attacked the Rus' army with a portion of his force. The Byzantines then feigned retreat, and succeeded in drawing off the Pecheneg contingent into the ambush, routing it. The remainder of the Rus' army then suffered heavy casualties from the pursuing Byzantines. The battle was important as it bought time for the Byzantine emperor John I Tzimiskes to settle his internal problems and assemble a large expedition, which eventually defeated Sviatoslav the next year.

Battle of Arginusae.headline: Bitka pri Arginuzah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arginuzah je potekala leta 406 pr. n. št. med peloponeško vojno blizu mesta Kane na Arginuzah, otočju vzhodno od otoka Lezbos. Atensko ladjevje, ki mu je poveljevalo osem strategov, je v bitki premagalo špartansko ladjevje pod Kalikratidovim poveljstvom. Bitko je sprožila špartanska zmaga, po kateri je bilo atensko ladjevje pod Kononovim poveljstvom blokirano v Mitileni. Da bi Konona osvobodili, so Atenci na hitro zbrali ladjevje, večinoma iz novih ladij z neizkušenimi posadkami. Neizkušeno ladjevje je bilo zato Špartancem taktično podrejeno, a so se njegovi poveljniki težavi izognili z novo in nenavadno taktiko, ki je Atencem prinesla osupljivo in nepričakovano zmago. Sužnji in metojki, ki so sodelovali v bitki, so morda dobili atensko državljanstvo.

source.title: Battle of Arginusae
paragraphs: The Battle of Arginusae took place in 406 BC during the Peloponnesian War near the city of Canae in the Arginusae Islands, east of the island of Lesbos. In the battle, an Athenian fleet commanded by eight strategoi defeated a Spartan fleet under Callicratidas. The battle was precipitated by a Spartan victory, which led to the Athenian fleet under Conon being blockaded at Mytilene. To relieve Conon, the Athenians assembled a scratch force composed largely of newly-constructed ships manned by inexperienced crews. The inexperienced fleet was thus tactically inferior to the Spartans, but its commanders circumvented the problem by employing new and unorthodox tactics, which allowed the Athenians to secure a dramatic and unexpected victory. Slaves and metics who participated in the battle may have been granted Athenian citizenship.

Bitka pri Arsufu je potekala 7. septembra 1191 v okviru tretje križarske vojne. Večnarodna križarska vojska pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Riharda I. je premagala precej večjo vojsko ajubidskega sultanata pod vodstvom Saladina.

source.title: Battle of Arsuf
paragraphs: The Battle of Arsuf took place on 7 September 1191, as part of the Third Crusade. It saw a multi-national force of Crusaders, led by Richard I of England, defeat a significantly larger army of the Ayyubid Sultanate, led by Saladin.

Battle of Artaxata.headline: Bitka pri Artaksati
paragraphs: Bitka pri Artaksati je potekala leta 68 pr. n. št. blizu reke Arsanias med vojsko Rimske republike in vojsko Kraljevine Armenije. Rimljane je vodil prokonzul Lucij Licinij Lukul, Armence pa armenski kralj Tigran II., ki je dajal zatočišče svojemu tastu, pontskemu kralju Mitridatu VI., ki je pobegnil iz Ponta. Bitka je bila del tretje mitridatske vojne in se je končala z rimsko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Artaxata
paragraphs: The Battle of Artaxata was fought near the Arsanias River in 68 BC between an army of the Roman Republic and the army of the Kingdom of Armenia. The Romans were led by proconsul Lucius Licinius Lucullus, while the Armenians were led by Tigranes II of Armenia, who was sheltering Mithridates VI of Pontus, his father-in-law and refugee King of Pontus. The battle was part of the Third Mithridatic War and ended in a Roman victory.

Battle of Avarayr.headline: Bitka pri Avarajru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Avarajru (armensko: Ավարայրի ճակատամարտ) je potekala 26. maja 451 na ravnini Avarajr v Vaspurakanu med krščansko armensko vojsko pod vodstvom Vardana Mamikonjana in sasanidsko Perzijo. Velja za eno prvih bitk v obrambo krščanske vere. Perzijci so na bojišču sicer zmagali, a je bila to pirova zmaga: Armenci so smeli še naprej svobodno izpovedovati krščanstvo.
Bitka velja za enega najpomembnejših dogodkov armenske zgodovine. Poveljnik armenskih sil Vardan Mamikonjan je narodni junak, Armenska apostolska cerkev pa ga je razglasila za svetnika.

source.title: Battle of Avarayr
paragraphs: The Battle of Avarayr (Armenian: Ավարայրի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Avarayri chakatamart) was fought on 26 May 451 on the Avarayr Plain in Vaspurakan between a Christian Armenian army under Vardan Mamikonian and Sassanid Persia. It is considered one of the first battles in defense of the Christian faith. Although the Persians were victorious on the battlefield, it was a pyrrhic victory. The Armenians were allowed to continue practising Christianity freely.

The battle is seen as one of the most significant events in Armenian history. The commander of the Armenian forces, Vardan Mamikonian, is considered a national hero and has been canonized by the Armenian Apostolic Church.

Battle of Ayn al-Tamr.headline: Bitka pri Ajn al Tamru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ajn al Tamru (arabsko: معركة عين التمر) je potekala na območju današnjega Iraka (Mezopotamije) med zgodnjimi muslimanskimi arabskimi silami ter Sasanidi in njihovimi krščanskimi arabskimi pomožnimi enotami. Ajn al Tamr leži zahodno od Anbarja in je bil obmejna postojanka, ustanovljena v pomoč Sasanidom.

Muslimani pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida so prepričljivo premagali sasanidske pomožne sile, med katerimi je bilo veliko nemuslimanskih Arabcev, ki so prelomili prejšnje zaveze z muslimani. Po Williamu Muirju je Halid ibn al Valid lastnoročno zajel krščanskega arabskega poveljnika Aka ibn Kajsa ibn Bašira, kar se ujema s pripovedma Ibn al Asira v delu Usd al ghabah fi marifat al Sahabah in Tabarija v njegovi Zgodovini (Tarikh).

source.title: Battle of Ayn al-Tamr
paragraphs: The Battle of Ayn al-Tamr (Arabic: معركة عين التمر) took place in modern-day Iraq (Mesopotamia) between the early Muslim Arab forces and the Sassanians along with their Arab Christian auxiliary forces. Ayn al-Tamr is located west of Anbar and was a frontier post which had been established to aid the Sassanids.

The Muslims under Khalid ibn al-Walid's command soundly defeated the Sassanian auxiliary force, which included large numbers of non-Muslim Arabs who broke earlier covenants with the Muslims. According to William Muir, Khalid ibn al-Walid captured the Arab Christian commander, Aqqa ibn Qays ibn Bashir, with his own hands, which matched the accounts of both Ibn Atheer in his Usd al-ghabah fi marifat al-Saḥabah, and Tabari in his Tarikh.

Battle of Ayn al-Warda.headline: Bitka pri Ajn al Vardi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ajn al Vardi (arabsko: مَعْرَكَة‌ عَيْن ٱلْوَرْدَة) je potekala v začetku januarja 685 med omajadsko vojsko in spokorniki (tavabin). Spokorniki so bili skupina Kufancev, privržencev Alidov, pod vodstvom Sulajmana ibn Surada, Mohamedovega tovariša, ki so se hoteli oddolžiti, ker leta 680 niso pomagali Huseinu ibn Aliju v njegovem spodletelem uporu proti Omajadom. Kufanci, privrženci Alidov, so Huseina nagovarjali k uporu proti omajadskemu kalifu Jazidu, a mu niso pomagali, ko je leta 680 padel v bitki pri Karbali. Sprva majhno podtalno gibanje je po Jazidovi smrti leta 683 dobilo široko podporo v Iraku. Večina privržencev ga je zapustila malo pred odhodom v severno Sirijo, kjer se je za ofenzivo proti Iraku zbirala velika omajadska vojska pod poveljstvom Ubajda Alaha ibn Zijada. V tridnevni bitki, ki je sledila pri Ras al Ajnu, so majhno vojsko spokornikov uničili, njene glavne voditelje, med njimi Ibn Surada, pa ubili. Bitka je bila kljub temu predhodnica in navdih poznejšega, uspešnejšega gibanja Muhtarja al Sakafija.

source.title: Battle of Ayn al-Warda
paragraphs: The Battle of Ayn al-Warda (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة‌ عَيْن ٱلْوَرْدَة) was fought in early January 685 between the Umayyad army and the Penitents (Tawwabin). The Penitents were a group of pro-Alid Kufans led by Sulayman ibn Surad, a companion of Muhammad, who wished to atone for their failure to assist Husayn ibn Ali in his abortive uprising against the Umayyads in 680. Pro-Alid Kufans had urged Husayn to revolt against the Umayyad caliph Yazid but then failed to assist him when he was killed in the Battle of Karbala in 680. Initially a small underground movement, the Penitents received widespread support in Iraq after the death of Yazid in 683. They were deserted by most of their supporters shortly before the departure to northern Syria where a large Umayyad army under the command of Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad had mustered in preparation for an offensive against Iraq. In the three-day long battle that ensued at Ras al-Ayn, the small Penitent army was annihilated and its senior leaders, including Ibn Surad, were killed. Nevertheless, this battle proved to be a forerunner and source of motivation for the later more successful movement of Mukhtar al-Thaqafi.

Battle of Azaz (1030).headline: Bitka pri Azazu (1030)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Azazu je potekala avgusta 1030 blizu sirskega mesta Azaz med bizantinsko vojsko, ki jo je osebno vodil cesar Roman III. Argir (vladal 1028–1034), in silami mirdasidskega emirata Alep, ki jim je prav tako osebno poveljeval emir Šibl al Daula Nasr (vladal 1029–1038). Mirdasidi so premagali precej večjo bizantinsko vojsko in zaplenili velik plen, čeprav zmage nazadnje niso znali izkoristiti.

source.title: Battle of Azaz (1030)
paragraphs: The Battle of Azaz was an engagement fought in August 1030 near the Syrian town of Azaz between the Byzantine army, led by Emperor Romanos III Argyros (r. 1028–1034) in person, and the forces of the Mirdasid Emirate of Aleppo, likewise under the personal command of Emir Shibl al-Dawla Nasr (r. 1029–1038). The Mirdasids defeated the much larger Byzantine army and took great booty, even though they were eventually unable to capitalise on their victory.

Battle of Azaz (1125).headline: Bitka pri Azazu (1125)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Azazu je potekala 11. junija 1125 med križarskimi silami jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina II. in zavezniškimi muslimanskimi silami pod vodstvom Ak Sunkurja al Bursukija, seldžuškega atabega Mosula. Bila je eden najbolj krvavih spopadov pred drugo križarsko vojno in se je končala z odločilno zmago križarjev, kar je zamajalo razmerje moči v Levantu in oslabilo seldžuško prevlado na tem območju. Sodobni kronist Matej iz Edese celo pravi, da so ostanke Bursukijeve vojske preganjali vse do Alepa. Bitka je dejansko končala obleganje Azaza in preprečila, da bi mesto padlo v turkmenske roke. (Po enem viru je bitka potekala 13. junija.)

source.title: Battle of Azaz (1125)
paragraphs: The Battle of Azaz was fought on 11 June 1125 between King Baldwin II of Jerusalem's crusader forces and allied Muslim forces led by Aq-Sunqur al-Bursuqi, the Seljuq atabeg of Mosul. One of the bloodiest confrontations before the Second Crusade, the battle resulted in a decisive victory for the Crusaders, causing disturbances of power in the Levant and weakening Seljuk domination in the area. Contemporary chronicler Matthew of Edessa even states that the remnants of al-Bursuqi's army were chased all the way to Aleppo. The battle effectively lifted the siege of Azaz and prevented it from falling to Turkoman hands. (One authority says the battle was fought on June 13.)

Battle of Ba'rin.headline: Bitka pri Barinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Barinu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Montferrandu) leta 1137 je potekala v Siriji, ko je Zengi, atabeg Mosula in Alepa, razpršil in porazil križarske sile pod poveljstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Fulka. Zaradi tega poraza so križarji za vedno izgubili grad Montferrand v Barinu.

source.title: Battle of Ba'rin
paragraphs: The Battle of Ba'rin (also known as Battle of Montferrand) in 1137 took place in Syria when a Crusader force commanded by King Fulk of Jerusalem was scattered and defeated by Zengi, the atabeg of Mosul and Aleppo. This setback resulted in the permanent loss of the Crusader castle of Montferrand in Baarin.

Bitka pri Badru, včasih imenovana tudi napad na Badr (arabsko: Ghazwatu Badr), v Koranu in pri muslimanih pa tudi dan razločevanja (Yawm al-Furqan), je potekala 13. marca 624 n. št. (17. ramadana leta 2 po hidžri) blizu mesta Badr v provinci Medina v današnji Savdski Arabiji. Mohamed je z vojsko svojih tovarišev (sahaba) premagal vojsko Kurajšitov pod vodstvom Amra ibn Hišama, med muslimani bolj znanega kot Abu Džahl. Bitka je pomenila začetek šestletne vojne med Mohamedom in njegovim plemenom.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Battle of Badr
paragraphs: The Battle of Badr or sometimes called The Raid of Badr (Arabic: غَزْوَةُ بَدْرٍ [ɣazwatu badr]; Ghazwatu Badr), also referred to as The Day of the Criterion (Arabic: يَوْمُ الْفُرْقَانْ, Arabic pronunciation: [jawm'ul fur'qaːn]; Yawm al-Furqan) in the Qur'an and by Muslims, was fought on 13 March 624 CE (17 Ramadan, 2 AH), near the city of Badr, Medina Province in present-day Saudi Arabia. Muhammad, commanding an army of his Sahaba, defeated an army of the Quraysh led by Amr ibn Hisham, better known among Muslims as Abu Jahl. The battle marked the beginning of the six-year war between Muhammad and his tribe.
Bitka za Bagdad (arabsko: Maʿrakatu baghdād), znana tudi kot padec Bagdada (suqūṭu baghdād), je bil vojaški spopad, ki je v začetku aprila 2003 potekal v Bagdadu v okviru invazije na Irak.

Tri tedne po začetku invazije so enote kopenskega poveljstva koalicijskih sil pod vodstvom 3. pehotne divizije ameriške vojske zavzele Bagdad. V bitki je padlo več kot 2000 iraških vojakov in 34 koalicijskih vojakov.

Po padcu Bagdada so koalicijske sile 10. aprila vstopile v Kirkuk, 15. aprila 2003 pa v Tikrit. Združene države so 15. aprila uradno razglasile zmago nad iraškim režimom Sadama Huseina, predsednik George W. Bush pa je 1. maja imel govor »Naloga opravljena«.

source.title: Battle of Baghdad (2003)
paragraphs: The Battle of Baghdad (Arabic: مَعْرَكَةُ بَغْدَاد, romanized: Maʿrakatu baghdād), also known as the Fall of Baghdad (Arabic: سُقُوطُ بَغْدَاد, romanized: suqūṭu baghdād), was a military engagement that took place in Baghdad in early April 2003, as part of the invasion of Iraq.

Three weeks into the invasion of Iraq, Coalition Forces Land Component Command elements, led by the U.S. Army 3rd Infantry Division, captured Baghdad. Over 2,000 Iraqi soldiers as well as 34 coalition troops were killed in the battle.

After the fall of Baghdad, Coalition forces entered the city of Kirkuk on April 10 and Tikrit on April 15, 2003. The United States officially declared victory against the Iraqi regime of Saddam Hussein on April 15, and President George W. Bush gave his Mission Accomplished speech on May 1.

Battle of Baghuz Fawqani.headline: Bitka za Baguz Favkani
paragraphs: Bitka za Baguz Favkani je bila ofenziva Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF) ob podpori letalskih napadov, topništva in specialnih enot koalicije Združena operativna skupina – operacija Neomajna odločnost (CJTF-OIR), ki se je začela 9. februarja 2019 v okviru kampanje za Dejr ez Zor v sirski državljanski vojni. Bitka, sestavljena iz vrste kopenskih napadov, je potekala v sirskem mestu Al Baguz Favkani v srednji dolini Evfrata blizu iraško-sirske meje in okolici ter je bila zadnja ozemeljska obramba Islamske države (IS) v vzhodni Siriji.

source.title: Battle of Baghuz Fawqani
paragraphs: The Battle of Baghuz Fawqani was an offensive by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), assisted by Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve (CJTF-OIR) coalition airstrikes, artillery, and special forces personnel, that began on 9 February 2019 as part of the Deir ez-Zor campaign of the Syrian Civil War. The battle—which was composed of a series of ground assaults—took place in and around the Syrian town of Al-Baghuz Fawqani in the Middle Euphrates River Valley near the Iraq–Syria border, and was the territorial last stand of the Islamic State (IS) in eastern Syria.

Battle of Baltim.headline: Bitka pri Baltimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Baltimu (tudi bitka pri Damieti, bitka pri Baltimu in Damieti ali bitka pri Damieti in El Burelosu) je potekala v noči z 8. na 9. oktober 1973 med izraelsko in egiptovsko vojno mornarico med jomkipursko vojno. Bojevali so se pred delto Nila, med Baltimom in Damieto. Bitka se je začela, ko so štirje egiptovski raketni čolni razreda Osa, ki so pripluli iz Aleksandrije, napadli šest izraelskih raketnih čolnov razreda Sa'ar, ki so pluli proti Port Saidu. Trajala je okoli štirideset minut. Čolni Osa so izstrelili izstrelke Styx, zgrešili in se začeli umikati proti Aleksandriji, ko so jih Izraelci začeli zasledovati. Dva čolna Osa so v desetih minutah potopili z izstrelki Gabriel, tretjega pa petindvajset minut pozneje. Četrti se je vrnil v oporišče.

source.title: Battle of Baltim
paragraphs: The Battle of Baltim (also Battle of Damietta, Battle of Baltim–Damietta, Battle of Damietta–Baltim or Battle of Damietta – El Burelos) was fought between the Israeli Navy and the Egyptian Navy on 8–9 October, 1973, during the Yom Kippur War. It took place off the Nile Delta, between Baltim and Damietta. The battle began when six Israeli Sa'ar-class missile boats heading toward Port Said were engaged by four Egyptian Osa-class missile boats coming from Alexandria. It lasted about forty minutes. The Osas fired Styx missiles, missed, and began to withdraw back to Alexandria when the Israelis began to give chase. Two Osas were sunk by Gabriel missiles within a span of ten minutes, and a third was sunk twenty-five minutes later. The fourth made it back to base.

Battle of Bapheus.headline: Bitka pri Bafeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bafeju je potekala 27. julija 1299 med osmansko turško vojsko pod Osmanom I. in bizantinsko vojsko pod Jurijem Muzalonom. Končala se je z odločilno osmansko zmago, ki je utrdila osmansko državo in napovedala, da bodo osmanski Turki dokončno zavzeli bizantinsko Bitinijo.

source.title: Battle of Bapheus
paragraphs: The Battle of Bapheus occurred on 27 July 1299, between an Ottoman Turkish army under Osman I and a Byzantine army under Georgios Mouzalon. The battle ended in a crucial Ottoman victory, cementing the Ottoman state and heralding the final capture of Byzantine Bithynia by the Ottoman Turks.

Battle of Bardia.headline: Bitka pri Bardiji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bardiji je potekala med 3. in 5. januarjem 1941 v okviru operacije Compass, prve britanske vojaške operacije kampanje v Zahodni puščavi v drugi svetovni vojni. Bila je prva bitka vojne, v kateri je sodelovala enota avstralske vojske, prva, ki ji je poveljeval avstralski general, in prva, ki jo je načrtoval avstralski štab. Avstralska 6. divizija (generalmajor Iven Mackay) je ob letalski podpori in obstreljevanju z ladij ter pod okriljem topniškega ognja napadla močno branjeno italijansko trdnjavo Bardija v Libiji. Avstralska 16. pehotna brigada je ob zori napadla z zahoda, kjer je bila obramba znano šibka. Saperji so z bangalorskimi torpedi razstrelili vrzeli v bodeči žici ter s krampi in lopatami zasuli in porušili stranice protitankovskega jarka. Tako so pehota in 23 tankov Matilda II 7. kraljevega tankovskega polka prodrli v trdnjavo in zavzeli vse cilje, ujeli pa so tudi 8000 vojakov.

source.title: Battle of Bardia
paragraphs: The Battle of Bardia was fought between 3 and 5 January 1941, as part of Operation Compass, the first British military operation of the Western Desert campaign of the Second World War. It was the first battle of the war in which an Australian Army formation took part, the first to be commanded by an Australian general and the first to be planned by an Australian staff. The 6th Australian Division (Major General Iven Mackay) assaulted the strongly held Italian fortress of Bardia, Libya, assisted by air support and naval gunfire and under the cover of an artillery barrage. The 16th Australian Infantry Brigade attacked at dawn from the west, where the defences were known to be weak.
