The battle ultimately ended in a decisive victory for the Muslims, and it is one of the few battles mentioned by name in the Quran, where it appears in Surat at-Tawbah.

Battle of Iconium (1190).headline: Bitka pri Ikoniju (1190)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ikoniju (včasih imenovana bitka pri Konyi) je potekala 18. maja 1190 med tretjo križarsko vojno, na pohodu Friderika Barbarosse v Sveto deželo. Ikonij, prestolnica Rumskega sultanata pod Kilidž Arslanom II., je zato padel v roke cesarskih sil.

source.title: Battle of Iconium (1190)
paragraphs: The Battle of Iconium (sometimes referred as the Battle of Konya) took place on May 18, 1190, during the Third Crusade, in the expedition of Frederick Barbarossa to the Holy Land. As a result, Iconium, the capital city of the Sultanate of Rûm under Kilij Arslan II, fell to the Imperial forces.

Battle of Imbros.headline: Bitka pri Imbrosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Imbrosu je bil pomorski spopad med prvo svetovno vojno. Zgodila se je 20. januarja 1918, ko je osmanska eskadra pred otokom Imbros v Egejskem morju napadla flotiljo britanske kraljeve vojne mornarice. Ker na tem območju ni bilo težkih zavezniških vojnih ladij, sta se osmanska bojna križarka Yavuz Sultan Selim in lahka križarka Midilli lahko podali v Sredozemsko morje ter pri Imbrosu napadli monitorje in rušilce kraljeve mornarice, nato pa še pomorsko oporišče v Mudrosu.

Čeprav so osmanske sile dosegle cilj in uničile monitorje pri Imbrosu, se je bitka zanje slabo končala, saj sta ladji med umikom zapluli v minsko polje. Midilli se je potopila, Yavuz Sultan Selim pa je bila hudo poškodovana. Yavûz Sultân Selîm se je sicer uspela nasesti v Dardanelah, a je bila več dni izpostavljena zračnim napadom, dokler je niso odvlekli na varno. Ker je bila najsodobnejša križarka osmanske vojne mornarice potopljena, edina bojna križarka pa onesposobljena, je bitka do konca vojne dejansko okrnila napadalne zmogljivosti osmanske mornarice.

source.title: Battle of Imbros
paragraphs: The Battle of Imbros was a naval action that took place during the First World War. The battle occurred on 20 January 1918 when an Ottoman squadron engaged a flotilla of the British Royal Navy off the island of Imbros in the Aegean Sea. A lack of heavy Allied warships in the area allowed the Ottoman battlecruiser Yavuz Sultan Selim and light cruiser Midilli to sortie into the Mediterranean and attack the Royal Navy monitors and destroyers at Imbros before assaulting the naval base at Mudros.

Although the Ottoman forces managed to complete their objective of destroying the monitors located at Imbros, the battle turned sour for them as they sailed through a minefield while withdrawing. Midilli was sunk and Yavuz Sultan Selim heavily damaged. Although Yavûz Sultân Selîm managed to beach herself within the Dardanelles, she was subjected to days of air attacks until she was towed to safety. With the most modern cruiser of the Ottoman Navy sunk, and its only battlecruiser out of action, the battle effectively curtailed the Ottoman Navy's offensive capability until the end of the war.

Battle of Immae.headline: Bitka pri Imah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Imah je potekala leta 272 med rimsko vojsko cesarja Avrelijana in vojskami Palmirskega cesarstva, katerega voditeljica, cesarica Zenobija, si je prisvojila rimski nadzor nad vzhodnimi provincami.

source.title: Battle of Immae
paragraphs: The Battle of Immae was fought in 272 between the Roman army of Emperor Aurelian, and the armies of the Palmyrene Empire, whose leader, Empress Zenobia, had usurped Roman control over the eastern provinces.

Battle of Inab.headline: Bitka pri Inabu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Inabu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Ard al Hatimu ali Fons Muratus, je potekala 29. junija 1149, med drugo križarsko vojno. Zengidska vojska atabega Nur ad Dina Zengija je uničila združeno vojsko antiohijskega kneza Rajmonda in asasinov Alija ibn Vafe. Knez je padel, Antiohijsko kneževino pa so nato izropali in zmanjšali, saj se je njena vzhodna meja pomaknila proti zahodu.

source.title: Battle of Inab
paragraphs: The Battle of Inab, also called Battle of Ard al-Hâtim or Fons Muratus, was fought on 29 June 1149, during the Second Crusade. The Zengid army of the atabeg Nur al-Din Zengi destroyed the combined army of Prince Raymond of Antioch and the Assassins of Ali ibn-Wafa. The prince was killed, and the Principality of Antioch was subsequently pillaged and reduced in size as its eastern border was pushed west.
Bitka pri Ipsusu (starogrško: Ἱψός) je potekala leta 301 pr. n. št. blizu mesta Ipsus v Frigiji med nasledniki Aleksandra Velikega (imenovanimi diadohi).

Antigon I. Monoftalmos, grško-makedonski vladar velikih delov Azije, in njegov sin Demetrij sta se spopadla s koalicijo treh drugih Aleksandrovih naslednikov: Kasandra, vladarja Makedonije, Lizimaha, vladarja Trakije, in Selevka I. Nikatorja, vladarja Babilonije in Perzije.

source.title: Battle of Ipsus
paragraphs: The Battle of Ipsus (Ancient Greek: Ἱψός) was fought between the successors of Alexander the Great (referred to as the Diadochi) in 301 BC near the town of Ipsus in Phrygia.

Antigonus I Monophthalmus, the Greek Macedonian ruler of large parts of Asia, and his son Demetrius were pitted against the coalition of three other successors of Alexander: Cassander, ruler of Macedon; Lysimachus, ruler of Thrace; and Seleucus I Nicator, ruler of Babylonia and Persia.

Battle of Isly.headline: Bitka pri Isliju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Isliju (arabsko: معركة إيسلي) je potekala 14. avgusta 1844 med Francijo in Marokom blizu reke Isly. Francoske sile pod poveljstvom maršala Thomasa Roberta Bugeauda so pognale v beg veliko večjo, a slabo organizirano maroško vojsko, večinoma bojevnike iz plemen Beni Snasen, pa tudi Beni Angad in Beni Ukil, ki ji je poveljeval Mohamed, sin maroškega sultana Abd ar Rahmana. Bugeaud, ki je hotel dokončati francosko osvojitev Alžirije, je bitko sprožil brez vojne napovedi, da bi pogajanja o maroški podpori vodji alžirskega odpora Abd el Kadru izsilil pod pogoji, ugodnimi za Francoze, ki so od maroškega sultana zahtevali, naj Abd el Kadru odtegne podporo.
Bugeaud, ki je zaplenil šotor in dežnik maroškega poveljnika (kar je ustrezalo zaplembi vojaškega prapora v evropskem vojskovanju), je za zmago dobil naziv vojvoda Islyjski.
Dan po bitki se je začelo bombardiranje Mogadorja.

source.title: Battle of Isly
paragraphs: The Battle of Isly (Arabic: معركة إيسلي) was fought on August 14, 1844, between France and Morocco, near the Isly River. French forces under Marshal Thomas Robert Bugeaud routed a much larger, but poorly organized, Moroccan force, mainly fighters from the tribes of Beni Snassen, but also from the Beni Angad and Beni Oukil; under Muhammad, son of the Sultan of Morocco, Abd al-Rahman. Bugeaud, attempting to complete the French conquest of Algeria, instigated the battle without a declaration of war in order to force negotiations concerning Moroccan support for the Algerian resistance leader Abd el-Kader to conclude on terms favorable to the French who demanded the Sultan of Morocco to withdraw support for Abd el-Kader.
Bugeaud, who recovered the Moroccan commander's tent and umbrella (equivalent to capturing a military standard in European warfare), was made Duke of Isly for his victory.
The day following the battle, the Bombardment of Mogador started.

Battle of Jaffa (1192).headline: Bitka pri Jafi (1192)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jafi je potekala med križarskimi vojnami kot eden od vrste pohodov med vojsko sultana Saladina (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Yūsuf ibn Ayyūb) in križarskimi silami pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Riharda I. (znanega kot Rihard Levjesrčni). Bila je zadnja bitka tretje križarske vojne, po kateri sta se Saladin in kralj Rihard lahko dogovorila o premirju. Križarji Jeruzalema sicer niso znova dobili v posest, krščanski romarji pa so smeli v mesto, križarji pa so obdržali nadzor nad precejšnjim pasom ozemlja od Bejruta do Jafe.

source.title: Battle of Jaffa (1192)
paragraphs: The Battle of Jaffa took place during the Crusades, as one of a series of campaigns between the army of Sultan Saladin (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Yūsuf ibn Ayyūb) and the Crusader forces led by King Richard I of England (known as Richard the Lionheart). It was the final battle of the Third Crusade, after which Saladin and King Richard were able to negotiate a truce. Although the Crusaders did not regain possession of Jerusalem, Christian pilgrims were permitted entry into the city, and the Crusaders were able to retain control of a sizable strip of land stretching from Beirut to Jaffa.

Battle of Jalula.headline: Bitka pri Džaluli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Džaluli je potekala med Sasanidskim imperijem in pravovernim kalifatom kmalu potem, ko je kalifat osvojil Ktezifon.

source.title: Battle of Jalula
paragraphs: The Battle of Jalula was fought between the Sasanian Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate soon after the conquest of Ctesiphon by the latter.

Battle of Jenin (2002).headline: Bitka za Džanin (2002)
paragraphs: Bitka za Džanin je od 1. do 11. aprila 2002 potekala v begunskem taborišču Džanin na Zahodnem bregu, ki ga zaseda Izrael. Izraelska vojska je med drugo intifado v okviru operacije Obrambni ščit vdrla v taborišče in na druga območja pod upravo palestinske oblasti.

Izraelske sile so uporabile pehoto, komandose in jurišne helikopterje. Palestinski borci so se na boj pripravili in po vsem taborišču nastavili pasti, in ko je izraelska kolona naletela na zasedo, se je vojska začela bolj zanašati na oklepne buldožerje. Palestinski borci so se 11. aprila začeli predajati, izraelske čete pa so se iz taborišča začele umikati 18. aprila.

source.title: Battle of Jenin (2002)
paragraphs: The Battle of Jenin, took place in the Jenin refugee camp in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on April 1–11, 2002. The Israeli military invaded the camp, and other areas under the administration of the Palestinian Authority, during the Second Intifada, as part of Operation Defensive Shield.

Israeli forces employed infantry, commando forces, and assault helicopters. Palestinian militants had prepared for a fight, booby trapping locations throughout the camp, and after an Israeli column walked into an ambush, the army began to rely more heavily on the use of armored bulldozers. On April 11, Palestinian militants began to surrender. Israeli troops began withdrawing from the camp on April 18.

Battle of Jerusalem.headline: Bitka za Jeruzalem (1917)
paragraphs: Bitka za Jeruzalem, znana tudi kot padec Jeruzalema, je potekala med »jeruzalemskimi operacijami« Britanskega imperija proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu v prvi svetovni vojni, ko so se boji za mesto razvili od 17. novembra in se po predaji nadaljevali do 30. decembra 1917, da bi zavarovali končni cilj južnopalestinske ofenzive v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji. Preden je bil Jeruzalem zavarovan, so Britanci priznali dve bitki v hebronskem gričevju severno in vzhodno od črte Hebron–Junction Station: bitko pri Nebi Samvilu od 17. do 24. novembra in obrambo Jeruzalema od 26. do 30. decembra 1917. V okviru jeruzalemskih operacij so priznali tudi uspešen drugi poskus prodora čez Nahr el Audžo 21. in 22. decembra 1917 kot bitko pri Jafi, čeprav je bila Jafa zasedena že po bitki pri grebenu Mughar 16. novembra.

source.title: Battle of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Battle of Jerusalem also known as the Fall of Jerusalem occurred during the British Empire's "Jerusalem Operations" against the Ottoman Empire, in World War I, when fighting for the city developed from 17 November, continuing after the surrender until 30 December 1917, to secure the final objective of the Southern Palestine Offensive during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I. Before Jerusalem could be secured, two battles were recognised by the British as being fought in the Hebron Hills to the north and east of the Hebron–Junction Station line. These were the Battle of Nebi Samwill from 17 to 24 November and the Defence of Jerusalem from 26 to 30 December 1917. They also recognised within these Jerusalem Operations, the successful second attempt on 21 and 22 December 1917 to advance across the Nahr el Auja, as the Battle of Jaffa, although Jaffa had been occupied as a consequence of the Battle of Mughar Ridge on 16 November.

Battle of Kalavrye.headline: Bitka pri Kalavriji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kalavriji (tudi Kalavrijaj ali Kalavrita) je potekala leta 1078 med bizantinskimi cesarskimi silami vojskovodje (in poznejšega cesarja) Alekseja Komnena in upornim guvernerjem Drača Nikeforjem Brienijem starejšim. Brienij se je uprl Mihaelu VII. Duki (vladal 1071–1078) in pridobil zvestobo rednih polkov bizantinske vojske na Balkanu. Tudi potem, ko je Duko strmoglavil Nikefor III. Botaniat (vladal 1078–1081), je Brienij nadaljeval upor in ogrožal Carigrad. Po neuspešnih pogajanjih je Botaniat proti njemu poslal mladega vojskovodjo Alekseja Komnena s silami, kolikor jih je ta lahko zbral.

source.title: Battle of Kalavrye
paragraphs: The Battle of Kalavrye (also Kalavryai or Kalavryta) was fought in 1078 between the Byzantine imperial forces of general (and future emperor) Alexios Komnenos and the rebellious governor of Dyrrhachium, Nikephoros Bryennios the Elder. Bryennios had rebelled against Michael VII Doukas (r. 1071–1078) and had won over the allegiance of the Byzantine army's regular regiments in the Balkans. Even after Doukas's overthrow by Nikephoros III Botaneiates (r. 1078–1081), Bryennios continued his revolt, and threatened Constantinople. After failed negotiations, Botaneiates sent the young general Alexios Komnenos with whatever forces he could gather to confront him.

Battle of Kapetron.headline: Bitka pri Kapetronu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kapetronu je potekala leta 1048 na Kapetronski planjavi (današnji Hasankale/Pasinler na severovzhodu Turčije) med bizantinsko-gruzijsko vojsko in seldžuškimi Turki. Bila je vrhunec velikega vpada, ki ga je seldžuški knez Ibrahim Inal vodil v Armenijo pod bizantinsko oblastjo. Zaradi več dejavnikov so bile redne bizantinske sile v precejšnji številčni podrejenosti: krajevne tematske vojske so bile razpuščene, veliko poklicnih enot pa so preusmerili na Balkan proti uporu Leona Tornikija. Bizantinska poveljnika, Aron in Katakalon Kekavmen, se zato nista strinjala, kako se najbolje zoperstaviti vdoru. Kekavmen se je zavzemal za takojšen preventivni napad, Aron pa za previdnejšo strategijo do prihoda okrepitev. Cesar Konstantin IX. se je odločil za drugo možnost in svojim silam ukazal, naj ostanejo pasivne, ter za pomoč zaprosil vladarja gruzijske vojvodine Kldekari Liparita IV. Turki so tako lahko pustošili po mili volji in med drugim izropali ter uničili veliko trgovsko središče Arce.

source.title: Battle of Kapetron
paragraphs: The Battle of Kapetron or Kapetrou was fought between a Byzantine-Georgian army and the Seljuq Turks at the plain of Kapetron (modern Hasankale/Pasinler in northeastern Turkey) in 1048. The event was the culmination of a major raid led by the Seljuq prince Ibrahim Inal into Byzantine-ruled Armenia. A combination of factors meant that the regular Byzantine forces were at a considerable numerical disadvantage against the Turks: the local thematic armies had been disbanded, while many of the professional troops had been diverted to the Balkans to face the revolt of Leo Tornikios. As a result, the Byzantine commanders, Aaron and Katakalon Kekaumenos, disagreed on how best to confront the invasion. Kekaumenos favoured an immediate and pre-emptive strike, while Aaron favoured a more cautious strategy until the arrival of reinforcements. Emperor Constantine IX chose the latter option and ordered his forces to adopt a passive stance, while requesting aid from the ruler of Georgian Duchy of Kldekari, Liparit IV. This allowed the Turks to ravage at will, notably leading to the sack and destruction of the great commercial centre of Artze.

Battle of Kara Killisse (1915).headline: Bitka pri Kara Kilise (1915)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kara Kilise (dobesedno »črna cerkev«; turško: Karakilise Muharebesi), znana tudi kot bitka pri Malazgirtu, je potekala na kavkaškem bojišču julija 1915, po bitki pri Manzikertu. Ruska zgodovinska literatura jo šteje za del »alaškertske obrambne operacije« (9. julija – 3. avgusta).

source.title: Battle of Kara Killisse (1915)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kara Killisse (Lit. Black church, Turkish: Karakilise Muharebesi), also known as the Battle of Malazgirt, was fought on the Caucasus front in July 1915 after the Battle of Manzikert. In Russian historical literature, this engagement is considered as a part of "Alashkert defensive operation" (9 July – 3 August).

Bitka pri Karameju (arabsko: معركة الكرامة) je bil 15-urni vojaški spopad med Izraelom ter združenimi silami Jordanije in Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) v jordanskem obmejnem mestu Karame med izčrpavalno vojno 21. marca 1968. Izrael ga je načrtoval kot enega od dveh hkratnih napadov na taborišča PLO, enega v Karameju ob reki Jordan, drugega pa v oddaljeni vasi Gor es Safi južno od Mrtvega morja.

source.title: Battle of Karameh
paragraphs: The Battle of Karameh (Arabic: معركة الكرامة) was a 15-hour military engagement between Israel and the combined forces of Jordan and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) in the Jordanian border town of Karameh during the War of Attrition on 21 March 1968. It was planned by Israel as one of two concurrent raids on PLO camps, one in Karameh along the Jordan River and the other in the distant village of Ghor es-Safi south of the Dead Sea.

Battle of Karbala.headline: Bitka pri Karbali
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karbali (arabsko: Maʿrakat Karbalāʾ) je potekala 10. oktobra 680 (10. muharama leta 61 po hidžri islamskega koledarja) pri Karbali na jugu današnjega Iraka, med silami drugega omajadskega kalifa Jazida I. (vladal 680–683) in majhno vojsko, ki jo je vodil Husein ibn Ali, Alijev drugi sin in vnuk islamskega preroka Mohameda.

source.title: Battle of Karbala
paragraphs: The Battle of Karbala (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة كَرْبَلَاء, romanized: Maʿrakat Karbalāʾ) was fought on 10 October 680 (10 Muharram in the year 61 AH of the Islamic calendar) between the forces of the second Umayyad caliph Yazid I (r. 680–683), and a small army led by Husayn ibn Ali, second son of Ali and grandson of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, at Karbala, in modern-day southern Iraq.

Battle of Kasserine Pass.headline: Bitka pri prelazu Kasserine
paragraphs: Bitka pri prelazu Kasserine je bila vrsta spopadov, ki so potekali od 19. do 24. februarja 1943 okoli prelaza Kasserine, 3,2 km široke vrzeli v verigi Veliki Dorsal gorovja Atlas v zahodni osrednji Tuniziji. Bila je del tunizijske kampanje druge svetovne vojne.

Sile osi pod vodstvom generalfeldmaršala Erwina Rommla so bile predvsem iz udarne skupine Afriškega korpusa, italijanske oklepne divizije Centauro in dveh oklepnih divizij, odvzetih 5. oklepni armadi. Zavezniške sile so bile iz ameriškega II. korpusa (generalmajor Lloyd Fredendall), britanske 6. oklepne divizije (generalmajor Charles Keightley) in drugih delov 1. armade (generalpodpolkovnik Kenneth Anderson).

source.title: Battle of Kasserine Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of Kasserine Pass was a series of engagements which took place from 19–24 February 1943 around Kasserine Pass, a 2-mile-wide (3.2 km) gap in the Grand Dorsal chain of the Atlas Mountains in west central Tunisia. It was a part of the Tunisian campaign of World War II.

The Axis forces, led by Generalfeldmarschall Erwin Rommel, were primarily from the Afrika Korps Assault Group, the Italian Centauro Armored Division and two Panzer divisions detached from the 5th Panzer Army. The Allied forces were from the U.S. II Corps (Major General Lloyd Fredendall), the British 6th Armoured Division (Major General Charles Keightley) and other parts of the First Army (Lieutenant General Kenneth Anderson).

Battle of Khafji.headline: Bitka pri Hafdžiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hafdžiju je bil prvi večji kopenski spopad zalivske vojne. Potekala je od 29. januarja do 1. februarja 1991 v savdskem mestu Hafdži in okolici.

Iraški voditelj Sadam Husein je že prej neuspešno skušal koalicijske sile zvabiti v drage kopenske spopade, tako da je obstreljeval savdske položaje in naftne rezervoarje ter na Izrael izstreljeval rakete zemlja-zemlja scud, zdaj pa je ukazal vdor v Savdsko Arabijo z juga Kuvajta. 1. in 5. mehanizirana divizija ter 3. oklepna divizija so dobile ukaz, naj z več strani vdrejo proti Hafdžiju in se ob obali spopadejo s savdskimi, kuvajtskimi in ameriškimi silami, podporne iraške komandoske enote pa naj se po morju prikradejo južneje in nadlegujejo koalicijsko zaledje.

source.title: Battle of Khafji
paragraphs: The Battle of Khafji was the first major ground engagement of the Gulf War. It took place in and around the Saudi Arabian city of Khafji, from 29 January to 1 February 1991.

Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, who had already tried and failed to draw Coalition forces into costly ground engagements by shelling Saudi Arabian positions and oil storage tanks and firing Scud surface-to-surface missiles at Israel, ordered the invasion of Saudi Arabia from southern Kuwait. The 1st and 5th Mechanized Divisions and 3rd Armored Division were ordered to conduct a multi-pronged invasion toward Khafji, engaging Saudi Arabian, Kuwaiti, and U.S. forces along the coastline, with a supporting Iraqi commando force ordered to infiltrate further south by sea and harass the Coalition's rear.

Battle of Khasham.headline: Bitka pri Hašamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hašamu, znana tudi kot bitka pri poljih Conoco, je bil vojaški spopad sirske državljanske vojne, ki je potekal 7. februarja 2018 blizu krajev Hašam in Al Tabija v guvernoratu Dejr ez Zor v Siriji. Koalicija operacije Neomajna odločnost je izvedla letalske in topniške napade na sirske oborožene sile in provladne milice, potem ko so te domnevno napadle položaj ameriške vojske in Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF) v pokrajini.

source.title: Battle of Khasham
paragraphs: The Battle of Khasham, also known as the Battle of Conoco Fields, was a military engagement of the Syrian civil war fought on 7 February 2018 near the towns of Khasham and Al Tabiyeh in the Deir ez-Zor Governorate, Syria. The Operation Inherent Resolve coalition delivered air and artillery strikes on Syrian Armed Forces and pro-government militias after they reportedly engaged a U.S. military and Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) position in the region.

Bitka pri Hajbarju (arabsko: Ghazwatu Khaybar) je bil oborožen spopad med zgodnjimi muslimani in judovsko skupnostjo v Hajbarju leta 628 n. št. V Hajbarju, ki leži približno 150 kilometrov severozahodno od Medine, je živela velika skupnost judovskih plemen.

Ko je Mohamedova vojska krenila proti Hajbarju, Banu Gatafan in druga z Judi zavezniška arabska plemena niso poslala ali niso mogla poslati pričakovanih okrepitev za obrambo naselbine, kar je še bolj ogrozilo slabe utrdbe judovske vojske. Po kratkem boju je Hajbar padel v roke muslimanov, judovski poveljnik Marhab ibn al Harit pa je padel, kot pravijo viri, od roke Alija ibn Abi Taliba.

source.title: Battle of Khaybar
paragraphs: The Battle of Khaybar (Arabic: غزوة خيبر, romanized: Ghazwatu Khaybar) was an armed confrontation between the early Muslims and the Jewish community of Khaybar in 628 CE. Khaybar, which is located approximately 150 kilometres (93 mi) to the northwest of Medina, was home to a sizable community of Jewish tribes.

As Muhammad's army began to march on Khaybar, the Banu Ghatafan and other Jewish-allied Arabian tribes did not, or could not, send the reinforcements that had been expected to arrive to defend the settlement, further endangering the Jewish army's poor fortifications. After a brief period of fighting, Khaybar fell to the Muslims and the Jewish commander Marhab ibn al-Harith was killed, reportedly by Ali ibn Abi Talib.

Battle of Khorramshahr (1980).headline: Bitka za Horamšahr (1980)
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Horamšahr je bila velika bitka iransko-iraške vojne, ki se je začela kmalu po iraškem vdoru v Iran septembra 1980. Med izčrpavajočimi uličnimi boji v mestu in okolici so Iranci Horamšahr začeli imenovati Huninšahr (perzijsko: خونین شهر, dobesedno »krvavo mesto«), saj sta obe strani v bojih utrpeli hude izgube. Bila je največja posamična ulična bitka iransko-iraške vojne.

Irak je mesto nazadnje zavzel, a drago: ofenziva na Horamšahr, ki je trajala 34 dni, je zahtevala ogromno vojakov, precej več, kot so predvidevali iraški vojni načrti. Ta izjemna zamuda je Iranu omogočila, da je ustalil fronte pri Dezfulu, Ahvazu in Susangerdu, in tako razmeroma hitro mobiliziral iranske okrepitve v z nafto bogati Huzestan, ki si ga je hotel Irak priključiti. Ob iraški ofenzivi so Horamšahr branili predvsem številčno močno podrejeni takavarani, nekatere enote 92. oklepne divizije, pasdarani in krajevne civilne milice.

source.title: Battle of Khorramshahr (1980)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Khorramshahr was a major battle in the Iran–Iraq War, beginning shortly after the Iraqi invasion of Iran in September 1980. Amidst the gruelling urban warfare in and around the city, Khorramshahr came to be referred to by the Iranians as Khuninshahr (Persian: خونین شهر, lit. 'City of Blood'), as both sides had suffered heavy casualties in combat. It was the single largest urban battle of the Iran–Iraq war.

Though Iraq ultimately captured the city, it had come at a high cost; the offensive into Khorramshahr, which took 34 days, drew an immense investment of troops, far beyond what Iraqi war plans had envisaged. The incredible delay allowed Iran to stabilize the frontlines at Dezful, Ahvaz, and Susangerd, consequently enabling the relatively swift mobilization of Iranian reinforcements into oil-rich Khuzestan, which Iraq had sought to annex. At the time of the Iraqi offensive, Khorramshahr was mainly being defended by the heavily outnumbered Takavaran, some units of the 92nd Armoured Division, the Pasdaran, and local civilian militias.

Battle of Khorramshahr (1982).headline: Bitka za Horamšahr (1982)
paragraphs: Druga bitka za Horamšahr, v Iranu znana tudi kot osvoboditev Horamšahra (perzijsko: Âzâdsâzī-ye Khorramshahr), je bila iranska ponovna osvojitev mesta Horamšahr 24. maja 1982, med iransko-iraško vojno. Iračani so mesto zavzeli prej v vojni, 26. oktobra 1980, kmalu po iraškem vdoru v Iran. Uspešna ponovna osvojitev je bila del iranske operacije Bejt ol Mokadas. Velja za prelomnico vojne, osvoboditev mesta pa v Iranu vsako leto praznujejo 24. maja.

source.title: Battle of Khorramshahr (1982)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Khorramshahr, also known in Iran as the Liberation of Khorramshahr (Persian: آزادسازی خرمشهر, romanized: Âzâdsâzī-ye Khorramshahr) was the Iranian recapture of the city of Khorramshahr on 24 May 1982, during the Iran–Iraq War. The city had been captured by the Iraqis earlier in the war, on 26 October 1980, shortly after the Iraqi invasion of Iran. The successful retaking of the city was part of Iran's Operation Beit ol-Moqaddas. It is perceived as a turning point in the war; and the liberation of the city is annually celebrated in Iran on 24 May.

Battle of Kirk Kilisse.headline: Bitka pri Kirk Kilise
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kirk Kilise, bitka pri Kırklareliju ali bitka pri Lozengradu je bila del prve balkanske vojne med vojskama Bolgarije in Osmanskega cesarstva. Potekala je od 22. do 24. oktobra 1912. Bolgarske sile 1. in 3. armade so premagale osmansko Vzhodno armado in zavzele Lozengrad. Zmaga je osmanske sile prisilila k umiku proti črti Lüleburgaz–Bunarhisar in Bolgarom odprla velik del severne Trakije.

source.title: Battle of Kirk Kilisse
paragraphs: The Battle of Kirk Kilisse or Battle of Kirklareli or Battle of Lozengrad was part of the First Balkan War between the armies of Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire. It took place on 22–24 October 1912. Bulgarian forces of the First and Third Armies defeated the Ottoman Eastern Army and captured Lozengrad. The victory forced the Ottoman forces to retreat toward the Lüleburgaz–Bunarhisar line and opened much of northern Thrace to the Bulgarians.

Battle of Kirkuk (2017).headline: Bitka za Kirkuk (2017)
paragraphs: Bitka za Kirkuk, s kodnim imenom operacija Uveljavljanje varnosti, v iraško-kurdskem spopadu leta 2017, je bila vojaška napotitev iraških varnostnih sil za ponovno zavzetje guvernorata Kirkuk, ki so ga držali pešmerge; ti so namreč prezrli ponavljajoča se opozorila, naj se umaknejo, kar je sprožilo spopade med silama. Prodor se je začel 15. oktobra 2017, mesto Kirkuk pa so iraške sile znova zavzele takoj ob vstopu, saj so Kurdi nemudoma pobegnili. Pet dni pozneje je bil ves guvernorat pod popolnim nadzorom iraških sil, druge iraške sile pa so v naslednjih dneh napredovale naprej in porazile pešmerge na obsežnih območjih severnega Iraka.

source.title: Battle of Kirkuk (2017)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kirkuk, codenamed Operation Enforcing Security of the 2017 Iraqi–Kurdish conflict, was a military deployment by the Iraqi Security Forces to retake Kirkuk Governorate from the Peshmerga after the latter ignored repeated warnings to withdraw, sparking clashes between the two forces. The advance began on 15 October 2017, with the city of Kirkuk being retaken upon entry of the Iraqi forces as the Kurds fled immediately. Five days later the entirety of the governorate was under full control of the Iraqi forces; meanwhile, other Iraqi forces continued their advances in subsequent days, defeating the Peshmerga forces across vast swathes of territory in northern Iraq.

Battle of Konya.headline: Bitka pri Konyi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Konyi je potekala 21. decembra 1832 med Egiptom in Osmanskim cesarstvom tik pred mestom Konya na ozemlju današnje Turčije. Egipčane je vodil Ibrahim paša, Osmane pa Reşid Mehmed paša. Zmagali so Egipčani.

source.title: Battle of Konya
paragraphs: The Battle of Konya was fought on December 21, 1832, between Egypt and the Ottoman Empire, just outside the city of Konya in modern-day Turkey. The Egyptians were led by Ibrahim Pasha, while the Ottomans were led by Reşid Mehmed Pasha. The Egyptians were victorious.

Battle of Kopidnadon.headline: Bitka pri Kopidnadonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kopidnadonu ali Kopidnadosu je potekala septembra 788 med vojskama Abasidskega kalifata in Bizantinskega cesarstva. Abasidska vojska je vdrla v bizantinsko Malo Azijo in se pri Kopidnadonu spopadla z bizantinskimi silami. Bitka se je končala z abasidsko zmago. Med bizantinskimi žrtvami je bil neki Diogen, v katerem nekateri raziskovalci vidijo verjetni izvirni zgled za literarnega junaka Digenisa Akritasa.

source.title: Battle of Kopidnadon
paragraphs: The Battle of Kopidnadon or Kopidnados took place in September 788 between the armies of the Abbasid Caliphate and the Byzantine Empire. The Abbasid army launched an invasion of Byzantine Asia Minor, and was confronted by a Byzantine force at Kopidnadon. The resulting battle was an Abbasid victory. Among the Byzantine losses was a certain Diogenes, who is identified by some scholars with the probable original source for the literary hero Digenes Akritas.

Battle of Köse Dağ.headline: Bitka pri Köse Dağu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Köse Dağu je potekala v vzhodni Anatoliji 26. junija 1243, ko se je vojska Rumskega sultanata pod vodstvom sultana Kajhosrava II. spopadla z napadalno mongolsko vojsko pod vojskovodjo Bajdžujem in bila odločilno poražena. Bitka je bila prelomni dogodek mongolske osvojitve Anatolije: Rumski sultanat, prej pomembna samostojna sila v vzhodnem Sredozemlju, je postal vazalno kraljestvo, njegova ozemlja pa so pozneje vključili v mongolski Ilkanat.

source.title: Battle of Köse Dağ
paragraphs: The Battle of Köse Dağ took place in eastern Anatolia on 26 June 1243 when an army of the Sultanate of Rum, led by Sultan Kaykhusraw II, confronted an invading Mongol army under the general Baiju and was decisively defeated. The battle was the pivotal event of the Mongol conquest of Anatolia: Rum, previously a significant independent power in the eastern Mediterranean, was reduced to the status of a client kingdom, and its territories were later absorbed into the Mongol Ilkhanate.

Battle of Kosmidion.headline: Bitka pri Kosmidionu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kosmidionu (turško: Eyüp Muharebesi) je potekala 15. junija 1410 v osmanskem medvladju med silami sprtih bratov Muse Çelebija in Süleymana Çelebija pri Kosmidionu (današnjem Eyüpu), tik pred kopenskim obzidjem Carigrada.

source.title: Battle of Kosmidion
paragraphs: The Battle of Kosmidion (Turkish: Eyüp Muharebesi) occurred on 15 June 1410, during the Ottoman Interregnum, and was fought between the forces of the rival brothers, Musa Çelebi and Süleyman Çelebi, at Kosmidion (modern Eyüp) just outside the land walls of Constantinople.

Battle of Krasos.headline: Bitka pri Krasosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Krasosu je potekala med arabsko-bizantinskimi vojnami avgusta 804 med Bizantinci pod cesarjem Nikeforjem I. (vladal 802–811) in abasidsko vojsko pod Ibrahimom ibn Džibrilom. Z Nikeforjevim prihodom na prestol leta 802 se je vojna med Bizancem in Abasidskim kalifatom znova razplamtela. Pozno poleti 804 so Abasidi vdrli v bizantinsko Malo Azijo v enem od svojih običajnih vpadov in Nikefor se jim je odpravil naproti. Pri Krasosu pa so ga presenetili in hudo porazili, komaj je ušel z življenjem. Nato so dogovorili premirje in izmenjavo ujetnikov. Nikefor je kljub porazu in obsežnemu abasidskemu vdoru naslednje leto vztrajal, dokler težave v vzhodnih provincah kalifata Abasidov niso prisilile, da so sklenili mir.

source.title: Battle of Krasos
paragraphs: The Battle of Krasos took place during the Arab–Byzantine Wars in August 804, between the Byzantines under Emperor Nikephoros I (r. 802–811) and an Abbasid army under Ibrahim ibn Jibril. Nikephoros' accession in 802 resulted in a resumption of warfare between Byzantium and the Abbasid Caliphate. In late summer 804, the Abbasids had invaded Byzantine Asia Minor for one of their customary raids, and Nikephoros set out to meet them. He was surprised, however, at Krasos and heavily defeated, barely escaping with his own life. A truce and prisoner exchange were afterwards arranged. Despite his defeat, and a massive Abbasid invasion the next year, Nikephoros persevered until troubles in the eastern provinces of the Caliphate forced the Abbasids to conclude a peace.

Battle of Lade.headline: Bitka pri Ladi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ladi (starogrško: Ναυμαχία τῆς Λάδης, Naumachia tēs Ladēs) je bila pomorska bitka med jonskim uporom leta 494 pr. n. št. Bojevali sta se zavezništvo jonskih mest (pridružili so se jim prebivalci Lezbosa) in Perzijsko cesarstvo Dareja Velikega, končala pa se je z odločilno zmago Perzijcev, ki je upor tako rekoč končala.

source.title: Battle of Lade
paragraphs: The Battle of Lade (Ancient Greek: Ναυμαχία τῆς Λάδης, romanized: Naumachia tēs Ladēs) was a naval battle which occurred during the Ionian Revolt, in 494 BC. It was fought between an alliance of the Ionian cities (joined by the Lesbians) and the Persian Empire of Darius the Great, and resulted in a decisive victory for the Persians which all but ended the revolt.

Battle of Lake Huleh (1157).headline: Bitka pri jezeru Hula (1157)
paragraphs: V bitki pri jezeru Hula junija 1157 je Nur ad Din Zengi, emir Alepa in Damaska, iz zasede napadel in hudo porazil križarsko vojsko pod vodstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina III. Kralj in nekaj bojevnikov se je umaknilo v bližnji grad, veliko pa jih je bilo ubitih ali ujetih. Latinsko Jeruzalemsko kraljestvo se je izognilo hujši škodi, ker je nasprotnik zbolel in zmage ni mogel izkoristiti. Dolina Hula leži na severovzhodu današnjega Izraela, v času bitke pa je pripadala Jeruzalemskemu kraljestvu.

source.title: Battle of Lake Huleh (1157)
paragraphs: In the Battle of Lake Huleh in June 1157, a Crusader army led by King Baldwin III of Jerusalem was ambushed and badly defeated by Nur ad-Din Zangi, the emir of Aleppo and Damascus. While the king and some fighting men escaped to a nearby castle, a large number were killed or made prisoner. The Latin Kingdom of Jerusalem escaped worse damage when their adversary became ill and was unable to follow up his victory. The Hula Valley is located in the northeast part of modern-day Israel. At the time of the battle, the area belonged to the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

Battle of Lalakaon.headline: Bitka pri Lalakaonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lalakaonu (grško: Μάχη τοῦ Λαλακάοντος) ali bitka pri Posonu oziroma Porsonu (Μάχη τοῦ Πό(ρ)σωνος) je potekala leta 863 v Paflagoniji (na severu današnje Turčije) med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in napadalno arabsko vojsko. Bizantinsko vojsko je vodil Petronas, stric cesarja Mihaela III., arabski viri pa omenjajo tudi navzočnost samega cesarja. Arabce je vodil emir Melitene (Malatye) Omar al Akta.

Omar al Akta je strl začetni bizantinski odpor proti svojemu vdoru in prodrl do Črnega morja. Bizantinci so nato zbrali svoje sile in arabsko vojsko obkolili blizu reke Lalakaon. Bitka se je končala z bizantinsko zmago in emirjevo smrtjo na bojišču, sledila pa ji je uspešna bizantinska protiofenziva čez mejo. Zmage so bile odločilne: glavne grožnje bizantinskim obmejnim območjem so bile odpravljene in začelo se je obdobje bizantinske prevlade na vzhodu, ki je doseglo vrhunec z osvajanji v 10. stoletju.

source.title: Battle of Lalakaon
paragraphs: The Battle of Lalakaon (Greek: Μάχη τοῦ Λαλακάοντος), or Battle of Poson or Porson (Μάχη τοῦ Πό(ρ)σωνος), was fought in 863 between the Byzantine Empire and an invading Arab army in Paphlagonia (modern northern Turkey). The Byzantine army was led by Petronas, the uncle of Emperor Michael III, although Arab sources also mention the presence of the Emperor in person. The Arabs were led by the emir of Melitene (Malatya), Umar al-Aqta.

Umar al-Aqta overcame initial Byzantine resistance to his invasion and reached the Black Sea. The Byzantines then mobilized their forces and encircled the Arab army near the Lalakaon river. The subsequent battle ended in a Byzantine victory and the emir's death on the field, and was followed by a successful Byzantine counteroffensive across the border. These victories were decisive; the main threats to the Byzantine borderlands were eliminated, and the era of Byzantine ascendancy in the East (culminating in the 10th-century conquests) began.

Battle of Latakia.headline: Bitka pri Latakiji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Latakiji (arabsko: معركة اللاذقية; hebrejsko: קרב לטקיה) je bil majhen, a prelomen pomorski spopad jomkipurske vojne, ki je 7. oktobra 1973 potekal med Izraelom in Sirijo. Bila je prva pomorska bitka v zgodovini, v kateri so se spopadli raketni čolni z izstrelki površje-površje in v kateri so uporabili elektronsko zavajanje.

source.title: Battle of Latakia
paragraphs: The Battle of Latakia (Arabic: معركة اللاذقية; Hebrew: קרב לטקיה) was a small but revolutionary naval action of the Yom Kippur War, fought on 7 October 1973 between Israel and Syria. It was the first naval battle in history to see combat between surface-to-surface missile-equipped missile boats and the use of electronic deception.

Battle of Levounion.headline: Bitka pri Levunionu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Levunionu je bila prva odločilna bizantinska zmaga komnenske obnove. Združene sile Bizantinskega cesarstva pod Aleksejem I. Komnenom in njegovih kumanskih zaveznikov so 29. aprila 1091 strle napadalno vojsko Pečenegov.

source.title: Battle of Levounion
paragraphs: The Battle of Levounion was the first decisive Byzantine victory of the Komnenian restoration. On 29 April 1091, an invading force of Pechenegs was crushed by the combined forces of the Byzantine Empire under Alexios I Komnenos and his Cuman allies.

Battle of Lule Burgas.headline: Bitka pri Lüleburgazu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lüleburgazu (turško: Lüleburgaz Muharebesi) ali bitka pri Lüleburgazu in Bunarhisarju (bolgarsko: Битка при Люлебургас – Бунархисар; turško: Lüleburgaz – Pınarhisar Muharebesi) je potekala med Kraljevino Bolgarijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom in je bila najbolj krvava bitka prve balkanske vojne. Potekala je od 28. oktobra do 2. novembra 1912. Številčno šibkejše bolgarske sile so Osmane prisilile k umiku na črto Çatalca, 30 km od osmanske prestolnice Carigrada. Po številu vojakov, ki so sodelovali v njej, je bila največja bitka v Evropi med koncem francosko-pruske vojne in začetkom prve svetovne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Lule Burgas
paragraphs: The Battle of Lule Burgas (Turkish: Lüleburgaz Muharebesi) or Battle of Luleburgas – Bunarhisar (Bulgarian: Битка при Люлебургас – Бунархисар, Turkish: Lüleburgaz – Pınarhisar Muharebesi) took place between the Kingdom of Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire and was the bloodiest battle of the First Balkan War. The battle took place from 28 October to 2 November 1912. The outnumbered Bulgarian forces made the Ottomans retreat to Çatalca line, 30 km from the Ottoman capital Constantinople. In terms of forces engaged it was the largest battle fought in Europe between the end of the Franco-Prussian War and the beginning of the First World War.

Battle of Magdhaba.headline: Bitka pri Magdhabi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Magdhabi je potekala 23. decembra 1916 v delu sinajsko-palestinske kampanje prve svetovne vojne, imenovanem obramba Egipta. Konjeniška divizija Anzac je napadla vkopano posadko osmanske vojske južno in vzhodno od Bir Lahfana v Sinajski puščavi, okoli 29–40 km v notranjost od sredozemske obale. Zmaga egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) nad osmansko posadko je zagotovila tudi mesto El Ariš, potem ko se je osmanska posadka umaknila.
notes: The miles (18–25 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Battle of Magdhaba
paragraphs: The Battle of Magdhaba took place on 23 December 1916 during the Defence of Egypt section of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign in the First World War. The attack by the Anzac Mounted Division took place against an entrenched Ottoman Army garrison to the south and east of Bir Lahfan in the Sinai desert, some 18–25 miles (29–40 km) inland from the Mediterranean coast. This Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory against the Ottoman Empire garrison also secured the town of El Arish after the Ottoman garrison withdrew.

Bitka pri Magneziji je potekala decembra 190 ali januarja 189 pr. n. št. Bila je del rimsko-selevkidske vojne: sile Rimske republike pod vodstvom konzula Lucija Kornelija Scipiona Azijskega in zavezniškega Kraljestva Pergamon pod Evmenom II. so se spopadle s selevkidsko vojsko Antioha III. Velikega. Vojski sta se sprva utaborili severovzhodno od Magnezije ob Sipilu v Mali Aziji (današnja Manisa v Turčiji) in več dni skušali druga drugo izzvati v bitko na ugodnem terenu.

Ko se je bitka nazadnje začela, je Evmen uspel zmesti levo krilo Selevkidov. Medtem ko je Antiohova konjenica na desnem krilu bojišča premagovala nasprotnike, je središče njegove vojske razpadlo, preden ga je lahko okrepil. Po sodobnih ocenah je padlo 10.000 Selevkidov in 5000 Rimljanov. Bitka se je končala z odločilno rimsko-pergamsko zmago, ki je pripeljala do mira v Apameji, s katerim je bilo konec selevkidske prevlade v Mali Aziji.

source.title: Battle of Magnesia
paragraphs: The Battle of Magnesia took place in either December 190 or January 189 BC. It was fought as part of the Roman–Seleucid War, pitting forces of the Roman Republic led by the consul Lucius Cornelius Scipio Asiaticus and the allied Kingdom of Pergamon under Eumenes II against a Seleucid army of Antiochus III the Great. The two armies initially camped northeast of Magnesia ad Sipylum in Asia Minor (modern-day Manisa, Turkey), attempting to provoke each other into a battle on favorable terrain for several days.

When the battle finally began, Eumenes managed to throw the Seleucid left flank into disarray. While Antiochus' cavalry overpowered his adversaries on the right flank of the battlefield, his army's center collapsed before he could reinforce it. Modern estimates give 10,000 dead for the Seleucids and 5,000 killed for the Romans. The battle resulted in a decisive Roman-Pergamene victory, which led to the Treaty of Apamea that ended Seleucid domination in Asia Minor.

Bitka v Mansuri je potekala od 8. do 11. februarja 1250 med križarji pod vodstvom francoskega kralja Ludvika IX. in ajubidskimi silami pod vodstvom vezirja Fahr ad Dina ibn aš Šejka, Kutuza, Faris ad Dina Aktaja in Bajbarsa. Bojevali so se v današnji Mansuri v Egiptu. Križarsko vojsko so zvabili v mesto, kjer so jo napadle muslimanske sile. Križarji so se v neredu umaknili v svoj tabor, kjer so jih oblegali Egipčani. V začetku aprila so se prebili in umaknili v Damieto.

source.title: Battle of Mansurah (1250)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mansurah was fought from 8 to 11 February 1250, between crusaders led by King Louis IX of France and Ayyubid forces led by Vizier Fakhr al-Din ibn al-Shaykh, Qutuz, Faris al-Din Aktay and Baybars. It was fought in present-day Mansoura, Egypt. The Crusader force was enticed into entering the town where it was set upon by the Muslim force. The Crusaders withdrew in disorder to their encampment where they were besieged by the Egyptians. The Crusaders broke out and withdrew to Damietta in early April.

Battle of Manzikert (1915).headline: Bitka pri Manzikertu (1915)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Manzikertu ali bitka pri Malazgirtu (rusko: Битва при Манцикерте, Bytva pri Mantsikerte; turško: Malazgirt Muharebesi) je potekala med kavkaško kampanjo prve svetovne vojne od 10. do 26. julija 1915. Čeprav sta imeli obe strani hude izgube, so se Rusi umaknili proti severu, Turki pa so znova zavzeli Malazgirt in nato prodirali naprej proti Karakiliseju, kjer so jih od 5. do 8. avgusta porazili v bitki pri Kara Kilise.

source.title: Battle of Manzikert (1915)
paragraphs: The Battle of Manzikert or Battle of Malazgirt (Russian: Битва при Манцикерте Bytva pri Mantsikerte; Turkish: Malazgirt Muharebesi) took place during the Caucasus Campaign of World War I, over the period July 10–26, 1915. Even though losses were heavy on both sides, the Russians retreated north and the Turks retook Malazgirt then they further advanced towards Karakilise where they were defeated on 5–8 August at the Battle of Kara Killisse.

Battle of Mari.headline: Bitka pri Mariju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mariju, imenovana tudi katastrofa pri Mariju, je bila bitka med Egipčani mameluškega sultanata in Armenci kilikijske Armenije 24. avgusta 1266.

source.title: Battle of Mari
paragraphs: The Battle of Mari, also called the Disaster of Mari, was a battle between the Egyptians of the Mamluk Sultanate and the Armenians of Cilician Armenia on 24 August 1266.

Battle of Marj al-Saffar (1303).headline: Bitka pri Mardž al Safarju (1303)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž al Safarju (ali Mardž al Sufarju), znana tudi kot bitka pri Šakhabu, je od 20. do 22. aprila 1303 potekala med egiptovskimi mameluki ter Mongoli in njihovimi armenskimi zavezniki blizu Kisveja v Siriji, tik južno od Damaska. Bitka je vplivna tako v islamski zgodovini kot v sedanjosti zaradi spornega džihada proti drugim muslimanom in fatev o ramadanu, ki jih je izdal Ibn Tajmija. Katastrofalni poraz Mongolov je končal mongolske vdore v Levant.

source.title: Battle of Marj al-Saffar (1303)
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj al-Saffar (or Marj al-Suffar), also known as the Battle of Shaqhab, took place on April 20 through April 22, 1303 between the Egyptian Mamluks and the Mongols and their Armenian allies near Kiswe, Syria, just south of Damascus. The battle has been influential in both Islamic history and contemporary time because of the controversial jihad against other Muslims and Ramadan related fatwas issued by Ibn Taymiyyah. The battle, a disastrous defeat for the Mongols, put an end to Mongol invasions of the Levant.

Battle of Marj Ayyun.headline: Bitka pri Mardž Ajunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž Ajunu je bil vojaški spopad pri Mardž Ajunu blizu reke Litani (v današnjem Libanonu) junija 1179 med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom pod vodstvom Balduina IV. in ajubidskimi vojskami pod vodstvom Saladina. Končala se je z odločilno zmago muslimanov in velja za prvo v dolgi vrsti islamskih zmag nad kristjani pod Saladinom. Krščanskega kralja Balduina IV. Jeruzalemskega, ki ga je hromila gobavost, je rešila telesna straža in je za las ušel ujetju.

source.title: Battle of Marj Ayyun
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj Ayyun was a military confrontation fought at Marj Ayyun near the Litani River (modern-day Lebanon) in June 1179 between the Kingdom of Jerusalem under Baldwin IV and the Ayyubid armies under the leadership of Saladin. It ended in a decisive victory for the Muslims and is considered the first in the long series of Islamic victories under Saladin against the Christians. However, the Christian King, Baldwin IV of Jerusalem, who was crippled by leprosy, was saved by his bodyguard and narrowly escaped capture.

Battle of Marj Dabiq.headline: Bitka pri Mardž Dabiku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž Dabiku (arabsko: مرج دابق, »travnik Dabik«; turško: Mercidabık Muharebesi), odločilni vojaški spopad v zgodovini Bližnjega vzhoda, je potekala 24. avgusta 1516 blizu kraja Dabik, 44 km severno od Alepa (v današnji Siriji). Bitka je bila del vojne med Osmanskim cesarstvom in mameluškim sultanatom v letih 1516–1517, ki se je končala z osmansko zmago, osvojitvijo večjega dela Bližnjega vzhoda in uničenjem mameluškega sultanata. Osmanska zmaga je Selimovim vojskam dala nadzor nad vso pokrajino Sirijo in odprla pot do osvojitve Egipta.

source.title: Battle of Marj Dabiq
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj Dābiq (Arabic: مرج دابق, meaning "the meadow of Dābiq"; Turkish: Mercidabık Muharebesi), a decisive military engagement in Middle Eastern history, was fought on 24 August 1516, near the town of Dabiq, 44 km north of Aleppo (modern Syria). The battle was part of the 1516–17 war between the Ottoman Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate, which ended in an Ottoman victory and conquest of much of the Middle East and brought about the destruction of the Mamluk Sultanate. The Ottoman victory in the battle gave Selim's armies control of the entire region of Syria and opened the door to the conquest of Egypt.

Battle of Marj Rahit (684).headline: Bitka pri Mardž Rahitu (684)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž Rahitu (arabsko: Yawm Marj Rāhiṭ) je bila ena zgodnjih bitk druge fitne. Potekala je 18. avgusta 684 med vojskami jemenske plemenske zveze, v kateri so prevladovali Kalbiti in ki je podpirala Omajade pod kalifom Mervanom I., ter Kajsiti pod vodstvom al Dahaka ibn Kajsa al Fihrija, ki so podpirali kalifa Abd Alaha ibn al Zubajra s sedežem v Meki. Odločilna omajadska zmaga je utrdila njihovo oblast nad Sirijo in jim utrla pot do končne zmage v vojni proti Zubajridom. Zapustila pa je tudi grenko dediščino razkola in rivalstva med Kajsiti in Jemenci, ki je bila do konca Omajadskega kalifata nenehen vir sporov in nestabilnosti.

source.title: Battle of Marj Rahit (684)
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj Rahit (Arabic: يوم مرج راهط, romanized: Yawm Marj Rāhiṭ) was one of the early battles of the Second Fitna. It was fought on 18 August 684 between the Kalb-dominated armies of the Yaman tribal confederation, supporting the Umayyads under Caliph Marwan I, and the Qays under al-Dahhak ibn Qays al-Fihri, who supported the Mecca-based Caliph Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr. The decisive Umayyad victory consolidated their power over Syria, paving the way for their eventual victory in the war against the Zubayrids. However, it also left a bitter legacy of division and rivalry between the Qays and the Yaman, which would be a constant source of strife and instability for the remainder of the Umayyad Caliphate.

Battle of Maysalun.headline: Bitka pri Majsalunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Majsalunu (arabsko: معركة ميسلون), znana tudi kot bitka v prelazu Majsalun ali bitka pri Kan Majsalunu (francosko: Bataille de Khan Mayssaloun), je bila štiriurna bitka med silami Arabskega kraljestva Sirija in francosko Levantsko armado 24. julija 1920 blizu Majsaluna v gorovju Antilibanon, okoli 25 kilometrov zahodno od Damaska.

Oktobra 1918 so arabski uporniki pod vodstvom hašemitskega emirja Fejsala med arabskim uporom proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu, ki ga je podpirala Britanija, zavzeli Damask. Fejsal je nato pod okriljem zavezniške vojaške okupacijske uprave »OETA East« v skladu s prejšnjim angleško-francoskim sporazumom sestavil vlado. Ko so francoske sile vstopile v deželo, so naletele na krajevne upore, marca 1920 pa so Fejsala razglasili za kralja Sirije. Mesec pozneje je Društvo narodov Sirijo kot mandat dodelilo Franciji.

source.title: Battle of Maysalun
paragraphs: The Battle of Maysalun (Arabic: معركة ميسلون), also known as the Battle of Maysalun Pass or the Battle of Khan Maysalun (French: Bataille de Khan Mayssaloun), was a four-hour battle fought between the forces of the Arab Kingdom of Syria and the French Army of the Levant on 24 July 1920 near Maysalun in the Anti-Lebanon Mountains, about 25 kilometres (16 mi) west of Damascus.

In October 1918, Arab rebels, under Hashemite Emir Faisal, captured Damascus during the British-backed Arab Revolt against the Ottoman Empire. Faisal then formed a government under the auspices of the Allied military occupation administration of "OETA East", consistent with an earlier Anglo-French agreement. The French encountered local revolts when their forces entered the country, and in March 1920, Faisal was proclaimed King of Syria. A month later, the League of Nations allocated Syria to France as a mandate.

Battle of Mecca (1916).headline: Bitka za Meko (1916)
paragraphs: Bitka za Meko je junija in julija 1916 potekala v muslimanskem svetem mestu Meka. Mekanski šarif Husein bin Ali, voditelj klana Banu Hašim, je 10. junija iz tega mesta sprožil upor proti osmanskemu kalifatu. Bitka za Meko je bila del arabskega upora v prvi svetovni vojni.

source.title: Battle of Mecca (1916)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mecca occurred in the Muslim holy city of Mecca in June and July 1916. On June 10, the Sharif of Mecca, Hussein bin Ali, the leader of the Banu Hashim clan, started a revolt against the Ottoman Caliphate from this city. The Battle of Mecca was part of the Arab Revolt of World War I.

Battle of Megiddo (1918).headline: Bitka pri Megidu (1918)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Megidu je med 19. in 25. septembrom 1918 potekala na ravnini Šaron pred Tulkaremom, Tabsorjem in Araro v Judejskem gričevju ter na ravnini Esdrelon pri Nazaretu, Afuli, Bejsanu, Džaninu in Samahu. Ime, ki ga opisujejo kot »morda zavajajoče«, saj so pri Tel Megidu potekali le zelo omejeni boji, je izbral britanski poveljnik Edmund Allenby zaradi njegovega svetopisemskega in simbolnega odmeva.

source.title: Battle of Megiddo (1918)
paragraphs: The Battle of Megiddo was fought between 19 and 25 September 1918, on the Plain of Sharon, in front of Tulkarm, Tabsor and Arara in the Judean Hills as well as on the Esdralon Plain at Nazareth, Afulah, Beisan, Jenin and Samakh. Its name, which has been described as "perhaps misleading" since very limited fighting took place near Tel Megiddo, was chosen by British commander Edmund Allenby for its biblical and symbolic resonance.

Battle of Megiddo (609 BC).headline: Bitka pri Megidu (609 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Ta bitka pri Megidu je po virih potekala leta 609 pr. n. št., ko je egiptovski faraon Neho II. vodil vojsko proti Karkemišu (v severni Siriji), da bi se pridružil zaveznikom, zatonu zapisanemu Novoasirskemu cesarstvu, proti vzpenjajočemu se Novobabilonskemu cesarstvu. Pri tem je moral prečkati ozemlje Kraljestva Juda. Judovski kralj Josija Egipčanov ni hotel spustiti skozi. Judovske sile so se z Egipčani spopadle pri Megidu, Josija je padel, njegovo kraljestvo pa je postalo egiptovska vazalna država. Bitko omenjajo hebrejska Biblija, grška 1. knjiga Ezdre in spisi judovskega zgodovinarja Jožefa Flavija.
Medtem ko je Neho II. dobil nadzor nad Kraljestvom Juda, so asirske sile ob padcu Harana izgubile proti Babiloncem in Medijcem, po čemer Asirija kot neodvisna država skoraj ni več obstajala.

source.title: Battle of Megiddo (609 BC)
paragraphs: This Battle of Megiddo is recorded as having taken place in 609 BC, when Pharaoh Necho II of Egypt led his army to Carchemish (northern Syria) to join with his allies, the fading Neo-Assyrian Empire, against the surging Neo-Babylonian Empire. This required passing through territory controlled by the Kingdom of Judah. The Judaean king Josiah refused to let the Egyptians pass. The Judaean forces battled the Egyptians at Megiddo, resulting in Josiah's death and his kingdom becoming a vassal state of Egypt. The battle is recorded in the Hebrew Bible, the Greek 1 Esdras, and the writings of Jewish historian Josephus.

While Necho II gained control of the Kingdom of Judah, the Assyrian forces lost to the Babylonians and Medes at the Fall of Harran, after which Assyria largely ceased to exist as an independent state.

Battle of Melitene.headline: Bitka pri Meliteni
paragraphs: V bitki pri Meliteni leta 1100 so turški Danišmendidi pod poveljstvom Gazija Gümüştigina pri Meliteni v vzhodni Anatoliji premagali križarske sile pod vodstvom antiohijskega kneza Bohemonda I.

Ko je Bohemond leta 1098 pridobil Antiohijsko kneževino, se je povezal z Armenci v Kilikiji. Ko je Gabriela iz Melitene in njegovo armensko posadko napadla danišmendidska država s severa, jim je Bohemond s frankovsko vojsko odšel na pomoč.

Danišmendidi Malika Gazija so odpravo napadli iz zasede in »večina križarjev je bila pobitih«. Bohemonda so ujeli skupaj z Rihardom iz Salerna. Med mrtvimi sta bila armenska škofa Maraša in Antiohije. Bohemonda so do leta 1103 držali za odkupnino, njegova rešitev pa je postala cilj enega od delov nesrečne križarske vojne leta 1101.

source.title: Battle of Melitene
paragraphs: In the Battle of Melitene in 1100, a Crusader force led by Bohemond I of Antioch was defeated in Melitene in eastern Anatolia by Danishmend Turks commanded by Gazi Gümüshtigin.

After acquiring the Principality of Antioch in 1098, Bohemond allied himself with the Armenians of Cilicia. When Gabriel of Melitene and his Armenian garrison came under attack from the Danishmend state to their north, Bohemond marched to their relief with a Frankish force.

Malik Ghazi's Danishmends ambushed the expedition and "most of the Crusaders were killed." Bohemond was captured along with Richard of Salerno. Among the dead were the Armenian bishops of Marash and Antioch. Bohemond was held for ransom until 1103, and his rescue became the object of one column of the ill-fated Crusade of 1101.

Battle of Misiche.headline: Bitka pri Misihi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Misihi (grško: Μισιχή), Mesihi ali Masiki (srednjeperzijsko in partsko: mšyk), datirana med 13. januarjem in 14. marcem 244 n. št., je potekala med Sasanidi in Rimljani pri Misihi v Mezopotamiji.

source.title: Battle of Misiche
paragraphs: The Battle of Misiche (Greek: Μισιχή), Mesiche, or Massice (Middle Persian: 𐭬𐭱‎𐭩‎𐭪‎‎‎‎ mšyk; Parthian: 𐭌‎𐭔‎𐭉‎𐭊‎ mšyk) (dated between January 13 and March 14, 244 AD) was fought between the Sasanians and the Romans in Misiche, Mesopotamia.

Bitka za Misrato (arabsko: معركة مصراتة), znana tudi kot obleganje Misrate, je bila bitka prve libijske državljanske vojne za nadzor nad Misrato. Bojevali so se vladi Moamerja Gadafija zvesti vojaki in Gadafijevi nasprotniki, uporniki, ki so držali Misrato, tretje največje mesto v Libiji. Po začetnih fazah vstaje je libijska vlada znova zavzela večino mest na zahodu države in Misrata je ostala edino večje mesto v Tripolitaniji pod uporniškim nadzorom. Mesto je kmalu postalo prizorišče ene glavnih bitk vojne, trpljenje njegovih prebivalcev pa je pritegnilo pozornost vsega sveta.

source.title: Battle of Misrata (2011)
paragraphs: The Battle of Misrata (Arabic: معركة مصراتة), also known as the Siege of Misrata, was a battle of the First Libyan Civil War for the control of Misrata. It was fought between troops loyal to the government of Muammar Gaddafi, and anti-Gaddafi rebels who held Misrata, the third largest city in Libya. Following the initial stages of the uprising, the Libyan government retook most towns in the west of the country, leaving Misrata the only major city under rebel control in Tripolitania. The city soon became the site of one of the war's major battles and the suffering of its citizens gained worldwide attention.
Bitka v Montgisardu je potekala med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom in ajubidskim sultanatom Egipta 25. novembra 1177 pri Montgisardu v Levantu, med Ramlo in Jibno.

Hudo gobavi jeruzalemski kralj Balduin IV. je skupaj z Renaudom de Châtillonom povedel krščanske sile proti muslimanskim četam pod vodstvom Saladina v enem najznamenitejših spopadov križarskih vojn. Egiptovsko vojsko so hitro razbili in jo preganjali dvanajst milj. Saladin je pobegnil v Kairo in tja prispel 8. decembra s komaj desetino vojske.

Saladin je Balduina IV. dve leti pozneje, leta 1179, sicer porazil v bitki pri Mardž Ajunu, a so muslimanski zgodovinarji njegov poraz pri Montgisardu šteli za tako hudega, da ga je odtehtala šele zmaga deset let pozneje v bitkah pri Cressonu in Hattinu ter pri obleganju Jeruzalema leta 1187.

source.title: Battle of Montgisard
paragraphs: The Battle of Montgisard was fought between the Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Ayyubid Sultanate of Egypt on 25 November 1177 at Montgisard, in the Levant between Ramla and Yibna.

Baldwin IV of Jerusalem, severely afflicted by leprosy, alongside Renaud de Châtillon, led Christian forces against Muslim troops led by Saladin in what became one of the most notable engagements of the Crusades. The Egyptian army was quickly routed and pursued for twelve miles. Saladin fled back to Cairo, reaching the city on 8 December, with only a tenth of his army.

While Saladin did defeat Baldwin IV in the Battle of Marj Ayyun in 1179, two years later, Muslim historians considered Saladin's defeat at Montgisard to be so severe that it was only redeemed by his victory ten years later at the battles of Cresson and Hattin and the Siege of Jerusalem in 1187.

Bitka za Mosul (arabsko: Ma'rakat al-Mawṣil) je bila velika bitka, ki so jo Irak in zavezniške sile sprožile, da bi mesto Mosul znova iztrgale Islamski državi (IS), ki ga je zavzela že junija 2014. Bila je največja konvencionalna kopenska bitka na svetu od zavzetja Bagdada leta 2003, največja posamična vojaška operacija na svetu od invazije na Irak leta 2003 in je veljala za najtežjo ulično bitko od druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Mosul (2016–2017)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mosul (Arabic: معركة الموصل, Ma'rakat al-Mawṣil) was a major battle initiated by Iraq and allied forces to retake the city of Mosul from the Islamic State (IS), which had seized the city years prior in June 2014. It was the largest conventional land battle in the world since the capture of Baghdad in 2003. It was also the world's single largest military operation overall since the 2003 invasion of Iraq and was considered the toughest urban battle since World War II.

Battle of Mount Cadmus.headline: Bitka pri gori Kadmos
paragraphs: Bitka pri gori Kadmos je potekala blizu Laodikeje pri Honah 6. januarja 1148 med drugo križarsko vojno. Rumski Seldžuki so premagali francosko križarsko vojsko pod vodstvom francoskega kralja Ludvika VII.

source.title: Battle of Mount Cadmus
paragraphs: The Battle of Mount Cadmus took place near Laodicea at Chonae on 6 January 1148 during the Second Crusade. The French Crusader army, led by Louis VII of France, was defeated by the Seljuks of Rum.

Battle of Mount Gindarus.headline: Bitka pri gori Gindaros
paragraphs: Bitka pri gori Gindaros ali bitka v Kirestiki leta 38 pr. n. št. je bila odločilna zmaga rimskega generala Publija Ventidija Basa nad partsko vojsko Pakorja, sina kralja Oroda, v okrožju Kirestika v Veliki Siriji.

source.title: Battle of Mount Gindarus
paragraphs: The Battle of Mount Gindarus or battle of Cyrrhestica in 38 BC was a decisive victory for the Roman general Publius Ventidius Bassus over the Parthian army of Pacorus, son of King Orodes, in the Greater Syria district of Cyrrhestica.

Battle of Mount Tabor (1799).headline: Bitka pri gori Tabor (1799)
paragraphs: Bitka pri gori Tabor je potekala 16. aprila 1799 med francoskimi silami pod poveljstvom Napoleona Bonaparta in Jeana-Baptista Kléberja ter osmansko vojsko damaščanskega paše Abdulaha paše al Azma. Bitka je potekala med obleganjem Akre v francoski invaziji na Egipt in Sirijo.

Ko je Bonaparte izvedel, da so iz Damaska proti Akri poslali osmansko vojsko, ki naj bi Francoze prisilila k opustitvi obleganja, je poslal odrede, da bi jo izsledili. Kléber je s svojo divizijo 2000 mož sklenil, da se z osmansko vojsko spopade blizu gore Tabor, in jo je zadrževal, dokler Bonaparte ni pripeljal 2000 mož okrepitev in izvedel obkoljevalnega manevra, s katerim je Osmane povsem presenetil v hrbet.
Francozi so v bitki prizadejali velike izgube in razpršili preostale al Azmove sile, ki so morale opustiti upanje na ponovno osvojitev Egipta, Bonaparte pa je lahko nadaljeval obleganje Akre.

source.title: Battle of Mount Tabor (1799)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mount Tabor was fought on 16 April 1799 between French forces commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte and Jean-Baptiste Kléber against an Ottoman army under Abdullah Pasha al-Azm, the pasha of Damascus. The battle took place during the siege of Acre of French invasion of Egypt and Syria.

Upon hearing that an Ottoman army had been sent from Damascus to Acre for the purpose of forcing the French to raise the siege, Bonaparte sent out detachments to track it down. Kléber led his division of 2,000 men and decided to engage the Ottoman army near Mount Tabor, managing to hold it off until Bonaparte led 2,000 reinforcements and engaged in a circling manoeuvre which took the Ottomans completely by surprise in their rear.

The resulting battle saw the French force inflict many casualties and scatter the remaining forces of al-Azm, forcing them to abandon their hopes of reconquering Egypt and leaving Bonaparte free to carry on the siege of Acre.

Battle of Mu'tah.headline: Bitka pri Muti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Muti (arabsko: Maʿrakat Muʿtah ali Ghazwat Muʿtah) je potekala septembra 629 (1. džumade al avala leta 8 po hidžri) med Mohamedovimi silami ter vojsko Bizantinskega cesarstva in njegovih gasanidskih vazalov. Potekala je v vasi Muta v Palaestini Salutaris vzhodno od reke Jordan, pri današnjem Keraku.

source.title: Battle of Mu'tah
paragraphs: The Battle of Mu'tah (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة مُؤْتَة, romanized: Maʿrakat Muʿtah, or Arabic: غَزْوَة مُؤْتَة Ghazwat Muʿtah) took place in September 629 (1 Jumada al-Awwal 8 AH), between the forces of Muhammad and the army of the Byzantine Empire and their Ghassanid vassals. It took place in the village of Mu'tah in Palaestina Salutaris at the east of the Jordan River and modern-day Karak.

Battle of Muzayyah.headline: Bitka pri Muzajahu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Muzajahu (arabsko: معركة المصيخ) je potekala med muslimansko arabsko vojsko in Sasanidskim imperijem. Ko je Halid ibn Valid odšel iz Ajn al Tamra v Dumat al Džandal na pomoč Ijadu ibn Ganmu, je perzijski dvor menil, da se je Halid z velikim delom vojske vrnil v Arabijo. Perzijci so sklenili muslimane pregnati nazaj v puščavo ter znova pridobiti ozemlja in ugled, ki ju je imperij izgubil. Odločili so se, da se s Halidom ne bodo več bojevali, z muslimani brez Halida ibn al Valida pa so se bili pripravljeni spopasti.

source.title: Battle of Muzayyah
paragraphs: Battle of Muzayyah (Arabic: معركة المصيخ) was between the Muslim Arab army and the Sasanian Empire. When Khalid ibn Walid left from Ayn al-Tamr to Dumat Al-Jandal for the help of Iyad ibn Ghanm, the Persian court believed that Khalid had returned to Arabia with a large part of his army. The Persians decided to throw the Muslims back into the desert and regain the territories and the prestige which the Persian Empire had lost. The Persians had resolved not to fight Khalid again, but they were quite prepared to fight the Muslims without Khalid ibn al-Walid.

Bitka pri Mikalah je bila ena od dveh velikih bitk (druga je bila bitka pri Platajah), ki sta končali drugi perzijski vdor v Grčijo med grško-perzijskimi vojnami. Potekala je 27. ali 28. avgusta 479 pr. n. št. na pobočjih gore Mikale na obali Jonije, nasproti otoka Samos. Bojevali sta se zavezništvo grških mestnih držav, med njimi Šparte, Aten in Korinta, ter Perzijsko cesarstvo Kserksa I.

Leto prej je perzijska napadalna vojska pod vodstvom samega Kserksa zmagala v bitkah pri Termopilah in Artemiziju ter osvojila Tesalijo, Beotijo in Atiko; v bitki pri Salamini, ki je sledila, pa je grška mornarica izbojevala nepričakovano zmago in tako preprečila osvojitev Peloponeza. Kserks se je nato umaknil, svojemu vojskovodji Mardoniju pa je pustil veliko vojsko, da bi naslednje leto dokončno premagal Grke.

source.title: Battle of Mycale
paragraphs: The Battle of Mycale was one of the two major battles (the other being the Battle of Plataea) that ended the second Persian invasion of Greece during the Greco-Persian Wars. It took place on 27 or 28 August, 479 BC on the slopes of Mount Mycale, which is located on the coast of Ionia opposite the island of Samos. The battle was fought between an alliance of Greek city-states, including Sparta, Athens and Corinth; and the Persian Empire of Xerxes I.

The previous year, the Persian invasion force, led by Xerxes himself, had scored victories at the battles of Thermopylae and Artemisium, and conquered Thessaly, Boeotia and Attica; however, at the ensuing Battle of Salamis, the Greek navy had won an unlikely victory, and therefore prevented the conquest of the Peloponnese. Xerxes then retreated, leaving his general Mardonius with a substantial army to finish off the Greeks the following year.

Battle of Myonessus.headline: Bitka pri Mionesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mionesu je potekala septembra 190 pr. n. št. Bila je del rimsko-selevkidske vojne: ladjevje Rimske republike pod vodstvom admirala Lucija Emilija Regila in njegovi rodoški zavezniki pod Evdamom so se spopadli s selevkidskim ladjevjem Poliksenidasa.

Poliksenidas je nasprotnike napadel, ko so izplovljali med Mionesom in polotokom Korikos. Rimsko-rodoško ladjevje je prvi napad zdržalo in se postavilo v bojni red. Evdam je nato rodoško eskadro povedel na desno krilo Rimljanov, preprečil selevkidski poskus obkolitve in premagal selevkidsko krilo na morski strani. Poliksenidas se je umaknil, potem ko je izgubil polovico ladjevja. Bitka je Rimljanom utrdila nadzor nad Egejskim morjem in jim omogočila vdor v selevkidsko Malo Azijo.

source.title: Battle of Myonessus
paragraphs: The Battle of Myonessus took place in September 190 BC. It was fought as part of the Roman–Seleucid War, pitting the fleets of the Roman Republic led by Admiral Lucius Aemilius Regillus and its Rhodian allies under Eudamus against a Seleucid fleet of Polyxenidas.

Polyxenidas attacked his adversaries as they were putting to sea between Myonessus and the Corycus peninsula. The Roman–Rhodian fleet withstood the first assault, managing to assume battle formation. Eudamus then led the Rhodian squadron to the right flank of the Romans, thwarting a Seleucid attempt at encirclement and overpowering the Seleucid seaward wing. Polyxenidas withdrew, having lost half of his fleet. The battle cemented Roman control over the Aegean Sea, enabling them to launch an invasion of Seleucid Asia Minor.

Battle of Myriokephalon.headline: Bitka pri Miriokefalonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Miriokefalonu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Miriocefalu; grško: Μάχη του Μυριοκέφαλου; turško: Miryokefalon Savaşı ali Düzbel Muharebesi) je bila bitka med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in seldžuškimi Turki v gorah zahodno od Ikonija (Konye) v zahodni osrednji Anatoliji 17. septembra 1176. Za bizantinske sile, ki so jih pri prehodu skozi gorski prelaz napadli iz zasede, je bila strateški neuspeh.

Leta 1161 sta rumski seldžuški sultan Kilidž Arslan II. in bizantinski cesar Manuel I. Komnen sklenila mirovni sporazum. Manuel je hotel s pomočjo te pogodbe zagotoviti mir svojim anatolskim provincam. Kilidž Arslan pa je moral odstraniti notranje tekmece in zbrati moči. Po smrti Nur ad Dina Zengija leta 1174 je sultan osvojil danišmendidske emirate in izgnal svojega brata Šahinšaha, vladarja Ankare. Emirji so pobegnili k Manuelu, ki je zahteval, naj mu sultan preda osvojena danišmendidska ozemlja, kar je bil sultan po pogodbi dolžan storiti. Kilidž Arslan pa je Manuelovo zahtevo prezrl.

source.title: Battle of Myriokephalon
paragraphs: The Battle of Myriokephalon (also known as the Battle of Myriocephalum, Greek: Μάχη του Μυριοκέφαλου, Turkish: Miryokefalon Savaşı or Düzbel Muharebesi) was a battle between the Byzantine Empire and the Seljuk Turks in the mountains west of Iconium (Konya) in west-central Anatolia on 17 September 1176. The battle was a strategic reverse for the Byzantine forces, who were ambushed when moving through a mountain pass.

In 1161, the Seljuk Sultan of Rum Kilij Arslan II and Byzantine Emperor Manuel I Komnenos concluded a peace agreement. Manuel wanted to achieve peace for his Anatolian provinces with the help of this treaty. Kilij Arslan needed to eliminate internal rivals and gather his strength. After the death of Nureddin Zangi in 1174, the Sultan conquered the Danishmend emirates and expelled his brother Shahinshah, the ruler of Ankara. The emirs fled to Manuel, who demanded the surrender of the captured territories of the Danishmendids to him, which the Sultan was obliged to do under the treaty. However, Kilij Arslan ignored Manuel's request.

Battle of Nahavand.headline: Bitka pri Nahavandu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nahavandu (arabsko: Maʿrakah Nahāwand, perzijsko: Nabard-e Nahâvand), pisano tudi Nihavand ali Nahavand, je potekala leta 642 med pravovernimi muslimanskimi silami pod vodstvom An Numana ibn Mukarina in sasanidsko vojsko kralja Jazdegerda III. Jazdegerd je pobegnil na območje Merva, a ni mogel več zbrati velike vojske. Bitka se je končala z zmago pravovernega kalifata, Sasanidi pa so nato izgubili okoliška mesta, med njimi Spahan (Isfahan). Spopad je bil za sasanidske sile katastrofalen poraz in pomeni konec organiziranega sasanidskega odpora. To je odprlo pot islamski širitvi v Perzijo in poznejši verski preobrazbi pokrajine.

Nekdanje sasanidske province so se v zavezništvu s partskimi in belohunskimi plemiči skoraj stoletje upirale v Tabaristanu, pokrajini južno od Kaspijskega jezera, tudi potem ko so pravoverni kalifat nadomestili Omajadi, in tako ohranjale sasanidski dvorni slog, zaratustrsko vero in perzijski jezik.

source.title: Battle of Nahavand
paragraphs: The Battle of Nahavand (Arabic: معركة نهاوند Maʿrakah Nahāwand, Persian: نبرد نهاوند Nabard-e Nahâvand), also spelled Nihavand or Nahawand, was fought in 642 between the Rashidun Muslim forces under An-Numan ibn Muqarrin and Sasanian army under King Yazdegerd III. Yazdegerd escaped to the Merv area, but was unable to raise another substantial army. The battle ended in a victory for the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanids consequently lost the surrounding cities including Spahan (Isfahan). The engagement resulted in a catastrophic defeat for the Sasanid forces and marks the end of organized Sasanid resistance. This opened the path for Islamic expansion into Persia and the subsequent religious transformation of the region.

The former Sasanid provinces, in alliance with Parthian and White Hun nobles, resisted for about a century in Tabaristan, the region south of the Caspian Sea, even as the Rashidun Caliphate was replaced by the Umayyads, thus perpetuating the Sasanid court styles, Zoroastrian religion, and Persian language.

Battle of Nahrawan.headline: Bitka pri Nahravanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nahravanu (arabsko: Ma'rakat an-Nahrawān) je julija 658 n. št. (safar 38 po hidžri) potekala med kufskimi silami četrtega pravovernega kalifa Alija ibn Abi Taliba in haridžiti, ki so jih sestavljali predvsem bralci Korana (kura) iz vsega Iraka. Haridžiti so bili skupina nekdanjih Alijevih zaveznikov v prvi fitni. Od njega so se ločili po bitki pri Sifinu, ko je Ali privolil, da spor z Muavijo ibn Abi Sufjanom, omajadskim guvernerjem Sirije, reši z razsodbo, kar je skupina označila za protikoransko. Po neuspelih poskusih, da bi si znova pridobil njihovo zvestobo, in zaradi njihovega upornega in nasilnega delovanja se je Ali s haridžiti spopadel blizu njihovega središča ob prekopu Nahravan, blizu današnjega Bagdada. Od 4000 upornikov so jih okoli 1200 pridobili z obljubo amnestije, večina preostalih 2800 pa je padla v bitki, ki je sledila. Po drugih virih je bilo žrtev od 1500 do 1800.

source.title: Battle of Nahrawan
paragraphs: The Battle of Nahrawan (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة النَّهْرَوَان, romanized: Ma'rakat an-Nahrawān) was fought between the Kufan forces of the fourth Rashidun caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Kharijites, who were primarily composed of qurra originating from across Iraq, in July 658 CE (Safar 38 AH). The latter were a group of former allies of Ali during the First Fitna. They separated from him following the Battle of Siffin when Ali agreed to settle the conflict with Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, the Umayyad governor of Syria, through arbitration, a move labeled by the group as against the Qur'an. After failed attempts to regain their loyalty and because of their rebellious and violent activities, Ali confronted the Kharijites near their headquarters by the Nahrawan Canal, near modern-day Baghdad. Of the 4,000 rebels, some 1,200 were won over with the promise of amnesty while the majority of the remaining 2,800 rebels were killed in the ensuing battle. Other sources put the casualties at 1500–1800.

Battle of Najaf (2003).headline: Bitka za Nadžaf (2003)
paragraphs: Bitka za Nadžaf je bila velika bitka ameriške invazije na Irak leta 2003. V prvi fazi se je ameriška 3. pehotna divizija bojevala, da bi mesto obkolila, v drugi pa so vojaki ameriške 101. zračnoprevozne divizije mesto počistili in zavarovali.

source.title: Battle of Najaf (2003)
paragraphs: The Battle of Najaf was a major battle in the 2003 U.S. invasion of Iraq. The first stage of the battle was fought when the U.S. 3rd Infantry Division fought to surround the town. The second stage was fought when soldiers from the U.S. 101st Airborne Division fought to clear and secure the city.

Battle of Najaf (2004).headline: Bitka za Nadžaf (2004)
paragraphs: Bitka za Nadžaf je bila bitka iraške vojne med silami Združenih držav in iraške vlade ter šiitsko uporniško Mahdijevo vojsko pod vodstvom Muktade al Sadra v iraškem mestu Nadžaf aprila 2004; spopad se je znova vnel avgusta 2004.

source.title: Battle of Najaf (2004)
paragraphs: The Battle of Najaf a battle during the Iraq War between United States-Iraqi government forces and the Shia insurgent Mahdi Army led by Muqtada al-Sadr in the Iraqi city of Najaf in April 2004 and conflict began again in August 2004.

Battle of Nasiriyah.headline: Bitka za Nasirijo
paragraphs: Bitka za Nasirijo je od 23. marca do 2. aprila 2003, med invazijo na Irak pod vodstvom ZDA, potekala med ameriško 2. ekspedicijsko brigado marincev in iraškimi silami. V noči s 24. na 25. marec je večina marincev polkovne bojne skupine 1 prek mostov prečkala mesto in napadla severno proti Bagdadu. Drugi deli so ostali v mestu in se bojevali z branilci, ki so se trdovratno upirali in koalicijskim silam prizadejali več deset žrtev, več kot v večini drugih bitk invazije. Odpor je prenehal 1. aprila.

source.title: Battle of Nasiriyah
paragraphs: The Battle of Nasiriyah was fought between the US 2nd Marine Expeditionary Brigade and Iraqi forces from 23 March to 2 April 2003 during the US-led invasion of Iraq.
