On the night of 24–25 March, the bulk of the Marines of Regimental Combat Team 1 passed through the city over the bridges and attacked north towards Baghdad. Other elements remained in the city to fight its defenders, who put up stiff resistance and inflicted several dozen casualties on coalition forces, more than in most other battles during the invasion. Resistance ceased on 1 April.

Battle of Nezib.headline: Bitka pri Nezibu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nezibu (arabsko: معركة نزب) (današnji Nizip na jugu osrednje Turčije) je potekala 24. junija 1839 med silami napol samostojne province osmanski Egipt in silami Osmanskega cesarstva. Egipčane je vodil Ibrahim paša, desnemu krilu egiptovske vojske pa je poveljeval Sulejman paša al Faransavi (nekdanji francoski častnik, ki je prestopil v islam). Osmane je vodil Hafız Mehmed paša, Helmuth von Moltke starejši pa je kot svetovalec poveljeval osmanskemu topništvu. Bitka se je končala z egiptovsko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Nezib
paragraphs: The Battle of Nezib (Arabic: معركة نزب) (present-day Nizip in south-central modern Turkey) was fought on 24 June 1839 between the forces of the quasi-autonomous province of Ottoman Egypt and those of the Ottoman Empire. The Egyptians were led by Ibrahim Pasha, with Soliman Pasha al-Faransawi (a former French officer who had converted to Islam) commanding the right flank of the Egyptian army. The Ottomans were led by Hafiz Mehmed Pasha, with Helmuth von Moltke the Elder playing an advisory role in command of the Ottoman artillery. The battle ended in an Egyptian victory.

Battle of Nihriya.headline: Bitka pri Nihriji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nihriji je bila vrhunec sovražnosti med Hetiti in Asirci za nadzor nad ostanki nekdanjega cesarstva Mitani v gornji Mezopotamiji v drugi polovici 13. stoletja pr. n. št.

source.title: Battle of Nihriya
paragraphs: The Battle of Niḫriya was the culminating point of the hostilities between the Hittites and the Assyrians for control over the remnants of the former empire of Mitanni in Upper Mesopotamia, in the second half of the 13th Century BC.

Battle of Nikiou.headline: Bitka pri Nikiuju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nikiuju je potekala maja 646 v Egiptu med arabskimi muslimanskimi enotami pod vojskovodjo Amrom ibn al Asom in Bizantinskim cesarstvom.

source.title: Battle of Nikiou
paragraphs: The Battle of Nikiou took place between Arab Muslim troops under General Amr ibn al-A'as and the Byzantine Empire in Egypt in May of 646.

Battle of Nisibis (217).headline: Bitka pri Nisibisu (217)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nisibisu je poleti leta 217 potekala med vojskami Rimskega cesarstva pod komaj ustoličenim cesarjem Makrinom in partsko vojsko kralja Artabana IV. Trajala je tri dni in se končala s krvavo partsko zmago, obe strani pa sta utrpeli velike izgube. Zaradi bitke je moral Makrin skleniti mir, Partom plačati ogromno vsoto in opustiti vdor v Mezopotamijo, ki ga je leto prej začel Karakala.

source.title: Battle of Nisibis (217)
paragraphs: The Battle of Nisibis was fought in the summer of 217 between the armies of the Roman Empire under the newly ascended emperor Macrinus and the Parthian army of King Artabanus IV. It lasted for three days, and ended with a bloody Parthian victory, with both sides suffering large casualties. As a result of the battle, Macrinus was forced to seek peace, paying the Parthians a huge sum and abandoning the invasion of Mesopotamia that Caracalla had begun a year before.

Battle of Notium.headline: Bitka pri Notiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Notiju (ali bitka pri Efezu) leta 406 pr. n. št. je bila špartanska pomorska zmaga v peloponeški vojni. Pred bitko je atenski poveljnik Alkibiad prepustil poveljstvo atenskega ladjevja, ki je blokiralo špartansko ladjevje v Efezu, svojemu krmarju Antiohu. Antioh je v nasprotju z ukazi skušal Špartance z majhno vabo zvabiti v bitko. Njegova strategija se je izjalovila in Špartanci pod Lizandrom so nad atenskim ladjevjem dosegli majhno, a simbolno pomembno zmago. Zmaga je pripeljala do Alkibiadovega padca in Lizandra uveljavila kot poveljnika, ki lahko Atence premaga na morju.

source.title: Battle of Notium
paragraphs: The Battle of Notium (or Battle of Ephesus) in 406 BC was a Spartan naval victory in the Peloponnesian War. Prior to the battle, the Athenian commander, Alcibiades, left his helmsman, Antiochus, in command of the Athenian fleet, which was blockading the Spartan fleet in Ephesus. In violation of his orders, Antiochus attempted to draw the Spartans into battle by tempting them with a small decoy force. His strategy backfired, and the Spartans under Lysander scored a small but symbolically significant victory over the Athenian fleet. This victory resulted in the downfall of Alcibiades, and established Lysander as a commander who could defeat the Athenians at sea.

Battle of Opis.headline: Bitka pri Opisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Opisu je bila zadnji večji vojaški spopad med Ahemenidskim imperijem in Novobabilonskim cesarstvom, ki je potekal septembra 539 pr. n. št., med perzijskim vdorom v Mezopotamijo. Babilonija je bila tedaj zadnja velika sila v zahodni Aziji, ki še ni bila pod perzijsko oblastjo. Bitka je potekala v strateškem obrečnem mestu Opis severno od prestolnice Babilon v današnjem Iraku ali v njegovi bližini in se končala z odločilno perzijsko zmago. Kmalu zatem se je perzijskim silam vdalo babilonsko mesto Sipar, nato pa so Perzijci domnevno brez nadaljnjega odpora vstopili v Babilon. Perzijski kralj Kir Veliki se je nato razglasil za kralja Babilonije in njenih podložnih ozemelj, s čimer je bilo konec njene neodvisnosti, vse nekdanje Novobabilonsko cesarstvo pa je postalo del širšega Ahemenidskega imperija.

source.title: Battle of Opis
paragraphs: The Battle of Opis was the last major military engagement between the Achaemenid Empire and the Neo-Babylonian Empire, which took place in September 539 BC, during the Persian invasion of Mesopotamia. At the time, Babylonia was the last major power in Western Asia that was not yet under Persian control. The battle was fought in or near the strategic riverside city of Opis, located north of the capital city of Babylon in modern-day Iraq, and resulted in a decisive victory for Persia. Shortly afterwards, the Babylonian city of Sippar surrendered to Persian forces, who then supposedly entered Babylon without facing any further resistance. The Persian king Cyrus the Great was subsequently proclaimed as the king of Babylonia and its subject territories, thus ending its independence and incorporating the entirety of the fallen Neo-Babylonian Empire into the greater Achaemenid Empire.

Battle of Otlukbeli.headline: Bitka pri Otlukbeliju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Otlukbeliju je potekala 11. avgusta 1473 med Akkojunli in Osmanskim cesarstvom.

source.title: Battle of Otlukbeli
paragraphs: The Battle of Otlukbeli was fought between the Aq Qoyunlu and the Ottoman Empire on 11 August 1473.

Battle of Panium.headline: Bitka pri Paneionu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Paneionu (tudi Panium, starogrško: Πάνειον, ali Paneas, Πανειάς) je potekala leta 200 pr. n. št. blizu Paneasa (Cezareje Filipove) med selevkidskimi in ptolemajskimi silami v okviru pete sirske vojne. Selevkide je vodil Antioh III. Veliki, ptolemajsko vojsko pa Skopas iz Etolije. Selevkidi so popolnoma zmagali, uničili ptolemajsko vojsko in osvojili provinco Celesirijo. Ptolemajsko kraljestvo si od poraza pri Paneionu ni nikoli opomoglo in ni bilo več samostojna velesila. Antioh si je zavaroval južni bok in se začel pripravljati na grozeči spopad z Rimsko republiko.

source.title: Battle of Panium
paragraphs: The Battle of Panium (also known as Paneion, Ancient Greek: Πάνειον, or Paneas, Πανειάς) was fought in 200 BC near Paneas (Caesarea Philippi) between Seleucid and Ptolemaic forces as part of the Fifth Syrian War. The Seleucids were led by Antiochus III the Great, while the Ptolemaic army was led by Scopas of Aetolia. The Seleucids achieved a complete victory, annihilating the Ptolemaic army and conquering the province of Coele-Syria. The Ptolemaic Kingdom never recovered from its defeat at Panium and ceased to be an independent great power. Antiochus secured his southern flank and began to concentrate on the looming conflict with the Roman Republic.

Battle of Pankaleia.headline: Bitka pri Pankaleji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pankaleji je potekala leta 978 ali 979 med vojsko, zvesto bizantinskemu cesarju Baziliju II., ki ji je poveljeval Bardas Fokas mlajši, in silami upornega vojskovodje Bardasa Sklera; spopad se je nazadnje končal s Sklerovim porazom in izgnanstvom. Viri o zaporedju in kraju dogodkov niso jasni: starejši raziskovalci so sledili Ivanu Skilici in bitko pri Pankaleji postavljali v marec 979 kot odločilno zmago cesarju zvestih sil, danes pa jo po poročilu Leona Diakona postavljajo v junij 978 in jo štejejo za Fokasov poraz.

source.title: Battle of Pankaleia
paragraphs: The Battle of Pankaleia was fought in 978 or 979 between the army loyal to the Byzantine emperor Basil II, commanded by Bardas Phokas the Younger, and the forces of the rebel general Bardas Skleros, which ultimately led to the defeat and exile of the latter. Sources are unclear in the succession and location of the events, so that while earlier scholars followed John Skylitzes in placing the Battle of Pankaleia in March 979 as the decisive victory for loyalist forces, today, following Leo the Deacon's account, it is placed in June 978 and regarded as a defeat for Phokas.

Bitka pri Paraitakeni (tudi Paraetacene; grško: Παραιτακηνή) je potekala leta 317 pr. n. št., med drugo od nasledstvenih vojn po smrti Aleksandra Velikega, t. i. diadoških vojn. V Paraitakeni, okrožju Perside, sta se vojski Antigona Enookega in Evmena iz Kardije spopadli v dolgi in krvavi bitki, ki se je končala neodločeno; ker je imel Antigon več izgub, bitko štejejo za Evmenovo zmago. Po bitki sta se vojski umaknili, Antigon proti satrapiji svojega zaveznika Pejtona v Mediji, Evmen pa proti Gabieni.

source.title: Battle of Paraitakene
paragraphs: The Battle of Paraitakene (also called Paraetacene; Greek: Παραιτακηνή) was fought in 317 BC, during the second of the succession wars that were fought after the death of Alexander the Great; the so called Wars of the Diadochi. In Paraitakene, a district of Persis, the armies of Antigonus Monophthalmus and Eumenes the Cardian engaged in a long and bloody battle that ended indecisively; since Antigonus suffered the most casualties the battle is seen as a victory for Eumenes. Both armies withdrew after the battle; Antigonus towards his ally Peithon's satrapy of Media, Eumenes towards Gabiene.

Battle of Pegae.headline: Bitka pri Pegah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pegah (bolgarsko: битка при Пиги; grško: Μάχη των Πηγαίων) je potekala med 11. in 18. marcem 921 na obrobju Carigrada med silami Bolgarskega cesarstva in Bizantinskega cesarstva v bizantinsko-bolgarski vojni v letih 913–927. Bitka je potekala v kraju Pege (»izvir«), imenovanem po bližnji cerkvi Device Marije pri Izviru. Bizantinske vrste so se zrušile že ob prvem bolgarskem napadu in njihovi poveljniki so pobegnili z bojišča. V begu, ki je sledil, je večina bizantinskih vojakov padla pod meči, utonila ali bila ujeta.

source.title: Battle of Pegae
paragraphs: The Battle of Pegae (Bulgarian: битка при Пиги, Greek: Μάχη των Πηγαίων) was fought between 11 and 18 March 921 in the outskirts of Constantinople between the forces of the Bulgarian Empire and the Byzantine Empire during the Byzantine–Bulgarian war of 913–927. The battle took place in a locality called Pegae (i.e. "the spring"), named after the nearby Church of St. Mary of the Spring. The Byzantine lines collapsed at the very first Bulgarian attack and their commanders fled the battlefield. In the subsequent rout most Byzantine soldiers were killed by the sword, drowned or were captured.

Battle of Pelekanon.headline: Bitka pri Pelekanonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pelekanonu, znana tudi v latinizirani obliki kot bitka pri Pelekanu, je potekala 10. in 11. junija 1329 med bizantinsko odpravo pod vodstvom Andronika III. in osmansko vojsko pod vodstvom Orhana I. Bizantinska vojska je bila poražena in nihče več ni poskušal osvoboditi mest v Anatoliji, ki so jih oblegali Osmani.

source.title: Battle of Pelekanon
paragraphs: The Battle of Pelekanon, also known by its Latinised form Battle of Pelecanum, occurred on June 10–11, 1329, between an expeditionary force by the Byzantines led by Andronikos IIl and an Ottoman army led by Orhan I. The Byzantine army was defeated, with no further attempt made at relieving the cities in Anatolia under Ottoman siege.

Battle of Pelusium.headline: Bitka pri Peluziju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Peluziju je bila prva velika bitka med Ahemenidskim imperijem in Egiptom. Ta odločilna bitka je faraonski prestol prenesla na perzijskega kralja Kambiza II. in pomenila začetek ahemenidske 27. egipčanske dinastije. Potekala je leta 525 pr. n. št. blizu Peluzija, pomembnega mesta na skrajnem vzhodu nilske delte, 30 km jugovzhodno od današnjega Port Saida. Pred bitko in po njej sta potekali obleganji Gaze in Memfisa.

source.title: Battle of Pelusium
paragraphs: The Battle of Pelusium was the first major battle between the Achaemenid Empire and Egypt. This decisive battle transferred the throne of the Pharaohs to Cambyses II of Persia, marking the beginning of the Achaemenid Twenty-seventh Dynasty of Egypt. It was fought in 525 BC near Pelusium, an important city in the eastern extremes of Egypt's Nile Delta, 30 km to the south-east of the modern Port Said. The battle was preceded and followed by sieges at Gaza and Memphis.

Battle of Philomelion (1116).headline: Bitka pri Filomeliju (1116)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Filomeliju (latinizirano Philomelium, današnji Akşehir) leta 1116 je bila vrsta spopadov v več dneh med bizantinsko odpravo pod cesarjem Aleksejem I. Komnenom in silami Rumskega sultanata pod sultanom Malik šahom, del bizantinsko-seldžuških vojn. Seldžuške sile so bizantinsko vojsko večkrat napadle brez uspeha; ko je Malik šah v teh napadih utrpel izgube, je zaprosil za mir.

source.title: Battle of Philomelion (1116)
paragraphs: The Battle of Philomelion (Latinised as Philomelium - modern Akşehir) of 1116 consisted of a series of clashes over a number of days between a Byzantine expeditionary army under Emperor Alexios I Komnenos and the forces of the Sultanate of Rûm under Sultan Malik Shah; it occurred in the course of the Byzantine–Seljuk wars. The Seljuk forces attacked the Byzantine army a number of times to no effect; having suffered losses to his army in the course of these attacks, Malik Shah sued for peace.

Battle of Poimanenon.headline: Bitka pri Pojmanenonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pojmanenonu je potekala v začetku leta 1224 (ali morda konec leta 1223) med silami dveh glavnih držav naslednic Bizantinskega cesarstva: Latinskega cesarstva in bizantinsko-grškega Nikejskega cesarstva. Nasprotni sili sta se spopadli pri Pojmanenonu, južno od Kizika v Miziji, blizu jezera Kuş.

source.title: Battle of Poimanenon
paragraphs: The Battle of Poimanenon or Poemanenum was fought in early 1224 (or possibly late 1223) between the forces of the two main successor states of the Byzantine Empire; the Latin Empire and the Byzantine Greek Empire of Nicaea. The opposing forces met at Poimanenon, south of Cyzicus in Mysia, near Lake Kuş.

Battle of Qarqar.headline: Bitka pri Karkarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karkarju je potekala leta 853 pr. n. št., ko je vojska Novoasirskega cesarstva pod vodstvom cesarja Salmanasarja III. pri Karkarju naletela na zavezniško vojsko enajstih kraljev, ki sta jo vodila Hadadezer, po asirsko Adad-idir, ki ga morda lahko enačimo s kraljem Ben-Hadadom II. iz Aram-Damaska, in izraelski kralj Ahab. Bitka, ki je potekala med asirskim osvajanjem Arama v letih 854–846 pr. n. št., je znana po tem, da se je v njej bojevalo več vojakov kot v kateri koli prejšnji bitki, in po tem, da nekatera ljudstva, kot so Arabci, z njo prvič stopijo v pisano zgodovino. Bitko opisujeta monolita iz Kurha. Po drugi različici asirskega seznama eponimov bi bitka potekala leta 854 pr. n. št.
Starodavno mesto Karkar, kjer je potekala bitka, navadno enačijo z današnjim arheološkim najdiščem Tel Karkur blizu vasi Karkur v guvernoratu Hama na severozahodu Sirije.

source.title: Battle of Qarqar
paragraphs: The Battle of Qarqar (or Ḳarḳar) was fought in 853 BC when the army of the Neo-Assyrian Empire led by Emperor Shalmaneser III encountered an allied army of eleven kings at Qarqar led by Hadadezer, called in Assyrian Adad-idir and possibly to be identified with King Benhadad II of Aram-Damascus; and Ahab, king of Israel. This battle, fought during the 854–846 BC Assyrian conquest of Aram, is notable for having a larger number of combatants than any previous battle, and for being the first instance in which some peoples enter recorded history, such as the Arabs. The battle is recorded on the Kurkh Monoliths. Using a different rescension of the Assyrian Eponym List would put the battle's date at 854 BC.

The ancient town of Qarqar at which the battle took place has generally been identified with the modern-day archaeological site of Tell Qarqur near the village of Qarqur in Hama Governorate, northwestern Syria.

Battle of Ramla (1101).headline: Bitka pri Ramli (1101)
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Ramli je potekala 7. septembra 1101 med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom in egiptovskimi Fatimidi. Mesto Ramla je ležalo ob cesti od Jeruzalema do Askalona, največje fatimidske trdnjave v Palestini. Fatimidski vezir Al Afdal Šahanšah je od leta 1099 do 1107 iz Askalona skoraj vsako leto napadal novoustanovljeno križarsko kraljestvo. Vojski sta se pri Ramli spopadli trikrat.

source.title: Battle of Ramla (1101)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Ramla (or Ramleh) took place on 7 September 1101 between the Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Fatimids of Egypt. The town of Ramla lay on the road from Jerusalem to Ascalon, the latter of which was the largest Fatimid fortress in Palestine. From Ascalon the Fatimid vizier, Al-Afdal Shahanshah, launched almost annual attacks into the newly founded Crusader kingdom from 1099 to 1107. It was thrice the case that the two armies met each other at Ramla.

Battle of Ramla (1102).headline: Bitka pri Ramli (1102)
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Ramli je potekala v Levantu 17. maja 1102 med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom in egiptovskim Fatimidskim kalifatom.

source.title: Battle of Ramla (1102)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Ramla (or Ramleh) took place in the Levant on 17 May 1102 between the Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Fatimid Caliphate of Egypt.

Battle of Ramla (1105).headline: Bitka pri Ramli (1105)
paragraphs: Tretja bitka pri Ramli je potekala 27. avgusta 1105 med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom in egiptovskimi Fatimidi.

source.title: Battle of Ramla (1105)
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Ramla (or Ramleh) took place on 27 August 1105 between the Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Fatimids of Egypt.

Battle of Raphia.headline: Bitka pri Rafiji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rafiji je potekala 22. junija 217 pr. n. št. blizu današnjega Rafaha med silami Ptolemaja IV. Filopatorja, kralja in faraona ptolemajskega Egipta, in Antioha III. Velikega iz Selevkidskega imperija med sirskimi vojnami. Bila je ena največjih bitk helenističnih kraljestev in starega veka sploh ter je odločila o oblasti nad Celesirijo.

source.title: Battle of Raphia
paragraphs: The Battle of Raphia was fought on 22 June 217 BC near modern Rafah between the forces of Ptolemy IV Philopator, king and pharaoh of Ptolemaic Egypt and Antiochus III the Great of the Seleucid Empire during the Syrian Wars. It was one of the largest battles of the Hellenistic kingdoms and of the ancient world, and determined the sovereignty of Coele-Syria.

Battle of Raqqa (2013).headline: Bitka za Rako (2013)
paragraphs: Bitka za Rako, znana tudi kot prva bitka za Rako, ki so jo uporniki poimenovali »napad Vsemogočnega«, je med sirsko državljansko vojno potekala za nadzor nad severnosirskim mestom Raka med sunitskimi islamističnimi uporniki in sirsko arabsko vojsko. Uporniške sile so ofenzivo sprožile v začetku marca 2013 in 5. marca razglasile, da mesto »skoraj v celoti nadzorujejo«, s čimer je Raka postala prva pokrajinska prestolnica, za katero so uporniki trdili, da so jo zavzeli. Na opozicijski strani sta bitko vodili predvsem Fronta al Nusra in Ahrar al Šam.

source.title: Battle of Raqqa (2013)
paragraphs: The Battle of Raqqa, also known as the First Battle of Raqqa and code named by rebels as the "Raid of the Almighty", was fought for control of the northern Syrian city of Raqqa during the Syrian civil war between Sunni Islamist rebel insurgents and the Syrian Arab Army. Rebel forces launched the offensive in early March 2013, and declared themselves in "near-total control" on 5 March, making it the first provincial capital claimed to come under rebel control in the civil war. The battle, on the opposition side, was primarily led by the al-Nusra Front and Ahrar al-Sham.

Battle of Raqqa (2017).headline: Bitka za Rako (2017)
paragraphs: Bitka za Rako (2017), znana tudi kot druga bitka za Rako, je bila peta in zadnja faza kampanje za Rako (2016–2017), ki so jo Sirske demokratične sile (SDF) sprožile proti Islamski državi (IS), da bi zavzele mesto Raka, od leta 2014 dejansko prestolnico ISIL. Bitka se je začela 6. junija 2017 ob podpori letalskih napadov in kopenskih enot koalicije pod vodstvom ZDA. SDF so operacijo poimenovale »velika bitka«. Končala se je 17. oktobra 2017, ko so SDF mesto Raka v celoti zavzele.

Bitka je potekala hkrati s sklepno fazo bitke za Mosul (2016–2017), ki se je začela sedem mesecev prej, v okviru prizadevanj CJTF–OIR in zaveznikov, da bi ISIL odvzeli regionalna središča moči in ga kot državo razgradili. Nadaljevala se je, ko so sirska arabska vojska in zavezniki začeli ISIL čistiti onkraj Evfrata in dosegli konec obleganja Dejr ez Zorja (2014–2017).

source.title: Battle of Raqqa (2017)
paragraphs: The battle of Raqqa (2017), also known as the second battle of Raqqa, was the fifth and final phase of the Raqqa campaign (2016–2017) launched by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) against the Islamic State (IS) with an aim to seize the city of Raqqa, the de facto capital of ISIL since 2014. The battle began on 6 June 2017, and was supported by airstrikes and ground troops from the US-led coalition. The operation was named the "Great Battle" by the SDF. It concluded on 17 October 2017, with the SDF fully capturing the city of Raqqa.

The battle ran concurrently with the conclusion of the Battle of Mosul (2016–2017), which had started seven months earlier, as part of an effort by the CJTF–OIR and its allies to strip ISIL of its regional centers of power and to dismantle it as a state. It continued while Syrian Arab Army and allies began clearing ISIL across the Euphrates, reaching the point of the lifting of the Siege of Deir ez-Zor (2014–2017).

Battle of Ras Lanuf.headline: Bitka za Ras Lanuf
paragraphs: Bitka za Ras Lanuf je bila dvodelna bitka v prvi polovici marca 2011 med libijsko državljansko vojno med silami, zvestimi libijskemu voditelju Moamerju Gadafiju, in silami, zvestimi Nacionalnemu prehodnemu svetu. Obe strani sta si prizadevali za nadzor nad mestom Ras Lanuf. Prva faza spopada je sledila dva dni po prvi bitki za Brego, ki je potekala v mestu Brega, približno 130 kilometrov vzhodno od Ras Lanufa. Ko so uporniki 4. marca zavzeli mesto, so prodirali naprej proti zahodu, da bi napadli Sirt, a so jih vladne sile odbile in 11. marca so vladne enote znova zavzele večji del Ras Lanufa.
notes: The miles conversion (81 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Ras Lanuf
paragraphs: The Battle of Ras Lanuf was a two-phase battle in early to mid-March 2011 during the Libyan Civil War between forces loyal to Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi and those loyal to the National Transitional Council. Both forces sought control of the town of Ras Lanuf. The first phase of confrontation followed two days after the First Battle of Brega which occurred in the town Brega, roughly 130 kilometres (81 mi) to the east of Ras Lanuf. After conquering the town on 4 March, the rebels pushed further west to attack Sirte but they were driven back by government forces and on 11 March, government troops reconquered most of Ras Lanuf.

Bitka v Re'imu (hebrejsko: קרב רעים; arabsko: معركة رعيم) je potekala 7. oktobra 2023, ko je Hamas napadel Izrael in sprožil vojno v Gazi. Ob 10.00, manj kot pet ur po Hamasovem napadu, so poročali o bojih pred vojaškim oporiščem Re'im, sedežem divizije Gaza.

V oporišču naj bi izraelske obrambne sile vodile operacije z droni in nadzor. Hamas naj bi objavil posnetek mrtvih izraelskih vojakov, ki jih je ubil v oporišču. Pozneje istega dne so izraelske obrambne sile (IDF) oporišče znova prevzele.

source.title: Battle of Re'im
paragraphs: The battle of Re'im (Hebrew: קרב רעים; Arabic: معركة رعيم) took place on October 7, 2023, when Hamas attacked Israel, initiating the Gaza war. At 10:00 am, less than five hours after Hamas attacked, fighting was reported outside of the Re'im Army Base, which is headquarters for the Gaza Division.

The base was reportedly the location of IDF drone and surveillance operations. Hamas reportedly posted a video of dead Israeli soldiers it had killed at the base. Later in the day, Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) regained control of the military base.

Battle of Resaena.headline: Bitka pri Resajni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Resajni blizu današnjega Ceylanpınarja v Turčiji je potekala leta 243 med silami Rimskega cesarstva pod vodstvom cesarja Gordijana III. in pretorijanskega prefekta Timeziteja ter silami Sasanidskega imperija v času vladavine Šapurja I. Zmagali so Rimljani.

source.title: Battle of Resaena
paragraphs: The Battle of Resaena or Resaina, near present-day Ceylanpınar, Turkey, was fought in 243 between the forces of the Roman Empire, led by the Emperor Gordian III and the Praetorian Prefect Timesitheus against the Sasanian Empire's forces during the reign of Shapur I. The Romans were victorious.

Battle of Ridaniya.headline: Bitka pri Ridaniji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ridaniji (arabsko: معركة الريدانية; turško: Ridaniye Muharebesi) je potekala 22. januarja 1517 v Egiptu. Osmanske sile Selima I. so premagale mameluške sile pod Al Ašrafom Tuman begom II. Turki so vkorakali v Kairo, odsekano glavo Tuman bega II., zadnjega mameluškega sultana Egipta, pa so obesili nad vhodna vrata v kairski četrti Al Guri. Po drugem izročilu so ga obesili na vrata in po treh dneh pokopali. V bitki je padel osmanski veliki vezir Hadım Sinan paša.

source.title: Battle of Ridaniya
paragraphs: The Battle of Ridaniya or Battle of Ridanieh (Arabic: معركة الريدانية; Turkish: Ridaniye Muharebesi) was fought on January 22, 1517, in Egypt. The Ottoman forces of Selim I defeated the Mamluk forces under Al-Ashraf Tuman bay II. The Turks marched into Cairo, and the severed head of Tuman bay II, Egypt’s last Mamluk Sultan, was hung over an entrance gate in the Al Ghourieh quarter of Cairo. Or, alternatively, he was hung from the gate and buried after three days. The Ottoman grand vizier, Hadım Sinan Pasha, was killed in action.

Battle of Río Salado.headline: Bitka pri Río Saladu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Río Saladu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Tarifi (30. oktobra 1340), je bila bitka zavezniških krščanskih vojsk kastiljskega kralja Alfonza XI. in portugalskega kralja Afonsa IV. proti zavezniškim muslimanskim vojskam marinidskega sultana Abu al Hasana Alija in emirja Granadskega emirata Jusufa I.

source.title: Battle of Río Salado
paragraphs: The Battle of Río Salado also known as the Battle of Tarifa (30 October 1340) was a battle of the allied Christian armies of King Alfonso XI of Castile and King Afonso IV of Portugal against the allied Muslim armies of Sultan Abu al-Hasan 'Ali of the Marinids and Emir Yusuf I of the Emirate of Granada.

Battle of Romani.headline: Bitka pri Romaniju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Romaniju je bil zadnji kopenski napad centralnih sil na Sueški prekop na začetku sinajsko-palestinske kampanje med prvo svetovno vojno. Potekala je med 3. in 5. avgustom 1916 blizu egiptovskega mesta Romani in kraja antičnega Peluzija na Sinajskem polotoku, 37 km vzhodno od Sueškega prekopa. Zmaga 52. (nižavske) divizije in konjeniške divizije Anzac egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) nad združeno osmansko in nemško vojsko, ki je prečkala Sinaj, je pomenila konec kampanje za obrambo Sueškega prekopa, znane tudi kot Offensive zur Eroberung des Suezkanals in İkinci Kanal Harekâtı, ki se je začela 26. januarja 1915.
notes: The miles (23 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Battle of Romani
paragraphs: The Battle of Romani was the last ground attack of the Central Powers on the Suez Canal at the beginning of the Sinai and Palestine campaign during the First World War. The battle was fought between 3 and 5 August 1916 near the Egyptian town of Romani and the site of ancient Pelusium on the Sinai Peninsula, 23 mi (37 km) east of the Suez Canal. This victory by the 52nd (Lowland) Division and the Anzac Mounted Division of the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) over a joint Ottoman and German force, which had marched across the Sinai, marked the end of the Defence of the Suez Canal campaign, also known as the Offensive zur Eroberung des Suezkanals and the İkinci Kanal Harekâtı, which had begun on 26 January 1915.

Battle of Ruspina.headline: Bitka pri Ruspini
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ruspini je potekala 4. januarja 46 pr. n. št. v rimski provinci Afriki med republikanskimi silami optimatov in silami, zvestimi Juliju Cezarju. Republikansko vojsko je vodil Tit Labien, Cezarjev nekdanji namestnik v galskih vojnah, ki je na začetku državljanske vojne prestopil na republikansko stran.

source.title: Battle of Ruspina
paragraphs: The Battle of Ruspina was fought on 4 January 46 BC in the Roman province of Africa, between the Republican forces of the Optimates and forces loyal to Julius Caesar. The Republican army was commanded by Titus Labienus, Caesar's former lieutenant during the Gallic Wars who had defected to the Republican side at the beginning of the civil war.

Battle of Salamis (306 BC).headline: Bitka pri Salamini (306 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Salamini leta 306 pr. n. št. je potekala pred Salamino na Cipru med ladjevjema Ptolemaja I. iz Egipta in Antigona I. Monoftalmosa, dveh diadohov, vojskovodij, ki so se po smrti Aleksandra Velikega med seboj bojevali za nadzor nad njegovim imperijem.

source.title: Battle of Salamis (306 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Salamis in 306 BC took place off Salamis, Cyprus between the fleets of Ptolemy I of Egypt and Antigonus I Monophthalmus, two of the Diadochi, the generals who, after the death of Alexander the Great, fought each other for control of his empire.

Battle of Samarra (363).headline: Bitka pri Samari (363)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Samari je potekala junija 363, med vdorom rimskega cesarja Julijana v Sasanidski imperij. Julijan je vojsko pripeljal do vrat Ktezifona, a mesta ni zavzel; ko je spoznal, da vojski na sovražnem ozemlju zmanjkuje živeža, je krenil proti Samari.

Bitka se je začela s sasanidskim napadom na rimsko zaščitnico, a je prerasla v veliko bitko. Julijan je bil v njej ranjen in je pozneje umrl, ne da bi izbral naslednika. Po njegovi smrti so Rimljani za cesarja izvolili Jovijana. Ta je obtičal globoko na sasanidskem ozemlju in brez zalog, zato je moral sprejeti mirovne pogoje.

source.title: Battle of Samarra (363)
paragraphs: The Battle of Samarra took place in June 363, during the invasion of the Sasanian Empire by the Roman emperor Julian. After marching his army to the gates of Ctesiphon and failing to take the city, Julian, realizing his army was low on provisions and in enemy territory, started marching towards Samarra.

The battle began as a Sasanian attack on the Roman rearguard, but developed into a major battle. Julian was wounded during the battle, and later died without choosing a successor. Following Julian's death, the Romans elected Jovian as emperor. Stranded deep in Sasanian territory and suffering from a lack of supplies, Jovian was forced to accept terms for peace.

Battle of Sardarabad.headline: Bitka pri Sardarabadu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sardarabadu (armensko: Սարդարապատի ճակատամարտ, Sardarapati chakatamart; turško: Serdarabad Muharebesi) je bila bitka kavkaške kampanje prve svetovne vojne, ki je od 21. do 29. maja 1918 potekala blizu Sardarabada v Armeniji med rednimi armenskimi vojaškimi enotami in milico na eni strani ter osmansko vojsko, ki je vdrla v vzhodno Armenijo, na drugi. Ker leži Sardarabad približno 40 kilometrov zahodno od prestolnice Erevan, bitka ni le ustavila osmanskega prodora v preostalo Armenijo, temveč je preprečila tudi popolno uničenje armenskega naroda. Odprla je pot ustanovitvi Prve republike Armenije in pogodbi iz Batumija, s katero je Osmansko cesarstvo priznalo Armenijo.
Po besedah Christopherja J. Walkerja bi, če bi Armenci to bitko izgubili, »bilo povsem mogoče, da bi beseda Armenija odtlej označevala le starinski zemljepisni izraz«.
notes: The miles conversion (25 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Sardarabad
paragraphs: The Battle of Sardarabad (Armenian: Սարդարապատի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Sardarapati chakatamart; Turkish: Serdarabad Muharebesi) was a battle of the Caucasus campaign of World War I that took place near Sardarabad, Armenia, from 21 to 29 May 1918, between the regular Armenian military units and militia on one side and the Ottoman army that had invaded Eastern Armenia on the other. As Sardarabad is approximately 40 kilometres (25 mi) west of the capital of Yerevan, the battle not only halted the Ottoman advance into the rest of Armenia, but also prevented the complete destruction of the Armenian nation. The battle paved the way for the establishment of the First Republic of Armenia and the Treaty of Batum: recognition of Armenia by the Ottoman Empire.
In the words of Christopher J. Walker, had the Armenians lost this battle, "it is perfectly possible that the word Armenia would have henceforth denoted only an antique geographical term".

Battle of Sarikamish.headline: Bitka pri Sarıkamışu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sarıkamışu je bil spopad med Ruskim in Osmanskim cesarstvom med prvo svetovno vojno. Potekala je od 22. decembra 1914 do 17. januarja 1915 v okviru kavkaške kampanje.

Bitka se je končala z odločilno rusko zmago. Osmanski načrt je temeljil na zelo gibljivih enotah, ki naj bi ob točno določenem času dosegle določene cilje, po nemških in napoleonskih taktičnih načelih. Osmanske sile pa niso bile ustrezno opremljene za ostre zimske razmere in so v gorovju Allahuekber utrpele hude izgube. Ocenjujejo, da je pred začetkom glavnega spopada zmrznilo okoli 25.000 osmanskih vojakov.
Po porazu je osmanski vojni minister Enver paša, ki je zasnoval strategijo pri Sarıkamışu, za izid okrivil Armence. Bitka je tako postala uvod v armenski genocid.

source.title: Battle of Sarikamish
paragraphs: The Battle of Sarikamish was an engagement between the Russian and Ottoman Empires during World War I. It took place from 22 December 1914, to 17 January 1915, as part of the Caucasus campaign.

The battle resulted in a decisive Russian victory. The Ottoman plan relied on highly mobile troops capable of reaching specific objectives at precise times, drawing on German and Napoleonic tactical principles. However, the Ottoman forces were inadequately equipped for the harsh winter conditions and suffered severe losses in the Allahuekber Mountains. It is estimated that approximately 25,000 Ottoman soldiers froze to death before the main engagement began.

Following the defeat, Ottoman Minister of War Enver Pasha, who had devised the strategy at Sarikamish, blamed the Armenians for the outcome. The battle subsequently became a prelude to the Armenian genocide.

Battle of Sarmin.headline: Bitka pri Sarminu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sarminu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Tel Danitu, je potekala 14. septembra 1115, ko je križarska vojska Rogerja iz Salerna presenetila in razbila vojsko seldžuških Turkov Bursuka ibn Bursuka iz Hamadana. Imenujejo jo tudi prva bitka pri Tel Danitu, da jo ločijo od bitke pri Habu leta 1119, druge bitke pri Tel Danitu.

source.title: Battle of Sarmin
paragraphs: The Battle of Sarmin, also known as the Battle of Tell Danith, took place on 14 September 1115 with Roger of Salerno's Crusader army surprising and routing the Seljuk Turkish army of Bursuq ibn Bursuq of Hamadan. It is also known as the First Battle of Tell Danith, distinguishing it from the Battle of Hab of 1119, the Second Battle of Tell Danith.

Battle of Satala (530).headline: Bitka pri Satali (530)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Satali je potekala junija 530 med silami Bizantinskega cesarstva in Sasanidskega (perzijskega) imperija blizu Satale v bizantinski Armeniji.

Perzijski vojskovodja Mihr-Mihroe je vojsko povedel na bizantinsko ozemlje z namenom, da zavzame Satalo, ki jo je branila manjša bizantinska vojska pod poveljstvom Sitasa in Doroteja. Perzijci so se utaborili blizu mesta in se pripravljali, da ga naslednji dan obkolijo.

source.title: Battle of Satala (530)
paragraphs: The Battle of Satala took place in June 530 between the forces of the Byzantine Empire and the Sassanid (Persian) Empire, near Satala in Byzantine Armenia.

The Persian general Mihr-Mihroe led an army into Byzantine territory, intending to capture Satala, which was defended by a smaller Byzantine force commanded by Sittas and Dorotheus. The Persians camped near the city and prepared to surround it the following day.

Bitka v Sderotu (hebrejsko: קרב שדרות; arabsko: معركة سديروت) se je začela 7. oktobra 2023, ko je Hamas sprožil obsežen nenaden napad na južni Izrael, ki ga je svet na splošno obsodil kot teroristično dejanje. Izraelsko mesto Sderot blizu meje med Izraelom in Gazo je bilo v izraelsko-palestinskem spopadu v Gazi pogosto tarča raketnih napadov in vdorov. Hamasovi borci so ubili številne civiliste in policiste.

source.title: Battle of Sderot
paragraphs: The battle of Sderot (Hebrew: קרב שדרות; Arabic: معركة سديروت) began on 7 October 2023, when Hamas launched a large-scale surprise attack on southern Israel, which was widely condemned as an act of terrorism. The Israeli city of Sderot (Hebrew: שְׂדֵרוֹת; Arabic: سديروت), located close to the border between Israel and the Gaza Strip, has frequently been the target of rocket attacks and incursions during the course of the Gaza–Israel conflict. Hamas militants killed numerous civilians and police officers.

Battle of Sebastopolis.headline: Bitka pri Sebastopolisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sebastopolisu je potekala leta 692 n. št. pri Sebastopolisu sredi teme Armeniakon med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in Omajadskim kalifatom. Z njo se je končal dolgoletni mir med silama, sklenjen leta 680.

Justinijan II. je hotel obnoviti ozemeljski obseg Rimskega cesarstva iz časa Justinijana I., zato je z vojaškimi pohodi obrnil politiko svojega očeta Konstantina IV. Že kmalu je prelomil pogodbo z Bolgari in napadel slovanska plemena pri Solunu, mnoge njihove pripadnike preselil v temo Opsikion in jih vključil v nov korpus pod Nebulom. Pozneje so se napetosti z Omajadi zaostrile, potem ko je Justinijan II. spodkopal veljavno pogodbo in se začel pripravljati na vojno.
Dolge bizantinske priprave pa so Omajadom dale dovolj časa, da so zbrali vojsko in vdrli na bizantinsko ozemlje.
notes: The English source breaks one sentence across its second and third paragraphs; the Slovenian moves the break to the sentence boundary.

source.title: Battle of Sebastopolis
paragraphs: The Battle of Sebastopolis was fought at Sebastopolis in the middle of the Armeniac Theme in 692 CE between the Byzantine Empire and the Umayyad Caliphate. With this battle, the long-standing peace between the two powers, established in 680, came to an end.

Justinian II sought to restore the territorial extent of the Roman Empire under Justinian I by pursuing military campaigns that reversed the policies of his father, Constantine IV. Early on, he broke a treaty with the Bulgarians and attacked Slavic tribes near Thessaloniki, resettling many in the Opsician Theme and enrolling them in a new corps under Neboulos. Later, tensions with the Umayyads increased after Justinian II undermined an existing treaty and prepared for war. However, the long preparation by the Byzantines gave sufficient time for the
Umayyads to assemble an army and invade Byzantine territories.

Battle of Shubra Khit.headline: Bitka pri Šubra Hitu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Šubra Hitu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Chobrakitu ali Chebreïssu) je bil drugi večji spopad francoske invazije na Egipt in Sirijo, potekala pa je 13. julija 1798. Na pohodu proti Kairu je francoska vojska naletela na osmansko vojsko iz mameluške konjenice in naborniških felahov pod Murad begom. Napoleon je svoje sile razporedil v pehotne kvadrate, taktiko, ki je pomagala odbiti mameluško konjenico, predvsem zato, ker teh kvadratov ni mogla prebiti brez hudih izgub. Prišlo je tudi do pomorske bitke, v kateri je francoska flotilja odbila osmansko.

source.title: Battle of Shubra Khit
paragraphs: The Battle of Shubra Khit (also known as the Battle of Chobrakit or the Battle of Chebreïss) was the second major engagement of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria and took place on 13 July 1798. On their march to Cairo, the French army encountered an Ottoman army consisting of Mamluk cavalry and drafted Fellahins under Murad Bey. Napoleon lined his forces up into infantry squares, a tactic which helped repel the Mamluk cavalry, largely due to their inability to penetrate them without suffering severe casualties. A naval battle also occurred, with an Ottoman flotilla being repelled by a French flotilla.

Battle of Sidi Bou Zid.headline: Bitka pri Sidi Bou Zidu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sidi Bou Zidu (Unternehmen Frühlingswind, operacija Pomladni veter) je potekala med tunizijsko kampanjo od 14. do 17. februarja 1943, v drugi svetovni vojni. Bojevali so se okoli Sidi Bou Zida, kjer so nemške in italijanske sile hudo zdelale veliko enot ameriške vojske. Sile osi so zaradi nje znova zavzele strateško pomembno mesto Sbeitla v osrednji Tuniziji.

Nemci so bitko načrtovali kot dvodelno napadalno-obrambno operacijo proti ameriškim položajem v zahodni Tuniziji. Generalpolkovnik Hans-Jürgen von Arnim je poveljeval več izkušenim bojnim enotam, med njimi 10. in 21. oklepni diviziji 5. oklepne armade, ki naj bi prodrli proti severu in zahodu, proti prelazu Kasserine, druga bojna skupina pa je Sidi Bou Zid napadla z juga. Napadu se je zoperstavil ameriški II. korpus pod generalmajorjem Lloydom Fredendallom.

source.title: Battle of Sidi Bou Zid
paragraphs: The Battle of Sidi Bou Zid (Unternehmen Frühlingswind/Operation Spring Breeze) took place during the Tunisia Campaign from 14–17 February 1943, in World War II. The battle was fought around Sidi Bou Zid, where a large number of U.S. Army units were mauled by German and Italian forces. It resulted in the Axis forces recapturing the strategically important town of Sbeitla in central Tunisia.

The battle was planned by the Germans to be a two-part offensive-defensive operation against U.S. positions in western Tunisia. Generaloberst Hans-Jürgen von Arnim commanded several experienced combat units, including the 10th Panzer Division and the 21st Panzer Division of the 5th Panzer Army, which were to sweep north and west towards the Kasserine Pass, while another battle group attacked Sidi Bou Zid from the south. Facing the attack was the II U.S. Corps under Major General Lloyd Fredendall.

Bitka pri Sifinu (arabsko: Maʿraka Ṣiffīn) je potekala leta 657 n. št. (37 po hidžri) med silami četrtega pravovernega kalifa Alija ibn Abi Taliba in silami omajadskega guvernerja Sirije Muavije ibn Abi Sufjana. Ime je dobila po kraju Sifin na bregovih Evfrata. Boji so prenehali, ko je Muavijeva sirska vojska, potem ko je Alijeva iraška vojska začela prevladovati, zahtevala razsodbo, v kar je Ali pod pritiskom večine svojih vojakov nerad privolil. Razsodba se je leta 658 končala brez odločitve, a je okrepila podporo Sircev Muaviji in njegov politični položaj ter oslabila Alijevo avtoriteto in med Iračani sprožila razkol. Bitka je bila del prve fitne in velja za velik korak k nastanku Omajadskega kalifata.

source.title: Battle of Siffin
paragraphs: The Battle of Siffin (Arabic: معركة صفّين, romanized: Maʿraka Ṣiffīn) was fought in 657 CE (37 AH) between the forces of the fourth Rashidun caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib, and the forces of the Umayyad governor of Syria, Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan. The battle is named after its location Siffin on the banks of the Euphrates river. The fighting stopped after Mu'awiya's Syrian army called for arbitration when Ali's Iraqi army started to gain the upper hand, to which Ali reluctantly agreed under pressure from the majority of his troops. The arbitration process ended inconclusively in 658 though it strengthened the Syrians' support for Mu'awiya and his political position while weakening the authority of Ali and causing dissension among the Iraqis. The battle was part of the First Fitna and is considered a major step towards the establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate.

Battle of Singara (344).headline: Bitka pri Singari (344)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Singari je potekala leta 344 med rimskimi in sasanidskimi perzijskimi silami. Rimljane je osebno vodil cesar Konstancij II., perzijsko vojsko pa perzijski kralj Šapur II. Med devetimi bitkami, ki naj bi potekale v več kot dvajset let dolgi vojni, v kateri so prevladovala neodločena obleganja, je edina, o kateri so se ohranile podrobnosti. Perzijske sile so na bojišču sicer zmagale, a sta obe strani utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Singara (344)
paragraphs: The Battle of Singara was fought in 344 between Roman and Sasanian Persian forces. The Romans were led in person by Emperor Constantius II, while the Persian army was led by King Shapur II of Persia. It is the only one of the nine pitched battles recorded to have been fought in a war of over twenty years, marked primarily by indecisive siege warfare, of which any details have been preserved. Although the Persian forces prevailed on the battlefield, both sides suffered heavy casualties.

Battle of Sinop.headline: Bitka pri Sinopu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sinopu ali Sinope je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala 30. novembra 1853 med carsko Rusijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom v začetni fazi krimske vojne (1853–1856). Potekala je pri Sinopu, pristanišču na južni obali Črnega morja (severni obali anatolske Turčije). Ruska eskadra je napadla in odločilno premagala osmansko eskadro, zasidrano v sinopskem pristanišču. Ruske sile pod vodstvom admirala Pavla Nahimova so štele šest linijskih ladij, dve fregati in tri oborožene parnike, osmanski branilci pod poveljstvom viceadmirala Osmana paše pa so imeli sedem fregat, tri korvete in dva oborožena parnika.

source.title: Battle of Sinop
paragraphs: The Battle of Sinop, or the Battle of Sinope, was a naval battle that took place on 30 November 1853 between Imperial Russia and the Ottoman Empire during the opening phase of the Crimean War (1853–1856). It took place at Sinop, a sea port on the southern shore of the Black Sea (the northern shore of Anatolian Turkey). A Russian squadron attacked and decisively defeated an Ottoman squadron anchored in Sinop's harbor. The Russian force consisted of six ships of the line, two frigates and three armed steamers, led by Admiral Pavel Nakhimov; the Ottoman defenders were seven frigates, three corvettes and two armed steamers, commanded by Vice Admiral Osman Pasha.

Battle of Sirte (2011).headline: Bitka za Sirt (2011)
paragraphs: Bitka za Sirt je bila zadnja in najbolj odločilna bitka prve libijske državljanske vojne. Začela se je, ko je Narodnoosvobodilna vojska napadla zadnje ostanke libijske vojske, ki so bili še zvesti Moamerju Gadafiju, v njegovem rojstnem mestu in določeni prestolnici Sirtu ob zalivu Sidra. Septembra 2011 sta bila Sirt in Bani Valid zadnji oporišči Gadafijevih privržencev, Nacionalni prehodni svet pa je upal, da bo padec Sirta končal vojno. Z bitko in dogodki po njej je padlo zadnje oporišče Gadafijevih privržencev. Gadafi in njegov sin Mutasim sta bila ranjena in ujeta, nato pa v manj kot uri v priporu mučena in ubita. Mesec dni dolga bitka je Sirt skoraj povsem spremenila v ruševine, veliko stavb je bilo poškodovanih ali povsem uničenih.

source.title: Battle of Sirte (2011)
paragraphs: The Battle of Sirte was the final and most decisive battle of the First Libyan Civil War, beginning when the National Liberation Army attacked the last remnants of the Libyan army still loyal to Muammar Gaddafi in his hometown and designated capital of Sirte, on the Gulf of Sidra. As of September 2011, Sirte and Bani Walid were the last strongholds of Gaddafi loyalists and the National Transitional Council hoped that the fall of Sirte would bring the war to an end. The battle and its aftermath marked the fall of the final stronghold of Gaddafi loyalists. Both Gaddafi and his son, Mutassim, were wounded and captured, then tortured and killed in custody less than an hour later. The month-long battle left Sirte almost completely in ruins, with many buildings damaged or totally destroyed.

Battle of Skafida.headline: Bitka pri Skafidi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Skafidi (bolgarsko: Битка при Скафида) je bil spopad med Bolgarskim cesarstvom in Bizantinskim cesarstvom, ki je potekal leta 1304 blizu Porosa (Burgasa) v današnji Bolgariji. Končal se je z bolgarsko zmago.
Bolgarsko cesarstvo je zato premagalo krizo s konca 13. stoletja, doseglo notranjo stabilnost in si znova pridobilo večji del Trakije. Bizanc mu nekaj časa ni bil resna grožnja.

source.title: Battle of Skafida
paragraphs: The Battle of Skafida (Bulgarian: Битка при Скафида) was an engagement between the Bulgarian Empire and the Byzantine Empire which occurred in 1304 near Poros (Burgas), modern Bulgaria. The outcome was Bulgarian victory.

As a result, the Bulgarian Empire overcame the crisis from the end of the 13th century, achieved internal stability and regained most of Thrace. For a time afterwards, Byzantium was not a serious threat to it.

Battle of Solachon.headline: Bitka pri Solahonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Solahonu je potekala leta 586 n. št. v severni Mezopotamiji med vzhodnorimskimi (bizantinskimi) silami pod vodstvom Filipika in sasanidskimi Perzijci pod Kardariganom. Spopad je bil del bizantinsko-sasanidske vojne v letih 572–591. Bitka pri Solahonu se je končala z veliko bizantinsko zmago, ki je izboljšala bizantinski položaj v Mezopotamiji, vendar nazadnje ni bila odločilna. Vojna se je vlekla do leta 591, ko se je končala z dogovorom med Mavricijem in perzijskim šahom Hosrovom II. (vladal 590–628).

source.title: Battle of Solachon
paragraphs: The Battle of Solachon was fought in 586 CE in northern Mesopotamia between the East Roman (Byzantine) forces, led by Philippicus, and the Sasanian Persians under Kardarigan. The engagement was part of the Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591. The Battle of Solachon ended in a major Byzantine victory which improved the Byzantine position in Mesopotamia, but it was not in the end decisive. The war dragged on until 591, when it ended with a negotiated settlement between Maurice and the Persian shah Khosrau II (r. 590–628).

Battle of Susa.headline: Bitka za Suzo
paragraphs: Bitka za Suzo je bila bitka med Asirci in Elamci. Asirski kralj Asurbanipal je bil sit elamskih napadov na Mezopotamce, zato se je odločil, da bo za kazen uničil Suzo.

Leta 647 pr. n. št. je Asurbanipal mesto zravnal z zemljo med vojno, v kateri so prebivalci Suze, kot kaže, sodelovali na nasprotni strani. Glinena tablica, ki jo je leta 1854 v Ninivah izkopal Austen Henry Layard, Asurbanipala prikazuje kot »maščevalca«, ki se je hotel maščevati za ponižanja, ki so jih Elamci stoletja prizadevali Mezopotamcem. Po uspešnem obleganju Suze Asurbanipal narekuje asirsko maščevanje:

source.title: Battle of Susa
paragraphs: The Battle of Susa was a battle involving Assyrians and Elamites. The Assyrian king Ashurbanipal, had grown tired of the Elamites' attacks on the Mesopotamians, and he decided to destroy Susa as punishment.

In 647 BC, the Assyrian king Ashurbanipal leveled the city during a war in which the people of Susa apparently participated on the other side. A tablet unearthed in 1854 by Austen Henry Layard in Nineveh reveals Ashurbanipal as an "avenger", seeking retribution for the humiliations the Elamites had inflicted on the Mesopotamians over the centuries. Ashurbanipal dictates Assyrian retribution after his successful siege of Susa:

Battle of Svindax.headline: Bitka pri Svindaksu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Svindaksu (gruzijsko: სვინდაქსის ბრძოლა) je potekala spomladi 1022 med bizantinsko vojsko cesarja Bazilija II. in gruzijsko vojsko kralja Giorgija I.

source.title: Battle of Svindax
paragraphs: The Battle of Svindax (Georgian: სვინდაქსის ბრძოლა) was fought during the spring of 1022 between the Byzantine army of Emperor Basil II and the Georgian army of King George I.

Battle of Syme.headline: Bitka pri Simiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Simiju je bila pomorska bitka med Šparto in Atenami leta 411 pr. n. št., med peloponeško vojno. Potekala je blizu otoka Simi v jugovzhodnem Egejskem morju.

Leta 411 so Špartanci sklenili zavezništvo s Perzijo. Sklenil ga je Terimen, ki je po koncu pogajanj špartansko ladjevje predal Astiohu; Terimen je pozneje utonil na morju. Astioh je dobil ukaz, naj odpluje v Knid in se tam sreča s sedemindvajsetimi ladjami iz Kavna, ki so jih zanje opremili Perzijci. Atensko ladjevje je bilo medtem nameščeno na Samosu pod poveljstvom Harmina. Harmin je od Melijcev izvedel, da Špartanci prihajajo, in se pripravil, da Astioha prestreže pri Simiju.

source.title: Battle of Syme
paragraphs: The Battle of Syme was a naval battle in 411 BC between Sparta and Athens, during the Peloponnesian War. It took place near the island of Syme in the south-eastern Aegean Sea.

In 411, the Spartans made an alliance with Persia. The alliance was made by Therimenes, who handed the Spartan fleet over to Astyochus once the negotiations were complete; Therimenes later drowned at sea. Astyochus was instructed to sail to Cnidus to meet up with twenty-seven ships from Caunus, equipped for them by the Persians. Meanwhile, the Athenian fleet was stationed at Samos under the command of Charminus. Charminus knew the Spartans were coming, having been informed by the Melians, and prepared to meet Astyochus at Syme.

Bitka za Tel el-Kebir (pogosto zapisano Tel-El-Kebir), ki je potekala 13. septembra 1882 pri Tel el-Kebirju v Egiptu, 110 km severno-severovzhodno od Kaira, je bila odločilni spopad angleško-egiptovske vojne leta 1882. Britanska vojska pod vodstvom generalpodpolkovnika sira Garneta Wolseleyja se je pod okriljem teme približala vkopanim egiptovskim silam pod poveljstvom Ahmeda Urabija in jih premagala z nenadnim napadom.

source.title: Battle of Tell El Kebir
paragraphs: The Battle of Tel El Kebir (often spelled Tel-El-Kebir), fought on 13 September 1882 at Tell El Kebir in Egypt, 110 km north-north-east of Cairo, proved the decisive engagement of the Anglo-Egyptian War of 1882. A British army led by Lieutenant General Sir Garnet Wolseley approached under cover of darkness and defeated an entrenched Egyptian force under the command of Ahmed ʻUrabi in a sudden assault.

Battle of Thapsus.headline: Bitka pri Tapsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tapsu je bil vojaški spopad, ki je potekal 6. aprila 46 pr. n. št. blizu Tapsa (v današnji Tuniziji). Sile Julija Cezarja so premagale sile optimatov pod vodstvom Kvinta Cecilija Metela Scipiona. Kmalu nato so si vzeli življenje Scipion in njegov zaveznik Mark Porcij Katon Utiški (Katon Mlajši), numidijski kralj Juba in njegov rimski zaveznik Mark Petrej.

source.title: Battle of Thapsus
paragraphs: The Battle of Thapsus was a military engagement that took place on April 6, 46 BC near Thapsus (in modern Tunisia). The forces of the Optimates, led by Quintus Caecilius Metellus Scipio, were defeated by the forces of Julius Caesar. It was followed shortly by the suicides of Scipio and his ally, Marcus Porcius Cato Uticensis (Cato the Younger), the Numidian king Juba, and his Roman peer Marcus Petreius.

Battle of the Bagradas (49 BC).headline: Bitka pri Bagradi (49 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bagradi (49 pr. n. št.) je potekala 24. avgusta blizu reke Bagrade (antično ime reke Medžerde) na ozemlju današnje Tunizije med Cezarjevim vojskovodjo Gajem Skribonijem Kurionom ter pompejanskimi republikanci pod Publijem Atijem Varom in numidijskim kraljem Jubo I. Končala se je s hudim porazom Cezarjevih sil in Kurionovo smrtjo.

source.title: Battle of the Bagradas (49 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Bagradas (49 BC) occurred near the Bagradas River (the classical name of the Medjerda) in what is now Tunisia on 24 August and was fought between Julius Caesar's general Gaius Scribonius Curio and the Pompeian Republicans under Publius Attius Varus and King Juba I of Numidia. The result was a crushing defeat for the Caesarean forces and the death of Curio.

Battle of the Bagradas River (255 BC).headline: Bitka pri Bagradi (255 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri reki Bagradi (antično ime Medžerde), znana tudi kot bitka pri Tunisu, je bila zmaga kartažanske vojske pod vodstvom Ksantipa nad rimsko vojsko pod vodstvom Marka Atilija Regula spomladi leta 255 pr. n. št., v devetem letu prve punske vojne. Leto prej si je novo zgrajena rimska vojna mornarica zagotovila premoč na morju nad Kartagino. Rimljani so to prednost izkoristili za vdor v kartažansko domovino, ki je približno ustrezala današnji Tuniziji v severni Afriki. Ko se je ladjevje izkrcalo na polotoku Cap Bon in izvedlo uspešen pohod, se je vrnilo na Sicilijo, Regulu pa je pustilo 15.500 mož, da bi čez zimo obdržal mostišče v Afriki.

source.title: Battle of the Bagradas River (255 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Bagradas River (the ancient name of the Medjerda), also known as the Battle of Tunis, was a victory by a Carthaginian army led by Xanthippus over a Roman army led by Marcus Atilius Regulus in the spring of 255 BC, nine years into the First Punic War. The previous year, the newly constructed Roman navy established naval superiority over Carthage. The Romans used this advantage to invade Carthage's homeland, which roughly aligned with modern-day Tunisia in North Africa. After landing on the Cape Bon Peninsula and conducting a successful campaign, the fleet returned to Sicily, leaving Regulus with 15,500 men to hold the lodgement in Africa over the winter.

Battle of the Camel.headline: Bitka pri kameli
paragraphs: Bitka pri kameli, znana tudi kot bitka pri Basri (arabsko: Maʿrakat al-Jamal), je potekala leta 656 n. št. pred Basro v Iraku. Bojevali so se privrženci četrtega pravovernega kalifa Alija in osmanovci pod vodstvom Aiše, Talhe in Zubajra. Alijeve privržence so sestavljale predvsem kufske in medinske čete, njegove nasprotnike pa koalicija mekanskih in basranskih sil. Ali je bil bratranec in zet islamskega preroka Mohameda, Aiša pa Mohamedova vdova; Talha in Zubajr sta bila zgodnja spreobrnjenca v islam in vidna Mohamedova tovariša.

source.title: Battle of the Camel
paragraphs: The Battle of the Camel, also known as the Battle of Basra (Arabic: معركة الجمل, romanized: Maʿrakat al-Jamal), took place in 656 CE outside of Basra in Iraq. It was fought between the partisans of the fourth Rashidun caliph Ali and the Uthmaniyya led by Aisha, Talha, and Zubayr. Ali's loyalists consisted predominantly of Kufan and Medinan troops, while his opponents consisted of a coalition of Meccan and Basran forces. Ali was the cousin and son-in-law of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, while Aisha was a widow of Muhammad; Talha and Zubayr were both early converts to Islam and prominent companions.

Battle of the Chinese Farm.headline: Bitka pri Kitajski farmi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kitajski farmi je potekala od 15. do 17. oktobra 1973 med egiptovsko vojsko in Izraelskimi obrambnimi silami (IDF) v okviru jomkipurske vojne. Bojevali so se na Sinajskem polotoku, severno od Velikega grenkega jezera in tik vzhodno od Sueškega prekopa, blizu egiptovske kmetijske raziskovalne postaje. Izraelska vojska je območje poznala kot Kitajsko farmo, napačno ime, ki je nastalo, ker je raziskovalna postaja uporabljala japonsko opremo, japonske napise na strojih pa so izraelski opazovalci zamenjali za kitajske.

Boji so se začeli, ko so IDF sprožile operacijo Abirej-Lev (»Vitezi srca«), s katero so skušale vzpostaviti koridor do prekopa in omogočiti postavitev mostov za prehod. V okviru te operacije so Izraelci napadli egiptovske sile v Kitajski farmi in okoli nje.

source.title: Battle of the Chinese Farm
paragraphs: The Battle of the Chinese Farm took place during October 15 to October 17, 1973 between the Egyptian Army and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), as part of the Yom Kippur War. It was fought in the Sinai Peninsula, north of the Great Bitter Lake and just east of the Suez Canal, near an Egyptian agricultural research station. The area was known to the Israeli military as the Chinese Farm – a misnomer resulting from the research station's use of Japanese-made equipment, with Japanese writing on the machinery mistaken by Israeli observers for Chinese.

Combat began when the IDF launched Operation Abiray-Lev ("Knights of the Heart"): an attempt to establish a corridor to the canal, and allow bridges to be laid for a crossing. Under Abiray-Lev, the Israelis attacked Egyptian forces in and around the Chinese Farm.

Battle of the Delta.headline: Bitka v delti
paragraphs: Bitka v delti je bila pomorska bitka med Egiptom in Ljudstvi z morja okoli leta 1175 pr. n. št., ko je egiptovski faraon Ramzes III. odbil veliko invazijo z morja. Spopad je potekal na obalah vzhodne nilske delte in na meji Egiptovskega cesarstva v Siriji, čeprav natančni kraji bitk niso znani. Ta veliki spopad je zabeležen na stenah Ramzesovega mrliškega templja v Medinet Habuju.

source.title: Battle of the Delta
paragraphs: The Battle of the Delta was a sea battle between Egypt and the Sea Peoples, circa 1175 BC, when the Egyptian pharaoh Ramesses III repelled a major sea invasion. The conflict occurred on the shores of the eastern Nile Delta and on the border of the Egyptian Empire in Syria, although precise locations of the battles are unknown. This major conflict is recorded on the temple walls of the mortuary temple of pharaoh Ramesses III at Medinet Habu.

Battle of the Eclipse.headline: Bitka ob mrku
paragraphs: Talesov mrk je bil sončni mrk, ki ga je po pričevanju starogrškega zgodovinarja Herodota (ki je pisal okoli 150 let pozneje) natančno napovedal grški filozof Tales iz Mileta. Če je Herodotovo poročilo točno, je to najstarejši zabeleženi mrk, ki so ga poznali vnaprej. Po Herodotu so spremembo dneva v noč razumeli kot znamenje, ki je prekinilo bitko v dolgotrajni vojni med Medijci in Lidijci v Anatoliji (današnji Turčiji). Edini sončni mrk, ki ustreza domnevnemu kraju, času in pogojem vidnosti, potrebnim za razlago zgodovinskega dogodka, je mrk 28. maja 585 pr. n. št. Kako natanko je Tales lahko napovedal sončni mrk, pa ostaja negotovo, sodobni raziskovalci pa o resničnosti zgodbe dvomijo. Nekateri zagovarjajo druge datume ali drugačne razlage Herodotovega poročila.

source.title: Eclipse of Thales
paragraphs: The eclipse of Thales was a solar eclipse, which was, according to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus (writing about 150 years later), accurately predicted by the Greek philosopher Thales of Miletus. If Herodotus's account is accurate, this eclipse is the earliest recorded as being known in advance of its occurrence. According to Herodotus, the change of day into night was interpreted as an omen, and interrupted a battle in a long-standing war between the Medes and the Lydians in Anatolia (present-day Turkey). The only solar eclipse matching the presumed place, era, and conditions of visibility necessary to explain the historical event is the eclipse of 28 May 585 BC. How exactly Thales could have predicted a solar eclipse remains uncertain, however, and modern scholars are sceptical of the story's veracity. Some have argued for different dates, or for other interpretations of Herodotus's account.

Battle of the Eurymedon (190 BC).headline: Bitka pri Evrimedontu (190 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Evrimedontu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Sidi, je potekala avgusta 190 pr. n. št. Bila je del rimsko-selevkidske vojne: rodoško ladjevje pod admiralom Evdamom se je spopadlo s selevkidskim ladjevjem Hanibala.

Bitka je potekala pred Sido, ko je Hanibal napadel rodoško ladjevje, zasidrano v ustju reke Evrimedont. Ko so Rodošani premagali začetno zmedo, so proti selevkidskemu krilu na morski strani izvedli manever diekplous. Polovica selevkidskih ladij je bila hudo poškodovana, zato so se morale umakniti. Hanibal je sicer ohranil večji del ladjevja, ni pa mogel okrepiti preostale selevkidske mornarice v Efezu, ki je tako ostala osamljena in ranljiva. To je Rimljanom omogočilo, da so nadaljevali vdor v selevkidsko Malo Azijo.

source.title: Battle of the Eurymedon (190 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Eurymedon, also known as the Battle of Side took place in August 190 BC. It was fought as part of the Roman–Seleucid War, pitting the fleets of Rhodes under admiral Eudamus against a Seleucid fleet of Hannibal.

The battle took place off Side, when Hannibal attacked the Rhodian fleet docked in the mouth of Eurymedon River. After overcoming some initial confusion, the Rhodians executed the diekplous maneuver against the Seleucid seaward wing. Half of the Seleucid ships were heavily damaged, forcing them to withdraw. While Hannibal managed to preserve most of his fleet, he was unable to reinforce the rest of the Seleucid navy in Ephesus which left it isolated and vulnerable. This allowed the Romans to proceed with their invasion of Seleucid Asia Minor.

Battle of the Great Plains.headline: Bitka na Velikih ravninah
paragraphs: Bitka na Velikih ravninah je potekala leta 203 pr. n. št. na ozemlju današnje Tunizije med rimsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Publija Kornelija Scipiona ter zavezniškima kartažansko in numidijsko vojsko, ki sta jima poveljevala Hasdrubal Giskon oziroma Sifaks. Bitka je bila del druge punske vojne in se je končala s hudim porazom Kartagine.

source.title: Battle of the Great Plains
paragraphs: The battle of the Great Plains was fought in 203 BC in modern Tunisia between a Roman army commanded by Publius Cornelius Scipio, and allied Carthaginian and Numidian armies commanded by Hasdrubal Gisco and Syphax respectively. The battle was part of the Second Punic War and resulted in a heavy defeat for Carthage.

Battle of the Hellespont.headline: Bitka v Helespontu
paragraphs: Bitka v Helespontu, sestavljena iz dveh ločenih pomorskih spopadov, je potekala leta 324 med Konstantinovim ladjevjem, ki ga je vodil najstarejši sin Konstantina I., Krisp, in večjim ladjevjem pod Licinijevim admiralom Abantom (ali Amandom). Čeprav je bil v manjšini, je Krisp dosegel popolno zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Hellespont
paragraphs: The Battle of the Hellespont, consisting of two separate naval clashes, was fought in 324 between a Constantinian fleet, led by the eldest son of Constantine I, Crispus; and a larger fleet under Licinius' admiral, Abantus (or Amandus). Despite being outnumbered, Crispus won a very complete victory.

Battle of the Hellespont (321 BC).headline: Bitka ob Helespontu (321 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka ob Helespontu je potekala leta 321 ali 320 pr. n. št. med vojskama Kratera in Neoptolema na eni strani ter Evmenom na drugi. Bila je del vojn med Aleksandrovimi nasledniki. Evmena in Neoptolema je Perdika poslal, da bi Kratru preprečila prehod čez Helespont v Azijo, a je Neoptolem prestopil h Kratru. Evmen je bitko dobil, Krater in Neoptolem pa sta padla.

source.title: Battle of the Hellespont (321 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Hellespont took place in 321 or 320 BC between the armies of Craterus and Neoptolemus against Eumenes. It was part of the wars between Alexander's successors. Eumenes and Neoptolemus were sent by Perdiccas to prevent Craterus crossing the Hellespont into Asia, but Neoptolemus deserted to join Craterus. Eumenes won the battle, and both Craterus and Neoptolemus were killed.

Battle of the Iron Bridge.headline: Bitka pri Železnem mostu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Železnem mostu je potekala leta 637 n. št. med muslimansko vojsko pravovernega kalifata in bizantinsko vojsko. Bitka, v kateri so zmagali muslimani, je dobila ime po bližnjem kamnitem mostu z devetimi loki čez reko Oront (znanem tudi kot Džisr al Hadid), katerega vrata so bila obložena z železnimi rezili. Bila je ena zadnjih bitk med Bizantinci in pravovernim kalifatom v provinci Siriji. Po bitki je padla prestolnica province Antiohija, s čimer je bila provinca skoraj v celoti priključena pravovernemu kalifatu.

source.title: Battle of the Iron Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of the Iron Bridge was fought between the Muslim Rashidun army and the Byzantine army in 637 AD. The battle, which the Muslims won, took its name from a nearby nine-arch stone bridge over the Orontes River (also known as Jisr al-Hadid), which had gates trimmed with iron blades. It was one of the last battles fought between the Byzantines and Rashidun Caliphate in the province of Syria. In the aftermath of the battle, the province's capital, Antioch, fell, marking the near-complete annexation of the province into the Rashidun Caliphate.

Battle of the Mareth Line.headline: Bitka na Marethski črti
paragraphs: Bitka na Marethski črti ali bitka pri Marethu je bil napad britanske osme armade (general Bernard Montgomery) v drugi svetovni vojni v Tuniziji na Marethsko črto, ki jo je držala italijansko-nemška 1. armada (general Giovanni Messe). Bila je prva velika operacija osme armade od druge bitke pri El Alameinu 4 mesece in pol prej. Operacija Pugilist, prvi britanski napad, je 19. marca 1943 vzpostavila mostišče, poskus preboja pa so odbili protinapadi sil osi. Pugilist je odprl drugo smer napada in načrtovali so operacijo Supercharge II, obhodni manever prek prelaza Tebaga. Montgomery je okrepil napad s boka, ki je od 26. do 31. marca 1. armado prisilil k umiku na Vadi Akarit, 64 km globlje v Tunizijo.
notes: "4+1⁄2 months" is written as 4 mesece in pol; the miles (40 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Battle of the Mareth Line
paragraphs: The Battle of the Mareth Line or the Battle of Mareth was an attack in the Second World War by the British Eighth Army (General Bernard Montgomery) in Tunisia, against the Mareth Line held by the Italo–German 1st Army (General Giovanni Messe). It was the first big operation by the Eighth Army since the Second Battle of El Alamein 4+1⁄2 months earlier. On 19 March 1943, Operation Pugilist, the first British attack, established a bridgehead but a break-out attempt was defeated by Axis counter-attacks. Pugilist established an alternative route of attack and Operation Supercharge II, an outflanking manoeuvre via the Tebaga Gap was planned. Montgomery reinforced the flanking attack, which from 26 to 31 March, forced the 1st Army to retreat to Wadi Akarit, another 40 mi (64 km) back in Tunisia.

Bitka na Nilu (znana tudi kot bitka v zalivu Abukir; francosko: Bataille d'Aboukir) je potekala med 1. in 3. avgustom 1798 v zalivu Abukir v Egiptu med britansko kraljevo vojno mornarico in francosko vojno mornarico. Bila je vrhunec sredozemske kampanje leta 1798, ki se je začela tri mesece prej, ko je veliko francosko ladjevje z odpravo pod Napoleonovim poveljstvom odplulo iz Toulona v Aleksandrijo. Britansko ladjevje pod vodstvom kontraadmirala modre eskadre sira Horatia Nelsona je odločilno premagalo francosko ladjevje pod viceadmiralom François-Paulom Brueysom d'Aigalliersom, ki je Napoleonovo vojsko pospremilo v Egipt.

source.title: Battle of the Nile
paragraphs: The Battle of the Nile (also known as the Battle of Aboukir Bay; French: Bataille d'Aboukir) was fought between the Royal Navy and the French Navy at Aboukir Bay in Egypt between 1 and 3 August 1798. It was the climax of the Mediterranean campaign of 1798, which had started three months earlier after a large French fleet sailed from Toulon to Alexandria carrying an expeditionary force under Napoleon. A British fleet, led by Rear-Admiral of the Blue Sir Horatio Nelson, decisively defeated a French fleet under Vice-admiral François-Paul Brueys d'Aigalliers, which had escorted Napoleon's army to Egypt.

Battle of the Nile (47 BC).headline: Bitka na Nilu (47 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: V bitki na Nilu v začetku leta 47 pr. n. št. sta združeni rimsko-egiptovski vojski Julija Cezarja in Kleopatre VII. premagali vojski tekmecev, kraljice Arsinoje IV. in kralja Ptolemaja XIII., ter si zagotovili egiptovski prestol.

source.title: Battle of the Nile (47 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Nile in early 47 BC saw the combined Roman–Egyptian armies of Julius Caesar and Cleopatra VII defeat those of the rival Queen Arsinoe IV and King Ptolemy XIII and secure the throne of Egypt.

Battle of the Orontes.headline: Bitka ob Orontu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Orontu je potekala 15. septembra 994 med Bizantinci in njihovimi hamdanidskimi zavezniki pod vodstvom Mihaela Burtza ter silami fatimidskega vezirja Damaska, turškega generala Mandžutakina. Bitka se je končala s fatimidsko zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Orontes
paragraphs: The Battle of the Orontes was fought on 15 September 994 between the Byzantines and their Hamdanid allies under Michael Bourtzes against the forces of the Fatimid vizier of Damascus, the Turkish general Manjutakin. The battle was a Fatimid victory.

Battle of the Persian Gate.headline: Bitka pri Perzijskih vratih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Perzijskih vratih je bila del vojn Aleksandra Velikega. Pozimi leta 330 pr. n. št. se je Ariobarzan iz Perside s številčno šibkejšo perzijsko vojsko zadnjič postavil po robu pri Perzijskih vratih blizu Perzepolisa in makedonsko vojsko zadrževal približno mesec dni. S pomočjo ujetnikov ali krajevnega pastirja pa je Aleksander našel pot, po kateri je perzijske čete obšel in jih napadel v hrbet, ter v novi odločilni zmagi nad Ahemenidskim imperijem zavzel polovico prave Perzije.

source.title: Battle of the Persian Gate
paragraphs: The Battle of the Persian Gate took place as part of the Wars of Alexander the Great. In the winter of 330 BC, Ariobarzanes of Persis led a last stand with his outnumbered Persian army at the Persian Gate, near Persepolis, and held back the Macedonian army for approximately a month. However, through captured prisoners of war or a local shepherd, Alexander found a path around to flank the Persian troops from the rear, allowing him to capture half of Persia proper in another decisive victory against the Achaemenid Empire.

Bitka pri piramidah (francosko: Bataille des Pyramides), znana tudi kot bitka pri Embabi (bataille d'Embabech), je potekala 21. julija 1798 med francosko invazijo na Egipt in Sirijo. Bitka je potekala blizu vasi Embaba v osmanskem Egiptu, Napoleon pa jo je poimenoval po oddaljeni Keopsovi piramidi v Gizi.

Ko je Napoleonova vojska zavzela Aleksandrijo in prodirala proti Kairu, se je spopadla s silami pod mameluškim vodstvom Murad bega. Francozi so se razporedili v velike divizijske kvadrate, ki so zdržali ponavljajoče se konjeniške napade, nato pa so naskočili utrjeno vas Embaba. Francoske izgube naj bi znašale okoli 300 mož, ocene mameluško-osmanskih izgub pa se zelo razlikujejo, od več tisoč do kar 10.000. Poraz je strl Muradovo vojsko na bojišču in ga prisilil k umiku v Gornji Egipt.

source.title: Battle of the Pyramids
paragraphs: The Battle of the Pyramids (French: Bataille des Pyramides), also known as the Battle of Embabeh (bataille d'Embabech), was fought on 21 July 1798 during the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. Occurring near the village of Embabeh, Ottoman Egypt, the battle was named by Napoleon after the distant Great Pyramid of Giza.

After capturing Alexandria and advancing toward Cairo, Napoleon's army confronted Murad Bey's Mamluk-led forces. The French deployed into large divisional squares that withstood repeated cavalry charges before storming the fortified village of Embabeh. French losses were reported at about 300, while estimates for Mamluk–Ottoman casualties vary widely, from several thousand to as many as 10,000. The defeat shattered Murad's field army, forcing him to retreat to Upper Egypt.

Battle of the River.headline: Bitka ob reki
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki, znana tudi kot bitka pri Al Madharju, je potekala v Mezopotamiji (provinca Asoristan) med silami pravovernega kalifata in Sasanidskim imperijem. Muslimani pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida so premagali številčnejšo sasanidsko vojsko.

source.title: Battle of the River
paragraphs: The Battle of the River, also known as Battle of Al Madhar, took place in Mesopotamia (Asoristan Province) between the forces of the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Empire. Muslims, under Khalid ibn al-Walid's command, defeated the numerically superior Sasanian army.

Bitka pri jarku (arabsko: Ghazwat al-Khandaq), znana tudi kot bitka na Hendeku (Ma’rakah al-Khandaq) in bitka zaveznikov (Ghazwat al-Ahzab), je bila del spopada med muslimani in Kurajšiti. Kurajšiti so napredovali proti muslimanom, ti pa so se v Medini ubranili tako, da so na predlog Salmana Perzijca okoli naselbine izkopali jarek. Bitka je potekala leta 627 in je trajala okoli dva tedna; muslimani so poročali o petih ali šestih žrtvah, Kurajšiti pa o treh.

source.title: Battle of the Trench
paragraphs: The Battle of the Trench (Arabic: غزوة الخندق, romanized: Ghazwat al-Khandaq), also known as the Battle of Khandaq (Arabic: معركة الخندق, romanized: Ma’rakah al-Khandaq) and the Battle of the Confederates (Arabic: غزوة الاحزاب, romanized: Ghazwat al-Ahzab), was part of the conflict between the Muslims and the Quraysh. The Quraysh advanced towards the Muslims, who defended themselves in Medina by digging a trench around their settlement at the suggestion of Salman the Persian. The battle took place in 627 and lasted around two weeks, resulting in five to six casualties reported by the Muslim, and three casualties amongst the Quraysh.

Battle of the Zab.headline: Bitka ob Zabu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Zabu (arabsko: معركة الزاب), v strokovni literaturi imenovana tudi bitka ob reki Veliki Zab, je potekala 25. januarja 750 na bregovih Velikega Zaba na ozemlju današnjega Iraka. Pomenila je konec Omajadskega kalifata in vzpon Abasidskega kalifata, ki je obstajal od leta 750 do 1258.

source.title: Battle of the Zab
paragraphs: The Battle of the Zab (Arabic: معركة الزاب), also referred to in scholarly contexts as Battle of the Great Zāb River, took place on January 25, 750, on the banks of the Great Zab in what is now the modern country of Iraq. It spelled the end of the Umayyad Caliphate and the rise of the Abbasid Caliphate, which would last from 750 to 1258.

Bitka pri Uhudu (arabsko: Ghazwat ʾUḥud) je med muslimansko-kurajšitskimi vojnami potekala med zgodnjimi muslimani in Kurajšiti v dolini severno od Medine blizu gore Uhud v soboto, 23. marca 625 n. št. (7. šavala leta 3 po hidžri).

source.title: Battle of Uhud
paragraphs: The Battle of Uhud (Arabic: غزوة أحد, romanized: Ghazwat ʾUḥud) was fought between the early Muslims and the Quraysh during the Muslim–Quraysh wars in a valley north of Medina near Mount Uhud on Saturday, 23 March 625 AD (7 Shawwal, 3 AH).

Battle of Ullais.headline: Bitka pri Ulaisu
