paragraphs: Bitka pri Ulaisu (arabsko: معركة أليس) je sredi junija 633 n. št. v Iraku potekala med silami pravovernega kalifata in Sasanidskim perzijskim imperijem; včasih jo imenujejo bitka pri Krvavi reki, saj je v njej padlo ogromno perzijskih sasanidskih vojakov in krščanskih Arabcev.

Bila je zadnja od štirih zaporednih bitk med muslimanskimi napadalci in perzijsko vojsko. Po vsaki bitki so se Perzijci in njihovi zavezniki znova zbrali in se spet spopadli. Bitke so se končale z umikom sasanidske perzijske vojske iz Iraka, ki so ga muslimani pravovernega kalifata osvojili.

source.title: Battle of Ullais
paragraphs: The Battle of Ullais (Arabic: معركة أليس) was fought between the forces of the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Persian Empire in the middle of June 633 AD in Iraq, and is sometimes referred to as the Battle of Blood River since, as a result of the battle, there were enormous amounts of Persian Sasanian and Arab Christian casualties.

This was now the last of four consecutive battles that were fought between invading Muslims and the Persian army. After each battle the Persians and their allies regrouped and fought again. These battles resulted in the retreat of the Sasanian Persian army from Iraq and its capture by Muslims under the Rashidun Caliphate.

Battle of Umm Qasr.headline: Bitka za Um Kasr
paragraphs: Bitka za Um Kasr je bil prvi vojaški spopad iraške vojne. Na začetku vojne je bilo pristanišče Um Kasr eden prvih ciljev. Ko so zavezniške sile 21. marca 2003 napredovale po južnem Iraku, so amfibijske sile zavzele novo pristaniško območje Um Kasra. Napad so vodili kraljevi marinci britanske 3. brigade komandosov, okrepljeni z ameriškimi marinci 15. ekspedicijske enote (MEU) in poljskimi vojaki enote JW GROM. Iraške sile v starem mestu Um Kasr so se nepričakovano močno upirale, zato so območje šele po več dneh bojev očistili branilcev. Pristanišče so 25. marca 2003 razglasili za varno in ga znova odprli.

source.title: Battle of Umm Qasr
paragraphs: The Battle of Umm Qasr was the first military confrontation in the Iraq War. At the start of the war, one of the first objectives was the port of Umm Qasr. On 21 March 2003, as allied forces advanced across Southern Iraq, an amphibious landing force captured the new port area of Umm Qasr. The assault was spearheaded by Royal Marines of the British 3 Commando Brigade, augmented by U.S. Marines of the American 15th MEU and Polish JW GROM troops. Iraqi forces in the old town of Umm Qasr put up unexpectedly strong resistance, requiring several days' fighting before the area was cleared of defenders. The port was finally declared safe and reopened on 25 March 2003.

Battle of Wadi (1916).headline: Bitka ob Vadiju (1916)
paragraphs: Bitka ob Vadiju 13. januarja 1916 je bil neuspešen poskus britanskih sil v osmanskem Iraku med prvo svetovno vojno, da bi rešile obkoljene sile sira Charlesa Townshenda, ki jih je osmanska šesta armada oblegala v Kut al Amari.

General Fenton Aylmer je na pritisk britanskega vrhovnega poveljnika v regiji sira Johna Nixona napadel osmanske obrambne položaje na bregovih reke Vadi. Vadi je bila strma dolina potoka, ki je s severa tekel v Tigris, okoli 9,7 km nad Šejk Saadom proti Kut al Amari. Napad na splošno velja za neuspeh: Aylmer je Vadi sicer zavzel, a ga je to stalo 1600 mož. Zaradi britanskega neuspeha se je Townshend vdal skupaj z 10.000 možmi, kar je bila tedaj največja posamična vdaja britanskih čet. Britanci so Kut znova zavzeli februarja 1917, na poti do zavzetja Bagdada šestnajst dni pozneje, 11. marca 1917.

source.title: Battle of Wadi (1916)
paragraphs: The Battle of Wadi, occurring on 13 January 1916, was an unsuccessful attempt by British forces fighting in Ottoman Iraq during World War I to relieve beleaguered forces under Sir Charles Townshend then under siege by the Ottoman Sixth Army at Kut-al-Amara.

Pushed by regional British Commander-in-Chief Sir John Nixon, General Fenton Aylmer launched an attack against Ottoman defensive positions on the banks of the Wadi River. The Wadi was a steep valley of a stream that ran from the north into the River Tigris, some 6 miles (9.7 km) upstream towards Kut-al-Amara from Sheikh Sa'ad. The attack is generally considered as a failure, as although Aylmer managed to capture the Wadi, it cost him 1,600 men. The British failure led to Townshend's surrender, along with 10,000 of his men, in the largest single surrender of British troops up to that time. However, the British recaptured Kut in February 1917, on their way to the capture of Baghdad sixteen days later on 11 March 1917.

Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar.headline: Bitka v Vadi al Haznadarju
paragraphs: Bitka v Vadi al Haznadarju, znana tudi kot tretja bitka pri Homsu, je bila zmaga Mongolov nad mameluki leta 1299.

source.title: Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar
paragraphs: The Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar, also known as the Third Battle of Homs, was a Mongol victory over the Mamluks in 1299.

Battle of Walaja.headline: Bitka pri Valadži
paragraphs: Bitka pri Valadži (arabsko: معركة الولجة) je potekala maja 633 v Mezopotamiji med vojsko pravovernega kalifata pod vodstvom Halida ibn al Valida in Al Mutane ibn Harite ter Sasanidskim imperijem in njegovimi arabskimi zavezniki.
Halid je sasanidske sile premagal z različico taktike dvojnega obkoljevanja, podobne manevru, s katerim je Hanibal porazil rimske sile v bitki pri Kanah.

source.title: Battle of Walaja
paragraphs: The Battle of Walaja (Arabic: معركة الولجة) was fought in Mesopotamia in May 633 between the Rashidun Caliphate army under Khalid ibn al-Walid and Al-Muthanna ibn Haritha against the Sassanid Empire and its Arab allies.

Khalid defeated the Sasanian forces by using a variation of the double envelopment tactical manoeuvre, similar to the manoeuvre that Hannibal had used to defeat the Roman forces at the Battle of Cannae.

Battle of Yibneh.headline: Bitka pri Jibni
paragraphs: V bitki pri Jibni leta 1123 so križarske sile pod vodstvom Evstahija Grenierja med Aškelonom in Jafo strle fatimidsko vojsko iz Egipta, ki jo je poslal vezir Al Mamun.

source.title: Battle of Yibneh
paragraphs: In the Battle of Yibneh (Yibna) in 1123, a Crusader force led by Eustace Grenier crushed a Fatimid army from Egypt sent by vizier Al-Ma'mun between Ascalon and Jaffa.

Battle of Zafar.headline: Bitka pri Zafarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Zafarju je leta 632 potekala med Halidom ibn al Validom, tovarišem islamskega preroka Mohameda, in plemensko poglavarko Salmo. Halid jo je premagal, ona pa je umrla na bojišču. Bitka je bila del vojn Ride.
Voditeljica odpadnikov je jahala kamelo, obdana z zvesto telesno stražo.
V tretjem tednu oktobra 632 n. št. se ji je Halid ibn al Valid približal s skupino mudžahedinov ter pobil njo in njeno telesno stražo. V bitki je umrlo več sto odpadnikov.

source.title: Battle of Zafar
paragraphs: The Battle of Zafar took place in 632 between Khalid ibn al-Walid, a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, and a tribal chieftess called Salma. Khalid defeated her and she died on the battlefield. The battle was part of the Ridda Wars.
The apostate leader was riding on a camel, surrounded by her loyal bodyguards.
In third week of October 632 CE Khalid ibn al-Walid approached her with a group of mujahideen and slaughtered her and her bodyguards. Several hundred apostates died in this battle.

Beylik of Dulkadir.headline: Beglik Dulkadir
paragraphs: Beglik Dulkadir (turško: Dulkadiroğulları Beyliği) je bil eden od turških anatolskih beglikov (kneževin), ki so jih po zatonu Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov ustanovili oguški turški klani Bajat, Afšar in Begdili.

source.title: Beylik of Dulkadir
paragraphs: The Beylik of Dulkadir (Turkish: Dulkadiroğulları Beyliği) was one of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks (principality) established by the Oghuz Turk clans Bayat, Afshar, and Begdili after the decline of Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm.

Beylik of Teke.headline: Beglik Teke
paragraphs: Anatolski beglik Teke (turško: Tekeoğulları Beyliği) je bil ena od obmejnih kneževin, ki so jih po zatonu Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov ustanovili oguški turški klani. Prestolnica je bila Antalya na južni obali današnje Turčije. Beglik je leta 1321 ustanovila veja dinastije Hamididov, obstajal pa je do leta 1423, ko si ga je dokončno priključilo Osmansko cesarstvo.

source.title: Beylik of Teke
paragraphs: The Anatolian beylik of Teke (Turkish: Tekeoğulları Beyliği), was one of the frontier principalities established by Oghuz Turkish clans after the decline of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm. Its capital was Antalya, on the southern coast of modern Turkey. The beylik was established by a branch of the Hamidid dynasty in 1321 and lasted until 1423, when it was permanently annexed by the Ottoman Empire.

Beglik Tunis (arabsko: بايلك تونس) je bila pravna oblika Tunizije med letoma 1705 in 1881. Vladala mu je dinastija Husainidov, dokler niso ustanovili francoskega protektorata Tunizija. Izraz beglik se nanaša na vladarja, imenovanega tuniški beg. Ta je v času protektorata ostal formalni poglavar države, Husainidi pa so bili večinoma le simbolni vladarji.

Begi so ostali zvesti Visoki porti, vendar so vladali kot monarhi, saj so se postopno osamosvojili od Osmanskega cesarstva. Med letoma 1861 in 1864 je Beglik Tunis postal ustavna monarhija, saj je sprejel prvo ustavo v Afriki in arabskem svetu. Država je imela svojo valuto in samostojno vojsko, leta 1831 pa je sprejela zastavo, ki jo uporablja še danes.
Dinastija Husainidov je Tuniziji vladala tudi po ustanovitvi francoskega protektorata leta 1881 in je obstajala vse do razglasitve republike 25. julija 1957, leto dni po osamosvojitvi.

source.title: Beylik of Tunis
paragraphs: The Beylik of Tunis (Arabic: بايلك تونس) was the legal form of Tunisia, between 1705 and 1881. It was ruled by the Husainid dynasty until the establishment of the French protectorate of Tunisia. The term beylik refers to the monarch, who was called the Bey of Tunis. Under the protectorate, the latter remained nominally the head of state, with the Husainids remaining as largely symbolic sovereigns.

The Beys remained faithful to the Sublime Porte, but reigned as monarchs after gradually gaining independence from the Ottoman Empire. Between 1861 and 1864, the Beylik of Tunis became a constitutional monarchy after adopting the first constitution in Africa and the Arab world. The country had its own currency and an independent army, and in 1831 it adopted its flag, which is still in use today.

The Husainid dynasty continued to rule Tunisia, even after the establishment of the French protectorate in 1881, and remained in existence until the republic was declared on 25 July 1957, one year after independence.

Black September.headline: Črni september
paragraphs: Črni september (arabsko: Aylūl al-ʾAswad), znan tudi kot jordanska državljanska vojna, je bil oborožen spopad med Jordanijo pod vodstvom kralja Huseina in Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO) pod vodstvom predsednika Jaserja Arafata. Glavna faza bojev je potekala med 16. in 27. septembrom 1970, nekateri vidiki spopada pa so se nadaljevali do 17. julija 1971.

source.title: Black September
paragraphs: Black September (Arabic: أيلول الأسود, romanized: Aylūl al-ʾAswad), also known as the Jordanian Civil War, was an armed conflict between Jordan, led by King Hussein, and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), led by chairman Yasser Arafat. The main phase of the fighting took place between 16 and 27 September 1970, though certain aspects of the conflict continued until 17 July 1971.

Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591.headline: Bizantinsko-sasanidska vojna v letih 572–591
paragraphs: Bizantinsko-sasanidska vojna v letih 572–591 je potekala med perzijskim Sasanidskim imperijem in Bizantinskim cesarstvom. Sprožili so jo probizantinski upori na območjih Kavkaza pod perzijsko prevlado, k izbruhu pa so prispevali tudi drugi dogodki. Boji so bili večinoma omejeni na južni Kavkaz in Mezopotamijo, segli pa so tudi v vzhodno Anatolijo, Sirijo in severni Iran. Vojna je bila del silovitega zaporedja vojn med imperijema, ki je zajelo večji del 6. in začetek 7. stoletja. Bila je tudi zadnja od mnogih vojn med njima po vzorcu, v katerem so boji potekali večinoma v obmejnih provincah in nobena stran ni trajno zasedla sovražnikovega ozemlja zunaj tega obmejnega pasu. Sledil ji je precej obsežnejši in silovitejši sklepni spopad v začetku 7. stoletja.

source.title: Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591
paragraphs: The Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591 was a war fought between the Sasanian Empire of Persia and the Byzantine Empire. It was triggered by pro-Byzantine revolts in areas of the Caucasus under Persian hegemony, although other events also contributed to its outbreak. The fighting was largely confined to the southern Caucasus and Mesopotamia, although it also extended into eastern Anatolia, Syria, and northern Iran. It was part of an intense sequence of wars between these two empires which occupied the majority of the 6th and early 7th centuries. It was also the last of the many wars between them to follow a pattern in which fighting was largely confined to frontier provinces and neither side achieved any lasting occupation of enemy territory beyond this border zone. It preceded a much more wide-ranging and dramatic final conflict in the early 7th century.

Candar dynasty.headline: Dinastija Candar
paragraphs: Dinastija Candar ali hiša Candar (sodobno turško: Candaroğulları), beglik Candar, kneževina Candar (Candaroğulları Beyliği, Candar Beyliği), znana tudi kot dinastija Isfendiyar (İsfendiyaroğulları), je bila oguška turška knežja anatolska dinastija, ki je od leta 1291 do 1461 vladala ozemljem, ki ustrezajo provincam Eflani, Kastamonu, Sinop, Zonguldak, Bartın, Karabük, Samsun, Bolu, Ankara in Çankırı v današnji Republiki Turčiji. V zahodni literaturi je pokrajina znana kot Paflagonija, ime, ki so ga za isto zemljepisno območje uporabljali v rimskem obdobju.
Dinastijo in kneževino, ki ju je ustanovil Şemseddin Yaman Candar beg, je sultan Mehmed II. leta 1461 vključil v Osmansko cesarstvo.
notes: The pronunciation /ˈdʒandar/ is dropped; Turkish names keep their Turkish spelling.

source.title: Candar dynasty
paragraphs: The Candar dynasty (/ˈdʒandar/) or the House of Candar (Modern Turkish: Candaroğulları), Beylik of Candar, Principality of Candar (Candaroğulları Beyliği, Candar Beyliği), also known as the Isfendiyar dynasty (İsfendiyaroğulları), was an Oghuz Turkic princely Anatolian dynasty that reigned in the territories corresponding to the provinces of Eflani, Kastamonu, Sinop, Zonguldak, Bartın, Karabük, Samsun, Bolu, Ankara and Çankırı in the present-day Republic of Turkey from the year 1291 to 1461. The region is known in Western literature as Paphlagonia, a name applied to the same geographical area during the Roman period.
The dynasty and principality, founded by Şemseddin Yaman Candar Bey, were incorporated into the Ottoman Empire by Sultan Mehmed II in 1461.

Zavzetje Bagdada leta 1534, ko je osmanski sultan Sulejman Veličastni mesto iztrgal safavidskemu šahu Tahmaspu I., je bilo del njegovega pohoda na oba Iraka med osmansko-safavidsko vojno (1532–1555). Mesto je padlo brez odpora, saj je safavidska oblast pobegnila in ga pustila nebranjenega.

Zavzetje Bagdada je bilo pomemben dosežek, saj je mesto obvladovalo Tigris in Evfrat ter mednarodno in regionalno trgovino na njiju. Skupaj s padcem Basre leta 1546 je pomenilo pomemben korak k osmanski zmagi in pridobitvi spodnje Mezopotamije ter ustij Evfrata in Tigrisa, kar je odprlo trgovski izhod v Perzijski zaliv.

source.title: Capture of Baghdad (1534)
paragraphs: The 1534 capture of Baghdad by the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent from the Safavid Shah Tahmasp I was part of his Campaign of the Two Iraqs during the Ottoman–Safavid War (1532–1555). The city was taken without resistance, the Safavid government having fled and leaving the city undefended.

Baghdad's capture was a significant achievement given its mastery of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers and their international and regional trade. It represented, along with the fall of Basra in 1546, a significant step towards eventual Ottoman victory and the procurement of the lower Mesopotamia, the mouths of the Euphrates and Tigris rivers, opening a trading outlet into the Persian Gulf.

Capture of Baghdad (1917).headline: Zavzetje Bagdada (1917)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Bagdada (11. marca 1917) se je zgodilo med mezopotamsko kampanjo, v kateri so se v prvi svetovni vojni bojevale sile Britanskega imperija in Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Capture of Baghdad (1917)
paragraphs: The capture of Baghdad (11 March 1917) occurred during the Mesopotamian campaign, fought between the forces of the British Empire and the Ottoman Empire in World War I.

Capture of Damascus (1918).headline: Zavzetje Damaska (1918)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Damaska je pomenilo zmago britanske in arabske vojske v pohodu proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne. Mesto so zavzeli 1. oktobra 1918, po zavzetju Haife in zmagi v bitki pri Samahu, ki je odprla pot za zasledovanje proti severu od Galilejskega jezera, ter po tretjem transjordanskem napadu, ki je odprl pot do Deraje in zasledovanje v notranjosti, vse to po odločilni zmagi egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) v bitki pri Megidu v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji. Damask je padel, ko so mesto obkolili indijsko-britanske čete pod vodstvom generala Barrowa, puščavski konjeniški korpus generala Chauvela, šarifska hedžaška vojska princa Fejsala in arabska vojska šarifa Nasirja iz Medine. Nemške in turške čete v mestu so se tej premoči zelo hitro vdale.

source.title: Capture of Damascus (1918)
paragraphs: The Capture of Damascus marked a victory of the British and Arab armies in their campaign against the Ottoman empire in the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I. The capture took place on 1 October 1918 after the capture of Haifa and the victory at the Battle of Samakh which opened the way for the pursuit north from the Sea of Galilee and the Third Transjordan attack which opened the way to Deraa and the inland pursuit, after the decisive Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory at the Battle of Megiddo during the Sinai and Palestine campaign of World War I. Damascus was captured when Indian British troops under general Barrow, the Desert Mounted Corps under general Chauvel, Prince Faisal's Sharifial Hejaz Army and an Arab army under Sharif Nasir of Medina encircled the city. Faced with this superior force, the German and Turkish troops in the city surrendered very quickly.

Capture of Mecca (1813).headline: Zavzetje Meke (1813)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Meke leta 1813 se je zgodilo nekaj dni po tem, ko so Osmani v prvem pohodu osmansko-vahabitske vojne zavzeli Džido.

source.title: Capture of Mecca (1813)
paragraphs: The Capture of Mecca in 1813 took place several days after the Ottoman Capture of Jeddah in the First Campaign of the Ottoman–Wahhabi war.

Capture of Mecca (1924).headline: Zavzetje Meke (1924)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Meke je 5. decembra 1924 v Meki potekalo v okviru savdske osvojitve Kraljevine Hedžas, ki jo je izvedel kralj Sultanata Nedžd Abdulaziz ibn Saud. Pokrajini Hedžas je kot kraljestvu vladal kralj Husein bin Ali iz hašemitske rodbine.

source.title: Capture of Mecca (1924)
paragraphs: The Capture of Mecca took place on 5 December 1924 in Mecca, as part of the Saudi conquest of the Kingdom of Hejaz by King Abdulaziz Ibn Saud of the Sultanate of Nejd. The Hejaz region was ruled as a kingdom under King Hussein bin Ali of the Hashemite family.

Cedar Revolution.headline: Cedrina revolucija
paragraphs: Cedrina revolucija (arabsko: thawrat al-arz), v Libanonu znana kot intifada za neodvisnost (intifadat al-istiqlal), je bila vrsta demonstracij v Libanonu (zlasti v prestolnici Bejrut), ki jih je sprožil umor nekdanjega libanonskega predsednika vlade Rafika Haririja. Ljudsko gibanje je bilo izjemno, ker se je izogibalo nasilju, ravnalo mirno in se v celoti zanašalo na metode državljanskega odpora.

Glavni cilji aktivistov so bili umik sirskih čet, ki so Libanon zasedale od leta 1976, zamenjava vlade, na katero so močno vplivali sirski interesi, z bolj neodvisnim vodstvom, ustanovitev mednarodne komisije za preiskavo umora predsednika vlade Haririja, odstop varnostnih uradnikov, ki naj bi zagotovil uspeh načrta, in svobodne parlamentarne volitve. Na splošno so demonstranti zahtevali konec sirskega vpliva na libanonsko politiko.

source.title: Cedar Revolution
paragraphs: The Cedar Revolution (Arabic: ثورة الأرز, romanized: thawrat al-arz), known in Lebanon as the Independence intifada (انتفاضة الاستقلال, intifadat al-istiqlal), was a chain of demonstrations in Lebanon (especially in the capital Beirut) triggered by the assassination of former Lebanese Prime Minister Rafic Hariri. The popular movement was remarkable for its avoidance of violence, peaceful approach, and its total reliance on methods of civil resistance.

The primary goals of the activists were the withdrawal of the Syrian troops which had occupied Lebanon since 1976, the replacement of a government heavily influenced by Syrian interests by more independent leadership, the establishment of an international commission to investigate the assassination of Prime Minister Hariri, the resignation of security officials to ensure the success of the plan, and the organization of free parliamentary elections. More generally, the demonstrators demanded the end of the Syrian influence in Lebanese politics.

Chobanids.headline: Čobanidi
paragraphs: Čobanidi ali Čupanidi (perzijsko: چوپانیان) so bili potomci mongolske družine iz klana Suldus, ki se je v Perziji uveljavila v 14. stoletju. Sprva so služili Ilkanom, po padcu Ilkanata pa so dejansko prevzeli oblast nad ozemljem. Vladali so Azerbajdžanu (kjer so imeli sedež), Aranu, delom Male Azije, Mezopotamiji in zahodni osrednji Perziji, Bagdad pa so prevzeli Džalairidi.

source.title: Chobanids
paragraphs: The Chobanids or the Chupanids (Persian: چوپانیان) were descendants of a Mongol family of the Suldus clan that came to prominence in 14th century Persia. At first serving under the Ilkhans, they took de facto control of the territory after the fall of the Ilkhanate. The Chobanids ruled over Azerbaijan (where they were based), Arrān, parts of Asia Minor, Mesopotamia, and west central Persia, while the Jalayirids took control in Baghdad.

Colonies in antiquity.headline: Kolonije v antiki
paragraphs: Kolonije v antiki so bile mestne države iz časa po železni dobi, ki jih je ustanovilo matično mesto ali metropola, ne pa širše ozemlje. Vezi med kolonijo in njeno metropolo so pogosto ostale tesne in so v klasični antiki dobile posebne oblike. Kolonije, ki so jih ustanovili stari Feničani, Kartagina, Rim, Aleksander Veliki in njegovi nasledniki, so na splošno ostale povezane s svojo metropolo, grške kolonije iz arhaične in klasične dobe pa so bile že od ustanovitve suverene in samoupravne. Starejše grške kolonije so pogosto ustanavljali zato, da bi z izselitvijo dela prebivalstva odpravili družbene nemire v matičnem mestu, helenistične, rimske, kartažanske in kitajske kolonije iz dinastije Han pa so bile središča trgovine (tranzitna skladišča), širjenja in gradnje imperija.

source.title: Colonies in antiquity
paragraphs: Colonies in antiquity were post-Iron Age city-states founded from a mother-city or metropolis rather than from a territory-at-large. Bonds between a colony and its metropolis often remained close, and took specific forms during the period of classical antiquity. Generally, colonies founded by the ancient Phoenicians, Carthage, Rome, Alexander the Great and his successors remained tied to their metropolis, though Greek colonies of the Archaic and Classical eras were sovereign and self-governing from their inception. While earlier Greek colonies were often founded to solve social unrest in the mother-city by expelling a part of the population, Hellenistic, Roman, Carthaginian, and Han Chinese colonies served as centres for trade (entrepôts), expansion and empire-building.

Zavzetje Meke (arabsko: Fatḥ Makka) je bil vojaški pohod, ki so ga izvedli Mohamed in njegovi tovariši med muslimansko-kurajšitsko vojno. Zgodnje muslimane so decembra 629 ali januarja 630 (10.–20. ramadana leta 8 po hidžri) povedli nad Meko, ki so jo nadzorovali Kurajšiti. Padec mesta v Mohamedove roke je formalno končal spopad med njegovimi privrženci in kurajšitsko plemensko zvezo.

source.title: Conquest of Mecca
paragraphs: The conquest of Mecca (Arabic: فتح مكة Fatḥ Makka) was a military campaign undertaken by Muhammad and his companions during the Muslim–Quraysh War. They led the early Muslims in an advance on the Quraysh-controlled city of Mecca in December 629 or January 630 (10–20 Ramadan, 8 AH). The fall of the city to Muhammad formally marked the end of the conflict between his followers and the Quraysh tribal confederation.

Perzijska ustavna revolucija je bila kratkotrajno prizadevanje za demokratično vladavino v obliki ustavne monarhije v zelo elitistični, a decentralizirani družbi pod Kadžari. Naraščajoči odpor duhovščine, trgovcev z bazarjev, kmetov, izobražencev in drugih slojev do šaha in njegove politike konec 19. in v začetku 20. stoletja je klasičen primer okolja, zrelega za protest, saj je vse več ljudi v družbi čutilo potrebo izraziti nezadovoljstvo z zatiralsko in večinoma avtokratsko vlado.

source.title: Constitutionalization attempts in Iran
paragraphs: The Iranian Constitutional Revolution was a short-lived push for democratic rule in the form of a constitutional monarchy within a highly elitist yet decentralized society under the Qajars. The mounting disgust amidst the clergy, bazaaris, farmers, intellectuals, and other segments of the populace with respect to the Shah, policies during the end of the 19th and beginning of the 20th century illustrates a classic example of an environment ripe for protest, as a wide array of people in society felt an increasing need to express their grievances with an oppressive and largely autocratic government.

Dhofar rebellion.headline: Upor v Dofarju
paragraphs: Upor v Dofarju, znan tudi kot dofarska vojna ali revolucija 9. junija, je bila revolucija, ki se je leta 1965 začela v pokrajini Dofar na Arabskem polotoku proti britanskemu imperializmu in sultanoma Saidu ibn Tajmurju in Kabusu bin Saidu iz omanske dinastije Al Bu Said. Spopad se je začel z ustanovitvijo Fronte za osvoboditev Dofarja, marksistično-leninistične skupine, ki je hotela v Perzijskem zalivu ustvariti ljudsko demokratično državo. Uporniki so imeli tudi širše cilje arabskega nacionalizma, med drugim konec britanskega vpliva v regiji. Cilj sultana in Britancev pa je bil v okviru širše hladne vojne zaustaviti »širjenje komunizma«.

Vojna je bila sprva upor nizke intenzivnosti, v katerem so uporniki z gverilskim bojevanjem napadali britansko-sultanske sile in tujo navzočnost v državi. Več dejavnikov, kot sta britanski umik iz Adna ter podpora Južnega Jemna in Kitajske, je upornikom prineslo večje uspehe, tako da so komunisti do konca 1960. let nadzorovali vso pokrajino.

source.title: Dhofar rebellion
paragraphs: The Dhofar rebellion, also known as the Dhofar War, or the 9 June revolution, was a revolution that began in 1965 in the Dhofar region of the Arabian Peninsula against British imperialism and Sultans Said ibn Taimur and Qaboos bin Said of the Al Bu Said dynasty in Oman. The conflict began with the formation of the Dhofar Liberation Front, a Marxist–Leninist group which aimed to create a people's democratic state in the Persian Gulf region. The rebels also held the broader goals of Arab nationalism, which included ending British influence in the region. Sultanic and British goals, on the other hand, were to halt "the spread of communism" as part of the broader Cold War.

The war initially took the form of a low-level insurgency, with guerrilla warfare being used against Anglo-Sultanic forces and the foreign presence in the country. Several factors, such as the British withdrawal from Aden and support from South Yemen and China, brought the rebels increased success, with the communists controlling the entirety of the region by the late 1960s.

Egyptian–Ottoman War (1831–1833).headline: Egiptovsko-osmanska vojna (1831–1833)
paragraphs: Prva egiptovsko-osmanska vojna ali prva sirska vojna (1831–1833) je bil vojaški spopad med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Egiptom, ki ga je sprožila zahteva Mohameda Ali paše, naj mu Visoka porta v zahvalo za pomoč sultanu v grški osamosvojitveni vojni prepusti oblast nad Veliko Sirijo. Egiptovske sile so tako za nekaj časa prevzele nadzor nad Sirijo in prodrle vse do Kütahye na severu.

source.title: Egyptian–Ottoman War (1831–1833)
paragraphs: The First Egyptian–Ottoman War or First Syrian War (1831–1833) was a military conflict between the Ottoman Empire and Egypt brought about by Muhammad Ali Pasha's demand to the Sublime Porte for control of Greater Syria, as reward for aiding the Sultan during the Greek War of Independence. As a result, Egyptian forces temporarily gained control of Syria, advancing as far north as Kütahya.

Prva savdska država (arabsko: ad-dawla as-suʿūdiyya al-ʾūlā), uradno Emirat Dirija (ʾimāra ad-dirʿiyya), je bila politična tvorba na Arabskem polotoku, ki je obstajala med letoma 1744 in 1818. Emir nedždskega mesta Dirija Mohamed bin Saud Al Mukrin in verski voditelj Mohamed ibn Abd al Vahab sta podpisala pakt, s katerim sta ustanovila družbeno-versko reformno gibanje, ki je pod političnim vodstvom rodbine Saud širilo vahabitski verski nauk.

Državo so nato razširili po Arabskem polotoku, Levantu, do obale iranskega mesta Bandar Abas in do ožine Bab el Mandeb. Prva savdska država se je končala leta 1818, ko so egiptovske sile po večmesečnem obleganju zavzele in porušile prestolnico Dirijo.

source.title: First Saudi state
paragraphs: The first Saudi state (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ السُّعُودِيَّةُ الْأُولَىٰ, romanized: ad-dawla as-suʿūdiyya al-ʾūlā), officially the Emirate of Diriyah (Arabic: إمارة الدرعية, romanized: ʾimāra ad-dirʿiyya), was a polity that existed on the Arabian Peninsula between 1744 and 1818. The emir of a Najdi town called Diriyah, Muhammad bin Saud Al Muqrin, and the religious leader Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab signed a pact founding a socio-religious reform movement that propagated the Wahhabi religious doctrine under the political leadership of the House of Saud.

They then proceeded to expand their state throughout the Arabian Peninsula, the Levant, the coast of the Iranian city of Bandar Abbas, and the Bab al-Mandab Strait. The first Saudi state ended in 1818 after the Egyptian forces captured and destroyed the Capital town of Diriyah following a siege that lasted for several months.

Emirate of Jabal Shammar.headline: Emirat Džabal Šamar
paragraphs: Emirat Džabal Šamar (arabsko: Imārah Jabal Shammar), znan tudi kot Emirat Hail ali Rašidski emirat, je bil država na severu Arabskega polotoka, vključno z Nedždom, ki je obstajala od sredine 19. stoletja do leta 1921. Šamar je bil zveza plemen na Arabskem polotoku, ime Džabal Šamar pa pomeni »Šamarjeva gora«. Prestolnica je bil Hail, vladala pa je monarhija dinastije Rašidov. Obsegal je dele današnje Savdske Arabije, Iraka in Jordanije.

source.title: Emirate of Jabal Shammar
paragraphs: The Emirate of Jabal Shammar (Arabic: إِمَارَة جَبَل شَمَّر, romanized: Imārah Jabal Shammar), also known as the Emirate of Haʾil (إِمَارَة حَائِل) or the Rashidi Emirate (إِمَارَة آل رَشِيْد), was a state in the northern part of the Arabian Peninsula, including Najd, existing from the mid-nineteenth century to 1921. Shammar had been a confederation in the Arabian Peninsula. Jabal Shammar in English is translated as the "Mountain of Shammar". Jabal Shammar's capital was Ha'il. It was led by the monarchy of the Rashidi dynasty. It included parts of modern-day Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Jordan.

Druga savdska država (arabsko: ad-Dawla as-Suʿūdiyya ath-Thāniyya), uradno Emirat Nedžd, je bila država, ki je med letoma 1824 in 1891 obstajala v pokrajini Nedžd na ozemlju današnje Savdske Arabije. Savdska oblast se je vrnila v osrednjo (Nedžd) in vzhodno Arabijo, potem ko je prvo savdsko državo v osmansko-vahabitski vojni strmoglavil egiptovski ejalet Osmanskega cesarstva.

Za drugo savdsko obdobje so bili značilni manjše ozemeljsko širjenje in manjša verska vnema, čeprav so se savdski voditelji še naprej imenovali imami in so še vedno zaposlovali vahabitske verske učenjake. Za začetek druge savdske države navadno velja Turki bin Abdulah, ki je leta 1824 osmansko-egiptovskim silam znova odvzel Rijad. Hudi notranji spori v rodbini Saud so dinastijo nazadnje pokopali v bitki pri Mulajdi leta 1891 med silami, zvestimi zadnjemu savdskemu imamu Abdulu Rahmanu bin Fejsalu, in dinastijo Rašidov iz Haila.

source.title: Second Saudi state
paragraphs: The second Saudi state (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ السُّعُودِيَّةُ الثَّانِيَةُ, romanized: ad-Dawla as-Suʿūdiyya ath-Thāniyya), officially known as the Emirate of Najd, was a state that existed between 1824 and 1891 in the Najd region of what is now Saudi Arabia. Saudi rule was restored to central (Najd) and Eastern Arabia after the first Saudi state having previously been brought down by the Ottoman Empire's Egypt Eyalet in the Ottoman–Wahhabi War.

The second Saudi period was marked by less territorial expansion and less religious zeal, although the Saudi leaders continued to be called Imam and still employed Wahhabist religious scholars. Turki bin Abdullah's reconquest of Riyadh from Ottoman-Egyptians forces in 1824 is generally regarded as the beginning of the second Saudi state. Severe internal conflicts within the House of Saud eventually led to the dynasty's downfall at the Battle of Mulayda in 1891, between the forces loyal to the last Saudi imam, Abdul Rahman bin Faisal, and the Rashidi dynasty of Hail.

Nekorski emirat ali Salihidski emirat (arabsko: إمارة بني صالح, ʾImārat Banī Ṣāliḥ) je bil emirat s središčem v pokrajini Rif na ozemlju današnjega Maroka. Prestolnica je bila sprva v Temsamanu, nato so jo preselili v Nekor. Vladajoči dinastiji pripisujejo bodisi himjaritski arabski bodisi berberski izvor iz plemena Nafza. Emirat je leta 710 n. št. na podlagi kalifove podelitve ustanovil Salih I. ibn Mansur. Pod njegovim vodstvom so krajevna berberska (amaziška) plemena sprejela islam, pozneje pa so ga odstavila in na njegovo mesto postavila nekega Davuda al Rundija iz plemena Nafza (ki verjetno ni bil doma iz Ronde). Nato so si premislila in Saliha ibn Mansurja znova postavila za vladarja. Njegova dinastija, Banu Salih, je nato pokrajini vladala do okoli leta 1015.

source.title: Emirate of Nekor
paragraphs: The Emirate of Nekor or Salihid Emirate (Arabic: إمارة بني صالح, romanized: ʾImārat Banī Ṣāliḥ) was an emirate centered in the Rif area of present-day Morocco. Its capital was initially located at Temsamane, and then moved to Nekor. The ruling dynasty has been described as either of Himyarite Arab descent or of Nafza Berber descent. The emirate was founded in 710 CE by Salih I ibn Mansur through a Caliphate grant. Under his guidance, the local Berber (Amazigh) tribes adopted Islam, but later deposed him in favor of one Dawud al-Rundi (unlikely to have been a native of Ronda) from the Nafza tribe. They subsequently changed their mind and reappointed Salih ibn Mansur. His dynasty, the Banu Salih, thereafter ruled the region until about 1015.

Eshrefids.headline: Ešrefidi
paragraphs: Ešrefidi ali Ašrafidi (sodobno turško: Eşrefoğulları ali Eşrefoğulları Beyliği) so bili turški anatolski beglik iz 13. in 14. stoletja.

source.title: Eshrefids
paragraphs: The Eshrefids or Ashrafids (Modern Turkish: Eşrefoğulları or Eşrefoğulları Beyliği ) was a 13th-14th century Turkish Anatolian beylik.

Expedition of Dumat al-Jandal.headline: Odprava na Dumat al Džandal
paragraphs: Odprava na Dumat al Džandal je bila zgodnja muslimanska odprava, ki je potekala avgusta ali septembra 626 n. št.

Po indijskem življenjepiscu islamskega preroka Mohameda Safiurju Rahmanu Mubarakpuriju je Dumat al Džandal od Medine oddaljen okoli petnajst dni hoda, od Damaska pa pet. Po zgodovinarju Williamu Montgomeryju Wattu je od Medine oddaljen 500 milj.

source.title: Expedition of Dumat al-Jandal
paragraphs: The Expedition of Dumat al-Jandal is an early Muslim expedition which took place in August or September of 626 AD.

According to Indian biographer of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, Safiur Rahman Mubarakpuri, Dumat al-Jandal is located at about a distance of fifteen days' march from Medina and five from Damascus. According to historian William Montgomery Watt, it is 500 miles from Medina.

Fall of Babylon.headline: Padec Babilona
paragraphs: Babilon je padel leta 539 pr. n. št., ko je Ahemenidski imperij osvojil Novobabilonsko cesarstvo. Uspešni perzijski pohod pod vodstvom Kira Velikega je končal vladavino zadnje domače dinastije Mezopotamije in Perzijcem dal nadzor nad preostankom Rodovitnega polmeseca.

Nabonid, zadnji babilonski kralj in sin asirske svečenice Adad-gupi, je prišel na prestol leta 556, ko je strmoglavil predhodnika Labaši-Marduka. Vladanje je dolga obdobja prepuščal sinu in prestolonasledniku Belsazarju, ki je kot politik ravnal tako slabo, da je kljub vojaški sposobnosti izgubil podporo duhovščine in celo vojaškega sloja.

Na vzhodu je politična in vojaška moč Perzijcev pod dinastijo Ahemenidov hitro rasla in do leta 540 je Kir sprožil napadalni pohod proti Novobabilonskemu cesarstvu. Konec leta 539 je perzijska vojska dosegla odločilno zmago v bitki pri Opisu in nato zmagoslavno vkorakala v Babilon.

source.title: Fall of Babylon
paragraphs: The fall of Babylon occurred in 539 BCE, when the Achaemenid Empire conquered the Neo-Babylonian Empire. The success of the Persian campaign, led by Cyrus the Great, brought an end to the reign of the last native dynasty of Mesopotamia and gave the Persians control over the rest of the Fertile Crescent.

Nabonidus, the final Babylonian king and son of the Assyrian priestess Adad-guppi, had ascended to the throne by overthrowing his predecessor Labashi-Marduk in 556. For long periods, he would entrust rule to his son and crown prince Belshazzar, whose poor performance as a politician lost him the support of the priesthood and even the military class, in spite of his capability as a soldier.

To the east, the Persians' political and military power had been growing at a rapid pace under the Achaemenid dynasty, and by 540, Cyrus had initiated an offensive campaign against the Neo-Babylonian Empire. In late 539, the Persian army secured a crucial victory in the Battle of Opis, thereafter triumphantly entering the city of Babylon.

Fall of Damascus (2024).headline: Padec Damaska (2024)
paragraphs: Sirska opozicijska skupina, znana kot Južna operativna soba, je 7. decembra 2024 v usklajevanju s poveljstvom vojaških operacij povedla sile, ki so z juga vstopile v sirsko pokrajino Rif Dimašk in se nato prestolnici Damask približale na 20 kilometrov. Sirska vojska se je umaknila z več točk na obrobju. Hkrati s prodorom proti Damasku sta opozicijska milica Tahrir al Šam in sirska narodna vojska pod turškim okriljem na severu sprožili ofenzivo na Homs, Svobodna sirska vojska pa je v prestolnico prodrla z jugovzhoda. Do 8. decembra 2024 so uporniške sile vstopile v mestno četrt Barzeh. Po uradnih državnih poročilih v ruskih množičnih medijih in medijskih posnetkih je predsednik Bašar al Asad z letalom odletel iz Damaska v Moskvo, kjer je dobil azil, s čimer je bil padec njegovega režima zapečaten.

source.title: Fall of Damascus (2024)
paragraphs: On 7 December 2024, the Syrian opposition group known as the Southern Operations Room, in co-ordination with the Military Operations Command, led forces that entered the Rif Dimashq region of Syria from the south, and those forces then came within 20 kilometres (12 mi) of the capital Damascus. The Syrian Army withdrew from multiple points in the outskirts. Concurrently with the advance towards Damascus, opposition militia Tahrir al-Sham and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army in the north launched an offensive into Homs, while the Syrian Free Army advanced into the capital from the southeast. By 8 December 2024, rebel forces entered the city's Barzeh neighborhood. According to official state reports in Russian mass media and media footage, President Bashar al-Assad left Damascus by air to Moscow, where he was granted asylum, sealing the fall of his regime.

Fall of Fallujah.headline: Padec Faludže
paragraphs: Padec Faludže je bila velika bitka v mestu Faludža v zahodnem Iraku, ki je od konca leta 2013 do začetka leta 2014 potekala med borci Islamske države Iraka in Levanta (ISIL) in drugimi sunitskimi uporniki, med njimi anbarskimi plemenskimi milicami, ki so mesto zavzeli. Faludža je bila eno prvih iraških mest, ki jim je iraška vlada izgubila nadzor, posledica pa je bila kampanja v Anbarju.

source.title: Fall of Fallujah
paragraphs: The fall of Fallujah was a major battle in the city of Fallujah in western Iraq that took place from late 2013 to early 2014, in which Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) militants and other Sunni insurgents including Anbar tribal militias captured the city of Fallujah. It was one of the first Iraqi cities to fall out of the control of the Iraqi Government, and resulted in the Anbar campaign.

Fall of Nineveh.headline: Padec Niniv
paragraphs: Padec Niniv, imenovan tudi bitka pri Ninivah, je bila velika bitka, ki je pomenila vrhunec osvojitve Asirskega cesarstva leta 612 pr. n. št. Po asirskem porazu ob padcu Asurja je zavezniška vojska Medijcev in Babiloncev oblegala Ninive (na območju današnjega Mosula) in zavzela tedaj eno največjih mest na svetu. Padec Niniv je v naslednjih treh letih pripeljal do uničenja Novoasirskega cesarstva kot prevladujoče države starega Bližnjega vzhoda. Arheološki zapisi kažejo, da se je nekdanja prestolnica mogočnega Asirskega cesarstva v desetletjih in stoletjih po bitki močno deurbanizirala in izpraznila. Popačeno poročilo o padcu mesta je pozneje dalo zgodbo o legendarnem kralju Sardanapalu.
Babilon je prvič po več kot tisoč letih postal cesarsko središče Mezopotamije, iz česar je nastalo Novobabilonsko cesarstvo, ki je kot nova dinastija zahtevalo cesarsko nasledstvo.

source.title: Fall of Nineveh
paragraphs: The Fall of Nineveh, also called the Battle of Nineveh, was a major battle that marked the climax of the Conquest of the Assyrian Empire in 612 BC. After the Assyrian defeat at the Fall of Assur, an allied army which involved the combined forces of Medes and the Babylonians besieged Nineveh (in modern-day Mosul) and took what was, at that time, one of the greatest cities in the world. The fall of Nineveh led to the destruction of the Neo-Assyrian Empire as the dominant state in the Ancient Near East over the following three years. Archeological records show that the capital of the once-mighty Assyrian Empire was extensively de-urbanized and depopulated in the decades and centuries following the battle. A garbled account of the fall of the city later led to the story of the legendary king Sardanapalus.
Babylon became the imperial center of Mesopotamia for the first time in over a thousand years, leading to the Neo-Babylonian Empire, claiming imperial continuity as a new dynasty.

Fao Landing.headline: Izkrcanje pri Favu
paragraphs: Izkrcanje pri Favu je potekalo od 6. do 8. novembra 1914, ko so britanske sile napadle osmansko oporišče Fav in njegovo trdnjavo. Izkrcanje je naletelo na malo odpora osmanskih branilcev, ki so po silovitem obstreljevanju pobegnili. Bila je prva vojaška operacija mezopotamske kampanje v prvi svetovni vojni, ki so jo izvedli za zaščito britanske oskrbe z nafto v Perzijskem zalivu.

source.title: Fao Landing
paragraphs: The Fao Landing occurred from 6 November to 8 November 1914 with British forces attacking the Ottoman stronghold of Fao and its fortress. The landing was met with little resistance from the Ottoman defenders who fled after intense shelling. It was the first military operation of the Mesopotamian Campaign, during the First World War, which was carried out to protect British oil supplies in the Persian Gulf.

Fihrids.headline: Fihridi
paragraphs: Fihridi (arabsko: الفهريون, al-Fihriyyūn), znani tudi kot Banu Fihr (arabsko: بنو فهر), so bili arabska družina in klan, ki je bil v 8. stoletju vpliven v Ifrikiji in Al Andaluzu.

Fihridi so izhajali iz arabskega klana Banu Fihr, dela plemena Kurejš, iz katerega je izhajal prerok. Najslavnejši Fihrid je bil verjetno Ukba ibn Nafi al Fihri, arabski muslimanski osvajalec severne Afrike v 670. in 680. letih in ustanovitelj Kajruana. Več njegovih sinov in vnukov je sodelovalo pri poznejši osvojitvi Hispanije leta 712.

source.title: Fihrids
paragraphs: The Fihrids (Arabic: الفهريون, romanized: al-Fihriyyūn), also known as Banū Fihr (Arabic: بنو فهر), were an Arab family and clan, prominent in Ifriqiya and Al-Andalus in the 8th century.

The Fihrids were from the Arabian clan of Banu Fihr, part of the Quraysh, the tribe of the Prophet. Probably the most illustrious of the Fihrids was Uqba ibn Nafi al-Fihri, the Arab Muslim conqueror of North Africa in 670-680s, and founder of al-Qayrawan. Several of his sons and grandsons participated in the subsequent conquest of Hispania in 712.

First Battle of al-Faw.headline: Prva bitka za Al Fav
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Al Fav je bila bitka iransko-iraške vojne, ki je med 10. februarjem in 10. marcem 1986 potekala na polotoku Al Fav. Iranska operacija velja za enega največjih iranskih dosežkov v iransko-iraški vojni. Iranci so zavzeli polotok Al Fav in Iraku presekali dostop do Perzijskega zaliva, kar je iraška stališča glede nadaljevanja vojne še zaostrilo. Iraške sile so polotok znova zavzele proti koncu vojne.

source.title: First Battle of al-Faw
paragraphs: The First Battle of al-Faw was a battle of the Iran–Iraq War, fought on the al-Faw peninsula between 10 February and 10 March 1986. The Iranian operation is considered to be one of Iran's greatest achievements in the Iran–Iraq War. The Iranians were able to capture the al-Faw peninsula, cutting off Iraqi access to the Persian Gulf in the process; this in turn hardened Iraqi attitudes to prosecute the war. The Faw peninsula was later recaptured by Iraqi forces near the end of the war.

First Battle of Fallujah.headline: Prva bitka za Faludžo
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Faludžo, s kodnim imenom operacija Budna odločnost, je bila operacija iraške vojne pod ameriškim vodstvom proti borcem v Faludži in hkrati poskus, da bi prijeli ali ubili storilce umora štirih ameriških pogodbenikov marca 2004.
Glavni povod za operacijo sta bila zelo odmeven umor in iznakaženje štirih zasebnih vojaških pogodbenikov družbe Blackwater USA ter umor petih ameriških vojakov v Habaniji nekaj dni prej.

Bitka, zlasti posnetki iraških civilistov, ubitih ali ranjenih v bojih, je mnoge Iračane navdala z zamero do ameriške navzočnosti. Zahodni novinarji so ugotovili, da so se celo nekateri Iračani, ki so prej podpirali ameriško invazijo in pozdravljali ameriška prizadevanja za izgradnjo države, vse bolj odtujevali in postajali do takih obljub nezaupljivi.

source.title: First Battle of Fallujah
paragraphs: The First Battle of Fallujah, code-named Operation Vigilant Resolve, was an American-led operation of the Iraq War against militants in Fallujah as well as an attempt to apprehend or kill the perpetrators of the killing of four U.S. contractors in March 2004.

The chief catalyst for the operation was the highly publicized killing and mutilation of four Blackwater USA private military contractors, and the killings of five American soldiers in Habbaniyah a few days earlier.

The battle, and especially the images of Iraqi civilians killed or injured in the fighting, caused many Iraqis to become resentful of the US presence. Western journalists found that even some Iraqis who previously supported the US invasion, and welcomed American state-building efforts, became increasingly alienated and skeptical of such promises.

First Battle of Gaza.headline: Prva bitka za Gazo
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Gazo je potekala 26. marca 1917, ob prvem poskusu egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF), vojaške tvorbe Britanskega imperija, ki so jo 10. marca 1916 pod poveljstvom generala Archibalda Murrayja sestavili iz sredozemskih ekspedicijskih sil in sil v Egiptu (1914–1915), na začetku sinajsko-palestinske kampanje prve svetovne vojne. Boji so potekali v mestu Gaza na sredozemski obali in okolici, ko so pehota in konjeniška pehota puščavske kolone, dela vzhodnih sil, napadle mesto. Pozno popoldne, ko je bila že tik pred zavzetjem Gaze, so puščavsko kolono umaknili, ker so se bali bližajoče se teme in velikih osmanskih okrepitev. Temu britanskemu porazu je nekaj tednov pozneje, aprila 1917, sledil še hujši poraz vzhodnih sil v drugi bitki za Gazo.

source.title: First Battle of Gaza
paragraphs: The First Battle of Gaza was fought on 26 March 1917 during the first attempt by the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF), which was a British Empire military formation, formed on 10 March 1916 under the command of General Archibald Murray from the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force and the Force in Egypt (1914–15), at the beginning of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Fighting took place in and around the town of Gaza on the Mediterranean coast when infantry and mounted infantry from the Desert Column, a component of the Eastern Force, attacked the town. Late in the afternoon, on the verge of capturing Gaza, the Desert Column was withdrawn due to concerns about the approaching darkness and large Ottoman reinforcements. This British defeat was followed a few weeks later by the even more emphatic defeat of the Eastern Force at the Second Battle of Gaza in April 1917.

First Battle of Homs.headline: Prva bitka pri Homsu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Homsu je potekala 10. decembra 1260 v Homsu v Siriji med Ilkanidi in muslimanskim zavezništvom Sirije.

Po mameluški zmagi nad Ilkanidi v bitki pri Ajn Džalutu septembra 1260 je vsa Sirija, vključno z Alepom, padla v mameluške roke. Hulagu je bil zaradi poraza pri Ajn Džalutu besen in je poslal novo vojsko pod vodstvom Bajdarja, enega od Kitbukovih generalov, ki je preživel Ajn Džalut. Novembra 1260 so mongolske sile znova zavzele Alep. Ko je za to izvedel ajubidski vladar Homsa Al Ašraf Musa, je sklenil koalicijo z emirjem Hame Al Mansurjem in mameluškimi emirji Alepa.

Mongolske sile so se z muslimani srečale pri Homsu, blizu grobnice arabskega poveljnika Halida ibn al Valida. Mongolska vojska je štela 6000 mož, muslimanska le 1400. Mongoli so se postavili v osem formacij z 1000 možmi spredaj in preostalimi za njimi. Muslimani so se razdelili v tri skupine: središče je vodil Al Ašraf, desno krilo Al Mansur, levo pa alepski emirji.

source.title: First Battle of Homs
paragraphs: The First Battle of Homs was fought in Homs, Syria, on December 10, 1260, between the Ilkhanids and the Muslim alliance of Syria.

After the Mamluk victory over the Ilkhanids at the Battle of Ain Jalut in September 1260, the whole of Syria, including Aleppo, fell into Mamluk hands. Furious at the defeat of Ain Jalut, Hulagu dispatched another army under Baidar, one of the Kitbuqa generals and a survivor of Ain Jalut. On November, 1260, the Mongol forces managed to recapture Aleppo. Alerted of this, the Ayyubid ruler of Homs, Al-Ashraf Musa, formed a coalition with the Emir of Hama, Al-Mansur, and the Mamluk Emirs of Aleppo.

The Mongol forces encountered the Muslims at Homs, near the tomb of the Arab commander, Khalid ibn al-Walid. The Mongol army consisted of 6,000 men, while the Muslim army had only 1,400 men. The Mongols formed eight formations with a force of 1,000 men at front, while the rest arranged behind it. The Muslims were divided into three groups: the center led by Al-Ashraf, the right under Al-Mansur, and the left under the Emirs of Aleppo.

Med letoma 636 in 637/638, med muslimansko osvojitvijo Levanta, je pravoverni kalifat Bizantinskemu cesarstvu odvzel Jeruzalem. Vse se je začelo, ko je vojska kalifata pod poveljstvom Abu Ubajde novembra 636 oblegala Jeruzalem. Po šestih mesecih je patriarh Sofronij privolil v predajo, s pogojem, da se podredi le kalifu. Leta 637 ali 638 je kalif Omar (vladal 634–644) osebno pripotoval v Jeruzalem, da bi sprejel predajo mesta, in patriarh se mu je vdal.

Muslimanska osvojitev mesta je utrdila arabsko oblast nad Palestino, ki je ostala del različnih sunitskih kalifatov, dokler je leta 969 ni prevzel šiitski Fatimidski kalifat. Leta 1073 so Jeruzalem zavzeli seldžuški Turki, krščanski vladarji pa so ga znova dobili med prvo križarsko vojno leta 1099.

source.title: First Muslim conquest of Jerusalem
paragraphs: Between 636 and 637/38, during the Muslim conquest of the Levant, the Rashidun Caliphate took Jerusalem from the Byzantine Empire. It began when the Rashidun army, under the command of Abu Ubayda, besieged Jerusalem in November 636. After six months, Patriarch Sophronius agreed to surrender, on condition that he submit only to the caliph. In 637 or 638, Caliph Umar (r. 634–644) traveled to Jerusalem in person to receive the submission of the city. The patriarch thus surrendered to him.

The Muslim conquest of the city solidified Arab control over Palestine, which remained part of various Sunni caliphates until the Shia-led Fatimid Caliphate took over in 969. In 1073 the Seljuk Turks took control of Jerusalem, and Christian rulers regained control at the time of the First Crusade in 1099.

First Sealand dynasty.headline: Prva dinastija Morske dežele
paragraphs: Prva dinastija Morske dežele (URU.KÙKI) ali 2. babilonska dinastija (čeprav je bila neodvisna od Babilona, ki so mu vladali Amoriti), zelo okvirno datirana v ok. 1732–1475 pr. n. št. (po srednji kronologiji), je skrivnostno zaporedje kraljev, ki ga izpričujejo predvsem jedrnate omembe na seznamih kraljev A in B ter sočasni zapisi na asirskem sinhronističnem seznamu kraljev A.117. Sprva so jo imenovali »dinastija Dežele morja«, pozneje pa se je uveljavilo ime Morska dežela.

Dinastija, ki se je odtrgala od starobabilonskega cesarstva, je dobila ime po provinci na skrajnem jugu Mezopotamije, močvirni pokrajini brez velikih naselij, ki se je z zasipavanjem ustij Tigrisa in Evfrata postopoma širila proti jugu (v železni dobi znani kot mat Kaldi, »Kaldeja«). Lončenino Morske dežele so našli v Girsuju, Uruku in Lagašu, severneje pa na nobenem najdišču.

source.title: First Sealand dynasty
paragraphs: The First Sealand dynasty (URU.KÙKI), or the 2nd Dynasty of Babylon (although it was independent of Amorite-ruled Babylon), very speculatively c. 1732–1475 BC (MC), is an enigmatic series of kings attested to primarily in laconic references in the King Lists A and B, and as contemporaries recorded on the Assyrian Synchronistic king list A.117. Initially it was named the "Dynasty of the Country of the Sea" with Sealand later becoming customary.

The dynasty, which had broken free of the Old Babylonian Empire, was named for the province in the far south of Mesopotamia, a swampy region bereft of large settlements which gradually expanded southwards with the silting up of the mouths of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers (the region known as mat Kaldi "Chaldaea" in the Iron Age). Sealand pottery has been found at Girsu, Uruk, and Lagash but in no site north of that.

Franco-Syrian War.headline: Francosko-sirska vojna
paragraphs: Francosko-sirska vojna je leta 1920 potekala med Francijo in hašemitskimi vladarji novoustanovljenega Arabskega kraljestva Sirija. V vrsti spopadov, ki so dosegli vrhunec v bitki pri Majsalunu, so francoske sile premagale sile hašemitskega kralja Fejsala in njegovih privržencev ter 24. julija 1920 vkorakale v Damask. V Siriji so 25. julija razglasili novo profrancosko vlado pod vodstvom Alaa al Dina al Darubija, pokrajino Sirijo pa so nazadnje razdelili na več odvisnih držav pod mandatom za Sirijo in Libanon. Britanska vlada je v skrbeh za svoj položaj v novem mandatu v Iraku privolila, da begunca Fejsala razglasi za novega iraškega kralja.

source.title: Franco-Syrian War
paragraphs: The Franco-Syrian War took place during 1920 between France and the Hashemite rulers of the newly established Arab Kingdom of Syria. During a series of engagements, which climaxed in the Battle of Maysalun, French forces defeated the forces of the Hashemite monarch King Faisal, and his supporters, entering Damascus on July 24, 1920. A new pro-French government was declared in Syria on July 25, headed by 'Alaa al-Din al-Darubi and the region of Syria was eventually divided into several client states under the Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon. The British government, concerned for their position in the new mandate in Iraq, agreed to declare the fugitive Faisal as the new king of Iraq.
Francoska Afrika obsega vse zgodovinske posesti Francije na afriški celini.

source.title: French Africa
paragraphs: French Africa includes all the historic holdings of France on the African continent.

Francoska Alžirija, znana tudi kot kolonialna Alžirija, je bila kolonija in pozneje sestavni del Francije. Francoska oblast je trajala od začetka francoske osvojitve leta 1830 do konca alžirske vojne, po kateri je Alžirija 5. julija 1962 postala neodvisna.

source.title: French Algeria
paragraphs: French Algeria, also known as Colonial Algeria, was a colony and later an integral part of France. French rule lasted from the beginning of the French conquest in 1830 until the end of the Algerian War which resulted in Algeria gaining independence on 5 July 1962.

Francoska invazija na Egipt in Sirijo (1798–1801) je bila vojaška odprava v Egipt in Sirijo pod osmansko oblastjo, ki jo je med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami vodil Napoleon Bonaparte. Pohod naj bi spodkopal britanske trgovske poti, razširil francoski vpliv ter v Egiptu vzpostavil znanstveno in upravno navzočnost. Napoleon je hotel tudi presekati britansko povezavo s kolonialnimi posestmi v Indiji, z dolgoročnim ciljem izzvati britansko prevlado v regiji.

source.title: French invasion of Egypt and Syria
paragraphs: The French invasion of Egypt and Syria (1798–1801) was a military expedition to Ottoman-held Egypt and Syria led by Napoleon Bonaparte during the French Revolutionary Wars. The campaign aimed to undermine British trade routes, expand French influence, and establish a scientific and administrative presence in Egypt. Napoleon also sought to sever Britain's connection to its colonial holdings in India, with the long-term ambition of challenging British dominance in the region.

Garamantes.headline: Garamanti
paragraphs: Garamanti (starogrško: Γαράμαντες, Garámantes; latinsko: Garamantes) so bili starodavno ljudstvo, ki je morda izhajalo iz berberskih plemen, plemen Tubu in saharskih pastirjev in se je najpozneje okoli leta 1000 pr. n. št. naselilo v pokrajini Fezan, kjer je ustvarilo civilizacijo, ki je cvetela do svojega konca v poznem 7. stoletju n. št. Garamanti so se kot pomembna regionalna sila prvič uveljavili sredi 2. stoletja n. št. in ustanovili kraljestvo, ki je obsegalo približno 180.000 km² v pokrajini Fezan na jugu Libije. Njihova rast in širitev sta temeljili na zapletenem in obsežnem namakalnem sistemu kanatov (berbersko: foggaras), ki je vzdrževal močno kmetijstvo in številno prebivalstvo. Pozneje so razvili prvo mestno družbo v veliki puščavi, ki ni bila vezana na rečni sistem: njihovo največje mesto, Garama, je imelo okoli štiri tisoč prebivalcev, v okoliških predmestjih pa jih je živelo še šest tisoč. Na vrhuncu je garamantsko kraljestvo vzpostavilo in ohranjalo »življenjsko raven, ki je daleč presegala raven katere koli druge starodavne saharske družbe«, sestavljali pa so ga »odlični kmetje, iznajdljivi inženirji in podjetni trgovci, ki so ustvarili izjemno civilizacijo«.
notes: The square-mile conversion (70,000 sq mi) is dropped.

source.title: Garamantes
paragraphs: The Garamantes (Ancient Greek: Γαράμαντες, romanized: Garámantes; Latin: Garamantes) were ancient peoples, who may have descended from Berber tribes, Toubou tribes, and Saharan pastoralists and who had settled, at least as early as 1000 BC, in the Fezzan region, where they established a civilization that flourished until its end in the late 7th century AD. The Garamantes first emerged as a major regional power in the mid-2nd century AD and established a kingdom that spanned roughly 180,000 km2 (70,000 sq mi) in the Fezzan region of southern Libya. Their growth and expansion was based on a complex and extensive qanat irrigation system (Berber: foggaras), which supported a strong agricultural economy and a large population. They subsequently developed the first urban society in a major desert that was not centered on a river system; their largest town, Garama, had a population of around four thousand, with an additional six thousand living in surrounding suburban areas. At its pinnacle, the Garamantian kingdom established and maintained a "standard of living far superior to that of any other ancient Saharan society" and was composed of "brilliant farmers, resourceful engineers, and enterprising merchants who produced a remarkable civilization."

Gaznavidski imperij (perzijsko: Ġaznaviyān) je bil kulturno perzijsko oblikovana sunitska muslimanska država turškega karluškega izvora. Cvetel je od leta 977 do 1186 in na vrhuncu segal od Oksa do doline Inda. Dinastijo je ustanovil Sabuktigin, ko je po smrti tasta Alp Tigina, nekdanjega generala Samanidskega imperija iz Balha, prevzel oblast v Gazni.

Sabuktiginov sin Mahmud iz Gazne je imperij razširil na vzhodu do Amudarje, Inda in Indijskega oceana, na zahodu pa do Reja in Hamadana. Pod Masudom I. je dinastija po bitki pri Dandanakanu leta 1040 začela izgubljati zahodna ozemlja v korist Seldžuškega imperija, zato se je njena posest skrčila na današnji Afganistan, Pakistan in severno Indijo.

source.title: Ghaznavid Empire
paragraphs: The Ghaznavid Empire (Persian: غزنویان, romanized: Ġaznaviyān) was a culturally Persianate, Sunni Muslim state of Turkic Karluk origin. Flourishing from 977 to 1186, the empire spread from the Oxus to the Indus Valley at its greatest extent. The dynasty was founded by Sabuktigin upon his succession to the rule of Ghazna after the death of his father-in-law, Alp Tigin, who was an ex-general of the Samanid Empire from Balkh.

Sabuktigin's son, Mahmud of Ghazni, expanded the Ghaznavid Empire to the Amu Darya, the Indus River and the Indian Ocean in the east and to Rey and Hamadan in the west. Under the reign of Mas'ud I, the Ghaznavid dynasty began losing control over its western territories to the Seljuk Empire after the Battle of Dandanaqan in 1040, resulting in a restriction of its holdings to modern-day Afghanistan, Pakistan and Northern India.

Gutian rule in Mesopotamia.headline: Gutejska vladavina v Mezopotamiji
paragraphs: Gutejska dinastija (sumersko: gu-ti-umKI) je bila vrsta kraljev iz ljudstva Gutejcev. Nekoč so menili, da so bili Gutejci horda, ki je pridrla v Mezopotamijo in strmoglavila akadsko in sumersko oblast, danes pa vemo, da so bili tedaj na tem območju že najmanj stoletje. Do konca akadskega obdobja so Gutejci zasedli sumersko mesto Adab in ga naredili za svojo prestolnico. Gutejska dinastija je prišla na oblast v Mezopotamiji proti koncu 3. tisočletja pr. n. št., po zatonu in propadu Akadskega imperija. Koliko časa so gutejski kralji vladali Mezopotamiji, ni gotovo, ocene pa segajo od nekaj let do stoletja. Konec dinastije zaznamuje vzpon uruškega vladarja Utu-hengala (ok. 2119–2112 pr. n. št.), s katerim se začne kratkotrajna »peta uruška dinastija«, za njim pa urskega vladarja Ur-Namuja (ok. 2112–2094 pr. n. št.), ustanovitelja tretje urske dinastije.

source.title: Gutian rule in Mesopotamia
paragraphs: The Gutian dynasty (Sumerian: 𒄖𒋾𒌝𒆠, gu-ti-umKI) was a line of kings, originating among the Gutian people. Originally thought to be a horde that swept in and brought down Akkadian and Sumerian rule in Mesopotamia, the Gutians are now known to have been in the area for at least a century by then. By the end of the Akkadian period, the Sumerian city of Adab was occupied by the Gutians, who made it their capital. The Gutian dynasty came to power in Mesopotamia near the end of the 3rd millennium BC, after the decline and fall of the Akkadian Empire. How long Gutian kings held rulership over Mesopotamia is uncertain, with estimates ranging from a few years up to a century. The end of the Gutian dynasty is marked by the accession of Uruk ruler Utu-hengal (c. 2119 - 2112 BC), marking the short-lived "Fifth dynasty of Uruk", followed by Ur ruler Ur-Nammu (c. 2112 – 2094 BC), founder of the Third Dynasty of Ur.

H-3 airstrike.headline: Letalski napad na H-3
paragraphs: Letalski napad na H-3 (perzijsko: عملیات اچ۳) je bil nenaden napad iranskega vojnega letalstva med iransko-iraško vojno 4. aprila 1981 na letalsko oporišče iraškega vojnega letalstva H-3 v zahodnem Iraku. Iranci so na tleh uničili najmanj 48 iraških letal, sami pa niso imeli izgub. Po doseženih izidih velja za enega najuspešnejših napadov v zgodovini letalskega vojskovanja.

source.title: H-3 airstrike
paragraphs: The H-3 airstrike (Persian: عملیات اچ۳) was a surprise air attack by the Iranian Air Force during the Iran–Iraq War on 4 April 1981 against the Iraqi Air Force's H-3 Air Base in western Iraq. The Iranians destroyed at least 48 Iraqi aircraft on the ground with no losses of their own. Based on the results achieved, it is considered one of the most successful raids in the history of aerial warfare.

Hammadid dynasty.headline: Hamadidi
paragraphs: Hamadidi (arabsko: الحماديون, Al-Hammādiyyūn, dobesedno »Hamadovi otroci«), znani tudi kot Hamadidski emirat ali Kraljestvo Bedžaja, so bili srednjeveško islamsko kraljestvo v osrednjem Magrebu, na ozemlju današnje Alžirije. Nastalo je v začetku 11. stoletja, ko se je Hamad ibn Bulugin razglasil za emirja in s tem razdelil ziridske posesti med dve ločeni dinastiji. Pod emirjem Al Nasirjem je emirat za kratek čas postal najpomembnejša država v Magrebu in dosegel največji obseg: od Tlemcena na zahodu do Tunisa na vzhodu ter od Sredozemskega morja na severu do puščavskih oaz Vargla in Ued Righ na jugu. Za kratek čas so Hamadidi nadzorovali tudi kneževino Fes na zahodu ter mesta, kot so Sfaks, Kajruan, Laribus in Tripoli, na vzhodu.
notes: The last English sentence is a fragment ("While they briefly controlled …"); translated as a full sentence with the same content.

source.title: Hammadid dynasty
paragraphs: The Hammadid dynasty (Arabic: الحماديون, romanized: Al-Hammādiyyūn, lit. 'children of Hammad'), also known as the Hammadid Emirate or the Kingdom of Bejaia, was a medieval Islamic kingdom in the central Maghreb, encompassing what is now Algeria. It was established at the beginning of the 11th century when Hammad ibn Buluggin declared himself emir, thus splitting the Zirid domains into two separate dynasties. Under the reign of Emir Al Nasir, the emirate briefly became the most important state in the Maghreb, and reached its greatest territorial extent, stretching from Tlemcen in the west to Tunis in the east, and from the Mediterranean Sea in the north to the desert oasis of Ouargla and Oued Righ in the south. While they briefly controlled the principality of Fez in the west and cities like Sfax, Kairouan, Laribus, and Tripoli to the east.

History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali.headline: Egipt pod dinastijo Mohameda Alija
paragraphs: Zgodovina Egipta pod dinastijo Mohameda Alija (1805–1953) zajema poznejše obdobje osmanskega Egipta, egiptovski kedivat pod britansko zasedbo ter navidezno neodvisna Egiptovski sultanat in Kraljevino Egipt, konča pa se z revolucijo leta 1952 in nastankom Republike Egipt.

source.title: History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty
paragraphs: The history of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty (1805–1953) spanned the later period of Ottoman Egypt, the Khedivate of Egypt under British occupation, and the nominally independent Sultanate of Egypt and Kingdom of Egypt, ending with the Revolution of 1952 and the formation of the Republic of Egypt.

Moamer Gadafi je 1. septembra 1969 postal dejanski voditelj Libije, potem ko je skupino častnikov libijske vojske povedel v nekrvav državni udar proti kralju Idrisu I. Ko je bil Idris na zdravljenju v Turčiji, je Revolucionarni poveljniški svet (RCC) pod Gadafijevim vodstvom odpravil monarhijo in ustavo ter ustanovil Libijsko arabsko republiko z baatističnim geslom »Enotnost, svoboda, socializem«.

source.title: History of Libya under Muammar Gaddafi
paragraphs: Muammar Gaddafi became the de facto leader of Libya on 1 September 1969 after leading a group of Libyan Army officers against King Idris I in a bloodless coup d'état. When Idris was in Turkey for medical treatment, the Revolutionary Command Council (RCC) headed by Gaddafi abolished the monarchy and the constitution and established the Libyan Arab Republic, with the Ba'athist motto "Unity, Freedom, Socialism".

History of Qatar.headline: Zgodovina Katarja
paragraphs: Zgodovina Katarja sega od prve človeške naselitve do nastanka sodobne države. Ljudje so v Katarju živeli že pred 50.000 leti, na Arabskem polotoku pa so izkopali kamenodobne tabore in orodje. Prva civilizacija, ki je bila na tem območju navzoča v neolitiku, je bila mezopotamska, kar dokazujejo najdbe črepinj iz obdobja Ubaid ob obalnih taborih.

source.title: History of Qatar
paragraphs: The history of Qatar spans from its first duration of human occupation to its formation as a modern state. Human occupation of Qatar dates back 50,000 years, and Stone Age encampments and tools have been unearthed in the Arabian Peninsula. Mesopotamia was the first civilization to have a presence in the area during the Neolithic period, evidenced by the discovery of potsherds originating from the Ubaid period near coastal encampments.

Zgodovina Sumerije zajema obdobje od poznega 5. do 3. tisočletja pr. n. št. v južni Mezopotamiji in priča o prvem prehodu na svetu od neolitskega vaškega življenja k zapleteni mestni civilizaciji. Razvoj je pospešila »monumentalizacija svetega«: skromna obredna svetišča, zlasti v Eriduju, so prerasla v ogromne templjeve komplekse, ki so delovali kot »sveti magneti«. Ta središča so pokrajino vlekla k sebi in sprožila »mestno implozijo«, ki je prebivalstvo zgostila v prvih pravih velemestih, kot je bil Uruk.

source.title: History of Sumer
paragraphs: The history of Sumer spans the late fifth to the third millennium BC in southern Mesopotamia, documenting the world's first transition from Neolithic village life to a complex urban civilization. This development was catalyzed by the "monumentalization of the sacred," a process where modest ritual shrines—most notably at Eridu—evolved into massive temple complexes that functioned as "sacred magnets." These centers exerted a centripetal force on the landscape, triggering an "urban implosion" that concentrated populations into the first true metropolises, such as Uruk.

Hotak dynasty.headline: Dinastija Hotaki
paragraphs: Imperij Hotaki (paštunsko: د هوتکيانو ټولواکمني; perzijsko: امپراتوری هوتکیان) je bila afganistanska dinastija paštunskih Gildžijev, ki je v 1720. letih za kratek čas vladala delom Irana in Afganistana. Leta 1709 jo je ustanovil Mirvais Hotak, ki je vodil uspešen upor proti propadajočemu perzijskemu Safavidskemu imperiju v pokrajini Loj Kandahar (»Veliki Kandahar«) na jugu današnjega Afganistana.

source.title: Hotak dynasty
paragraphs: The Hotak Empire (Pashto: د هوتکيانو ټولواکمني; Persian: امپراتوری هوتکیان) also known as the Hotaki Empire was an Afghan dynasty founded by Ghilji Pashtuns that briefly ruled parts of Iran and Afghanistan during the 1720s. It was established in 1709 by Mirwais Hotak, who led a successful rebellion against the declining Persian Safavid empire in the region of Loy Kandahar ("Greater Kandahar") in what is now southern Afghanistan.

Rodbina Al Kalifa (arabsko: Āl Khalīfah) je vladajoča družina Kraljevine Bahrajn. Pripada malikitski pravni šoli sunitskega islama in plemenu Aneza. Nekateri člani plemena so se pridružili zavezništvu Utub, ki se je iz Nedžda v osrednji Arabiji preselilo v Kuvajt, nato pa vladalo vsemu Katarju, natančneje Al Zubari, ki so jo zgradili in ji vladali, preden so leta 1783 osvojili Bahrajn. Družina Al Kalifa je zatirala domorodno prebivalstvo Baharna v Bahrajnu.

Družina danes vodi avtoritarni režim, v katerem so politične in državljanske svoboščine močno omejene. Njen sedanji poglavar je kralj Hamad bin Isa Al Kalifa, ki je leta 1999 postal bahrajnski emir, leta 2002 pa se je razglasil za kralja Bahrajna in tako dejansko postal ustavni monarh.
Leta 2025 je bila približno polovica ministrov bahrajnske vlade iz kraljeve družine Al Kalifa, iz nje pa je tudi predsednik vlade Salman bin Hamad Al Kalifa, sin sedanjega kralja.

source.title: House of Khalifa
paragraphs: The House of Khalifa (Arabic: آل خليفة, romanized: Āl Khalīfah) is the ruling family of the Kingdom of Bahrain. They follow the Maliki school of Sunni Islam and belong to the Anizah tribe. Some members of this tribe joined the Utub alliance which migrated from Najd in central Arabia to Kuwait, then ruled all of Qatar, more specifically Al Zubarah, which they built and ruled over before conquering Bahrain in 1783. The Khalifa family repressed the indigenous Baharna population in Bahrain.

The family currently heads an authoritarian regime where political and civil freedoms are substantially curtailed. The current head of the family is King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa, who became the Emir of Bahrain in 1999 and proclaimed himself King of Bahrain in 2002, in fact becoming a constitutional monarch.

As of 2025, roughly half of the serving cabinet ministers of Bahrain were members of the Al Khalifa royal family, while the country's Prime Minister, Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa, is also from the Al Khalifa family and is the son of the current King.

Hutijska vstaja, znana tudi kot vojne v Sadi, je bil vojaški upor zajdijskih šiitskih Hutijev, ki se je začel na severu Jemna in je odtlej prerasel v vsesplošno državljansko vojno. Spopad je leta 2004 sprožil vladni poskus, da bi aretirala Huseina al Hutija, zajdijskega verskega voditelja Hutijev in nekdanjega poslanca, za čigar glavo je vlada razpisala 55.000 dolarjev nagrade.

Sprva je večina bojev potekala v guvernoratu Sada na severozahodu Jemna, nekaj pa se jih je razširilo v sosednje guvernorate Hadža, Amran in Al Džauf ter v savdsko provinco Džizan. Ko so Hutiji konec leta 2014 zavzeli prestolnico Sano, je vstaja prerasla v vsesplošno državljansko vojno z velikim posredovanjem pod savdskim vodstvom v Jemnu, ki se je začelo marca 2015.

source.title: Houthi insurgency
paragraphs: The Houthi insurgency, also known as the Sa'dah Wars, was a military rebellion pitting Zaidi Shia Houthis that began in northern Yemen and has since escalated into a full-scale civil war. The conflict was sparked in 2004 by the government's attempt to arrest Hussein al-Houthi, a Zaidi religious leader of the Houthis and a former parliamentarian on whose head the government had placed a $55,000 bounty.

Initially, most of the fighting took place in Saada Governorate in northwestern Yemen, but some of the fighting spread to neighbouring governorates Hajjah, 'Amran, al-Jawf and the Saudi province of Jizan. After the Houthi takeover of the capital city Sanaa in late 2014, the insurgency became a full-blown civil war with a major Saudi-led intervention in Yemen beginning in March 2015.

Hutijski prevzem oblasti v Jemnu, ki ga Hutiji imenujejo revolucija 21. septembra, nasprotniki pa jemenski državni udar v letih 2014–2015, je bila ljudska revolucija proti jemenskemu predsedniku Abdrabuhu Mansurju Hadiju pod vodstvom Hutijev in njihovih privržencev, ki je vlado odrinila z oblasti. Izvirala je iz protestov pod vodstvom Hutijev, ki so se začeli mesec prej, zaostrila pa se je, ko so Hutiji 21. septembra 2014 vdrli v prestolnico Sano. Sledil je odstop predsednika vlade Mohameda Basindve, nato pa 22. januarja 2015, ko so hutijske sile zavzele predsedniško palačo, rezidenco in ključne vojaške objekte, še odstop predsednika Abdrabuha Mansurja Hadija in njegovih ministrov; 6. februarja 2015 so hutijski borci ustanovili vladajoči svet.

source.title: Houthi takeover of Yemen
paragraphs: The Houthi takeover in Yemen, also known by the Houthis as the September 21 Revolution, or 2014–15 Yemeni coup d'état (by opponents), was a popular revolution against Yemeni President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi led by the Houthis and their supporters that pushed the Yemeni government from power. It had origins in Houthi-led protests that began the previous month, and escalated when the Houthis stormed the Yemeni capital Sanaa on 21 September 2014, causing the resignation of Prime Minister Mohammed Basindawa, and later the resignation of President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi and his ministers on 22 January 2015 after Houthi forces seized the presidential palace, residence, and key military installations, and the formation of a ruling council by Houthi militants on 6 February 2015.

Iberska unija ali hispanska monarhija označuje obdobje od leta 1580 do 1640, ko je španska monarhija pod habsburško dinastijo, tedaj personalna unija kron Kastilje in Aragona, v personalno unijo pritegnila še Kraljevino Portugalsko. Pod španskimi habsburškimi vladarji Filipom II., Filipom III. in Filipom IV. je obsegala ves Iberski polotok razen Andore in francoskega ozemlja ter portugalske in španske čezmorske posesti. Unija se je začela po portugalski nasledstveni krizi leta 1580 in vojni za portugalsko nasledstvo, ki je sledila, trajala pa je do portugalske restavracijske vojne, v kateri je z razglasitvijo Ivana IV. za novega portugalskega kralja na oblast prišla nova vladajoča dinastija, rodbina Braganza.

source.title: Iberian Union
paragraphs: The Iberian Union, or the Hispanic Monarchy, describes the period from 1580 to 1640 in which the Monarchy of Spain under the Habsburg dynasty, then the personal union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon, brought in personal union also the Kingdom of Portugal. It incorporated the entire Iberian Peninsula, except Andorra and French territory, as well as Portuguese and Spanish overseas possessions, under the Spanish Habsburg monarchs Philip II, Philip III, and Philip IV. The union began after the Portuguese succession crisis of 1580 and the ensuing War of the Portuguese Succession, and lasted until the Portuguese Restoration War, during which the House of Braganza was established as Portugal's new ruling dynasty with the acclamation of John IV as the new king of Portugal.

Jemenski imami, pozneje tudi jemenski kralji, so bili verski voditelji (imami) zajdijske veje šiitskega islama. Od leta 897 so v delih Jemna vzpostavili preplet verske in posvetne politične oblasti. Njihov imamat se je v spreminjajočih se okoliščinah ohranil do konca severnojemenske državljanske vojne leta 1970, ki je sledila republikanski revoluciji leta 1962. Zajdijska teologija se od ismailizma in dvanajstniškega šiizma razlikuje po tem, da poudarja navzočnost dejavnega in vidnega imama kot voditelja. Od imama so pričakovali, da je podkovan v verskih vedah in se izkaže kot vreden voditelj skupnosti, če je bilo treba, tudi v boju. Kdor se je potegoval za imamat, je razglasil »poziv« (dava), in ni bilo redko, da je bilo kandidatov več.

source.title: Imams of Yemen
