paragraphs: The Imams of Yemen, later also titled the Kings of Yemen, were religiously consecrated leaders (imams) belonging to the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam. They established a blend of religious and temporal-political rule in parts of Yemen from 897. Their imamate endured under varying circumstances until the end of the North Yemen civil war in 1970, following the republican revolution in 1962. Zaydi theology differs from Isma'ilism and Twelver Shi'ism by stressing the presence of an active and visible imam as leader. The imam was expected to be knowledgeable in religious scholarship, and to prove himself a worthy headman of the community, even in battle if this was necessary. A claimant of the imamate would proclaim a "call" (dawah), and there were not infrequently more than one claimant.

Indoskiti, znani tudi kot Indosaki, so bili nomadsko ljudstvo iranskega skitskega izvora, ki se je iz Srednje Azije preselilo proti jugu na območje današnjega Afganistana, vzhodnega Irana in severozahodne indijske podceline (današnji Pakistan in severna Indija). Selitve so trajale od sredine 2. stoletja pr. n. št. do 4. stoletja n. št.

source.title: Indo-Scythian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Indo-Scythians, also known as Indo-Sakas, were a group of nomadic people of Iranic Scythian origin who migrated from Central Asia southward into the present-day regions of Afghanistan, eastern Iran and the northwestern Indian subcontinent (present-day Pakistan and northern India). The migrations persisted from the middle of the second century BCE to the fourth century CE.

Injuids.headline: Indžuidi
paragraphs: Indžuidi (perzijsko: اینجویان), tudi Indžu ali rodbina Indžu, so bili iranska dinastija perzijskega izvora, ki je v 14. stoletju zavladala mestoma Širaz in Isfahan. Po razpadu Ilkanata so njeni člani postali dejansko neodvisni vladarji, dokler jih leta 1357 niso porazili Muzafaridi.

source.title: Injuids
paragraphs: The Injuids (Persian: اینجویان), also Injus or House of Inju, were an Iranian dynasty of Persian origin that came to rule over the cities of Shiraz and Isfahan during the 14th century. Its members became de facto independent rulers following the breakup of the Ilkhanate until their defeat in 1357 against the Muzaffarids.

Invasion of Buhran.headline: Pohod na Buhran
paragraphs: Pohod na Buhran je potekal leta 3 po hidžri islamskega koledarja, v 4. ali 5. mesecu. Muslimani so dobili poročilo, da mogočna vojska plemena Banu Sulajm iz Buhrana napreduje proti Medini. Islamski prerok Mohamed je s 300 možmi krenil v Hidžaz do Buhrana, kjer so Banu Sulajm v paniki pobegnili.
Med pohodom niso naleteli na sovražnika in do boja ni prišlo. Muslimanski učenjak Saifur Rahman al Mubarakpuri pohod šteje za »patruljni pohod«.
Dogodek omenjata Ibn Hišamov Mohamedov življenjepis in sodobni islamski viri, kot je Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum (Zapečateni nektar) Saifurja Rahmana al Mubarakpurija.

source.title: Invasion of Buhran
paragraphs: The Invasion of Buhran occurred in 3 A.H of the Islamic calendar of the 4th or 5th month. A report had arrived to the Muslims that a formidable force of the Banu Sulaym from Buhran were advancing on Madinah. The Islamic prophet Muhammad, took 300 men, to Hijaz reaching to Buhran, where the Banu Sulaym fled in panic.
Throughout the expedition, they did not meet any enemies, and no fighting took place. The expedition is regarded as a "patrolling invasion", according to Muslim scholar Saifur Rahman al-Mubarakpuri.
This event is mentioned in Ibn Hisham's biography of Muhammad and modern Islamic sources such as Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum by Saifur Rahman Al-Mubarakpuri.

Iranska revolucija, znana tudi kot islamska revolucija, se je leta 1979 končala s strmoglavljenjem dinastije Pahlavijev. Cesarsko državo Iran je nadomestila Islamska republika Iran: monarhično vlado šaha Mohameda Reze Pahlavija je zamenjal islamistični klerik Ruholah Homeini, ki je vodil eno od uporniških frakcij in postal vrhovni voditelj države. Odstavitev Mohameda Reze Pahlavija, zadnjega iranskega šaha, je formalno končala zgodovinsko iransko monarhijo.

Leta 1953 je iranski državni udar, ki sta ga podprli Cia in MI6, strmoglavil iranskega predsednika vlade Mohameda Mosadeka, ki je nacionaliziral Anglo-perzijsko naftno družbo. Udar je Mohamedu Rezi Pahlaviju vrnil položaj absolutnega monarha in močno okrepil vpliv Združenih držav v Iranu.

source.title: Iranian Revolution
paragraphs: The Iranian Revolution, also known as the Islamic Revolution, culminated in the overthrow of the Pahlavi dynasty in 1979. The revolution led to the replacement of the Imperial State of Iran by the Islamic Republic of Iran, as the monarchical government of Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi was superseded by Ruhollah Khomeini, an Islamist cleric who had headed one of the rebel factions, and became the country’s supreme leader.The ousting of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the last Shah of Iran, formally marked the end of Iran's historical monarchy.

In 1953, the CIA and MI6-backed 1953 Iranian coup d'état overthrew Iran's prime minister, Mohammad Mossadegh, who had nationalized the Anglo-Persian Oil Company. The coup reinstated Mohammad Reza Pahlavi as an absolute monarch and significantly increased the level of influence of the United States over Iran.

Iraški konflikt je vrsta nasilnih dogodkov, ki so se začeli z invazijo na Irak pod ameriškim vodstvom leta 2003 in odstavitvijo iraškega diktatorja Sadama Huseina, sledila pa jim je vrsta spopadov, med njimi dolgotrajna iraška vojna (2003–2011), iraška vstaja (2011–2013), vojna v Iraku (2013–2017) in nazadnje uporništvo Islamske države majhnega obsega v 4 provincah severnega Iraka od leta 2017.

source.title: Iraqi conflict
paragraphs: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.

Iraško uporništvo je trajalo od leta 2003 do 2011: začelo se je kmalu po tem, ko je ameriška invazija leta 2003 odstavila dolgoletnega voditelja Sadama Huseina, in trajalo do konca iraške vojne in ameriškega umika leta 2011. Sledila mu je nova vstaja.

Prvi izbruh nasilja (faza 2003–2006) je sprožil padec režima, potekal pa je pred tem, ko so večnacionalne sile v Iraku (MNF–I) pod vodstvom ZDA vzpostavile novo iraško vlado. Približno od leta 2004 do maja 2007 so iraški uporniki napadali predvsem vojake MNF-I, pozneje pa tudi povojne iraške varnostne sile.

Uporniki so bili raznolika mešanica zasebnih milic, baatistov, zvestih Sadamu, krajevnih Iračanov, ki so nasprotovali MNF–I in/ali iraški vladi po Sadamu, ter nekaj tujih džihadistov. Različne uporniške skupine so proti MNF–I in iraški vladi bojevale asimetrično izčrpavalno vojno, hkrati pa so se spopadale tudi med seboj.

source.title: Iraqi insurgency (2003–2011)
paragraphs: The Iraqi insurgency lasted from 2003 until 2011, beginning shortly after the 2003 American invasion deposed longtime leader Saddam Hussein, and lasting until the end of the Iraq War and U.S. withdrawal in 2011. It was followed by a renewed insurgency.

The initial outbreak of violence (the 2003–2006 phase) was triggered by the fall and preceded the establishment of the new Iraqi government by the Multi-National Force – Iraq (MNF–I), which was led by the U.S. From around 2004 to May 2007, Iraqi insurgents largely focused their attacks on MNF-I troops, but later shifted to targeting the post-invasion Iraqi security forces as well.

The insurgents were composed of a diverse mix of private militias, pro-Saddam Ba'athists, local Iraqis opposed to the MNF–I and/or the post-Saddam Iraqi government, and a number of foreign jihadists. The various insurgent groups fought an asymmetric war of attrition against the MNF–I and the Iraqi government, while also fighting among themselves.

Iraška vstaja je bila vstaja, ki se je začela konec leta 2011 po koncu iraške vojne in umiku ameriških čet iz Iraka in je pripeljala do nasilnega spopada z osrednjo vlado ter do verskega nasilja nizke intenzivnosti med iraškimi verskimi skupinami.

Vstaja je bila neposredno nadaljevanje dogodkov po invaziji na Irak pod ameriškim vodstvom leta 2003. Sunitske borbene skupine so okrepile napade na šiitsko večino, da bi spodkopale zaupanje v vlado pod šiitskim vodstvom in njena prizadevanja, da bi ljudi zaščitila brez pomoči koalicije. Številne sunitske frakcije so nasprotovale sirski vladi, ki so jo šiitske skupine začele podpirati, mnogi pripadniki obeh veroizpovedi pa so prestopili mejo in se bojevali v Siriji.

source.title: Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013)
paragraphs: The Iraqi insurgency was an insurgency that began in late 2011 after the end of the Iraq War and the withdrawal of U.S. troops from Iraq, resulting in violent conflict with the central government, as well as low-level sectarian violence among Iraq's religious groups.

The insurgency was a direct continuation of events following the U.S.-led invasion of Iraq in 2003. Sunni militant groups stepped up attacks targeting the country's majority Shia population to undermine confidence in the Shia-led government and its efforts to protect people without coalition assistance. Many Sunni factions stood against the Syrian government, which Shia groups moved to support, and numerous members of both sects also crossed the border to fight in Syria.

Iraqi Kurdish Civil War.headline: Iraška kurdska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Iraška kurdska državljanska vojna (kurdsko: Şerî birakujî, dobesedno »bratomorna vojna«) je bila državljanska vojna med tekmujočimi kurdskimi frakcijami v iraškem Kurdistanu sredi 1990. let, predvsem med Patriotsko unijo Kurdistana in Kurdistansko demokratsko stranko. Med spopadom so se v boje zapletle kurdske frakcije iz Irana in Turčije ter iranske, iraške in turške sile, posredovale pa so tudi ameriške sile. Ubitih je bilo od 5000 do 8000 borcev in civilistov.

source.title: Iraqi Kurdish Civil War
paragraphs: The Iraqi Kurdish Civil War (Kurdish: شەڕی براکوژی, romanized: Şerî birakujî, lit. 'fratricidal war') was a civil war that took place between rival Kurdish factions in Iraqi Kurdistan during the mid-1990s, mostly between the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan and the Kurdistan Democratic Party. Over the course of the conflict, Kurdish factions from Iran and Turkey, as well as Iranian, Iraqi and Turkish forces, were drawn into the fighting, with additional involvement from American forces. Between 5,000 and 8,000 fighters and civilians were killed.

Iraško-kurdski konflikt sestavlja vrsta vojn, uporov in sporov med Kurdi in osrednjo iraško oblastjo, ki se je začela v 20. stoletju, kmalu po porazu Osmanskega cesarstva v prvi svetovni vojni. Nekateri za začetek spopada štejejo poskus Mahmuda Barzandžija, da bi ustanovil neodvisno Kraljevino Kurdistan, drugi pa za spopad štejejo le upor Barzanijev po letu 1961.

source.title: Iraqi–Kurdish conflict
paragraphs: The Iraqi–Kurdish conflict consists of a series of wars, rebellions and disputes between the Kurds and the central authority of Iraq starting in the 20th century shortly after the defeat of the Ottoman Empire in World War I. Some put the marking point of the conflict beginning to the attempt by Mahmud Barzanji to establish an independent Kingdom of Kurdistan, while others relate to the conflict as only the post-1961 insurrection by the Barzanis.

Israel–Jordan peace treaty.headline: Izraelsko-jordanska mirovna pogodba
paragraphs: Izraelsko-jordanska mirovna pogodba (uradno Mirovna pogodba med Državo Izrael in Hašemitsko kraljevino Jordanijo), včasih imenovana pogodba iz Vadi Arabe, je sporazum, ki je končal vojno stanje med državama, trajajoče od arabsko-izraelske vojne leta 1948, in vzpostavil diplomatske odnose. Pogodba je poleg miru razrešila tudi spore o zemlji in vodi, predvidela široko sodelovanje v turizmu in trgovini ter obe državi zavezala, da ne bosta dovolili, da bi tretja država njuno ozemlje uporabila kot izhodišče za vojaške napade.
Slovesnost ob podpisu je potekala na južnem mejnem prehodu Araba 26. oktobra 1994. Jordanija je bila za Egiptom druga arabska država, ki je z Izraelom podpisala mirovni sporazum.

source.title: Israel–Jordan peace treaty
paragraphs: The Israel–Jordan peace treaty (formally the Treaty of Peace Between the State of Israel and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan), sometimes referred to as the Wadi Araba Treaty, is an agreement that ended the state of war that had existed between the two countries since the 1948 Arab–Israeli War and established mutual diplomatic relations. In addition to establishing peace between the two countries, the treaty also settled land and water disputes, provided for broad cooperation in tourism and trade, and obligated both countries to prevent their territory being used as a staging ground for military strikes by a third country.
The signing ceremony took place at the southern border crossing of Arabah on 26 October 1994. Jordan was the second Arab country, after Egypt, to sign a peace accord with Israel.

Izrael je 9. oktobra 2023 zaostril blokado Gaze, ko je po napadih 7. oktobra in vojni v Gazi, ki je sledila, razglasil »popolno blokado« in preprečil dovoz hrane, vode, zdravil, goriva in elektrike. Blokada je po ocenah znatno prispevala h genocidu v Gazi. Izrael je odpravo blokade pogojeval z vrnitvijo talcev, ki jih je ugrabil Hamas, kar so kritizirali kot kolektivno kaznovanje in očitni vojni zločin. Avgusta 2025 je 27 evropskih držav in več kot 100 mednarodnih humanitarnih organizacij pozvalo k odpravi izraelske blokade pomoči v Gazo.

source.title: Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)
paragraphs: On 9 October 2023, Israel intensified its blockade of the Gaza Strip when it announced a "total blockade", blocking the entry of food, water, medicine, fuel and electricity after the October 7 attacks and the ensuing Gaza war. The blockade has been credited with contributing significantly to the Gaza genocide. Israel has conditioned its lifting of the blockade with the return of the hostages abducted by Hamas, which has been criticized as collective punishment and an apparent war crime. As of August 2025, 27 European countries and over 100 international aid organizations have called for an end to Israel's blockade of aid into Gaza.

Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present).headline: Izraelska invazija na Sirijo (od 2024)
paragraphs: Po padcu Asadovega režima 8. decembra 2024 je Izrael vdrl v demilitarizirano tamponsko območje na jugozahodu Sirije (ob Golanski planoti, ki jo zaseda Izrael) in ga še vedno zaseda. Izrael je izvedel tudi kampanjo letalskih napadov, da bi ohromil sirske oborožene sile, od katerih je zahteval, naj se ne vračajo na jug Sirije. Izraelska vlada je dejala, da naj bi ti ukrepi preprečili vsako »morebitno grožnjo« povojne Sirije.

source.title: Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)
paragraphs: Following the fall of the Assad regime on 8 December 2024, Israel invaded the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria (adjacent to the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights) and has continued to occupy it. Israel also carried out an airstrike campaign to cripple the Syrian Armed Forces, and demanded that it stay out of southern Syria. The Israeli government remarked that these actions were intended to prevent any "potential threat" from post-war Syria.

Jalayirid Sultanate.headline: Džalairidski sultanat
paragraphs: Džalairidski sultanat (perzijsko: Jalāyiriyān), imenovan tudi dinastija Ilka ali Ilkanidi, je bila mongolska dinastija, ki je po razpadu Ilkanata v 1330. letih vladala današnjemu Iraku in zahodnemu Iranu. Širila se je okoli petdeset let, dokler je niso zaustavili Timurjeva osvajanja in upori turkmenskih Kara Kojunlujev. Po Timurjevi smrti leta 1405 so sultanat za kratek čas skušali obnoviti v južnem Iraku in Huzestanu, Kara Kojunluji pa so Džalairide dokončno odpravili leta 1432.

source.title: Jalayirid Sultanate
paragraphs: The Jalayirid Sultanate (Persian: جلایریان, romanized: Jalāyiriyān), also Ilka dynasty or Ilkanids, was a Mongol dynasty which ruled over modern-day Iraq and western Iran after the breakup of the Ilkhanate in the 1330s. It expanded for about fifty years, until disrupted by Timur's conquests and the revolts of the Qara Qoyunlu Turkoman. After Timur's death in 1405, there was a brief attempt to re-establish the sultanate in southern Iraq and Khuzistan. The Jalayirids were finally eliminated by the Qara Qoyunlu in 1432.

Julian's Persian expedition.headline: Julijanov perzijski pohod
paragraphs: Julijanov perzijski pohod je potekal od marca do julija 363 n. št. Bil je zadnji vojaški pohod rimskega cesarja Julijana, ki je padel v bitki pri Samari. Rimsko cesarstvo se je bojevalo proti Sasanidskemu imperiju, ki mu je tedaj vladal Šapur II., in je hotelo zavzeti sasanidsko prestolnico Ktezifon.

Da bi sovražnika zavedel in izvedel klešče, je Julijan poslal odred, ki naj bi se pridružil njegovemu zavezniku Aršaku II. iz arsakidske Armenije in s severa krenil ob Tigrisu. Njegova glavna vojska in velika flota sta medtem skoraj brez odpora hitro napredovali ob Evfratu navzdol in na poti uničili več dobro utrjenih mest. Ladje so nato prispele do obzidja Ktezifona, kjer se je na obrambnih položajih zbrala velika sasanidska vojska.

source.title: Julian's Persian expedition
paragraphs: Julian's Persian expedition took place from March to July 363 AD. It was the final military campaign to be undertaken by Roman emperor Julian, who died in battle at Samarra. The Roman Empire fought against the Sasanian Empire, which was ruled at the time by Shapur II, and sought to capture the Sasanian capital city Ctesiphon.

In order to mislead the enemy and to carry out a pincer attack, Julian sent a detachment to join with his ally Arshak II of Arsacid Armenia to take the Tigris route from the north. Meanwhile, his main army and a large fleet, facing little opposition, advanced rapidly down the Euphrates, destroying several well-fortified cities along the way. The ships then reached the walls of Ctesiphon, where a large Sasanian army had assembled in defensive positions.

Jungle Movement of Gilan.headline: Gibanje Džangal v Gilanu
paragraphs: Gibanje Džangal (»gozd« ali »džungla«; perzijsko: جنبش جنگل) je bil upor proti monarhistični osrednji vladi Vzvišene države Iran v Gilanu, ki je trajal od leta 1915 do 1921.

source.title: Jungle Movement of Gilan
paragraphs: The Jangal (Forest or Jungle) Movement (Persian: جنبش جنگل) was a rebellion against the monarchist central government of the Sublime State of Iran in Gilan, which lasted from 1915 to 1921.

Karamanli dynasty.headline: Karamanliji
paragraphs: Karamanliji (tudi Caramanli ali Qaramanli) so bili samostojna dinastija, ki je od leta 1711 do 1835 vladala osmanski Tripolitaniji. Njihovo ozemlje je obsegalo Tripoli z okolico na območju današnje Libije. Na vrhuncu je vpliv Karamanlijev segal do Kirenajke in Fezana in je pokrival večji del Libije. Ustanovitelj dinastije je bil Ahmed Karamanli, potomec srednjeveških Karamanidov. Najbolj znani karamanlijski vladar je bil Jusuf ibn Ali Karamanli, ki je vladal od leta 1795 do 1832 in se med letoma 1801 in 1805 vojskoval z Združenimi državami Amerike. Zadnji iz dinastije je bil Ali II.

source.title: Karamanli dynasty
paragraphs: The Karamanli dynasty (also spelled Caramanli or Qaramanli) was an autonomous dynasty that ruled Ottoman Tripolitania from 1711 to 1835. Their territory comprised Tripoli and its surroundings in present-day Libya. At its peak, the Karamanli dynasty's influence reached Cyrenaica and Fezzan, covering most of Libya. The founder of the dynasty was Ahmed Karamanli, a descendant of the medieval Karamanids. The most well-known Karamanli ruler was Yusuf ibn Ali Karamanli who reigned from 1795 to 1832, who fought a war with the United States between 1801 and 1805. Ali II was the last of the dynasty.

Karasids.headline: Karasidi
paragraphs: Karasidi (osmansko turško: قرا صـی; turško: Karesioğulları) so bili turkmenska dinastija, ki je v prvi polovici 14. stoletja vladala pokrajini Miziji na severozahodu Anatolije. Legendarni rodovniki družino sicer povezujejo z Danišmendidi, dinastijo iz osrednje Anatolije iz 11. in 12. stoletja, vendar naj bi prva karasidska vladarja, Karasi beg, po katerem se dinastija imenuje, in njegov oče Kalam šah, prevzela pokrajino okoli Balıkesirja med vladavino Mesuda II. (vladal 1284–1297 in 1303–1308) iz Rumskega sultanata in razglasila samostojnost. Po smrti Karasi bega je dinastija vladala dvema ločenima emiratoma, na čelu katerih sta bila Demir kan in Jahši kan. Demir kan je s svojim ladjevjem nadlegoval mesto Kizik in naselja v Trakiji, zato je leta 1328 sklenil premirje z bizantinskim cesarjem Andronikom III. (vladal 1328–1341). Leta 1333 se je sestal z Ibn Batuto, ki je o njem pisal neprizanesljivo. Sulejman beg, zadnji karasidski vladar, ki ga omenjajo bizantinski viri, je bil poročen s hčerjo Ivana Vataca in se je vmešaval v notranje boje na bizantinskem ozemlju. Po tem bizantinski viri Karasidov ne omenjajo več.
notes: Abbreviated reign ranges (1284–97, 1303–8, 1328–41) are written in full, as the Pravopis asks.

source.title: Karasids
paragraphs: The Karasids (Ottoman Turkish: قرا صـی; Turkish: Karesioğulları) were a Turkoman dynasty that ruled the region of Mysia in northwestern Anatolia during the first half of the 14th century. While legendary lineages link the family to the Danishmendids, an 11–12th-century dynasty in central Anatolia, the earliest Karasid rulers the eponymous Karasi Bey and his father Kalam Shah are thought to have taken over the region around Balıkesir during the reign of Mesud II (r. 1284–97, 1303–8) of the Sultanate of Rum claiming independence. Following the death of Karasi Bey, the dynasty ended up ruling two separate emirates, headed by Demir Khan and Yakhshi Khan. Demir Khan is known to have harassed the town of Cyzicus and settlements in Thrace through his naval forces and thus signed a truce with the Byzantine Emperor Andronikos III (r. 1328–41) in 1328. In 1333, he met with Ibn Battuta, who wrote unfavorably about him. Suleiman Bey, the latest Karasid ruler attested to by Byzantine sources, was married to the daughter of John Vatatzes and meddled with the internal strife within the Byzantine domains. Byzantine sources ceased mentioning the Karasids after that point.

Kart dynasty.headline: Dinastija Kart
paragraphs: Dinastija Kart ali Kartidi (perzijsko: آل کرت) je bila sunitska muslimanska dinastija tadžiškega izvora, tesno povezana z Guridi, ki je v 13. in 14. stoletju vladala velikemu delu Horasana. Vladali so iz prestolnice Herat in iz Bamjana v osrednjem Horasanu, sprva kot podložniki sultana Guridskega imperija Gijas ad Dina Mohameda bin Sama, s katerim so bili v sorodu, nato pa kot vazalni knezi v Mongolskem imperiju. Ko je Ilkanat leta 1335 razpadel, je Muiz ad Din Husein ibn Gijas ad Din skušal svojo kneževino razširiti. Huseinova smrt leta 1370 in Timurjev vdor leta 1381 sta končala ambicije dinastije.

source.title: Kart dynasty
paragraphs: The Kart dynasty, also known as the Kartids (Persian: آل کرت), was a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Tajik origin, closely related to the Ghurids, that ruled over a large part of Khorasan during the 13th and 14th centuries. Ruling from their capital at Herat and central Khorasan in the Bamyan, they were at first subordinates of Sultan Abul-Fateh Ghiyāṣ-ud-din Muhammad bin Sām, Sultan of the Ghurid Empire, to whom they were related, and then as vassal princes within the Mongol Empire. Upon the fragmentation of the Ilkhanate in 1335, Mu'izz-uddin Husayn ibn Ghiyath-uddin worked to expand his principality. The death of Husayn b. Ghiyath-uddin in 1370 and the invasion of Timur in 1381, ended the Kart dynasty's ambitions.

Kastamonu.headline: Kastamonu
paragraphs: Kastamonu je mesto na severu Turčije in sedež province Kastamonu in okrožja Kastamonu. Ima 125.622 prebivalcev (2021). Mesto leži na nadmorski višini 904 m, na južnem delu province.
notes: The feet conversion (2,966 ft) is dropped.
The record is a state, but its link points to the article on the modern city of Kastamonu; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Kastamonu
paragraphs: Kastamonu is a city in northern Turkey. It is the seat of Kastamonu Province and Kastamonu District. Its population is 125,622 (2021). The city lies at an elevation of 904 m (2,966 ft). It is located in the southern part of the province.

Egiptovski kedivat je bil samostojna tributarna država Osmanskega cesarstva, ki so jo ustanovili in ji vladali pripadniki dinastije Mohameda Alija. Po porazu in izgonu Napoleonovih sil iz Egipta leta 1801 in po vzhodni krizi leta 1840 so Mohamed Ali in njegovi nasledniki osmanskemu Egiptu že vladali z veliko samostojnostjo. Leta 1867 je osmanski sultan vnuku Mohameda Alija, Ismail paši (vladal 1863–1879), podelil naziv kediva skupaj s skoraj popolno samostojnostjo v notranjih zadevah, nekaterimi diplomatskimi privilegiji in pravico do določanja nasledstva.

source.title: Khedivate of Egypt
paragraphs: The Khedivate of Egypt was an autonomous tributary state of the Ottoman Empire established and ruled by members of the dynasty of Muhammad Ali. Following the defeat and expulsion of Napoleon's forces from Egypt in 1801, and then the Oriental Crisis of 1840, Muhammad Ali and his successors had already ruled Ottoman Egypt with a significant degree of autonomy. In 1867, the Ottoman sultan granted Muhammad Ali's grandson, Isma'il Pasha (r. 1863–1879), the title of Khedive along with near-total autonomy over internal affairs, certain diplomatic privileges, and the order of succession.

Kingdom of Africa.headline: Afriško kraljestvo
paragraphs: Afriško kraljestvo je bilo podaljšek obmejnega pasu Sicilskega kraljestva v nekdanji rimski provinci Afriki (arabsko Ifrīqiya), ki ustreza današnji Tuniziji ter delom Alžirije in Libije. Glavni primarni viri o kraljestvu so arabski (muslimanski), latinskih (krščanskih) je manj.

source.title: Kingdom of Africa
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Africa was an extension of the frontier zone of the Kingdom of Sicily in the former Roman province of Africa (Ifrīqiya in Arabic), corresponding to Tunisia and parts of Algeria and Libya today. The main primary sources for the kingdom are Arabic (Muslim); the Latin (Christian) sources are scanter.

Kraljestvo Bitinija (starogrško: Βιθυνία) je bilo helenistično kraljestvo s središčem v zgodovinski pokrajini Bitiniji na severozahodu Anatolije, ki je bilo očitno ustanovljeno v 4. stoletju pr. n. št. Sredi vojn diadohov si je Zipojt leta 297 pr. n. št. nadel grški naziv basileus (kralj).

Njegov sin in naslednik Nikomed I. je ustanovil Nikomedijo, ki je kmalu zelo uspevala. Med njegovo dolgo vladavino (ok. 278 – ok. 255 pr. n. št.) in vladavinami njegovih naslednikov Prusiasa I. (vladal ok. 228–182 pr. n. št.), Prusiasa II. (vladal ok. 182–149 pr. n. št.) in Nikomeda II. (vladal ok. 149–127 pr. n. št.) je Kraljestvo Bitinija cvetelo in imelo precejšen ugled in vpliv med manjšimi monarhijami Anatolije. Zadnji kralj, Nikomed IV., pa se ni mogel obdržati na oblasti proti pontskemu kralju Mitridatu VI. Ko ga je rimski senat vrnil na prestol, je leta 74 pr. n. št. z oporoko zapustil kraljestvo Rimski republiki, ki ga je istega leta preoblikovala v provinco Bitinija in Pont.

source.title: Kingdom of Bithynia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Bithynia (Ancient Greek: Βιθυνία) was a Hellenistic kingdom centred in the historical region of Bithynia, in northwest Anatolia, which seems to have been established in the 4th century BC. In the midst of the Wars of the Diadochi, Zipoites assumed the Greek title of basileus (meaning king) in 297 BC.

His son and successor, Nicomedes I, founded Nicomedia, which soon rose to great prosperity. During his long reign (c. 278 – c. 255 BC), as well as those of his successors, Prusias I (r. c. 228 – 182 BC), Prusias II (r. c. 182 – 149 BC) and Nicomedes II (r. c. 149 – 127 BC), the Kingdom of Bithynia prospered and had a considerable standing and influence among the minor monarchies of Anatolia. But the last king, Nicomedes IV, was unable to maintain himself in power against Mithridates VI of Pontus. After being restored to his throne by the Roman Senate, he bequeathed his kingdom through his will to the Roman republic in 74 BC and it became the province of Bithynia et Pontus in 74 BC.
Kapadokija (grško: Καππαδοκία) je bila iransko kraljestvo helenističnega obdobja s središčem v zgodovinski pokrajini Kapadokiji v Mali Aziji (v današnji osrednji Turčiji).

Razvilo se je iz nekdanje ahemenidske satrapije Kapadokije, ustanovil pa ga je njen zadnji satrap Ariarat (pozneje Ariarat I.). V vsej svoji zgodovini so mu zaporedoma vladale tri rodbine: Ariaratova (331–96 pr. n. št.), Ariobarzanova (96–36 pr. n. št.) in nazadnje Arhelajeva (36 pr. n. št.–17 n. št.). Kapadoški kralji so različne vidike kraljestva načrtno helenizirali. Leta 17 n. št., po Arhelajevi smrti in med vladavino rimskega cesarja Tiberija (14–37 n. št.), so kraljestvo vključili v rimsko provinco.

source.title: Kingdom of Cappadocia
paragraphs: Cappadocia (Greek: Καππαδοκία) was a Hellenistic-era Iranian kingdom centered in the historical region of Cappadocia in Asia Minor (present-day central Turkey).

It developed from the former Achaemenid satrapy of Cappadocia, and it was founded by its last satrap, Ariarathes (later Ariarathes I). Throughout its history, it was ruled by three families in succession: the House of Ariarathes (331–96 BC), the House of Ariobarzanes (96–36 BC), and lastly that of Archelaus (36 BC–17 AD). The Cappadocian kings Hellenized various aspects of the kingdom on purpose. In 17 AD, following the death of Archelaus, during the reign of Roman emperor Tiberius (14–37 AD), the kingdom was incorporated as a Roman province.

Kraljevina Egipt (arabsko: Al-Mamlaka Al-Miṣriyya, dobesedno »Egiptovsko kraljestvo«) je bila pravna oblika egiptovske države v zadnjem obdobju vladavine dinastije Mohameda Alija, od leta 1922, ko je Združeno kraljestvo priznalo egiptovsko neodvisnost, do odprave monarhije Egipta in Sudana leta 1953 po egiptovski revoluciji leta 1952. Do angleško-egiptovske pogodbe leta 1936 je bila kraljevina neodvisna le navidezno, saj je Združeno kraljestvo obdržalo nadzor nad zunanjimi odnosi, komunikacijami, vojsko in ozemljem Angleško-egiptovskega Sudana. Uradno je bil Sudan kondominij obeh držav, v resnici pa je imelo oblast v Sudanu Združeno kraljestvo. Med letoma 1936 in 1953 so Britanci v zmanjšanem obsegu ohranili vojaško navzočnost ob Sueškem prekopu in vpliv na politične svetovalce Egipta.

source.title: Kingdom of Egypt
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Egypt (Arabic: المملكة المصرية, romanized: Al-Mamlaka Al-Miṣriyya, lit. 'The Egyptian Kingdom') was the legal form of the Egyptian state during the latter period of the Muhammad Ali dynasty's reign, from the United Kingdom's recognition of Egyptian independence in 1922 until the abolition of the monarchy of Egypt and the Sudan in 1953 following the Egyptian Revolution of 1952. Until the Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936, the Kingdom was only nominally independent, as the United Kingdom retained control of foreign relations, communications, the military, and the territory of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan. Officially, Sudan was governed as a condominium of the two states; however, in reality, true power in Sudan lay with the United Kingdom. Between 1936 and 1953, the British continued to maintain their military presence in the Suez Canal, as well as influence over Egypt's political advisers, at a reduced level.

Kraljestvo Gruzija, znano tudi kot Gruzijski imperij, je bila srednjeveška evrazijska monarhija, ustanovljena ok. leta 1008 n. št. Zlato dobo politične in gospodarske moči je doživelo med vladavino kralja Davida IV. in kraljice Tamare Velike od 11. do 13. stoletja. Gruzija je postala ena vodilnih držav krščanskega vzhoda, njen vsekavkaški imperij in mreža tributarnih ozemelj pa sta segala od vzhodne Evrope do Anatolije in severnih obmejnih območij Irana. Na vrhuncu vpliva je imela Gruzija tudi več pomembnih verskih središč v tujini, kot so samostan Bačkovo v Bolgariji, samostan Svetega križa v Jeruzalemu in samostan Iviron v Grčiji. Kraljestvo je glavna zgodovinska predhodnica današnje Gruzije.

source.title: Kingdom of Georgia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Georgia, also known as the Georgian Empire, was a medieval Eurasian monarchy that was founded in c. 1008 AD. It reached its Golden Age of political and economic strength during the reign of King David IV and Queen Tamar the Great from the 11th to 13th centuries. Georgia became one of the pre-eminent nations of the Christian East, and its pan-Caucasian empire and network of tributaries stretched from Eastern Europe to Anatolia and northern frontiers of Iran. At the height of its influence, Georgia also maintained several important religious centers abroad, such as the Bachkovo Monastery in Bulgaria, Monastery of the Cross in Jerusalem and the Monastery of Iviron in Greece. It is the principal historical precursor of present-day Georgia.

Hašemitsko kraljestvo Hedžas (arabsko: Al-Mamlakah al-Ḥijāziyyah Al-Hāshimiyyah) je bila država v pokrajini Hedžas v zahodni Aziji, ki je obsegala zahodni del Arabskega polotoka in ji je vladala hašemitska dinastija. Za kraljestvo se je razglasila junija 1916, med prvo svetovno vojno, da bi postala neodvisna od Osmanskega cesarstva, na podlagi zavezništva z Britanskim imperijem, s katerim naj bi med arabskim uporom pregnali osmansko vojsko z Arabskega polotoka.

source.title: Kingdom of Hejaz
paragraphs: The Hashemite Kingdom of Hejaz (Arabic: المملكة الحجازية الهاشمية, romanized: Al-Mamlakah al-Ḥijāziyyah Al-Hāshimiyyah) was a state in the Hejaz region of Western Asia that included the western portion of the Arabian Peninsula that was ruled by the Hashemite dynasty. It was self-proclaimed as a kingdom in June 1916 during the First World War, to be independent from the Ottoman Empire, on the basis of an alliance with the British Empire to drive the Ottoman Army from the Arabian Peninsula during the Arab Revolt.

Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd.headline: Kraljevina Hedžas in Nedžd
paragraphs: Tretja savdska država je sedanja savdska država in naslednica prvih dveh, ustanovil pa jo je Abdul Aziz bin Abdul Rahman (znan tudi kot Ibn Saud), ki je 13. januarja 1902 zavzel mesto Rijad. Dolga vrsta spopadov in osvajanj je nazadnje pripeljala do nastanka sodobne savdske države, Kraljevine Savdske Arabije.

Tretja savdska država se je na začetku imenovala »Emirat Rijad« (1902–1913) in »Emirat Nedžd in Hasa« (1913–1921). Ko je strmoglavila tekmeca, Emirat Hail, in tako dobila nadzor nad vso pokrajino Nedžd, se je preimenovala v Sultanat Nedžd. Abdul Aziz je leta 1925 osvojil Kraljevino Hedžas, leta 1927 pa je Nedžd povzdignil v kraljevino, njegova posest pa se je odtlej imenovala Kraljevina Hedžas in Nedžd s pridruženimi ozemlji. Oba dela dvojne kraljevine je upravljal ločeno, dokler ni priključil Južnega ozemlja in leta 1932 razglasil ustanovitve Kraljevine Savdske Arabije.

source.title: Third Saudi state
paragraphs: The third Saudi state is the current Saudi state and successor to the two earlier states: the first and the second, founded by Abdul Aziz bin Abdul Rahman (also known as "Ibn Saud"), who managed to capture the city of Riyadh on January 13, 1902. A long series of conflicts and conquests ultimately led to the establishment of the modern and contemporary Saudi state, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The third Saudi state was known at the beginning of its reign as "the Emirate of Riyadh" (1902–1913) and "the Emirate of Nejd and Hasa" (1913–1921). After the overthrow of the rival Emirate of Ha'il, which gave the Emirate of Najd and Al-Ahsa control of the entire Nejd region, it became known as the Sultanate of Nejd. Abdul Aziz conquered the Kingdom of Hejaz in 1925. He raised Nejd to a kingdom in 1927, and his dominions became known as the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd and its annexes. Abdul Aziz administered the two portions of his dual kingdom separately until the annexation of the Southern Territory and the announcement of the establishment of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932.

Hašemitska Kraljevina Irak je bila iraška država na Bližnjem vzhodu, ki je obstajala od leta 1932 do 1958. Kot Kraljevino Irak so jo ustanovili 23. avgusta 1921, po porazu Osmanskega cesarstva v mezopotamski kampanji prve svetovne vojne. Društvo narodov je mandat sicer leta 1920 podelilo Združenemu kraljestvu, a je zaradi iraškega upora istega leta prvotni načrt mandata propadel; nadomestila ga je formalno suverena iraška kraljevina, ki pa je bila dejansko pod britansko upravo. Načrt je formalno uveljavila angleško-iraška pogodba. Kraljevina je imela ob ustanovitvi leta 1928 2,8 milijona prebivalcev, ob koncu leta 1958 pa 6,5 milijona.

source.title: Kingdom of Iraq
paragraphs: The Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq was the Iraqi state located in the Middle East from 1932 to 1958. It was founded on 23 August 1921 as the Kingdom of Iraq, following the defeat of the Ottoman Empire in the Mesopotamian campaign of the World War I. Although a League of Nations mandate was awarded to the United Kingdom in 1920, the 1920 Iraqi revolt resulted in the scrapping of the original mandate plan in favour of a formally sovereign Iraqi kingdom, but one that was under effective British administration. The plan was formally established by the Anglo-Iraqi Treaty. The population of the Kingdom was 2.8 million at the founding in 1928, and by the end of the Kingdom in 1958 it was 6.5 million.

Kraljestvo Juda je bilo izraelsko kraljestvo na južnem Levantu v železni dobi. Središče je imelo v višavju zahodno od Mrtvega morja, prestolnica pa je bil Jeruzalem. Štiri stoletja mu je vladala Davidova rodbina. Judje so dobili ime po Judi in izhajajo predvsem od ljudi, ki so živeli na tem območju.

source.title: Kingdom of Judah
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Judah was an Israelite kingdom of the Southern Levant during the Iron Age. Centered in the highlands to the west of the Dead Sea, the kingdom's capital was Jerusalem. It was ruled by the House of David for four centuries. Jews are named after Judah, and primarily descend from people who lived in the region.

Kraljevina Libija (arabsko: المملكة الليبية, Al-Mamlakah Al-Lībiyya, dobesedno »Libijsko kraljestvo«; italijansko: Regno di Libia), od leta 1951 do 1963 znana kot Združena kraljevina Libija, je bila ustavna monarhija v severni Afriki.

Združena kraljevina je nastala 24. decembra 1951, ko se je osamosvojila od Združenega kraljestva in Francije, in je obstajala do nekrvavega državnega udara 1. septembra 1969. Udar, ki ga je vodil Moamer Gadafi, je strmoglavil kralja Idrisa in ustanovil Libijsko arabsko republiko.

source.title: Kingdom of Libya
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Libya (Arabic: المملكة الليبية, romanized: Al-Mamlakah Al-Lībiyya, lit. 'Libyan Kingdom'; Italian: Regno di Libia), known as the United Kingdom of Libya from 1951 to 1963, was a constitutional monarchy in North Africa.

The unified kingdom came into existence upon independence on 24 December 1951 from the United Kingdom and France and lasted until a bloodless coup d'état on 1 September 1969. The coup, led by Muammar Gaddafi, overthrew King Idris and established the Libyan Arab Republic.

Kraljestvo Pergamon, imenovano tudi Pergamsko ali Atalidsko kraljestvo, je bilo grška država helenističnega obdobja, ki je iz prestolnice Pergamon vladala velikemu delu zahodne Male Azije (današnje Turčije). Vladala mu je dinastija Atalidov (grško: Δυναστεία τῶν Ἀτταλιδῶν, Dynasteía ton Attalidón).

Kraljestvo je nastalo kot ostanek ozemlja, ki mu je vladal Lizimah, vojskovodja Aleksandra Velikega. Filetajros, eden od Lizimahovih poveljnikov, se je uprl ter zavzel mesto Pergamon z okolico, Lizimah pa je kmalu nato, leta 281 pr. n. št., umrl. Novo kraljestvo je bilo sprva v nekakšnem vazalnem razmerju formalne zvestobe do Selevkidskega cesarstva, a je imelo precejšnjo samostojnost in je kmalu postalo povsem neodvisno. Kraljestvo je bilo monarhija, ki so ji vladali Filetajrosova razširjena družina in njeni potomci. Obstajalo je približno 150 let, dokler ga v letih 133–129 pr. n. št. ni nazadnje vključila Rimska republika.

source.title: Kingdom of Pergamon
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Pergamon, Pergamene Kingdom, or Attalid kingdom was a Greek state during the Hellenistic period that ruled much of the Western part of Asia Minor (now Turkey) from its capital city of Pergamon. It was ruled by the Attalid dynasty (Greek: Δυναστεία τῶν Ἀτταλιδῶν, romanized: Dynasteía ton Attalidón).

The kingdom was a rump state that was created from the territory ruled by Lysimachus, a general of Alexander the Great. Philetaerus, one of Lysimachus' lieutenants, rebelled and seized the city of Pergamon and the surrounding regions; Lysimachus died soon after in 281 BC. The new kingdom was initially in a vassal-like relationship of nominal fealty to the Seleucid Empire, but exercised considerable autonomy and soon became entirely independent. It was a monarchy ruled by Philetaerus's extended family and their descendants. It lasted around 150 years before being eventually absorbed by the Roman Republic during the period from 133–129 BC.

Kraljevina Portugalska je bila monarhija na zahodu Iberskega polotoka in predhodnica sodobne Portugalske republike. V različnem obsegu je obstajala od sredine 12. do začetka 20. stoletja, po letu 1471 pa so jo imenovali tudi Kraljevina Portugalska in Algarve. Bila je glavni del Združenega kraljestva Portugalske, Brazilije in Algarvov, ki je obstajalo med letoma 1815 in 1822. Obstajala je ob Portugalskem imperiju, čezmorskih kolonijah kraljestva.

Jedro portugalske države je bila Portugalska grofija, ki jo je v 9. stoletju v okviru rekonkviste ustanovil Vímara Peres, vazal asturijskega kralja. Grofija je leta 1097 postala del Kraljevine León, portugalski grofje pa so se v 12. stoletju, po bitki pri São Mamedeju, uveljavili kot vladarji neodvisnega kraljestva. Kraljestvu je vladala afonzinska dinastija do portugalskega medvladja v letih 1383–1385, nato pa je monarhija prešla na rodbino Aviz.

source.title: Kingdom of Portugal
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Portugal was a monarchy in the western Iberian Peninsula and the predecessor of the modern Portuguese Republic. Existing to various extents between the mid-12th century and the early 20th century, it was also known as the Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves after 1471, and was the main constituent of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves, which existed between 1815 and 1822. It coexisted with the Portuguese Empire, the realm's overseas colonies.

The nucleus of the Portuguese state was the County of Portugal, established in the 9th century as part of the Reconquista by Vímara Peres, a vassal of the King of Asturias. The county became part of the Kingdom of León in 1097, and the Counts of Portugal established themselves as rulers of an independent kingdom in the 12th century, following the Battle of São Mamede. The kingdom was ruled by the Afonsine dynasty until the 1383–1385 Portuguese interregnum, after which the monarchy passed to the House of Aviz.

Kraljestvo Sofena (armensko: Ծոփք, Tsop’k’; starogrško: Σωφηνή, Sōphēnḗ) je bila politična tvorba helenističnega obdobja med staro Armenijo in Sirijo. Njeno ozemlje je bilo nekoč del armenske satrapije, ki ji je vladala dinastija Orontidov, kot samostojno kraljestvo pa se je izoblikovalo v 3. stoletju pr. n. št. pod vejo te dinastije. Kraljestvo je ohranilo neodvisnost do ok. 95 pr. n. št., ko je artaksidski kralj Tigran Veliki njegova ozemlja osvojil in jih vključil v svoj imperij. Kraljestvo je bilo kulturno mešano, z grškimi, armenskimi, iranskimi, sirskimi, anatolskimi in rimskimi vplivi.

source.title: Kingdom of Sophene
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Sophene (Armenian: Ծոփք, romanized: Tsop’k’, Ancient Greek: Σωφηνή, romanized: Sōphēnḗ) was a Hellenistic-era political entity situated between ancient Armenia and Syria. Its territory was once a part of the Satrapy of Armenia, which was ruled by the Orontid dynasty, and it emerged as a separate kingdom in the 3rd century BCE under a branch of that dynasty. The kingdom maintained independence until c. 95 BCE when the Artaxiad king Tigranes the Great conquered the territories as part of his empire. The kingdom was culturally mixed with Greek, Armenian, Iranian, Syrian, Anatolian and Roman influences.

Kraljestvo Ibercev je bila srednjeveška gruzijska monarhija pod dinastijo Bagrationov, ki je nastala okoli leta 888 n. št. kot naslednica Iberske kneževine v zgodovinski pokrajini Tao-Klardžeti ali gornji Iberiji na severovzhodu Turčije in v delih današnje jugozahodne Gruzije; segala je od Iberskih vrat na jugu do Malega Kavkaza na severu.

Zgodovinsko je območje obsegalo naslednja zgodovinska okrožja: zahodno od gorovja Arsiani so bili Tao, Klardžeti, Nigali in Šavšeti, vzhodno pa Mesheti, Erušeti, Džavaheti, Artaani, Aboci, Kola in Basiani. Pokrajino zaznamujejo gore ter porečji Čoruha in Kure. Območje je bilo ključno za združitev vseh gruzijskih dežel in kneževin v Kraljestvo Gruzijo leta 1008.

source.title: Kingdom of the Iberians
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Iberians was a medieval Georgian monarchy under the Bagrationi dynasty which emerged circa 888 AD, succeeding the Principality of Iberia, in historical region of Tao-Klarjeti, or upper Iberia in north-eastern Turkey as well parts of modern southwestern Georgia, that stretched from the Iberian gates in the south and to the Lesser Caucasus in the north.

Historically, the area comprised the following historical districts: West of the Arsiani Mountains were Tao, Klarjeti, Nigali, and Shavsheti, to the east lay Meskheti, Erusheti, Javakheti, Artaani, Abotsi, Kola and Basiani. The landscape is characterised by mountains and the river-systems of the Çoruh and the Kura. The region played a crucial role in the unification of all Georgian lands and principalities into the Kingdom of Georgia in 1008.

Kurdske nacionalistične vstaje so v Turčiji izbruhnile občasno, začenši s turško osamosvojitveno vojno in prehodom od Osmanskega cesarstva k sodobni turški državi, nadaljujejo pa se do danes s sedanjim spopadom med PKK in Turčijo.

source.title: Kurdish–Turkish conflict
paragraphs: Kurdish nationalist uprisings have periodically occurred in Turkey, beginning with the Turkish War of Independence and the consequent transition from the Ottoman Empire to the modern Turkish state and continuing to the present day with the current PKK–Turkey conflict.

Laomedon of Mytilene.headline: Laomedont iz Mitilene
paragraphs: Laomedont (grško: Λαoμέδων ὁ Μυτιληναῖος; živel v 4. stoletju pr. n. št.) je bil grški vojskovodja iz Mitilene, Larihov sin. Bil je eden od generalov Aleksandra Velikega in je, kot kaže, užival njegovo zaupanje že pred smrtjo Filipa II., saj ga je ta vladar (skupaj z bratom Erigijem, Ptolemajem, Nearhom in drugimi) izgnal, ker je sodeloval v spletkah mladega princa.

Po Filipovi smrti leta 336 pr. n. št. je Aleksander Laomedonta, tako kot druge, ki so tedaj trpeli, kar najbolj častil: Laomedont ga je spremljal v Azijo, kjer so mu, ker je znal perzijsko, zaupali ujetnike. Čeprav ga v poznejših Aleksandrovih vojnah ne omenjajo več, njegov visoki ugled dovolj potrjuje to, da je po kraljevi smrti leta 323 pr. n. št. pri delitvi provinc dobil pomembno upravo Sirije.

source.title: Laomedon of Mytilene
paragraphs: Laomedon (Greek: Λαoμέδων ὁ Μυτιληναῖος; lived during the 4th century BC) was a Greek military commander, native of Mytilene and son of Larichus. He was one of Alexander the Great's generals, and appears to have enjoyed a high place in his confidence even before the death of Philip II, as he was one of those banished by that monarch (together with his brother Erigyius, Ptolemy, Nearchus, and others) for taking part in the intrigues of the young prince.

After the death of Philip in 336 BC, Laomedon, in common with the others who had suffered on this occasion, was held by Alexander in the highest honour: he accompanied him to Asia, where, on account of his acquaintance with the Persian language, he was appointed in charge of the captives. Though his name is not afterwards mentioned during the wars of Alexander, the high consideration he enjoyed is sufficiently attested by his obtaining in the division of the provinces, after the king's death in 323 BC, the important government of Syria.

Late Period of Egypt.headline: Pozno obdobje starega Egipta
paragraphs: Pozno obdobje starega Egipta je čas zadnjega razcveta domačih egipčanskih vladarjev po tretjem vmesnem obdobju, v 26. (saiški) dinastiji, ki jo je ustanovil Psametik I.; obsega pa tudi čas ahemenidske oblasti nad Egiptom po osvojitvi Kambiza II. leta 525 pr. n. št. Trajalo je od leta 664 do 332 pr. n. št., po obdobju tuje vladavine nubijske 25. dinastije, začelo pa se je s kratkim obdobjem novoasirske nadoblasti, saj je Psametik I. sprva vladal kot asirski vazal. Končalo se je, ko je Aleksander Veliki osvojil Ahemenidski imperij in je njegov vojskovodja Ptolemaj I. Soter, eden od helenističnih diadohov iz Makedonije na severu Grčije, ustanovil ptolemajsko dinastijo. Z makedonsko-grško osvojitvijo v drugi polovici 4. stoletja pr. n. št. se je začela doba helenističnega Egipta.

source.title: Late Period of Egypt
paragraphs: The Late Period of Egypt refers to the last flowering of native Egyptian rulers after the Third Intermediate Period in the 26th Saite Dynasty founded by Psamtik I, but includes the time of Achaemenid rule over Egypt after the conquest by Cambyses II in 525 BC. The Late Period existed from 664 BC until 332 BC, following a period of foreign rule by the Nubian 25th Dynasty and beginning with a short period of Neo-Assyrian suzerainty, with Psamtik I initially ruling as their vassal. The period ended with the conquests of the Achaemenid Empire by Alexander the Great and the establishment of the Ptolemaic dynasty by his general Ptolemy I Soter, one of the Hellenistic diadochi from Macedon in northern Greece. With the Macedonian Greek conquest in the latter half of the 4th century BC, the age of Hellenistic Egypt began.

Makabejska vstaja (hebrejsko: מֶרֶד הַמַּכַּבִּים) ali hasmonejski upor je bil judovski upor pod vodstvom Makabejcev proti Selevkidskemu imperiju in helenističnemu vplivu na judovsko življenje. Glavna faza upora je trajala od leta 167 do 160 pr. n. št. in se končala tako, da so Selevkidi obdržali nadzor nad Judejo, spor med makabejskimi Judi, heleniziranimi Judi in Selevkidi pa se je nadaljeval do leta 134 pr. n. št., ko so Makabejci nazadnje dosegli neodvisnost.

source.title: Maccabean Revolt
paragraphs: The Maccabean Revolt (Hebrew: מֶרֶד הַמַּכַּבִּים) or the Hasmonean revolt (מֶרֶד הַחַשְׁמוֹנָאִים) was a Jewish rebellion led by the Maccabees against the Seleucid Empire and against Hellenistic influence on Jewish life. The main phase of the revolt lasted from 167 to 160 BCE and ended with the Seleucids in control of Judea, but conflict between the Maccabeean Jews, Hellenized Jews, and the Seleucids continued until 134 BCE, with the Maccabees eventually attaining independence.

Mahdids.headline: Mahdidi
paragraphs: Mahdidi (arabsko: Banī Mahdī) so bili dinastija v Jemnu, ki je bila za kratek čas na oblasti med letoma 1159 in 1174.

source.title: Mahdids
paragraphs: The Mahdids (Arabic: بني مهدي, romanized: Banī Mahdī) were a dynasty in Yemen who briefly held power in the period between 1159 and 1174.

Mahsa Amini protests.headline: Protesti po smrti Mahse Amini
paragraphs: Državljanski nemiri in protesti proti vladi Islamske republike Iran, povezani s smrtjo Mahse Amini (perzijsko: مهسا امینی) v policijskem priporu, so se začeli 16. septembra 2022 in nadaljevali v leto 2023, do pomladi 2023 pa so večinoma potihnili, politično vodstvo pa je ostalo nespremenjeno in trdno na oblasti. Proteste so opisovali kot »drugačne od vseh, kar jih je država kdaj videla«, kot »največji izziv« vladi in kot »najbolj razširjen upor« od islamske revolucije leta 1979.

source.title: Mahsa Amini protests
paragraphs: Civil unrest and protests against the government of the Islamic Republic of Iran associated with the death in police custody of Mahsa Amini (Persian: مهسا امینی) began on 16 September 2022 and carried on into 2023, but by spring 2023, the protests had largely subsided, ultimately leaving the political leadership unchanged and firmly entrenched in power. The protests were described as "unlike any the country had seen before", the "biggest challenge" to the government, and "most widespread revolt" since the Islamic Revolution in 1979.

Makurija (staronubijsko: ⲇⲱⲧⲁⲩⲟ, Dotawo; grško: Μακουρία, Makouria; arabsko: المقرة, al-Muqurra) je bila srednjeveško nubijsko kraljestvo na ozemlju današnjega severnega Sudana in južnega Egipta. Prestolnica je bila Dongola (staronubijsko: ⲧⲟⲩⲅⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Touggoul) v rodovitnem dongolskem odseku Nila, približno na polovici poti med 3. in 4. nilskim kataraktom.

Nastala je po propadu Kraljestva Kuš v 4. stoletju in je sprva obsegala dolino Nila od 3. katarakta do nekje južno od Abu Hameda pri otoku Mograt. Prestolnico Dongolo so ustanovili okoli leta 500 in kmalu nato, sredi 6. stoletja, je Makurija sprejela krščanstvo. Verjetno v začetku 7. stoletja si je Makurija priključila severno sosedo Nobatijo in tako začela mejiti na bizantinski Egipt.

source.title: Makuria
paragraphs: Makuria (Old Nubian: ⲇⲱⲧⲁⲩⲟ, Dotawo; Greek: Μακουρία, romanized: Makouria; Arabic: المقرة, romanized: al-Muqurra) was a medieval Nubian kingdom in what is today northern Sudan and southern Egypt. Its capital was Dongola (Old Nubian: ⲧⲟⲩⲅⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Touggoul) in the fertile Dongola Reach, about halfway between the 3rd and 4th Nile cataract.

Coming into being after the collapse of the Kingdom of Kush in the 4th century, it originally covered the Nile Valley from the 3rd cataract to somewhere south of Abu Hamed at Mograt Island. The capital of Dongola was founded around 500 and soon after, in the mid-6th century, Makuria converted to Christianity. Probably in the early 7th century Makuria annexed its northern neighbour Nobatia, now sharing a border with Byzantine Egypt.

Mandat za Sirijo in Libanon (francosko: Mandat pour la Syrie et le Liban; arabsko: al-intidāb al-faransī ʻalā sūriyā wa-lubnān), imenovan tudi levantske države (1923–1946), je bil mandat Društva narodov, ustanovljen po prvi svetovni vojni in razdelitvi Osmanskega cesarstva za ozemlji Sirije in Libanona. Mandatni sistem naj bi se razlikoval od kolonializma: upravljavska država naj bi delovala kot skrbnica, dokler prebivalci ne bi bili sposobni samouprave. Tedaj bi se mandat končal in rodila bi se suverena država.

source.title: Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon
paragraphs: The Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon (French: Mandat pour la Syrie et le Liban; Arabic: الانتداب الفرنسي على سوريا ولبنان, romanized: al-intidāb al-faransī ʻalā sūriyā wa-lubnān, also referred to as the Levant States; 1923−1946) was a League of Nations mandate founded in the aftermath of the First World War and the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire concerning the territories of Syria and Lebanon. The mandate system was supposed to differ from colonialism, with the governing country intended to act as a trustee until the inhabitants were considered eligible for self-government. At that point, the mandate would terminate, and a sovereign state would be born.

May 17 Agreement.headline: Sporazum 17. maja
paragraphs: Sporazum 17. maja 1983 je bil sporazum, ki sta ga Libanon in Izrael podpisala 17. maja 1983, med libanonsko državljansko vojno, potem ko je Izrael leta 1982 vdrl v Libanon, da bi končal čezmejne napade, in oblegal Bejrut. Predvideval je umik izraelske vojske iz Bejruta in okvir za vzpostavitev normalnih dvostranskih odnosov med državama. Libanon je bil med pogajanji pod izraelsko in sirsko vojaško zasedbo.

source.title: May 17 Agreement
paragraphs: The May 17 Agreement of 1983 was an agreement signed between Lebanon and Israel during the Lebanese Civil War on May 17, 1983, after Israel invaded Lebanon to end cross border attacks and besieged Beirut in 1982. It called for the withdrawal of the Israeli Army from Beirut and provided a framework for the establishment of normal bilateral relations between the two countries. Lebanon was under both Israeli and Syrian military occupations during its negotiation.

Median dynasty.headline: Medijska dinastija
paragraphs: Medija (staroperzijsko: Māda; grško: Μηδία; akadsko: Mādāya) je bila politična tvorba s središčem v Ekbatani, ki je obstajala od 7. stoletja do sredine 6. stoletja pr. n. št. in je domnevno obvladovala velik del Iranske planote, pred mogočnim Ahemenidskim imperijem. Pogosto vmešavanje Asircev v pokrajino Zagros je spodbudilo združevanje medijskih plemen. Do leta 612 pr. n. št. so se Medijci dovolj okrepili, da so v zavezništvu z Babilonci strmoglavili propadajoče Asirsko cesarstvo. Sodobni raziskovalci pa dvomijo, da je enotno medijsko kraljestvo ali država obstajala vsaj večji del 7. stoletja pr. n. št.

Po starogrškem zgodovinarju Herodotu so medijsko dinastijo sestavljali štirje kralji, ki so medijskemu imperiju vladali 150 let. Če je Herodotova pripoved točna, je Medijce združil mož po imenu Dejok, prvi od štirih kraljev medijskega imperija, mogočne države, ki je obsegala velike dele Irana in vzhodne Anatolije.

source.title: Median dynasty
paragraphs: Media (Old Persian: 𐎶𐎠𐎭 Māda; Greek: Μηδία Mēdía; Akkadian: Mādāya) was a political entity centered in Ecbatana that existed from the 7th century BC until the mid-6th century BC and is believed to have dominated a significant portion of the Iranian plateau, preceding the powerful Achaemenid Empire. The frequent interference of the Assyrians in the Zagros region led to the process of unifying the Median tribes. By 612 BC, the Medes became strong enough to overthrow the declining Assyrian empire in alliance with the Babylonians. However, contemporary scholarship tends to be skeptical about the existence of a united Median kingdom or state, at least for most of the 7th century BCE.

The Median dynasty was, according to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus, a dynasty composed of four kings who ruled for 150 years under the Median Empire. If Herodotus' story is accurate, the Medes were unified by a man named Deioces, the first of the four kings who would rule the Median Empire; a mighty empire that included large parts of Iran and eastern Anatolia.

Medo-Persian conflict.headline: Medijsko-perzijski spopad
paragraphs: Medijsko-perzijski spopad je bil pohod medijskega kralja Astiaga proti Persidi sredi 6. stoletja pr. n. št. Klasični viri trdijo, da je bila Persida vazal medijskega kraljestva, ki se je uprl medijski oblasti, česar pa sodobni dokazi ne potrjujejo. Po nekaj bitkah so zmagali Perzijci pod vodstvom Kira Velikega, ki so nato osvojili medijska ozemlja in ustanovili Ahemenidski imperij.

Glavna vira o spopadu sta Zgodbe grškega zgodovinarja Herodota in dva klinopisna napisa babilonskega kralja Nabonida. Babilonska besedila kažejo, da sta bila odločilna bitka in zavzetje Ekbatane, prestolnice Medije, le vrhunec medijsko-perzijskih sovražnosti, ki so trajale najmanj tri leta (553–550 pr. n. št.).

source.title: Medo-Persian conflict
paragraphs: The Medo-Persian conflict was a campaign led by the Median king Astyages against Persis in the mid 6th-century BCE. Classical sources claim that Persis had been a vassal of the Median kingdom that revolted against Median rule, but this is not confirmed by contemporary evidence. After some battles the Persians led by Cyrus the Great emerged victorious, subsequently conquering Median territories and establishing the Achaemenid Empire.

The main sources on the conflict are the Histories of the Greek historian Herodotus and two cuneiform inscriptions of the Babylonian king Nabonidus. The Babylonian texts suggest that the decisive battle and the capture of Ecbatana, the capital of Media, were only the climax of the Medo-Persian hostilities that lasted for at least three years (553-550 BCE).

Menteshe.headline: Menteše
paragraphs: Menteše (osmansko turško: منتشه; turško: Menteşe) je bil prvi od turških anatolskih beglikov (kneževin), obmejnih kneževin, ki so jih po zatonu Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov ustanovili oguški Turki. Ustanovljen je bil leta 1260 ali 1290 in se je imenoval po ustanovitelju Menteše begu. Prestolnica je bila Milas (Mylasa) na jugozahodu Anatolije.

Osrčje beglika je približno ustrezalo antični Kariji oziroma zgodnjenovoveški provinci Muğla v Turčiji, skupaj s tremi polotoki te province. Med pomembnimi središči beglika so bila mesta Beçin, Milas, Balat, Elmalı, Finike, Kaş, Mağrı (današnji Fethiye), Muğla, Çameli, Acıpayam, Tavas, Bozdoğan in Çine. Mesto Aydın (nekdanje Trales) je beglik nekaj časa nadzoroval in tedaj se je imenovalo »Güzelhisar«; pozneje je prešlo k Ajdinidom na severu, ki so ga preimenovali po ustanovitelju svoje dinastije.

source.title: Menteshe
paragraphs: Menteshe (Ottoman Turkish: منتشه, Turkish: Menteşe) was the first of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks (principality), the frontier principalities established by the Oghuz Turks after the decline of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum. Founded in 1260/1290, it was named for its founder, Menteshe Bey. Its capital city was Milas (Mylasa) in southwestern Anatolia.

The heartland of the beylik corresponded roughly to ancient Caria or to the early modern Muğla Province in Turkey, including the province's three protruding peninsulas. Among the important centers within the beylik were the cities of Beçin, Milas, Balat, Elmalı, Finike, Kaş, Mağrı (modern Fethiye), Muğla, Çameli, Acıpayam, Tavas, Bozdoğan, and Çine. The city of Aydın (formerly Tralles) was controlled by this beylik for a time, during which it was called "Güzelhisar"; it later was transferred to the Aydinids in the north, who renamed the city for the founder of their dynasty.

Mesopotamian campaign.headline: Mezopotamska kampanja
paragraphs: Mezopotamska kampanja ali mezopotamska fronta (turško: Irak Cephesi) je bila kampanja na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne, v kateri sta se za nadzor nad osmanskim Irakom bojevala Britanski imperij z vojaki iz Britanije, Avstralije in v veliki večini iz Britanske Indije ter centralne sile, predvsem Osmansko cesarstvo. Začela se je po britanskem izkrcanju pri Favu leta 1914, s katerim so hoteli zaščititi naftna polja Anglo-perzijske naftne družbe v provinci Huzestan in plovno pot Šat al Arab. Fronta je pozneje prerasla v večjo kampanjo, s katero so hoteli zavzeti Bagdad in odvrniti osmanske sile z drugih front. Končala se je z mudroškim premirjem leta 1918, ki je pripeljalo do odstopa Iraka in nadaljnje razdelitve Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Mesopotamian campaign
paragraphs: The Mesopotamian campaign or Mesopotamian front (Turkish: Irak Cephesi) was a campaign in the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I fought between the British Empire, with troops from Britain, Australia and the vast majority from the British Raj, and the Central Powers, primarily the Ottoman Empire, over control of Ottoman Iraq. It started after the British Fao Landing in 1914, which sought to protect Anglo-Persian Oil Company oil fields in Khuzestan province and the Shatt al-Arab waterway. The front later evolved into a larger campaign that sought to capture the city of Baghdad and divert Ottoman forces from other fronts. It ended with the Armistice of Mudros in 1918, leading to the cession of Iraq and further partition of the Ottoman Empire.

Minaeans.headline: Minejci
paragraphs: Main (minejsko: 𐩣𐩲𐩬; arabsko: Maʿīn) je bilo starodavno južnoarabsko kraljestvo v današnjem Jemnu. Ležalo je ob puščavskem pasu, ki so ga srednjeveški arabski geografi imenovali Sajhad, danes pa je znan kot Ramlat as Sabatajn. Narodni bog Maina je bil Vad, govorili pa so minejščino. Kraljestvo se v zgodovinskih virih pojavi v 8. stoletju pr. n. št., iz mestne države pa se je v kraljestvo preoblikovalo v zadnji četrtini 7. stoletja pr. n. št. O datumu konca Maina se raziskovalci močno prerekajo, po najbolj razširjeni domnevi pa je propadel v 1. stoletju n. št.

Minejci so bili ena od štirih starodavnih jemenskih skupin, ki jih omenja Eratosten; druge so bile Sabejci, Hadramavtci in Katabanci. Vsaka je imela v starodavnem Jemnu svoje regionalno kraljestvo: Minejci na severozahodu (v vadiju Al Džauf), Sabejci jugovzhodno od njih, Katabanci jugovzhodno od Sabejcev in Hadramavtci še vzhodneje.

source.title: Ma'in
paragraphs: Ma'in (Minaean: 𐩣𐩲𐩬; Arabic: معين, romanized: Maʿīn) was an ancient South Arabian kingdom in modern-day Yemen. It was located along the strip of desert called Ṣayhad by medieval Arab geographers, which is now known as Ramlat al-Sab'atayn. Wadd was the national god of Ma'in. The spoken language was Minaic. The kingdom appears in the historical record in the 8th century BCE, and transition from a city-state to kingdom in the last quarter of the 7th century BCE. The date of the end of Ma'in is heavily disputed, but the most popular hypothesis places its demise in the 1st century CE.

The Minaean people were one of four ancient Yemeni groups mentioned by Eratosthenes. The others were the Sabaeans, Ḥaḍramites and Qatabānians. Each of these had regional kingdoms in ancient Yemen, with the Minaeans in the north-west (in Wādī al-Jawf), the Sabaeans to the south-east of them, the Qatabānians to the south-east of the Sabaeans, and the Ḥaḑramites further east still.

Muškat in Oman (arabsko: مسقط و عُمان), uradno Sultanat Muškat in Oman (Salṭanat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān), med vladavino Tajmurja bin Fejsala za kratek čas tudi Država Muškat in Oman, je bila država pod dejansko britansko zaščito, ki je obstajala v drugi polovici 19. stoletja in v 20. stoletju. Obsegala je današnji Sultanat Oman ter dele današnjih Združenih arabskih emiratov in Pakistana.

Ko je leta 1856 umrl zadnji vladar Omanskega imperija Said bin Sultan, je imperij razpadel na dve ločeni politični tvorbi, Sultanat Muškat in Oman ter Sultanat Zanzibar. Prvemu je še naprej vladala dinastija Al Busaid, ki pa je prešla v novo obliko vladavine po palačnem udaru 23. julija 1970, v katerem so Britanci in sultanov sin Kabus bin Said strmoglavili sultana Saida bin Tajmurja; Kabus je ustanovil današnji Sultanat Oman.

source.title: Muscat and Oman
paragraphs: Muscat and Oman (Arabic: مسقط و عُمان), officially known as the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman (Arabic: سلطنة مسقط وعُمان, romanized: Salṭanat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān), also known briefly as the State of Muscat and Oman (Arabic: دولة مسقط وعُمان, romanized: Dawlat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān) during the rule of Taimur bin Faisal, was a state that was under de facto British protection which existed in the second half of the 19th century and 20th century. It encompassed the present-day Sultanate of Oman and parts of present-day United Arab Emirates and Pakistan.

In 1856, upon the death of the last ruler of the Omani Empire, Said bin Sultan, the empire split into two separate political entities: the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman and the Sultanate of Zanzibar. The former continued to be led by the Al Busaid dynasty, but transitioned into a new form of government after the palace coup of 23 July 1970 in which the sultan Said bin Taimur was overthrown by the British and his son, Qaboos bin Said, who established the modern-day Sultanate of Oman.

Muzaffarids.headline: Muzafaridi
paragraphs: Izraz Muzafaridi ali dinastija Muzafaridov lahko označuje:
Muzafaridi (Iran), vladarji delov osrednjega in jugozahodnega Irana od leta 1335 do 1393,
Muzafaridi (Gudžarat), vladarji Gudžaratskega sultanata v Indiji od leta 1391 do 1583.

source.title: Muzaffarids
paragraphs: Muzaffarids or Muzaffarid dynasty may refer to:
Muzaffarids (Iran), rulers of parts of central and southwestern Iran from 1335 to 1393
Muzaffarids (Gujarat), rulers of the Sultanate of Gujarat in India from 1391 to 1583

Nabhani dynasty.headline: Nabhanidi
paragraphs: Rodbina Al Nabhan (arabsko: Āl Nabhān), znana tudi kot dinastija Nabhani ali Nabhanidi, je arabska kraljeva rodbina, ki je Omanu kot dedni kralji (muluk) vladala od leta 1154 do 1624, ko je oblast prevzela dinastija Jaruba. Rodbina, ki izhaja iz plemena Azd, je na svojem ozemlju vzpostavila osrednji državni aparat in tradicionalne izvoljene ibaditske imame skoraj pet stoletij potisnila v večinoma simbolno versko vlogo. Glavni sedež nabhanidskih kraljev se je menjaval med utrjenimi prestolnicami v notranjosti, Nizvo, Bahlo in Maknijatom, od koder so nadzorovali donosne kopenske poti trgovine s kadilom in začimbami. Ena njihovih najtrajnejših arhitekturnih in kulturnih zapuščin je utrdba Bahla, ogromen kompleks stavb iz nežgane opeke na kamnitih temeljih, zgrajen med 12. in 15. stoletjem, ki so ga leta 1987 vpisali na Unescov seznam svetovne dediščine.

source.title: Nabhani dynasty
paragraphs: The House of Al-Nabhan (Arabic: آل نبهان, romanized: Āl Nabhān), also known as the Nabhani dynasty or Nabhanids, is an Arab royal house that ruled Oman as hereditary kings (muluk) from 1154 until 1624, when the Yaruba dynasty took power. Descending from the Azdi tribe, the family established a centralized state apparatus across their territorial domains, reducing the traditional Ibadi elected imams to a largely symbolic religious role for nearly five centuries. The primary seat of power for the Nabhani kings fluctuated between the fortified interior capitals of Nizwa, Bahla, and Maqniyat, from which they controlled the lucrative overland frankincense and spice trade routes. One of their most enduring architectural and cultural legacies is the Bahla Fort, a massive complex of mud-brick buildings on stone foundations built between the 12th and 15th centuries, which was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

Kibuc Nahal Oz in bližnje vojaško oporišče ob severnem robu Gaze sta bila leta 2023 napadena v okviru napadov 7. oktobra. V napadu je bilo ubitih več kot 60 izraelskih vojakov in 15 civilistov. Nekaj vojakov in osem civilistov so ugrabili in odpeljali v Gazo. Po navedbah izraelskih obrambnih sil so v Gazo odpeljali tudi več trupel ubitih.

source.title: Nahal Oz attack
paragraphs: The kibbutz of Nahal Oz and the adjacent military base near the northern Gaza Strip were attacked in 2023 as part of the October 7 attacks. In the attack, more than 60 Israeli soldiers and 15 civilians were killed. Some soldiers and eight civilians were kidnapped and taken to the Gaza Strip. According to the IDF, several bodies were also taken to the Gaza Strip after being killed.

Najahid dynasty.headline: Nadžahidi
paragraphs: Nadžahidi (arabsko: Banū Najāḥ) so bili sunitska muslimanska dinastija abesinskih mamelukov, ki je od leta 1022 do 1158 iz prestolnice Zabid vladala delom Jemna. Nadžah je dobil priznanje abasidskega kalifa al Kadirja in častni naziv al Muajad Nasr ad Din. Sovražni so jim bili šiitski ismailitski Sulajhidi, zvesti Fatimidom. Zadnjega vladarja dinastije je leta 1158 ubil haridžit Ali ibn Mahdi.

source.title: Najahid dynasty
paragraphs: The Najahid dynasty (Arabic: بنو نجاح; Banū Najāḥ) was a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Abyssinian Mamluks that ruled parts of Yemen from 1022-1158 from its capital at Zabīd. Najah would obtain the recognition of the Abbasid Caliph al-Qadir and would be given the honorific title 'al- Mu'ayyad Nasr al-din'. They faced hostilities from the Shia Ismailis Sulayhids who were loyal to the Fatimids. Their last sovereign was killed by Ali ibn Mahdi the Kharijite in 1158.

Novoasirsko cesarstvo je bilo četrta in predzadnja stopnja starodavne asirske zgodovine. Začelo se je z vzponom Adad-nirarija II. leta 911 pr. n. št. in v večjem delu 9. do 7. stoletja pr. n. št. obvladovalo stari Bližnji vzhod ter dele južnega Kavkaza, severne Afrike in vzhodnega Sredozemlja, s čimer je postalo največji imperij v dotedanji zgodovini. Zaradi geopolitične prevlade in ideologije svetovnega gospostva ga opisujejo kot prvi svetovni imperij v zgodovini. Kulturno, upravno in vojaško je vplivalo na druge imperije starega veka, med njimi na novobabilonskega, ahemenidskega in selevkidskega. Na vrhuncu je bilo najmočnejša vojaška sila na svetu in je vladalo vsej Mezopotamiji, Levantu in Egiptu ter delom Anatolije, Arabije in današnjega Irana in Armenije.
notes: The glossary headline was Novo asirsko kraljestvo; it is now corrected to Novoasirsko cesarstvo, as in the text.

source.title: Neo-Assyrian Empire
paragraphs: The Neo-Assyrian Empire was the fourth and penultimate stage of ancient Assyrian history. Beginning with the accession of Adad-nirari II in 911 BCE, the Neo-Assyrian Empire grew to dominate the ancient Near East and parts of the South Caucasus, North Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean throughout much of the 9th to 7th centuries BCE, becoming the largest empire in history up to that point. Because of its geopolitical dominance and ideology based in world domination, the Neo-Assyrian Empire has been described as the first world empire in history. It influenced other empires of the ancient world culturally, administratively, and militarily, including the Neo-Babylonians, the Achaemenids, and the Seleucids. At its height, the empire was the strongest military power in the world and ruled over all of Mesopotamia, the Levant and Egypt, as well as parts of Anatolia, Arabia and what is now Iran and Armenia.

Novobabilonsko cesarstvo ali drugo babilonsko cesarstvo, v zgodovini znano kot Kaldejsko cesarstvo, je bila zadnja politična tvorba, ki so ji vladali domači vladarji starodavne Mezopotamije. Začelo se je s kronanjem Nabopolasarja za babilonskega kralja leta 626 pr. n. št., trdno pa se je uveljavilo s padcem Asirskega cesarstva v letih 612–609 pr. n. št.; Perzijski Ahemenidski imperij ga je osvojil leta 539 pr. n. št., manj kot stoletje po ustanovitvi kaldejske dinastije.

S porazom Asirskega cesarstva in vrnitvijo moči v Babilon sta mesto in južna Mezopotamija prvič po propadu starobabilonskega cesarstva (pod Hamurabijem) skoraj tisoč let prej spet zavladala staremu Bližnjemu vzhodu. Novobabilonska vladavina je po vsej Babiloniji prinesla brezprimerno gospodarsko in demografsko rast ter sprožila kulturno in umetniško renesanso, saj so kralji začeli velike gradbene projekte, predvsem v Babilonu, in obudili številne prvine sumersko-akadske kulture iz prejšnjih dveh tisočletij.
notes: The glossary headline was Novo babilonsko kraljestvo; it is now corrected to Novobabilonsko cesarstvo, as in the text.

source.title: Neo-Babylonian Empire
paragraphs: The Neo-Babylonian Empire or Second Babylonian Empire, historically known as the Chaldean Empire, was the last polity ruled by monarchs native to ancient Mesopotamia. Beginning with the coronation of Nabopolassar as the King of Babylon in 626 BC and being firmly established through the fall of the Assyrian Empire in 612–609 BC, the Neo-Babylonian Empire was conquered by the Achaemenid Persian Empire in 539 BC, less than a century after the founding of the Chaldean dynasty.

The defeat of the Assyrian Empire and subsequent return of power to Babylon marked the first time that the city, and southern Mesopotamia in general, had risen to dominate the ancient Near East since the collapse of the Old Babylonian Empire (under Hammurabi) nearly a thousand years earlier. Neo-Babylonian rule produced unprecedented economic and population growth across Babylonia and sparked a cultural and artistic renaissance as its kings initiated major building projects, chiefly in Babylon, reviving many elements of the preceding two thousand years of Sumero-Akkadian culture.

Neo-Hittite states.headline: Novohetitske države
paragraphs: Države, imenovane novohetitske, sirsko-hetitske (v starejši literaturi) ali luvijsko-aramejske (v sodobnih znanstvenih delih), so bile luvijske in aramejske regionalne politične tvorbe železne dobe na jugovzhodu današnje Turčije in severozahodu današnje Sirije, v antiki znane kot dežele Hatti in Aram. Nastale so po propadu Novega hetitskega kraljestva v 12. stoletju pr. n. št. in so obstajale, dokler jih v 8. stoletju pr. n. št. ni pokorilo Asirsko cesarstvo. Raziskovalci jih združujejo na podlagi več kulturnih meril, ki so jih prepoznali kot podobna in skupna obema družbama, severni (luvijski) in južni (aramejski). Kulturna izmenjava med njima velja za poseben regionalni pojav, zlasti ob velikih jezikovnih razlikah med glavnima jezikoma regije: luvijščina spada v anatolsko skupino indoevropskih jezikov, aramejščina pa v severozahodno skupino semitskih jezikov. O več vprašanjih, povezanih z regionalnim združevanjem luvijskih in aramejskih držav, raziskovalci menijo različno, nekateri so do takega združevanja na splošno kritični.

source.title: Neo-Hittite states
paragraphs: The states called Neo-Hittite, Syro-Hittite (in older literature), or Luwian-Aramean (in modern scholarly works) were Luwian and Aramean regional polities of the Iron Age, situated in southeastern parts of modern Turkey and northwestern parts of modern Syria, known in ancient times as lands of Hatti and Aram. They arose following the collapse of the Hittite New Kingdom in the 12th century BCE, and lasted until they were subdued by the Assyrian Empire in the 8th century BCE. They are grouped together by scholars on the basis of several cultural criteria that are recognized as similar and shared between both societies: northern (Luwian) and southern (Aramean). Cultural exchange between those societies is seen as a specific regional phenomenon, particularly in light of significant linguistic distinctions between the two main regional languages, with Luwian belonging to the Anatolian group of Indo-European languages and Aramaic belonging to the Northwest Semitic group of Semitic languages. Several questions related to the regional grouping of Luwian and Aramaean states are viewed differently among scholars, including some views that are critical towards such grouping in general.

Nobatia.headline: Nobatija
paragraphs: Nobatija ali Nobadija (grško: Νοβαδία, Nobadia; staronubijsko: ⲙⲓⲅⲛ̅ Migin ali ⲙⲓⲅⲓⲧⲛ︦ ⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Migitin Goul, dobesedno »nobadijske dežele«) je bila poznoantično kraljestvo v Spodnji Nubiji, na jugu današnjega Egipta. Skupaj z drugima dvema koptsko-nubijskima kraljestvoma, Makurijo in Alodijo, je nasledila Kraljestvo Kuš. Po ustanovitvi okoli leta 400 se je Nobadija postopno širila: na severu je premagala Blemijce, na jugu pa si je priključila ozemlje med drugim in tretjim nilskim kataraktom. Leta 543 je sprejela koptsko krščanstvo. V 7. stoletju si jo je v neznanih okoliščinah priključila Makurija.

source.title: Nobatia
paragraphs: Nobatia or Nobadia (Greek: Νοβαδία, Nobadia; Old Nubian: ⲙⲓⲅⲛ̅ Migin or ⲙⲓⲅⲓⲧⲛ︦ ⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Migitin Goul lit. "of Nobadia's land") was a late antique kingdom in Lower Nubia, modern day southern Egypt. Together with the two other Coptic-Nubian kingdoms, Makuria and Alodia, it succeeded the kingdom of Kush. After its establishment in around 400, Nobadia gradually expanded by defeating the Blemmyes in the north and incorporating the territory between the second and third Nile cataract in the south. In 543, it converted to Coptic Christianity. It would then be annexed by Makuria, under unknown circumstances, during the 7th century.

Severni Jemen (arabsko: al-Yaman al-šamāliyya) je izraz za Kraljevino Jemen (1918–1962), Jemensko arabsko republiko (1962–1990) in režime pred njima, ki so imeli suverenost nad tem delom Jemna. Prestolnica je bila Sana od leta 1918 do 1948 in znova od leta 1962 do 1990.
