Pokrajina (Gornji Jemen) leži na jugozahodu Arabskega polotoka in meri približno 136.000 kvadratnih kilometrov, pred združitvijo Jemna pa je imela okoli trinajst milijonov prebivalcev. Na severu je mejila na Savdsko Arabijo, na jugu in vzhodu na Južni Jemen, na zahodu na Rdeče morje, na jugozahodu pa na Bab el Mandeb.

Severni Jemen je postal član Združenih narodov 30. septembra 1947. Leta 1962 je izbruhnila krvava državljanska vojna, ki se je leta 1970 končala z odpravo monarhije in ustanovitvijo republike. Skupaj z Južnim Jemnom je bil ena od predhodnic Republike Jemen, dokler se nista leta 1990 združila.
notes: The glossary named this record Nordjemen, which is not Slovenian; it is now corrected to Severni Jemen, as in the text.

source.title: North Yemen
paragraphs: North Yemen (Arabic: اليمن الشمالي, romanized: al-Yaman al-šamāliyya) is a term used to describe the Kingdom of Yemen (1918–1962), the Yemen Arab Republic (1962–1990), and the regimes that preceded them and exercised sovereignty over that region of Yemen. Its capital was Sanaa from 1918 to 1948 and again from 1962 to 1990. Located in the southwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula, the area of the region (Upper Yemen) is approximately 136,000 square kilometers, and it used to have a population of about thirteen million people prior to the Yemeni unification. It was bordered to the north by Saudi Arabia, to the south and east by South Yemen, to the west by the Red Sea, and to Bab al-Mandab in the southwest.

North Yemen was admitted to the United Nations on September 30, 1947. In 1962, the country fought a bloody civil war that ended with the abolition of the monarchy and the creation of a republic in 1970. It was one of the predecessor states of the Republic of Yemen, alongside South Yemen, until its eventual unification in 1990.

Severnojemenska državljanska vojna, v Jemnu znana tudi kot revolucija 26. septembra, je bila državljanska vojna, ki je od leta 1962 do 1970 v Severnem Jemnu potekala med privrženci mutavakilitskega kraljestva in podporniki Jemenske arabske republike. Začela se je z državnim udarom leta 1962, ki so ga izvedli revolucionarni republikanci pod vodstvom vojske in poveljstvom Abdulaha al Salala. Ta je odstavil komaj kronanega kralja in imama Mohameda al Badra in Jemen razglasil za republiko s seboj kot predsednikom. Njegova vlada je v Jemnu odpravila suženjstvo. Imam je pobegnil na savdsko mejo, kjer je za ponovni prevzem oblasti zbral podporo severnih zajdijskih plemen, spopad pa je hitro prerasel v vsesplošno državljansko vojno.

source.title: North Yemen civil war
paragraphs: The North Yemen civil war, also known in Yemen as the 26 September Revolution, was a civil war fought in North Yemen from 1962 to 1970 between partisans of the Mutawakkilite Kingdom and supporters of the Yemen Arab Republic. The war began with a coup d'état carried out in 1962 by revolutionary republicans led by the army under the command of Abdullah al-Sallal. He dethroned the newly crowned King and Imam Muhammad al-Badr and declared Yemen a republic under his presidency. His government abolished slavery in Yemen. The Imam escaped to the Saudi Arabian border where he rallied popular support from northern Zaydi tribes to retake power, and the conflict rapidly escalated to a full-scale civil war.

November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iraku novembra 1963
paragraphs: Iraški državni udar novembra 1963 je potekal med 13. in 18. novembrom 1963, ko so po notranjih razkolih v stranki naseristični iraški častniki izvedli vojaški udar v stranki Baath. Sam udar je bil nekrvav, v povezanih spopadih pa je umrlo 250 ljudi.
Vlada je nato trajala do revolucije 17. julija leta 1968.

source.title: November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état
paragraphs: The November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état took place between November 13 and November 18, 1963, when, following internal party divisions, pro-Nasserist Iraqi officers led a military coup within the Ba'ath Party. Although the coup itself was bloodless, 250 people were killed in related actions.
The government subsequently lasted until the 17 July Revolution in 1968.

Operation Nasr.headline: Operacija Nasr
paragraphs: Operacija Nasr, znana tudi kot operacija Hovejze, je bila velika bitka iransko-iraške vojne v začetku januarja 1981. Bila je največja tankovska bitka vojne.

Trije iranski oklepni polki so napredovali proti iraškim silam, ki so vdrle na iransko ozemlje med mesti Ahvaz, Susangerd in Dezful. Iraške sile so za premik izvedele in se navidezno umaknile. Iz treh oklepnih brigad so oblikovale zasedo v obliki tristranske škatle. Iranci so slepo zapeljali vanjo, tankovski sili pa sta se štiri dni bojevali v morju blata. Iranci so se umaknili in pustili veliko uničenih in poškodovanih tankov, ki so obtičali v blatu ali jim je zaradi slabega logističnega načrtovanja zmanjkalo goriva in streliva. Zaradi terena se strani nista mogli čisto ločiti, iraške sile pa niso mogle z vso silo zasledovati ostankov iranskih enot.

source.title: Operation Nasr
paragraphs: Operation Nasr, also known as Operation Hoveyzeh, was a major battle in the Iran–Iraq War fought in early January 1981. It was the biggest tank battle of the war.

Three Iranian armored regiments advanced towards Iraqi forces that had invaded Iranian territory between the cities of Ahvaz, Susangerd and Dezful. The Iraqi forces were alerted to this movement and feigned a withdrawal. The Iraqis formed three armored brigades into a three-sided box ambush. The Iranians blundered into the ambush and the two tank forces battled for four days in a sea of mud. The Iranians withdrew, leaving many destroyed and disabled tanks stuck in the mud, or, because of logistical misplanning, had run out of fuel and ammunition. The condition of the terrain prevented a clean break from the battle and did not allow the Iraqi forces to pursue what was left of the Iranians en force.

Operacija Oljčna vejica (turško: Zeytin Dalı Harekâtı) je bila invazija turških oboroženih sil in Sirske narodne vojske (SNA) v pretežno kurdsko okrožje Afrin na severozahodu Sirije, proti Enotam za zaščito ljudstva (YPG) Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF). Letalska vojna in uporaba težkega topništva sta se končali, ko so arabske in turkmenske milice SNA 18. marca 2018 vstopile v mesto Afrin.

V invaziji je bilo po poročilih ubitih od 395 do 510 civilistov. Med drugimi poročanimi vojnimi zločini so iznakaženje ženskega trupla, ki so ga zagrešili borci SNA, ubijanje civilistov z neselektivnim obstreljevanjem turških sil, domnevna uporaba kemičnega plina turške vojske in neselektivno streljanje generalnega poveljstva žandarmerije na begunce, ki so z bojišča bežali v Turčijo.

source.title: Operation Olive Branch
paragraphs: Operation Olive Branch (Turkish: Zeytin Dalı Harekâtı) was an invasion by the Turkish Armed Forces and Syrian National Army (SNA) in the Kurdish-majority Afrin District of northwest Syria, against the People's Protection Units (YPG) of the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF). The air war and use of major artillery ended as the Arab and Turkmen militias of the SNA entered the city of Afrin on 18 March 2018.

Between 395 and 510 civilians were reported killed in the invasion. Other reported war crimes include the mutilation of a female corpse by SNA fighters, the killing of civilians due to indiscriminate shelling by Turkish forces, the alleged use of chemical gas by the Turkish Army, and the indiscriminate shooting of refugees fleeing from the conflict area into Turkey by the Gendarmerie General Command.

Ottoman Tripolitania.headline: Osmanska Tripolitanija
paragraphs: Osmanska Tripolitanija, znana tudi kot Tripolitansko regentstvo, je bila od leta 1551 do 1912 uradno pod oblastjo Osmanskega cesarstva. Približno je ustrezala severnim delom današnje Libije, zgodovinskima pokrajinama Tripolitanija in Kirenajka. Sprva so jo ustanovili kot osmansko provinco, ki ji je vladal paša (guverner) v Tripoliju, imenovan iz Carigrada, v resnici pa je bila zaradi moči krajevnih janičarjev napol samostojna. Od leta 1711 do 1835 je provinci kot dejanska dedna monarhija vladala dinastija Karamanlijev, ki je ostala pod formalno osmansko nadoblastjo. Leta 1835 so Osmani znova vzpostavili neposreden nadzor nad pokrajino in ga obdržali do italijanske priključitve leta 1912.

Tako kot osmanski regentstvi v Tunisu in Alžiru je bilo tudi Tripolitansko regentstvo pomembno oporišče za gusarske pohode severnoafriških korzarjev, ki so Tripoliju prinašali tudi dohodke. Ostanek stoletij turške vladavine je prebivalstvo turškega in delno turškega izvora, Kuluglije.

source.title: Ottoman Tripolitania
paragraphs: Ottoman Tripolitania, also known as the Regency of Tripoli, was officially ruled by the Ottoman Empire from 1551 to 1912. It corresponded roughly to the northern parts of modern-day Libya in historic Tripolitania and Cyrenaica. It was initially established as an Ottoman province ruled by a pasha (governor) in Tripoli who was appointed from Constantinople, though in practice it was semi-autonomous due to the power of the local Janissaries. From 1711 to 1835, the Karamanli dynasty ruled the province as a de facto hereditary monarchy while remaining under nominal Ottoman suzerainty. In 1835, the Ottomans reestablished direct control over the region until its annexation by Italy in 1912.

Like the Ottoman regencies in Tunis and Algiers, the Regency of Tripoli was a major base for the privateering activities of the North African corsairs, who also provided revenues for Tripoli. A remnant of the centuries of Turkish rule is the presence of a population of Turkish origin, and those of partial Turkish origin, the Kouloughlis.

Ottoman–Persian War (1743–1746).headline: Osmansko-perzijska vojna (1743–1746)
paragraphs: Osmansko-perzijska vojna v letih 1743–1746 ali osmansko-iranska vojna v letih 1743–1746 je potekala med Osmanskim cesarstvom in afšaridskim Iranom.

source.title: Ottoman–Persian War (1743–1746)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Persian War of 1743–1746 or Ottoman–Iranian War of 1743–1746 was fought between the Ottoman Empire and Afsharid Iran.

Ottoman–Persian War (1776–1779).headline: Osmansko-perzijska vojna (1776–1779)
paragraphs: Osmansko-perzijska vojna v letih 1776–1779 ali osmansko-iranska vojna v letih 1776–1779 je potekala med Osmanskim cesarstvom in zandskim Iranom. Iranci, ki jim je vladal Karim kan Zand, vodil pa njegov brat Sadek kan Zand, so vdrli v južni Irak in po letu obleganja leta 1776 Osmanom iztrgali Basro. Osmani niso mogli poslati vojske, zato so bili za obrambo pokrajine odvisni od mameluških guvernerjev.

Osmanski sultan Abdulhamid I. je, da bi zbral vojake in zaloge za vojno, Sulejmana al Džalilija imenoval za mubajaadžija (uradnika za oskrbo) in mu ukazal, naj pošilja zaloge v Bagdad, kar je ta prezrl in namesto tega trgovcem omejil prodajo blaga. Zato so Iranci Basro držali do smrti Karima kana leta 1779, ko so jo Osmani pod vodstvom Sulejmana age znova zavzeli.

source.title: Ottoman–Persian War (1776–1779)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Persian War of 1776–1779 or Ottoman–Iranian War of 1776–1779 was fought between the Ottoman Empire and Zand Iran. The Iranians, ruled by Karim Khan Zand and led by his brother Sadeq Khan Zand, invaded southern Iraq and after besieging Basra for a year, took the city from the Ottomans in 1776. The Ottomans, unable to send troops, were dependent on the Mamluk governors to defend that region.

In an attempt to raise troops and provisions for this war, Ottoman Sultan Abdul Hamid I, made Suleiman al-Jalili mubayaaci (official of provisions), ordering him to send provisions to Baghdad, which he ignored, instead restricting merchants from selling their goods. As a result, the Iranians held Basra until Karim Khan's death in 1779 when the Ottomans, under Sulayman Agha, retook the city.

Ottoman–Safavid War (1532–1555).headline: Osmansko-safavidska vojna (1532–1555)
paragraphs: Osmansko-safavidska vojna v letih 1532–1555 je bila eden od mnogih vojaških spopadov med večnima tekmecema, Osmanskim cesarstvom pod vodstvom Sulejmana Veličastnega in Safavidskim imperijem pod vodstvom Tahmaspa I. Osmanske ozemeljske pridobitve je potrdil amasijski mir.

source.title: Ottoman–Safavid War (1532–1555)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Safavid War of 1532–1555 was one of the many military conflicts fought between the two arch rivals, the Ottoman Empire led by Suleiman the Magnificent, and the Safavid Empire led by Tahmasp I. Ottoman territorial gains were confirmed in the Peace of Amasya.
Osmansko-safavidska vojna v letih 1578–1590 je bila ena od mnogih vojn med sosednjima večnima tekmecema, Safavidskim imperijem in Osmanskim cesarstvom.

Že nekaj let pred vojno in večji del vojne so se Safavidi po smrti šaha Tahmaspa I. otepali hudih notranjih težav in tekmovanja plemiških frakcij na dvoru. Osmani so se odločili, da bodo v letih 1577–1578 napovedali vojno in izkoristili kaos. Kljub hitrim osmanskim zmagam v prvih letih in obsežni podpori osmanskega vazala Krimskega kanata v več fazah vojne je ta nazadnje za nekaj let postala geopolitično in vojaško razmeroma stabilna, obe strani pa sta do okoli leta 1580 izgubljali in dobivali manjše bitke. Prelomnica je prišla po bitki bakel od 7. do 11. maja 1583 in umoru safavidskih generalov Mirze Salmana Džaberija in Hamze Mirze. Po teh preobratih in notranjem kaosu v safavidski državi so se Osmani leta 1590 dokopali do končne zmage.

source.title: Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Safavid War of 1578–1590 was one of the many wars between the neighboring arch-rivals of the Safavid Empire and the Ottoman Empire.

Starting several years prior to the war and up to and including most of the war itself, the Safavids were experiencing significant domestic issues and rivalling noble factions within the court since the death of Shah Tahmasp I. The Ottomans decided to declare war in 1577–1578 to exploit the chaos. The war, despite swift Ottoman victories in the first few years and extensive support from the Ottoman vassal Crimean Khanate during several stages of the war, eventually became geo-politically and military relatively stable for several years with both parties losing and winning smaller battles till around 1580. It eventually had a turning point following the Battle of Torches on 7–11 May 1583 and the assassination of the Safavid generals Mirza Salman Jaberi and Hamza Mirza. Following these turns of events and internal chaos in the Safavid state, the Ottomans headed towards the eventual victory in 1590.

Osmansko-safavidsko vojno v letih 1603–1612 sta sestavljali dve vojni med safavidskim Iranom pod šahom Abasom I. ter Osmanskim cesarstvom pod Mehmedom III. in njegovim sinom Ahmedom I. Prva vojna se je začela leta 1603 in se končala s safavidsko zmago leta 1612, ko so Safavidi znova pridobili in vzpostavili nadoblast nad Kavkazom in zahodnim Iranom, ki so ju izgubili s carigrajsko pogodbo leta 1590.

source.title: Ottoman–Safavid war (1603–1612)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Safavid war of 1603–1612 consisted of two wars between Safavid Iran under Shah Abbas I and the Ottoman Empire under Mehmed III and his son Ahmed I. The first war began in 1603 and ended with a Safavid victory in 1612, when they regained and reestablished their suzerainty over the Caucasus and Western Iran, which had been lost at the Treaty of Constantinople in 1590.
Osmansko-safavidska vojna v letih 1623–1639 je bil spopad med Osmanskim cesarstvom in safavidskim Iranom, tedaj velesilama zahodne Azije, za nadzor nad Mezopotamijo.

source.title: Ottoman–Safavid War (1623–1639)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Safavid War of 1623–1639 was a conflict fought between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran, then the two major powers of Western Asia, over control of Mesopotamia.

Palmyra offensive (December 2016).headline: Ofenziva na Palmiro (december 2016)
paragraphs: Ofenziva na Palmiro decembra 2016 je bila vojaška operacija vojske ISIL, s katero je ta znova zavzela starodavno mesto Palmira, neuspešen pa je bil napad ISIL na letalsko oporišče Tijas T-4 zahodno od mesta. ISIL je mesto prej nadzoroval od maja 2015 do marca 2016.

Nepričakovana bliskovita ofenziva je potekala hkrati s tremi velikimi ofenzivami proti ISIL: turško ofenzivo zahodno od Al Baba in bitko za Al Bab severno od Alepa, kurdsko-arabsko kampanjo za Rako in iraško bitko za Mosul v Iraku, v katerih so vse tri pridobivale ozemlje od Islamske države.
Januarja 2017 so sirska vojska in zavezniške sile sprožile novo ofenzivo za ponovno zavzetje Palmire in okolice.

source.title: Palmyra offensive (December 2016)
paragraphs: The Palmyra offensive in December 2016 was a military operation launched by the military of ISIL which led to the re-capture of the ancient city of Palmyra, and an unsuccessful ISIL attack on the Tiyas T-4 Airbase to the west of the city. ISIL previously controlled the city from May 2015 until March 2016.

The unexpected blitz offensive occurred concurrently with three major anti-ISIL offensives: the Turkish Western al-Bab offensive and Battle of al-Bab north of Aleppo, the Kurdish-Arab Raqqa campaign, and the Iraqi Battle of Mosul in Iraq, which saw all three gaining ground from the Islamic State.
In January 2017, the Syrian Army and allied forces launched another offensive to recapture Palmyra and its surrounding areas.

Palmyra offensive (March 2016).headline: Ofenziva na Palmiro (marec 2016)
paragraphs: Ofenziva na Palmiro (marec 2016) je bila vojaška operacija sirske arabske vojske ob podpori ruskih letalskih napadov, s katero je Islamski državi znova iztrgala mesto Tadmur (blizu ruševin starodavnega mesta Palmira), ki je bilo zaradi lege v osrednji Siriji strateško pomembno za obe strani. Mesto so v celoti znova zavzeli 27. marca.

source.title: Palmyra offensive (March 2016)
paragraphs: The Palmyra offensive (March 2016) was a military operation of the Syrian Arab Army, supported by Russian airstrikes, to recapture from the Islamic State the city of Tadmur (near the ruins of the ancient city of Palmyra), which was strategically important for both forces due to its position in central Syria. The city was fully recaptured on 27 March.

Palmyra offensive (May 2015).headline: Ofenziva na Palmiro (maj 2015)
paragraphs: Ofenziva na Palmiro maja 2015 je bila vojaška operacija, ki jo je Islamska država (IS) med sirsko državljansko vojno izvedla od 13. do 26. maja 2015, da bi zavzela okrožje Tadmur v guvernoratu Homs, ki ga je držala vlada, z upravnim središčem Tadmur, v angleščini znanim kot Palmira. Ruševine in starodavni spomeniki Palmire na jugozahodnem robu sodobnega mesta so od leta 1980 na Unescovem seznamu svetovne dediščine. Ruševine so bile del puščavske oaze, enega najpomembnejših kulturnih središč starega sveta, ki je s trgovino povezovala civilizacije Perzije, Indije in Kitajske z Rimskim cesarstvom. Ofenziva je bila ena največjih, kar jih je sprožil ISIL, in njegova največja v Siriji po ofenzivi v vzhodni Siriji leta 2014; z njo je ISIL svoj nadzor nad Sirijo razširil na najmanj 50 % ozemlja.

source.title: Palmyra offensive (May 2015)
paragraphs: The Palmyra offensive of May 2015 was a military operation launched during the Syrian Civil War by the Islamic State (IS) on May 13–26, 2015, in an attempt to capture the government-held Tadmur District of the Homs Governorate, including the administrative centre of Tadmur, known in English as Palmyra. The ruins and ancient monuments of Palmyra, which lie on the south-western fringe of the modern city, have been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1980. The ruins were part of a desert oasis that was one of the most significant cultural centers of the ancient world, linking the civilizations of Persia, India, China with the Roman Empire through trade. The offensive was one of the largest offensives launched by ISIL, the largest one conducted by ISIL in Syria since the 2014 Eastern Syria offensive, with the result of the offensive increasing ISIL's control of Syria to at least 50%.

Partition of Triparadisus.headline: Delitev v Triparadisu
paragraphs: Delitev v Triparadisu je bil sporazum o delitvi oblasti, ki so ga leta 321 pr. n. št. v Triparadisu sklenili generali (diadohi) Aleksandra Velikega; imenovali so novega regenta in si na novo razdelili satrapije Aleksandrovega imperija. Sledila je delitvi v Babilonu ob Aleksandrovi smrti leta 323 pr. n. št. in jo spremenila.

Po Aleksandrovi smrti so vladavino nad imperijem dobili njegov polbrat Filip Aridej in Aleksandrov sin Aleksander IV. Ker pa je bil Filip duševno bolan, Aleksander IV. pa se je rodil šele po očetovi smrti, so za regenta imenovali Perdika, Aleksandrove nekdanje generale pa za satrape posameznih pokrajin imperija.

source.title: Partition of Triparadisus
paragraphs: The Partition of Triparadisus was a power-sharing agreement passed at Triparadisus in 321 BC between the generals (Diadochi) of Alexander the Great, in which they named a new regent and arranged the repartition of the satrapies of Alexander's empire among themselves. It followed and modified the Partition of Babylon made in 323 BC upon Alexander's death.

Following the death of Alexander, the rule of his empire was given to his half-brother Philip Arrhidaeus and Alexander's son Alexander IV. However, since Philip was mentally ill and Alexander IV born only after the death of his father, a regent was named as Perdiccas; in the meantime, the former generals of Alexander were named satraps of the various regions of his empire.

Peace of Antalcidas.headline: Antalkidov mir
paragraphs: Kraljev mir (387 pr. n. št.) je bila mirovna pogodba, ki jo je zagotovil perzijski kralj Artakserks II. in je končala korintsko vojno v stari Grčiji. Znana je tudi kot Antalkidov mir, po špartanskem diplomatu Antalkidu, ki je odpotoval v Suzo, da bi se s kraljem ahemenidske Perzije pogajal o pogojih. V antiki pa so jo pogosteje imenovali kraljev mir, kar kaže, kako globok je bil perzijski vpliv na pogodbo, saj je prejšnjo vojno poganjalo perzijsko zlato. Pogodba je bila oblika splošnega miru, podobna tridesetletnemu miru, ki je končal prvo peloponeško vojno.

source.title: Peace of Antalcidas
paragraphs: The King's Peace (387 BC) was a peace treaty guaranteed by the Persian King Artaxerxes II that ended the Corinthian War in ancient Greece. The treaty is also known as the Peace of Antalcidas, after Antalcidas, the Spartan diplomat who traveled to Susa to negotiate the terms of the treaty with the king of Achaemenid Persia. The treaty was more commonly known in antiquity, however, as the King's Peace, a name that reflects the depth of Persian influence in the treaty, as Persian gold had driven the preceding war. The treaty was a form of Common Peace, similar to the Thirty Years' Peace which ended the First Peloponnesian War.

Persian campaign (World War I).headline: Perzijska kampanja (prva svetovna vojna)
paragraphs: Perzijska kampanja ali invazija na Iran (perzijsko: اشغال ایران در جنگ جهانی اول) je bila vrsta vojaških spopadov med Osmanskim cesarstvom, Britanskim imperijem in Ruskim imperijem na različnih območjih tedaj nevtralnega kadžarskega Irana, ki se je začela decembra 1914 in končala z mudroškim premirjem 30. oktobra 1918, v okviru bližnjevzhodnega bojišča prve svetovne vojne. V bojih so sodelovale tudi krajevne perzijske enote, ki so se v Iranu bojevale proti antanti in osmanskim silam. Spopad je bil za Perzijo uničujoča izkušnja: umrlo je več kot 2 milijona perzijskih civilistov, večinoma zaradi perzijske lakote v letih 1917–1919, na katero so vplivala britanska in ruska dejanja. Ker kadžarska vlada med prvo svetovno vojno in neposredno po njej ni mogla ohraniti suverenosti države, je leta 1921 prišlo do državnega udara, Reza šah pa je ustanovil dinastijo Pahlavijev.

source.title: Persian campaign (World War I)
paragraphs: The Persian campaign or invasion of Iran (Persian: اشغال ایران در جنگ جهانی اول) was a series of military conflicts between the Ottoman Empire, British Empire and Russian Empire in various areas of what was then neutral Qajar Iran, beginning in December 1914 and ending with the Armistice of Mudros on 30 October 1918, as part of the Middle Eastern Theatre of World War I. The fighting also involved local Persian units, who fought against the Entente and Ottoman forces in Iran. The conflict proved to be a devastating experience for Persia. Over 2 million Persian civilians died in the conflict, mostly due to the Persian famine of 1917–1919, influenced by British and Russian actions. The Qajar government's inability to maintain the country's sovereignty during and immediately after the First World War led to a coup d'état in 1921 and Reza Shah's establishment of the Pahlavi dynasty.

Filisteja označuje ozemlje Filistejcev v Kanaanu, kjer so imeli zvezo petih mest: Gaze, Aškelona, Ašdoda, Ekrona in Gata. Nekaj časa je Filisteji pripadala tudi Jafa, ki je morda za kratek čas prešla v izraelske roke, preden jo je med Senaheribovim levantskim pohodom dokončno dobilo Novoasirsko cesarstvo.

Raziskovalci menijo, da so Filistejci izvirali iz grških priseljenskih skupin egejske civilizacije, ki so se približno od leta 1200 pr. n. št. naseljevale na tem območju in se postopoma mešale z domačim kanaanskim prebivalstvom. V tej zvezi jih navadno enačijo s Peleseti, ki jih omenjajo staroegiptovski zapisi in naj bi bili med napadalnimi morskimi ljudstvi ob propadu pozne bronaste dobe. Na ozemeljskem vrhuncu je filistejska zveza morda segala ob kanaanski obali od El Ariša na Sinajskem polotoku do reke Jarkon, ki teče skozi Tel Aviv, v notranjost pa do Ekrona in Gata.

source.title: Philistia
paragraphs: Philistia refers to the territory inhabited by the Philistines in Canaan, where they maintained a pentapolis comprising the cities of Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron, and Gath. For a time, Philistia also included Jaffa, which may have briefly changed hands with Israel before it was ultimately lost to the Neo-Assyrian Empire during Sennacherib's Levantine campaign.

Scholars believe that the Philistines originated from Greek migrant groups of the Aegean civilization that, from roughly 1200 BC onwards, settled in the area and gradually intermixed with the indigenous Canaanite population. In this context, they are also generally identified with the Peleset, who are mentioned in ancient Egyptian records and are hypothesized to have been among the invading Sea Peoples around the Late Bronze Age collapse. At their territorial zenith, the Philistine confederation may have stretched along the Canaanite coast from Arish in the Sinai Peninsula to the Yarkon River running through Tel Aviv, and as far inland as Ekron and Gath.

Plague of Sheroe.headline: Šeroejeva kuga
paragraphs: Šeroejeva kuga v letih 627–628 n. št. je bila epidemija kuge – smrtonosne nalezljive bolezni, ki jo povzroča bakterija Yersinia pestis –, ki je opustošila zahodne pokrajine Sasanidskega imperija in pospešila njegov zaton. Pustošila je po Mezopotamiji, gosto poseljeni in življenjsko pomembni kmetijski pokrajini, kjer je bila tudi cesarska prestolnica Ktezifon. Ocene smrtnosti se razlikujejo; po nekaterih zapisih je samo v prestolnici umrlo več kot 100.000 ljudi. Med žrtvami je bil tudi vladajoči kralj kraljev (šahanšah) Kavad II., z rojstnim imenom Šeroe. Kavad je bolezni podlegel leta 628, le nekaj mesecev potem, ko je prestol zasedel tako, da je pobil večino svoje družine.

Šeroejeva kuga je bila pomemben dejavnik zatona in propada Sasanidskega imperija. Leta 632 je pravoverni kalifat napadel od kuge oslabljenega sasanidskega soseda, do leta 654 pa je bila arabska osvojitev Perzije končana.

source.title: Plague of Sheroe
paragraphs: The Plague of Sheroe of 627–628 CE (also called Sheroe's Plague) was an epidemic of the plague—the deadly contagious disease caused by the Yersinia pestis bacterium—that devastated the western regions of the Sasanian Empire and hastened its decline. The epidemic ravaged Mesopotamia, a populous and vital agricultural region that was also home to the imperial capital Ctesiphon. Estimates of the plague's lethality vary; some records indicate that it left over 100,000 dead in the capital alone. Among its victims was the reigning King of Kings (shahanshah) Kavad II, whose birth name was "Sheroe". Kavad himself succumbed to the disease in 628, just months after seizing the throne by murdering most of his family.

Sheroe's Plague was a major factor in the decline and fall of the Sasanian Empire. In 632 the Rashidun Caliphate would attack its plague-weakened Sasanian neighbor, and by 654 the Arab conquest of Persia was complete.

Raid on Nakhla.headline: Napad pri Nahli
paragraphs: Napad pri Nahli (arabsko: سرِيَّة نَخْلَة) je bil napad, ki ga Mohamedovi tovariši sprva niso načrtovali, a velja za prvi uspešni napad na Mekance, saj so ga izvedli med vohunsko nalogo. Napad je potekal pri Nahli v pokrajini Hedžas na ozemlju današnje Savdske Arabije, v redžebu leta 2 po hidžri (januarja 624 n. št.). Poveljnik je bil Abdulah ibn Džahš al Asadi, ki ga je Mohamed poslal v Nahlo na čelu 12 izseljencev s šestimi kamelami. Muslimani so pri napadu dobili bogat plen in ga prinesli Mohamedu v Medino. To pa je med ljudmi sprožilo spor, saj je bilo po poganskem običaju bojevanje v svetem mesecu strogo prepovedano in je napad pomenil kršitev dogovora.

source.title: Raid on Nakhla
paragraphs: The Raid on Nakhla (Arabic: سرِيَّة نَخْلَة) was a raid that was initially unplanned by the companions of Muhammad, but is considered to be the first successful raid against the Meccans, since it was carried out during an espionage event. This raid took place at Nakhla, in the Hejazi region of what is now Saudi Arabia. It took place in Rajab A.H. 2 (January AD 624). The commander was 'Abdullah ibn Jahsh al-Asadi, whom Muhammad dispatched to Nakhla as the head of 12 Emigrants with six camels. The Muslims obtained rich plunder from the raid and brought it before Muhammad in Medina. However, this sparked controversy among the people since warfare was strictly forbidden during the holy month by Pagan convention and a raid was a transgression against the agreement.

Ramadan Revolution.headline: Ramadanska revolucija
paragraphs: Ramadanska revolucija, imenovana tudi revolucija 8. februarja ali državni udar februarja 1963 (arabsko: حركة 8 شباط) v Iraku, je bil vojaški udar iraške veje stranke Baath februarja 1963, ki je strmoglavil iraškega predsednika vlade Abdula Karima Kasima in na oblast pripeljal baatistično vlado. Devet mesecev pozneje je sledil protiudar, ki je novo vlado odstavil in očistil člane stranke Baath.

Najmočnejši voditelj baatistične vlade, ki je nastala z udarom, je bil generalni sekretar iraške stranke Baath Ali Salih al Sadi, ki je nadzoroval milico narodne garde in po udaru organiziral pokol več sto, če ne več tisoč domnevnih komunistov in drugih disidentov. Kasimov nekdanji namestnik Abdul Salam Arif, ki ni bil baatist, je dobil večinoma ceremonialni naziv predsednika, vidni baatistični general Ahmed Hasan al Bakr pa je postal predsednik vlade.

source.title: Ramadan Revolution
paragraphs: The Ramadan Revolution, also referred to as the 8 February Revolution and the February 1963 coup d'état (Arabic: حركة 8 شباط) in Iraq, was a military coup by the Iraqi branch of the Ba'ath Party in February 1963 that overthrew the prime minister of Iraq, Abdul-Karim Qasim in favour of a Ba'athist government. The coup was followed nine months later by a counter coup that saw the removal of the new government and a purging of Ba'ath Party members.

The most powerful leader of the Ba'athist government that emerged from the coup was the secretary general of the Iraqi Ba'ath Party, Ali Salih al-Sa'di, who controlled the National Guard militia and organized a massacre of hundreds—if not thousands—of suspected communists and other dissidents following the coup. Qasim's former deputy, Abdul Salam Arif, who was not a Ba'athist, was given the largely ceremonial title of president, while prominent Ba'athist general Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr was named prime minister.

Ramadanid Emirate.headline: Ramadanidski emirat
paragraphs: Ramadanidski emirat (sodobno turško: Ramazanoğulları Beyliği) je bila turška avtonomna uprava in dejansko neodvisen emirat, ki je od leta 1352 do 1608 obstajal v Kilikiji, kjer je oblast prevzel od Armenskega kraljestva Kilikija. Emirat je bil do konca 14. stoletja protektorat mameluškega sultanata, nato je bil več kot stoletje dejansko neodvisen, od leta 1517 pa protektorat Osmanskega cesarstva. Prestolnica je bila Adana.

Ramadanidski emirat je bil edini emirat v Anatoliji, ki ni bil naslednik Anatolskega seldžuškega sultanata. Pogosto ga napačno uvrščajo med anatolske beglike, čeprav je bil tvorba pod mameluško oblastjo. Kilikija je bila okoli preloma 11. stoletja le kratek čas pod Seldžuki, zato je ni zajelo širjenje sunitskih tarikatov v 13. stoletju. Konec 14. stoletja so se v Kilikijo preselili Turki Yüreğir, ki so imeli svojsko kulturo, v kateri so se islamu pridružili vplivi bektašijskih izročil s šamanskimi obredi.

source.title: Ramadanid Emirate
paragraphs: The Ramadanid Emirate (Modern Turkish: Ramazanoğulları Beyliği) was a Turkish autonomous administration and a de facto independent emirate that existed from 1352 to 1608 in Cilicia, taking over the rule of the region from the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia. The emirate was a protectorate of the Mamluk Sultanate until the end of the 14th century, then it was de facto independent for more than a century, and then, from 1517, a protectorate of the Ottoman Empire. The capital was Adana.

The Ramadanid Emirate was the only emirate in Anatolia that was not a successor of the Anatolian Seljuk Sultanate. It is often misclassified as an Anatolian beylik, though it was an entity under the Mamluks. Cilicia was part of the Seljuks for a short time around the turn of the 11th century and thus was not affected by the Sunni tariqa expansionism of the 13th century. In the late 14th century, the Yüreğir Turks moved to Cilicia and had a distinct culture with influence from Bektashi traditions of shamanic rituals along with Islam.

Raqqa campaign (2016–2017).headline: Kampanja za Rako (2016–2017)
paragraphs: Kampanja za Rako (s kodnim imenom operacija Evfratova jeza) je bila vojaška operacija, ki so jo Sirske demokratične sile (SDF) novembra 2016 med spopadom med Rojavo in islamisti sprožile proti Islamski državi (IS) v guvernoratu Raka, da bi osamile in nazadnje zavzele prestolnico Islamske države Rako. Med postranskimi cilji SDF so bili zavzetje jezu Tabka, bližnjega mesta Al Thaura in jezu Mansura niže ob reki. Kampanja se je oktobra 2017 uspešno končala z zavzetjem Rake.

Ofenziva je potekala hkrati z bitko za Sirt v Libiji, bitko za Mosul v Iraku, bitko za Al Bab v guvernoratu Alep, ofenzivo na Palmiro, ponovnimi boji pri obleganju Dejr ez Zorja, kampanjo v osrednji Siriji in ofenzivo na Majadin.

source.title: Raqqa campaign (2016–2017)
paragraphs: The Raqqa campaign (codenamed Operation Wrath of Euphrates) was a military operation launched in November 2016 during the Rojava–Islamist conflict by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) against the Islamic State (IS) in the Raqqa Governorate, with the goal of isolating and eventually capturing the Islamic State's capital city, Raqqa. The SDF's subsidiary goals included capturing the Tabqa Dam, the nearby city of al-Thawrah, and the Mansoura Dam further downstream. The campaign ended successfully in October 2017, with the capture of the city of Raqqa.

The offensive was concurrent with the Battle of Sirte in Libya, the Battle of Mosul in Iraq, the Battle of al-Bab in the Aleppo Governorate, the Palmyra offensive, the reignition of fighting in Deir ez-Zor's siege, the Central Syria campaign, and the Mayadin offensive.

Rassid dynasty.headline: Rasidi
paragraphs: Jemenski imami in pozneje tudi jemenski kralji so bili verski voditelji zajdijske veje šiitskega islama. Od leta 897 so v delih Jemna vzpostavili preplet verske in politične oblasti. Njihov imamat se je v spreminjajočih se okoliščinah ohranil do republikanske revolucije leta 1962 in nato do formalne odprave monarhije leta 1970. Zajdijska teologija se je od ismailitov in dvanajstniških šiitov razlikovala po tem, da je poudarjala navzočnost dejavnega in vidnega imama kot voditelja. Od imama so pričakovali, da je podkovan v verskih vedah in se izkaže kot vreden voditelj skupnosti, če je bilo treba, tudi v boju. Kdor se je potegoval za imamat, je razglasil »poziv« (dava), in ni bilo redko, da je bilo kandidatov več. Zgodovinar Ibn Haldun (umrl 1406) omenja rod, iz katerega so navadno izhajali imami, kot Banu Rasi ali Rasidi. V izvirnih arabskih virih izraz Rasidi sicer skoraj ni v rabi, v zahodni literaturi pa navadno označuje imame srednjega veka, do 16. stoletja. Veja Rasidov, ki je prišla na oblast z imamom al Mansurjem al Kasimom (vladal 1597–1620), je znana kot Kasimidi.

source.title: Rassid dynasty
paragraphs: The Imams of Yemen and later also the Kings of Yemen were religiously consecrated leaders belonging to the Zaidiyyah branch of Shia Islam. They established a blend of religious and political rule in parts of Yemen from 897. Their imamate endured under varying circumstances until the republican revolution in 1962, then the formal abolition of the monarchy in 1970. Zaidiyyah theology differed from Ismailis or Twelver Shi'ites by stressing the presence of an active and visible imam as leader. The imam was expected to be knowledgeable in religious sciences, and to prove himself a worthy headman of the community, even in battle if this was necessary. A claimant of the imamate would proclaim a "call" (da'wa), and there were not infrequently more than one claimant. The historian Ibn Khaldun (d. 1406) mentions the clan that usually provided the imams as the Banu Rassi or Rassids (Arabic: الرسيين). In the original Arab sources the term Rassids is otherwise hardly used; in Western literature it usually refers to the Imams of the medieval period, up to the 16th century. The Rassid branch that came to power with imam al-Mansur al-Qasim (r. 1597-1620) is known as Qasimids (Al al-Qasimi).
Rasulidi (arabsko: Banū Rasūl) so bili sunitska jemenska dinastija, ki je Jemnu vladala od leta 1229 do 1454.

source.title: Rasulid dynasty
paragraphs: The Rasulid dynasty or Rasulids (Arabic: بنو رسول, romanized: Banū Rasūl) were a Sunni Yemeni dynasty who ruled Yemen from 1229 to 1454.

Alžirsko regentstvo je bilo zgodnjenovoveška napol samostojna osmanska obmejna provinca in vazalna država na Berberski obali severne Afrike od leta 1516 do 1830. Ustanovila sta ga brata, korzarja Oruč in Hajredin (znana tudi kot brata Barbarossa), in postalo je središče osmanske oblasti v Magrebu ter mogočno oporišče, iz katerega so proti evropskim krščanskim silam vodili pomorsko sveto vojno (džihad). Vladali so mu izvoljeni regenti v okviru stratokracije, ki so jo vodili janičarji in korzarji. Čeprav so evropski viri Alžir pogosto povezovali s piratstvom, je imel dolgoletne diplomatske vezi z evropskimi državami in je veljal za priznano sredozemsko silo.

source.title: Regency of Algiers
paragraphs: The Regency of Algiers was an early modern semi-independent Ottoman frontier province and vassal state on the Barbary Coast of North Africa from 1516 to 1830. Founded by the privateer brothers Aruj and Hayreddin Reis (also known as the Barbarossa brothers), the Regency became the centre of Ottoman authority in the Maghreb and a formidable base that waged maritime holy war (Jihad) on European Christian powers. It was ruled by elected regents under a stratocracy led by Janissaries and corsairs. Although European sources often associated Algiers with piracy, Algiers maintained long-standing diplomatic ties with European states and was a recognized Mediterranean power.

Rojava Revolution.headline: Revolucija v Rojavi
paragraphs: Revolucija v Rojavi, znana tudi kot spopad v Rojavi, je bila politični prevrat in vojaški spopad, ki je od leta 2012 do 2026 potekal na severu Sirije, med Kurdi znanem kot zahodni Kurdistan ali Rojava.

Med sirsko državljansko vojno, ki se je začela leta 2011, si je koalicija pod kurdsko prevlado in vodstvom Stranke demokratične unije skupaj z nekaterimi drugimi kurdskimi, arabskimi, asirskimi in turkmenskimi skupinami prizadevala za novo ustavo avtonomne regije, vojaška krila in zavezniške milice pa so se bojevala za nadzor nad njo. To je leta 2016 pripeljalo do ustanovitve Demokratične avtonomne uprave Severne in Vzhodne Sirije (DAANES).

Podporniki kurdskega gibanja so dogodke razumeli kot družbeno revolucijo, v kateri so imele ženske vidno vlogo tako na bojišču kot v oblikovanem političnem sistemu, ob uvajanju demokratičnega konfederalizma, oblike libertarnega socializma, ki je poudarjal decentralizacijo, enakost spolov in potrebo po krajevni samoupravi z neposredno demokracijo.

source.title: Rojava Revolution
paragraphs: The Rojava Revolution, also known as the Rojava conflict, was a political upheaval and military conflict that took place from 2012 to 2026 in northern Syria, known among Kurds as Western Kurdistan or Rojava.

During the Syrian civil war that began in 2011, a Kurdish-dominated coalition led by the Democratic Union Party as well as some other Kurdish, Arab, Assyrian, and Turkmen groups had sought to establish a new constitution for the autonomous region, while military wings and allied militias fought to maintain control of the region. This led to the establishment of the Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria (DAANES) in 2016.

Supporters of the Kurdish movement viewed the events as a social revolution in which women had played a prominent role both on the battlefield and within the formed political system, alongside the implementation of democratic confederalism, a form of libertarian socialism that emphasized decentralization, gender equality and the need for local governance through direct democracy.

Rustamid dynasty.headline: Rustamidi
paragraphs: Rustamidi (arabsko: الرستميون) so bili ibaditska dinastija perzijskega izvora, ki je vladala državi s središčem na ozemlju današnje Alžirije. Dinastija je stoletje in pol vladala kot muslimanska teokracija iz prestolnice Tahert (današnji Tagdemt), dokler je ni premagal ismailitski Fatimidski kalifat. Rustamidska oblast je segala čez današnjo osrednjo in zahodno Alžirijo, dele južne Tunizije ter pokrajini Džebel Nafusa in Fezan v Libiji vse do Zavile.

source.title: Rustamid dynasty
paragraphs: The Rustamid dynasty (Arabic: الرستميون) was an Ibadi dynasty of Persian origin which ruled a state that was centered in present-day Algeria. The dynasty governed as a Muslim theocracy for a century and a half from its capital Tahert (present day Tagdemt) until the Isma'ili Fatimid Caliphate defeated it. Rustamid authority extended over what is now central and western Algeria, parts of southern Tunisia, and the Jebel Nafusa and Fezzan regions in Libya as far as Zawila.

Saadijski sultanat (arabsko: السعديون, as-saʿdiyyūn), znan tudi kot Šerifski sultanat (arabsko: السلطنة الشريفة), je bila država, ki je v 16. in 17. stoletju vladala današnjemu Maroku in delom severozahodne Afrike. Vodila jo je dinastija Saaditov, arabska šerifska dinastija.

source.title: Saadi Sultanate
paragraphs: The Saadi Sultanate (Arabic: السعديون, romanized: as-saʿdiyyūn), also known as the Sharifian Sultanate (Arabic: السلطنة الشريفة), was a state which ruled present-day Morocco and parts of Northwest Africa in the 16th and 17th centuries. It was led by the Saadi dynasty, an Arab Sharifian dynasty.

Sajid dynasty.headline: Sadžidi
paragraphs: Sadžidi (perzijsko: sâjiyân, znani tudi kot Banu Sadž) so bili muslimanska dinastija iranskega izvora, ki je vladala od leta 889/890 do 929. Azerbajdžanu in delom Armenije so vladali najprej iz Marage in Barde, nato pa iz Ardabila. Izvirali so iz srednjeazijske pokrajine Ušrusana, bili so iranskega (sogdijskega) rodu in kulturno arabizirani. Mohameda ibn Abi Sadža Divdada, sina Divdada, prvega sadžidskega vladarja Azerbajdžana, so za vladarja imenovali leta 889 ali 890. Mohamedov oče Abu Sadž Devdad se je bojeval pod ušrusanskim knezom Afšinom Hajdarjem v njegovem zadnjem pohodu proti uporniku Babaku Horamdinu v Azerbajdžanu, pozneje pa je služil kalifom. Proti koncu desetega stoletja, ko je osrednja oblast Abasidskega kalifata slabela, je Mohamed lahko ustanovil skoraj neodvisno državo. Sadžidi so večino moči vložili v poskuse, da bi zavladali sosednji Armeniji. Dinastija se je končala s smrtjo Abu Musafirja al Fataha leta 929.

source.title: Sajid dynasty
paragraphs: The Sajid dynasty (Persian: ساجیان, romanized: sâjiyân, also known as Banu Saj) was a Muslim dynasty, of Iranian origin, that ruled from 889/890 until 929. The Sajids ruled Azerbaijan and parts of Armenia first from Maragha and Barda and then from Ardabil. The Sajids originated from the Central Asian province of Ushrusana and were of Iranian (Sogdian) descent and culturally Arabised. Muhammad ibn Abi'l-Saj Diwdad the son of Diwdad, the first Sajid ruler of Azerbaijan, was appointed as its ruler in 889 or 890. Muhammad's father Abu'l-Saj Devdad had fought under the Ushrusanan prince Afshin Khaydar during the latter's final campaign against the rebel Babak Khorramdin in Azerbaijan, and later served the caliphs. Toward the end of the tenth century, as the central authority of the Abbasid Caliphate weakened, Muhammad was able to form a virtually independent state. Much of the Sajids' energies were spent in attempting to take control of neighboring Armenia. The dynasty ended with the death of Abu'l-Musafir al-Fath in 929.

Samanidski imperij (perzijsko: Sāmāniyān) je bil perzijsko oblikovan sunitski muslimanski imperij, ki mu je od leta 819 do 999 vladala dinastija iranskega dihkanskega izvora. Središče je imel v Horasanu in Transoksaniji, na vrhuncu pa je obsegal severovzhodni Iran in Srednjo Azijo.

Dinastija izvira od štirih bratov, Nuha, Ahmada, Jahje in Iljasa, ki so leta 819 postali guvernerji ozemelj pod abasidsko nadoblastjo. Leta 892 je Ahmadov sin Ismail Samani Samanide združil pod svojo oblastjo in pod njim so se dejansko osamosvojili od Abasidov. Do leta 945 pa je vlado dejansko prevzela frakcija turških vojaških sužnjev, oblast samanidske rodbine pa je postala zgolj simbolna.

Samanidski imperij je del iranskega intermezza, v katerem sta nastali perzijsko oblikovana kultura in identiteta, ki sta iranski jezik in izročila vključili v islamski svet. To je pozneje prispevalo k nastanku turško-perzijske kulture.

source.title: Samanid Empire
paragraphs: The Samanid Empire (Persian: سامانیان, romanized: Sāmāniyān) was a Persianate Sunni Muslim empire, ruled by a dynasty of Iranian dehqan origin, from 819 to 999. The empire was centred in Khorasan and Transoxiana, and at its greatest extent included northeastern Iran and Central Asia.

The Samanid dynasty originated with four brothers: Nuh, Ahmad, Yahya, and Ilyas, who were made governors of territories under Abbasid suzerainty in 819. In 892, Ismail Samani, son of Ahmad, united the Samanids under his rule. It was also under him that the Samanids became effectively independent of the Abbasids. However, by 945, the government had fallen under the de facto control of the Turkic military slave faction, and the Samanid family's authority had become purely symbolic.

The Samanid Empire is part of the Iranian Intermezzo, which saw the creation of a Persianate culture and identity that brought Iranian speech and traditions into the fold of the Islamic world. This later contributed to the formation of the Turco-Persian culture.

Samche-Saatabago ali atabegat Samche (gruzijsko: სამცხე-საათაბაგო), imenovan tudi kneževina Samche (სამცხის სამთავრო), je bila gruzijska fevdalna kneževina v Zemo Kartliju (Gornjem Kartliju), ki ji je skoraj tri stoletja in pol, med letoma 1268 in 1625, vladal gruzijski atabeg (vzgojitelj). Njeno ozemlje je obsegalo današnjo pokrajino Samche-Džavaheti in zgodovinsko pokrajino Tao-Klardžeti.
notes: The glossary headline is Kneževina Meshetija; the text keeps the Georgian name Samche-Saatabago with its translation.

source.title: Samtskhe-Saatabago
paragraphs: The Samtskhe-Saatabago or Samtskhe Atabegate (Georgian: სამცხე-საათაბაგო), also called the Principality of Samtskhe (სამცხის სამთავრო), was a Georgian feudal principality in Zemo Kartli, ruled by an atabeg (tutor) of Georgia for nearly three and a half centuries, between 1268 and 1625. Its territory consisted of the modern-day Samtskhe-Javakheti region and the historical region of Tao-Klarjeti.

Sarbadars.headline: Sarbadarji
paragraphs: Sarbadarji (iz perzijskega sarbadār, »glava na vešalih«; znani tudi kot Sarbedaran) so bili mešanica verskih dervišev in posvetnih vladarjev, ki so sredi 14. stoletja, ko je razpadal mongolski Ilkanat, zavladali delu zahodnega Horasana (država je nastala leta 1337). S središčem v prestolnici Sabzevar so vladali, dokler se Hodža Ali Muajad leta 1381 ni podredil Timurju, in so bili ena redkih skupin, ki se jim je Timurjeva razvpita brutalnost večinoma izognila.

source.title: Sarbadars
paragraphs: The Sarbadars (from Persian: سربدار sarbadār, "head on gallows"; also known as Sarbedaran سربداران) were a mixture of religious dervishes and secular rulers that came to rule over part of western Khurasan in the midst of the disintegration of the Mongol Ilkhanate in the mid-14th century (established in 1337). Centered in their capital of Sabzavar, they continued their reign until Khwaja 'Ali-yi Mu'ayyad submitted to Timur in 1381, and were one of the few groups that managed to mostly avoid Timur's famous brutality.

Saruhanidi ali dinastija Saruhanidov (sodobno turško: Saruhanoğulları, Saruhanoğulları Beyliği), znani tudi kot kneževina Saruhan in beglik Saruhan (Saruhan Beyliği), so bili eden od turških anatolskih beglikov (kneževin) s središčem v Manisi.

Izvor Saruhanidov ni znan, po nekaterih teorijah naj bi bili oguškega ali kipčaškega izvora. Nekateri raziskovalci jih povezujejo s plemenom »Sarı« Kipčakov-Kimekov. Beglik je okoli leta 1300 ustanovil plemenski poglavar Saruhan in je prvič obstajal do leta 1390, ko je pokrajino zavzel Bajazid I., dokončno pa do leta 1412, ko je osmanski sultan Mehmed I. ubil Hızırja, zadnjega saruhanidskega vladarja, in beglik kot provinco vključil v Osmansko cesarstvo.
notes: The English has a garbled sentence ("The Saruhanids It was founded …"); translated as meant.

source.title: Sarukhanids
paragraphs: The Sarukhanids or Sarukhanid dynasty (Modern Turkish: Saruhanoğulları, Saruhanoğulları Beyliği), also known as the Principality of Saruhan and Beylik of Saruhan (Saruhan Beyliği), was one of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks (principality), centered in Manisa.

Although the origin of Saruhanids is not known, there are theories that they may be of Oghuz or Kipchak origin. Some researchers attribute the origins of Saruhanids to the "Sarı" tribe of Kipchak-Kimeks. The Saruhanids It was founded by the tribal chief Saruhan about 1300 and lasted for a first time until 1390, when Bayezid I overran the region and finally until 1412, when the Ottoman Sultan Mehmed I killed Hızır, the last Saruhan ruler, and absorbed the Beylik into the Ottoman Empire as a province.

Sasanian civil war of 589–591.headline: Sasanidska državljanska vojna v letih 589–591
paragraphs: Sasanidska državljanska vojna v letih 589–591 je bil spopad, ki je izbruhnil leta 589 zaradi velikega nezadovoljstva plemstva z vladavino Hormizda IV. Trajala je do leta 591 in se končala s strmoglavljenjem mihranidskega uzurpatorja Bahrama Čobina in vrnitvijo sasanidske rodbine na iranski prestol.

Glavni vzrok vojne sta bila Hormizdovo nezaupanje do plemstva in duhovščine ter njegovo trdo ravnanje z njima. To je Bahrama Čobina nazadnje spodbudilo k velikemu uporu, brata Vistahm in Vinduj iz rodbine Ispahbudhan pa sta proti Hormizdu izvedla palačni udar, ki se je končal z njegovo oslepitvijo in nazadnje smrtjo. Za kralja so nato kronali njegovega sina Hosrova II.

source.title: Sasanian civil war of 589–591
paragraphs: The Sasanian civil war of 589–591 was a conflict that broke out in 589, due to the great deal of dissatisfaction among the nobles towards the rule of Hormizd IV. The civil war lasted until 591, ending with the overthrow of the Mihranid usurper Bahram Chobin and the restoration of the Sasanian family as the rulers of Iran.

Hormizd IV's distrust and harsh treatment of nobility and clergy was a major cause of the war. This eventually made Bahram Chobin start a major rebellion, while the two Ispahbudhan brothers Vistahm and Vinduyih made a palace coup against him, resulting in the blinding and eventually death of Hormizd IV. His son, Khosrow II, was thereafter crowned as king.

Sasanidsko zavzetje Jeruzalema v začetku leta 614 je bil pomemben dogodek bizantinsko-sasanidske vojne v letih 602–628. Bilo je plod velike ofenzive Sasanidskega imperija po Rodovitnem polmesecu, ki se je končala s priključitvijo Jeruzalema in vse Palaestine Prime. Sasanidsko napredovanje je okrepil pravočasni izbruh judovskega upora proti Herakliju, ki je bil posledica desetletij preganjanja Judov in Samarijanov v Bizantinskem cesarstvu, čeprav je bila Heraklijeva dinastija na oblasti šele štiri leta.

source.title: Sasanian conquest of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Sasanian conquest of Jerusalem in early 614 was a significant development in the Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628. It was the result of a major offensive by the Sasanian Empire across the Fertile Crescent, culminating in the annexation of Jerusalem and Palaestina Prima as a whole. The Sasanian advance had been bolstered by the timely outbreak of the Jewish revolt against Heraclius, owing to decades of persecution of Jews and Samaritans by the Byzantine Empire, although the Heraclian dynasty itself had only been in power for four years.

Saudi–Yemeni war (1934).headline: Savdsko-jemenska vojna (1934)
paragraphs: Savdsko-jemenska vojna (arabsko: الحرب السعودية اليمنية) je bila vojna med Kraljevino Savdsko Arabijo in Kraljevino Jemen leta 1934.

source.title: Saudi–Yemeni war (1934)
paragraphs: The Saudi–Yemeni war (Arabic: الحرب السعودية اليمنية) was a war between the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Kingdom of Yemen in 1934.

Tekma za Afriko je bila invazija, osvojitev in kolonizacija večjega dela Afrike, ki jih je konec 19. in v začetku 20. stoletja, v dobi »novega imperializma«, izvedlo sedem zahodnoevropskih sil, ki jih je gnala druga industrijska revolucija. Za Afriko so tekmovale Belgija, Francija, Nemčija, Italija, Portugalska, Španija in Združeno kraljestvo.

Berlinska konferenca v letih 1884–1885 je uredila evropsko kolonizacijo in trgovino v Afriki in velja za simbol »tekme«. V zadnji četrtini 19. stoletja so med evropskimi imperiji vladala velika politična rivalstva, ki so spodbudila kolonizacijo. Konec 19. stoletja so prešli od »neformalnega imperializma«, vojaškega vpliva in gospodarske prevlade, k neposredni oblasti.

source.title: Scramble for Africa
paragraphs: The Scramble for Africa was the invasion, conquest, and colonisation of most of Africa by seven Western European powers, which were driven by the Second Industrial Revolution during the late 19th and early 20th centuries through the era of "New Imperialism". Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom were the contending powers.

The 1884–1885 Berlin Conference regulated European colonisation and trade in Africa, and is seen as emblematic of the "scramble". In the last quarter of the 19th century, there were considerable political rivalries between the European empires, which provided the impetus for the colonisation. The later years of the 19th century saw a transition from "informal imperialism" – military influence and economic dominance – to direct rule.

Druga bitka za Faludžo, sprva s kodnim imenom operacija Fantomski bes ali operacija Al Fadžr (arabsko: الفجر, »zora«), je bila ofenziva iraške vojne pod ameriškim vodstvom, ki se je začela 7. novembra 2004 in je trajala okoli šest tednov.

Bitka, skupni vojaški napor Združenih držav, iraške začasne vlade in Združenega kraljestva, je bila prvi večji spopad vojne, ki so ga bojevali izključno proti iraškim upornikom, ne proti vojaškim silam baatistične iraške vlade.

Operacija Fantomski bes je potekala sedem mesecev po prvi bitki za Faludžo, poskusu, da bi zajeli ali ubili upornike, vpletene v zasedo v Faludži leta 2004, v kateri so umrli štirje uslužbenci zasebne vojaške družbe Blackwater. Po tisti bitki so nadzor nad mestom prepustili krajevnim varnostnim silam pod iraškim vodstvom, ki so začele kopičiti orožje in graditi zapleteno obrambo.

source.title: Second Battle of Fallujah
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Fallujah, initially codenamed Operation Phantom Fury, Operation al-Fajr (Arabic: الفجر, lit. 'The Dawn') was an American-led offensive of the Iraq War that began on 7 November 2004 and lasted about six weeks.

A joint military effort of the United States, the Iraqi Interim Government, and the United Kingdom, the battle was the war's first major engagement fought solely against the Iraqi insurgency, not the military forces of the Ba'athist Iraq government.

Operation Phantom Fury took place seven months after the First Battle of Fallujah, an attempt to capture or kill insurgent elements involved in the 2004 Fallujah ambush that killed four employees of the private military contractor Blackwater. After that battle, control of the city was transferred to an Iraqi-run local security force, which began stockpiling weapons and building complex defenses.

Second Battle of Gaza.headline: Druga bitka za Gazo
paragraphs: Druga bitka za Gazo je potekala od 17. do 19. aprila 1917, po porazu egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) v prvi bitki za Gazo marca, med sinajsko-palestinsko kampanjo prve svetovne vojne. Gazo je branila močno utrjena posadka osmanske vojske, ki so jo po prvi bitki okrepili z velikimi silami. Branilci so zasedli mestno obrambo in črto močnih redut, ki se je ob cesti od Gaze do Beršebe raztezala proti vzhodu. Napadle so jih tri pehotne divizije vzhodnih sil ob podpori dveh konjeniških divizij, a so moč branilcev, njihovi okopi in podporno topništvo napadalce zdesetkali.

source.title: Second Battle of Gaza
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Gaza was fought on 17–19 April 1917, following the defeat of the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) at the First Battle of Gaza in March, during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Gaza was defended by the strongly entrenched Ottoman Army garrison, which had been reinforced after the first battle by substantial forces. They manned the town's defences and a line of strong redoubts which extended eastwards along the road from Gaza to Beersheba. The defenders were attacked by the Eastern Force's three infantry divisions, supported by two mounted divisions, but the strength of the defenders, their entrenchments & supporting artillery decimated the attackers.

Second Battle of Homs.headline: Druga bitka pri Homsu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Homsu je potekala 29. oktobra 1281 v zahodni Siriji med vojskama egiptovske mameluške dinastije in Ilkanata, dela Mongolskega imperija s središčem v Iranu. Bitka je bila del poskusa Abaka kana, da bi Egipčanom iztrgal Sirijo.

source.title: Second Battle of Homs
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Homs was fought in western Syria on 29 October 1281, between the armies of the Mamluk dynasty of Egypt and the Ilkhanate, a division of the Mongol Empire centered on Iran. The battle was part of Abaqa Khan's attempt at taking Syria from the Egyptians.

Druga intifada (arabsko: al-Intifāḍa aṯ-Ṯāniya, dobesedno »druga vstaja«; hebrejsko: ha-Intifada ha-Shniya), znana tudi kot intifada Al Aksa, je bila velika vstaja Palestincev proti Izraelu in njegovi zasedbi od leta 2000. Sprva so jo sprožili civilni protesti arabskih prebivalcev vzhodnega Jeruzalema in območij v samem Izraelu, nato pa je prerasla v dolgo obdobje stopnjevanega nasilja v Izraelu, na Zahodnem bregu in v Gazi. Nasilje, ki je vključevalo streljanje, samomorilske bombne napade in vojaške operacije, je trajalo do vrha v Šarm el Šejku leta 2005, ki je končal sovražnosti.

source.title: Second Intifada
paragraphs: The Second Intifada (Arabic: الانتفاضة الثانية, romanized: al-Intifāḍa aṯ-Ṯāniya, lit. 'The Second Uprising'; Hebrew: האינתיפאדה השנייה, romanized: ha-Intifada ha-Shniya), also known as the Al-Aqsa Intifada, was a major uprising by Palestinians against Israel and its occupation from 2000. Initially sparked by civilian protests by Arab residents in East Jerusalem and areas within Israel proper, the uprising escalated into a prolonged period of heightened violence in Israel, the West Bank and the Gaza Strip. This violence, which included shootings, suicide bombings, and military operations, continued until the Sharm el-Sheikh Summit of 2005, which ended hostilities.

Druga sirska republika, uradno Sirska republika od leta 1950 do 1958 in Sirska arabska republika od leta 1961 do 1963, je nasledila prvo sirsko republiko, ki se je aprila 1946 dejansko osamosvojila od francoskega mandata. Ustanovila jo je sirska ustava iz leta 1950, ki je bila od leta 1950 do 1954, med vladavino Adiba Šišaklija, odložena, pozneje pa je prenehala veljati, ko se je Sirija leta 1958 z Republiko Egipt združila v Združeno arabsko republiko. Druga republika je bila obnovljena, ko je Sirija leta 1961 izstopila iz zveze. Leta 1963 je sirska stranka Baath z nekrvavim vojaškim udarom prevzela oblast, postavila temelje politične ureditve baatistične Sirije in končala obdobje demokratičnih poskusov v postkolonialni Siriji.

source.title: Second Syrian Republic
paragraphs: The Second Syrian Republic, officially the Syrian Republic from 1950 to 1958 and the Syrian Arab Republic from 1961 to 1963, succeeded the First Syrian Republic, which had become de facto independent from the French Mandate in April 1946. The Second Republic was established under the Syrian Constitution of 1950, which was suspended from 1950 to 1954 during Adib Shishakli's rule and later became inoperative when Syria joined with the Republic of Egypt to form the United Arab Republic in 1958. The Second Republic was restored when Syria withdrew from the union in 1961. In 1963, the Syrian Ba'athist Party came to power in a bloodless military coup, which laid the foundations for the political structure of Ba'athist Syria and ended the era of democratic experimentation in post-colonial Syria.

Selevkidi (grško: Σελευκίδαι, Seleukídai, »Selevkovi potomci«) so bili makedonska grška kraljeva rodbina, ki je v helenističnem obdobju vladala Selevkidskemu imperiju s središčem v zahodni Aziji. Ustanovil jo je Selevk I. Nikator, general in naslednik Aleksandra Velikega, po razdelitvi Makedonskega imperija v vojnah diadohov.

source.title: Seleucid dynasty
paragraphs: The Seleucid dynasty or the Seleucidae (Greek: Σελευκίδαι, Seleukídai, "descendants of Seleucus") was a Macedonian Greek royal family, which ruled the Seleucid Empire based in West Asia during the Hellenistic period. It was founded by Seleucus I Nicator, a general and successor of Alexander the Great, after the division of the Macedonian Empire as a result of the Wars of the Successors (Diadochi).

Seljuk campaign on the Crusaders (1111).headline: Seldžuški pohod proti križarjem (1111)
paragraphs: Seldžuški pohod proti križarjem (1111) je bil vojaški pohod v gornji Mezopotamiji in Levantu, ki ga je Masud ibn Mohamed vodil proti križarjem in njihovim državam.

source.title: Seljuk campaign on the Crusaders (1111)
paragraphs: The Seljuk campaign on the Crusaders (1111) was a military campaign that took place in Upper Mesopotamia and Levant, led by Mas'ud ibn Muhammed against the Crusaders and their states.

Siege of Abadan.headline: Obleganje Abadana
paragraphs: Obleganje Abadana je bilo obkolitev mesta, ki so jo iraške sile začele novembra 1980. Mesto so skoraj vsak dan bombardirali že od prvih dni vojne, ki se je začela septembra prej.
Na otoku Abadan je stala rafinerija Abadan, ena največjih naftnih rafinerij na svetu.

source.title: Siege of Abadan
paragraphs: The siege of Abadan was the encirclement of the city by Iraqi forces beginning in November 1980. The city had already been under almost daily bombardment since the early days of the war, which began the previous September.
Abadan Island was the site of the Abadan Refinery, one of the world's largest oil refineries.

Obleganje Akre je bil prvi pomembni protinapad jeruzalemskega kralja Guya proti Saladinu, sultanu Egipta in Sirije. To prelomno obleganje je bilo del tega, kar so pozneje poimenovali tretja križarska vojna. Trajalo je od avgusta 1189 do julija 1191; zaradi obalne lege mesta ga latinski napadalci niso mogli povsem zavzeti, Saladin pa ga ni mogel povsem osvoboditi, saj sta obe strani dobivali zaloge in sredstva po morju. Končalo se je s ključno zmago križarjev in hudim udarcem za Saladinovo namero, da bi uničil križarske države.

source.title: Siege of Acre (1189–1191)
paragraphs: The siege of Acre was the first significant counterattack by Guy of Jerusalem against Saladin, Sultan of Egypt and Syria. This pivotal siege formed part of what later became known as the Third Crusade. The siege lasted from August 1189 until July 1191, at which time the city's coastal position meant the attacking Latin forces were unable to fully capture the city and Saladin was unable to fully relieve it, with both sides receiving supplies and resources by sea. It concluded as a key victory for the Crusaders and a serious setback for Saladin's ambition to destroy the Crusader states.

Obleganje Akre (imenovano tudi padec Akre) je potekalo leta 1291 in se končalo tako, da so križarji Akro izgubili v korist egiptovskega mameluškega sultanata. Velja za eno najpomembnejših bitk tistega obdobja. Čeprav se je križarsko gibanje nadaljevalo še več stoletij, je zavzetje mesta pomenilo konec nadaljnjih križarskih vojn v Levantu. S padcem Akre so križarji izgubili zadnje veliko oporišče križarskega Jeruzalemskega kraljestva.

source.title: Siege of Acre (1291)
paragraphs: The siege of Acre (also called the fall of Acre) took place in 1291 and resulted in the Crusaders' losing control of Acre to the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt. It is considered one of the most important battles of the period. Although the crusading movement continued for several more centuries, the capture of the city marked the end of further crusades to the Levant. When Acre fell, the Crusaders lost their last major stronghold of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.

Obleganje Akre leta 1799 je bilo neuspešno francosko obleganje osmanskega mesta Akra in je bilo skupaj z bitko na Nilu prelomnica Napoleonove invazije na Egipt in Sirijo. Bil je Napoleonov tretji taktični poraz v karieri – tri leta prej je bil med italijansko kampanjo poražen v drugi bitki pri Bassanu in v bitki pri Caldieru – ter njegov prvi veliki strateški poraz, hkrati pa zadnjič za 10 let, da je bil poražen v bitki. Po spodletelem obleganju se je Napoleon dva meseca pozneje umaknil v Egipt.

source.title: Siege of Acre (1799)
paragraphs: The siege of Acre of 1799 was an unsuccessful French siege of the Ottoman city of Acre and was the turning point of Napoleon's invasion of Egypt and Syria, along with the Battle of the Nile. It was Napoleon's third tactical defeat in his career, being defeated at the Second Battle of Bassano and the Battle of Caldiero three years previously during the Italian campaign, and his first major strategic defeat, along with the last time he was defeated in battle for 10 years. As a result of the failed siege, Napoleon retreated two months later and withdrew to Egypt.
Obleganje Alepa, bizantinske trdnjave in enega redkih preostalih bizantinskih gradov na severu Levanta po odločilni bitki pri Jarmuku, je potekalo med avgustom in oktobrom 637.

source.title: Siege of Aleppo (637)
paragraphs: The siege of Aleppo, the Byzantine stronghold and one of the few remaining Byzantine castles in the northern Levant after the decisive Battle of Yarmouk, was laid between August and October 637.

Obleganje Aškelona je potekalo od 25. januarja do 22. avgusta 1153, v obdobju med drugo in tretjo križarsko vojno, in se je končalo tako, da je Jeruzalemsko kraljestvo zavzelo fatimidsko egiptovsko trdnjavo. Aškelon je bil pomemben grad, iz katerega so Fatimidi vpadali na ozemlje križarskega kraljestva, do leta 1153 pa je bil zadnje obalno mesto v Palestini, ki ga križarji niso nadzorovali.

source.title: Siege of Ascalon
paragraphs: The siege of Ascalon took place from 25 January to 22 August 1153, in the time period between the Second and Third Crusades, and resulted in the capture of the Fatimid Egyptian fortress by the Kingdom of Jerusalem. Ascalon was an important castle that was used by the Fatimids to launch raids into the Crusader kingdom's territory, and by 1153 it was the last coastal city in Palestine that was not controlled by the Crusaders.

Siege of Baghdad (1638).headline: Obleganje Bagdada (1638)
paragraphs: Obleganje Bagdada (perzijsko: محاصره بغداد) pozimi 1638 je po obdobju safavidske oblasti znova vzpostavilo osmanski nadzor nad Irakom. Bilo je del osmansko-safavidske vojne v letih 1623–1639.

source.title: Siege of Baghdad (1638)
paragraphs: The siege of Baghdad (Persian: محاصره بغداد) in the winter of 1638 marked the re-establishment of Ottoman control over Iraq, following a prior period of Safavid rule. It was part of the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1623–1639.

Siege of Baghdad (1821).headline: Obleganje Bagdada (1821)
paragraphs: Osmansko-perzijska vojna v letih 1820–1823 je od leta 1820 do 1823 potekala med Osmanskim cesarstvom in kadžarskim Iranom.

source.title: Ottoman–Persian War (1820–1823)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Persian War of 1820–1823 was fought between the Ottoman Empire and Qajar Iran from 1820 to 1823.

Siege of Banu Qaynuqa.headline: Obleganje Banu Kajnuka
paragraphs: Obleganje Banu Kajnuka je potekalo aprila 624. Banu Kajnuka so bili judovsko pleme, ki ga je islamski prerok Mohamed izgnal, ker je prelomilo pogodbo, znano kot medinska ustava.

source.title: Siege of Banu Qaynuqa
paragraphs: The siege of Banu Qaynuqa occurred in April 624. The Banu Qaynuqa were a Jewish tribe expelled by the Islamic prophet Muhammad for breaking the treaty known as the Constitution of Medina.

Siege of Basra.headline: Obleganje Basre
paragraphs: Obleganje Basre, s kodnim imenom operacija Karbala-5 ali velika žetev (arabsko: الحصاد الأكبر), je bila napadalna operacija, s katero je Iran v začetku leta 1987 skušal zavzeti iraško pristaniško mesto Basra. Bitka, znana po ogromnih izgubah in krutih razmerah, je bila največja bitka vojne in se je izkazala za zadnjo veliko iransko ofenzivo. Iranci cilja niso dosegli.

source.title: Siege of Basra
paragraphs: The siege of Basra, code-named Operation Karbala-5 or The Great Harvest (Arabic: الحصاد الأكبر), was an offensive operation carried out by Iran in an effort to capture the Iraqi port city of Basra in early 1987. This battle, known for its extensive casualties and ferocious conditions, was the biggest battle of the war and proved to be the last major Iranian offensive. The Iranians failed to reach their objective.

Siege of Beirut.headline: Obleganje Bejruta
paragraphs: Med libanonsko vojno leta 1982 je Izrael oblegal Bejrut, potem ko je propadlo premirje, ki so ga Združeni narodi uveljavili med libanonsko državljansko vojno. Dva meseca dolgo obleganje, ki se je začelo sredi junija, je zahtevalo na tisoče civilnih žrtev in se končalo z izgonom Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) iz Bejruta in preostalega Libanona.

source.title: Siege of Beirut
paragraphs: During the 1982 Lebanon War, the city of Beirut was besieged by Israel following the breakdown of the ceasefire that had been imposed by the United Nations amidst the Lebanese Civil War. Beginning in mid-June, the two-month-long siege resulted in thousands of civilian deaths and the expulsion of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) from Beirut and the rest of Lebanon.

Siege of Ctesiphon (637).headline: Obleganje Ktezifona (637)
paragraphs: Obleganje Ktezifona je potekalo od januarja do marca 637, kmalu potem, ko je pravoverni kalifat v bitki pri Al Kadisiji premagal Sasanidski imperij. Ker je bil Ktezifon perzijska prestolnica že od partskega obdobja, je bila zmaga kalifata pri Ktezifonu eden najpomembnejših dogodkov muslimanske osvojitve Perzije: muslimanska oblast se je utrdila nad vso Mezopotamijo. Zmaga pri obleganju je pripravila tudi pot nadaljnjim muslimanskim vdorom v perzijsko notranjost, kamor se je umaknila sasanidska vojska.

source.title: Siege of Ctesiphon (637)
paragraphs: The siege of Ctesiphon took place from January to March 637, shortly after the Rashidun Caliphate defeated the Sasanian Empire in the Battle of al-Qadisiyyah. As it had served as the Persian capital city since the Parthian period, the Rashidun victory at Ctesiphon was one of the most significant events of the Muslim conquest of Persia; Muslim rule was consolidated over all of Mesopotamia. The victory of the Rashidun army during this siege also set the stage for further Muslim invasions of the Persian mainland, where the Sasanian army found itself confined.

Siege of Damascus (1148).headline: Obleganje Damaska (1148)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damaska je med drugo križarsko vojno potekalo med 24. in 28. julijem 1148 (po starem koledarju). Dve križarski vojski iz Evrope in vojska križarskega Jeruzalemskega kraljestva sta skušali oblegati Damask, mesto Seldžuškega imperija. Poskus se je končal s porazom križarjev. Bitka se je zgodila, ko je razpadalo zavezništvo med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom in Muin ad Dinom Unurjem, emirjem Damaska, križarska Edeška grofija pa je padala v roke Imad ad Dina Zengija, emirja seldžuškega Alepa.

Med krščanskimi vojskami iz zahodne Evrope, ki so se odzvale pozivu h križarski vojni za ponovno zavzetje Edese, sta bili vojski francoskega kralja Ludvika VII. in Konrada III., rimskega kralja v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu. Oba sta večino vojske izgubila med prečkanjem Anatolije.

source.title: Siege of Damascus (1148)
paragraphs: The siege of Damascus took place between 24 and 28 July 1148 O.S. during the Second Crusade. Two Crusader armies from Europe and the army of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem attempted to lay siege to the Seljuk Empire city of Damascus. The effort ended in a Crusader defeat. The battle occurred as the alliance between the Kingdom of Jerusalem and Mu'in ad-Din Unur, emir of the city of Damascus, was unraveling and the Crusader County of Edessa was falling to Imad al-Din Zengi, emir of the Seljuk city of Aleppo.

Among the Christian armies from Western Europe which responded to the call for a crusade to retake Edessa were armies led Louis VII, King of France, and Conrad III, King of the Romans in the Holy Roman Empire. Both lost the majority of their forces crossing Anatolia.

Siege of Damascus (1400).headline: Obleganje Damaska (1400)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damaska (znano tudi kot plenjenje Damaska in zavzetje Damaska) je bil velik dogodek v letih 1400–1401 med vojno med Timuridskim imperijem in mameluškim sultanatom.

source.title: Siege of Damascus (1400)
paragraphs: The siege of Damascus (also known as the Sack of Damascus and the Capture of Damascus) was a major event in 1400–01 during the war between the Timurid Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate.

Siege of Damascus (634).headline: Obleganje Damaska (634)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damaska (634) je trajalo od 21. avgusta do 19. septembra 634, ko je mesto padlo v roke pravovernega kalifata. Damask je bil prvo veliko mesto Vzhodnega rimskega cesarstva, ki je padlo med muslimansko osvojitvijo Sirije.

Zadnja rimsko-perzijska vojna se je končala leta 628, potem ko je Heraklij uspešno končal pohod proti Perzijcem v Mezopotamiji. Hkrati je Mohamed pod zastavo islama združil Arabce. Po njegovi smrti leta 632 ga je kot prvi kalif nasledil Abu Bakr, ki je zatrl več notranjih uporov in hotel razširiti oblast zunaj meja Arabskega polotoka.

source.title: Siege of Damascus (634)
paragraphs: The siege of Damascus (634) lasted from 21 August to 19 September 634 before the city fell to the Rashidun Caliphate. Damascus was the first major city of the Eastern Roman Empire to fall in the Muslim conquest of Syria.

The last of the Roman–Persian Wars ended in 628, after Heraclius concluded a successful campaign against the Persians in Mesopotamia. At the same time, Muhammad united the Arabs under the banner of Islam. After his death in 632, Abu Bakr succeeded him as the first caliph. Suppressing several internal revolts, Abu Bakr sought to expand the empire beyond the confines of the Arabian Peninsula.

Siege of Daraa.headline: Obleganje Deraje
paragraphs: Obleganje Deraje je potekalo v okviru protestov arabske pomladi v Siriji leta 2011, v katerih je bila Deraja žarišče nemirov. Sirska vojska je 25. aprila 2011 začela desetdnevno obleganje mesta, operacijo, ki je pripomogla, da je vstaja prerasla v oborožen upor in nato v državljansko vojno.
V obleganju so sodelovali tanki, helikopterji in do 6000 vojakov. Aretirali so več kot 1000 ljudi, ubitih pa je bilo več kot 244 ljudi, med njimi veliko otrok.

source.title: Siege of Daraa
paragraphs: The siege of Daraa occurred within the context of the 2011 Arab Spring protests in Syria, in which Daraa was the center of unrest. On 25 April 2011, the Syrian Army began a ten-day siege of the city, an operation that helped escalate the uprising into an armed rebellion and subsequent civil war.
The Syrian Army's siege involved tanks, helicopters, and up to 6,000 troops. More than 1,000 people were arrested and more than 244 people were killed, many of them children.

Obleganje Dejr ez Zorja je bilo obsežno obleganje, ki ga je borbena skupina Islamska država (IS) izvajala nad več četrtmi mesta Dejr ez Zor, ki so jih držale sile sirske vlade, da bi zavzela mesto in si zagotovila popoln nadzor nad guvernoratom Dejr ez Zor. Obleganje je trajalo skoraj 3 leta in 2 meseca, nato pa je sirska vojska sprožila uspešno ofenzivo, s katero je mesto devet tednov pozneje v celoti znova zavzela.

Aprila 2014 je IS sprožila obsežno ofenzivo proti sirskim uporniškim silam v guvernoratu Dejr ez Zor. Uporniške skupine so bile popolnoma poražene, IS pa je do julija 2014 zavzela skoraj ves guvernorat. Sile sirske vlade so ostale obkoljene v žepu ozemlja, ki so ga še nadzorovale. Sile sirske vlade so obleganje 10. septembra 2017 dokončno prebile. Po nadaljnjih dveh mesecih bojev je sirska arabska vojska do 17. novembra 2017 zavzela dele mesta Dejr ez Zor in okolice, ki jih je držala IS.

source.title: Siege of Deir ez-Zor (2014–2017)
paragraphs: The siege of Deir ez-Zor was a large-scale siege imposed by the Islamic State (IS) militant group against several districts in the city of Deir ez-Zor held by the Syrian government's military forces, in an attempt to capture the city and secure full control of the Deir ez-Zor Governorate. The ISIL siege of the city lasted for almost 3 years and 2 months, after which the Syrian Army launched a successful offensive that fully recaptured the city nine weeks later.

In April 2014, IS launched a large-scale offensive against Syrian rebel forces in Deir ez-Zor governorate. This resulted in the total defeat of rebel groups in Deir ez-Zor governorate, and IS gained control of almost all of Deir ez-Zor Governorate by July 2014. Syrian government forces remained besieged in the pocket of territory they continued to control. On 10 September 2017, the siege was fully broken by Syrian government forces. After another two months of fighting, the Syrian Arab Army captured the IS-held parts of Deir ez-Zor city and its environs, by 17 November 2017.
