Siege of Emesa.headline: Obleganje Emese
paragraphs: Sile pravovernega kalifata so Emeso oblegale od decembra 635 do marca 636. Obleganje je pripeljalo do islamske osvojitve Emese, velikega trgovskega mesta Bizantinskega cesarstva v Levantu.

source.title: Siege of Emesa
paragraphs: The siege of Emesa was laid by the forces of the Rashidun Caliphate from December 635 up until March 636. This led to the Islamic conquest of Emesa, which was a major trading city of the Byzantine Empire in the Levant.

Obleganje Gaze je v okviru vojn Aleksandra Velikega potekalo oktobra 332 pr. n. št. Končalo se je z makedonsko zmago in koncem 31. egiptovske dinastije, ki je delovala kot satrapija Ahemenidskega perzijskega imperija.

Aleksandru je uspelo prebiti obzidje Gaze z oblegovalnimi stroji, ki jih je prej istega leta uporabil pri obleganju Tira in jih je pripeljal Hefajstion. Po treh neuspešnih juriših je makedonska vojska gaško trdnjavo naskočila in zavzela.

source.title: Siege of Gaza (332 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Gaza, as part of the Wars of Alexander the Great, took place in October of 332 BC. Resulting in a victory for Macedon, it ended the 31st Dynasty of Egypt, which functioned as a satrapy under the Achaemenid Persian Empire.

Alexander succeeded in breaching the walls of Gaza by utilizing the engines that he had employed earlier that year, during the siege of Tyre brought by Hephaestion. Following three unsuccessful assaults, the Macedonian army was able to storm and take the Gazan stronghold.

Siege of Homs.headline: Obleganje Homsa
paragraphs: Obleganje Homsa je bil vojaški spopad med sirsko vlado in sirsko opozicijo v Homsu, velikem uporniškem oporišču med sirsko državljansko vojno. Obleganje je trajalo tri leta, od maja 2011 do maja 2014, in se je nazadnje končalo z umikom opozicije iz mesta.

Protivladni protesti po vsej državi so se začeli marca 2011, spopadi med varnostnimi silami in protestniki v Homsu pa so se okrepili aprila. V začetku maja 2011 je sirska vojska v Homsu obračunala s protivladnimi protestniki, med katerimi so bili nekateri oboroženi in so streljali na varnostne sile. Vladnim silam je sicer s podobno vojaško operacijo uspelo za nekaj časa zatreti proteste v Deraji marca in aprila, njihova operacija v Homsu v začetku maja pa civilnega odpora ni hitro strla. Do septembra so imeli verski spopadi in prelivanje krvi med alaviti in suniti v nemirih v Homsu večjo vlogo kot drugod po Siriji.

source.title: Siege of Homs
paragraphs: The Siege of Homs was a military confrontation between the Syrian government and the Syrian opposition in the city of Homs, a major rebel stronghold during the Syrian Civil War. The siege lasted three years from May 2011 to May 2014, and ultimately resulted in an opposition withdrawal from the city.

Nationwide anti-government protests began in March 2011, and clashes between security forces and protestors in Homs intensified in April. In early May 2011, the Syrian military conducted a crackdown against anti-government protesters in Homs, some of whom were armed and fired on security forces. Though government forces had succeeded in temporarily quelling the March–April Daraa protests during a similar military operation, their early May operation in Homs failed in quickly subduing the civil resistance. By September, sectarian clashes and bloodshed in Homs between Alawites and Sunnis played a larger role in the Homs unrest than in the rest of Syria.

Siege of Isfahan.headline: Obleganje Isfahana
paragraphs: Obleganje Isfahana (perzijsko: سقوط اصفهان) je bilo šestmesečno obleganje Isfahana, prestolnice iranske dinastije Safavidov, ki ga je izvajala afganistanska vojska pod vodstvom Hotakijev. Trajalo je od marca do oktobra 1722 in se končalo s padcem mesta in začetkom konca safavidske dinastije.

source.title: Siege of Isfahan
paragraphs: The siege of Isfahan (Persian: سقوط اصفهان) was a six-month-long siege of Isfahan, the capital of the Safavid dynasty of Iran, by the Hotaki-led Afghan army. It lasted from March to October 1722 and resulted in the city's fall and the beginning of the end of the Safavid dynasty.

Siege of Jacob's Ford.headline: Obleganje Jakobovega broda
paragraphs: Obleganje Jakobovega broda je bila zmaga muslimanskega sultana Saladina nad neimenovanim templjarskim kastelanom Jakobovega broda. Zgodilo se je avgusta 1179, ko je Saladin osvojil in porušil Chastelet, nov obmejni grad, ki so ga vitezi templjarji zgradili pri Jakobovem brodu na gornjem toku Jordana, zgodovinskem prehodu med Golansko planoto in severno Galilejo. Jakobov brod je znan tudi z latinskim imenom Vadum Iacob, v sodobni hebrejščini pa kot Ateret. Mnogi raziskovalci menijo, da je ta zgodnejša zmaga napovedala Saladinovo ponovno osvojitev Svete dežele in Jeruzalema leta 1187.

source.title: Siege of Jacob's Ford
paragraphs: The siege of Jacob's Ford was a victory of the Muslim Sultan Saladin over an unnamed Templar Castellan of Jacob's Ford. It occurred in August 1179, when Saladin conquered and destroyed Chastelet, a new border castle built by the Knights Templar at Jacob's Ford on the upper Jordan River, a historic passage point between the Golan Heights and north Galilee. Jacob's Ford is also known by the Latin name of Vadum Iacob and in modern Hebrew as Ateret. Many scholars believe that Saladin's reconquest of the Holy Land and Jerusalem in 1187 was heralded by this earlier victory.

Obleganje Jafe je bil vojaški spopad med francosko vojsko pod vodstvom Napoleona Bonaparta in osmanskimi silami pod vodstvom Ahmeda al Džazarja. Francozi so 3. marca 1799 oblegali mesto Jafa pod osmansko oblastjo. Boji so trajali od 3. do 7. marca, ko so francoske sile mesto zavzele. Zaradi plenjenja mesta, poboja civilnega prebivalstva in usmrtitve 4100 osmanskih vojnih ujetnikov so obleganje označili za »eno najbolj tragičnih epizod [Napoleonove] egiptovske kampanje«.

source.title: Siege of Jaffa
paragraphs: The siege of Jaffa was a military engagement between the French Army under Napoleon Bonaparte and Ottoman forces under Ahmed al-Jazzar. On March 3, 1799, the French laid siege to the city of Jaffa, which was under Ottoman control. It was fought from March 3 to 7, when French forces managed to capture the city. For the pillaging of the city, the murder of its civilian population and the execution of 4,100 Ottoman prisoners of war, the siege has been called "one of the most tragic episodes of [Napoleon's] Egyptian campaign".
Obleganje Jeruzalema leta 1244 je potekalo po šesti križarski vojni, ko je horezmijska vojska 15. julija 1244 osvojila mesto.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (1244)
paragraphs: The siege of Jerusalem of 1244 took place after the Sixth Crusade, when a Khwarazmian army conquered the city on July 15, 1244.

Obleganje Jeruzalema v letih 589–587 pr. n. št. je bilo zadnje dejanje judejskih uporov proti Babilonu. Nebukadnezar II., kralj Novobabilonskega cesarstva, je judejsko prestolnico oblegal približno 30 mesecev. Mesto je nazadnje padlo poleti 587 pr. n. št., nato pa so Babilonci Jeruzalem načrtno uničili in Salomonov tempelj zravnali z zemljo. Kraljestvo je prenehalo obstajati, velik del prebivalstva pa so izgnali v Babilonijo.

Konec 7. stoletja pr. n. št. je Judeja postala babilonsko vazalno kraljestvo. Leta 601 pr. n. št. se je judejski kralj Jojakim kljub odločnim svarilom preroka Jeremija uprl babilonski oblasti. Jojakim je umrl iz nepojasnjenih razlogov, nasledil pa ga je sin Jehonija. Leta 597 pr. n. št. so Babilonci oblegali Jeruzalem in mesto se je vdalo. Nebukadnezar je Jeruzalem izropal ter Jehonijo in druge ugledne meščane izgnal v Babilon, za kralja pa je postavil Jehonijevega strica Sedekija. Pozneje je Sedekija ob egiptovski spodbudi sprožil drugi upor, zato so Babilonci poslali vojsko, da bi Jeruzalem znova zavzela.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (587 BC)
paragraphs: Jerusalem was besieged from 589–587 BC, marking the final phase of Judah's revolts against Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar II, king of the Neo-Babylonian Empire, besieged Judah's capital city for approximately 30 months. The city ultimately fell in the summer of 587 BC, after which the Babylonians systematically destroyed Jerusalem and razed Solomon's Temple. The kingdom was dissolved, and a large segment of the population was exiled to Babylonia.

During the late 7th century BC, Judah became a vassal kingdom of Babylon. In 601 BC, Jehoiakim, king of Judah, revolted against Babylonian rule despite the strong remonstrances of the prophet Jeremiah. Jehoiakim died for reasons unclear, and was succeeded by his son, Jeconiah. In 597 BC, the Babylonians besieged Jerusalem, and the city surrendered. Nebuchadnezzar pillaged Jerusalem and deported Jeconiah and other prominent citizens to Babylon; Jeconiah's uncle, Zedekiah, was installed as king. Later, encouraged by the Egyptians, Zedekiah launched a second revolt, and a Babylonian army was sent to retake Jerusalem.

Obleganje Jeruzalema (597 pr. n. št.) je bil vojaški pohod Nebukadnezarja II., kralja Novobabilonskega cesarstva, v katerem je oblegal Jeruzalem, tedanjo prestolnico Judejskega kraljestva. Mesto se je vdalo, njegovega kralja Jehonijo pa so izgnali v Babilon in ga nadomestili z njegovim stricem Sedekijem, ki so ga postavili Babilonci. Obleganje omenjata tako hebrejska Biblija (2 Kr 24,10–16) kot babilonska Nebukadnezarjeva kronika.

Leta 601 pr. n. št. je Nebukadnezar II. neuspešno poskušal zavzeti Egipt in so ga s hudimi izgubami odbili. Judejski kralj Jojakim je priložnost izkoristil za upor proti babilonski oblasti in se kljub odločnim svarilom preroka Jeremija postavil na egiptovsko stran. Okoliščine Jojakimove smrti niso jasne. Nasledil ga je mladoletni sin Jehonija.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (597 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Jerusalem (597 BC) was a military campaign carried out by Nebuchadnezzar II, king of the Neo-Babylonian Empire, in which he besieged Jerusalem, then capital of the Kingdom of Judah. The city surrendered, and its king Jeconiah was deported to Babylon and replaced by his Babylonian-appointed uncle, Zedekiah. The siege is recorded in both the Hebrew Bible (2 Kings 24:10–16) and the Babylonian Nebuchadnezzar Chronicle.

In 601 BC, Nebuchadnezzar II unsuccessfully attempted to take Egypt and was repulsed with heavy losses. Jehoiakim—the king of Judah—seized this opportunity to revolt against Babylonian rule, taking a pro-Egyptian position, despite the strong remonstrances of the prophet Jeremiah. The circumstances of Jehoiakim's death are not clear. He was succeeded by his young son, Jeconiah.

Obleganje Jeruzalema leta 63 pr. n. št. je potekalo med pohodi rimskega vojskovodje Pompeja Velikega na vzhodu, kmalu potem, ko je uspešno končal tretjo mitridatsko vojno. Pompeja so prosili, naj posreduje v sporu o nasledstvu hasmonejskega prestola, ki je prerasel v vojno med Hirkanom II. in Aristobulom II. Z njegovim zavzetjem Jeruzalema je bilo konec samostojne judovske države: Judeja je postala vazalno kraljestvo Rimske republike in pozneje provinca Rimskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (63 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Jerusalem in 63 BC occurred during the campaigns of Roman general Pompey the Great in the East, shortly after his successful conclusion of the Third Mithridatic War. Pompey had been asked to intervene in a dispute over succession to the Hasmonean throne, which turned into a war between Hyrcanus II and Aristobulus II. His conquest of Jerusalem spelled the end of an independent Jewish state, and thus the incorporation of Judea as a client kingdom of the Roman Republic and later as a province of the Roman Empire.

Siege of Kerak (1183).headline: Obleganje Keraka (1183)
paragraphs: Grad Kerak, ena najbolj neosvojljivih trdnjav Jeruzalemskega kraljestva, je konec leta 1183 doživel prvo večje obleganje. Saladin, vladar Egipta in Damaska, je Kerak oblegal od začetka novembra 1183, potem ko je njegov gospod Rajnald Châtillonski vpadal na Saladinovo ozemlje.

Saladin se je iz Damaska odpravil 22. oktobra in Kerak oblegal prav takrat, ko je v njem potekala poroka Rajnaldovega pastorka Humfrida IV. Toronskega z Izabelo, polsestro kralja Balduina IV. Rajnald je obleganje skušal zavleči z obrambo obzidanega naselja pred trdnjavo, a je to hitro padlo. Kljub temu uspehu in silovitemu obstreljevanju Saladin ni mogel napredovati, ovirala sta ga namreč globok jarek in gorati teren okoli Keraka. Ko je za obleganje izvedel bolni kralj Balduin, je moral najprej urediti nasledstvo in šele nato zbrati vojsko, ki bi oblegance osvobodila. Po kronanju nečaka Balduina V. je vojsko spremljal do Keraka, poveljstvo pa je prepustil sorodniku, tripolitanskemu grofu Rajmondu III. Saladin se je spopadu s kraljevo vojsko izognil in 3. decembra obleganje opustil.

source.title: Siege of Kerak (1183)
paragraphs: Kerak Castle, one of the most impregnable strongholds in the Kingdom of Jerusalem, underwent its first significant siege in late 1183. Saladin, ruler of Egypt and Damascus, besieged Kerak in early November 1183 after its lord, Raynald of Châtillon, conducted raids of Saladin's lands.

Saladin set out from Damascus on 22 October and besieged Kerak as it hosted the wedding of Raynald's stepson Humphrey IV of Toron and King Baldwin IV's half-sister Isabella. Raynald attempted to delay the siege by defending the walled settlement outside the fortress, but it fell quickly. Despite this success and intense bombardment, Saladin was unable to make progress, hindered by Kerak's deep moat and mountainous terrain. When ailing King Baldwin learned about the siege, he found himself obligated to settle his succession before mustering a relief force. After the coronation of his nephew, Baldwin V, he accompanied his army to Kerak but ceded command to his kinsman Count Raymond III of Tripoli. Saladin refused to engage the royal army and lifted the siege on 3 December.

Siege of Kut.headline: Obleganje Kuta
paragraphs: Obleganje Kut al Amare (7. decembra 1915 – 29. aprila 1916), znano tudi kot prva bitka pri Kutu, je bilo obleganje posadke britanske indijske vojske z 8000 vojaki v mestu Kut 160 km južno od Bagdada, ki ga je izvajala osmanska vojska. Leta 1915 je imelo mesto okoli 6500 prebivalcev. Ko se je posadka 29. aprila 1916 vdala, so preživele odgnali v ujetništvo v Alep in mnogi so med potjo umrli. Zgodovinar Christopher Catherwood je obleganje označil za »najhujši poraz zaveznikov v prvi svetovni vojni«. Deset mesecev pozneje je britanska indijska vojska, ki so jo sestavljali skoraj izključno novi naborniki iz zahodne Indije, ob padcu Bagdada osvojila Kut, Bagdad in vmesna območja.
notes: The miles conversion (100 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Siege of Kut
paragraphs: The siege of Kut Al Amara (7 December 1915 – 29 April 1916), also known as the first battle of Kut, was the besieging of an 8,000-strong British Indian Army garrison in the town of Kut, 160 km (100 mi) south of Baghdad, by the Ottoman Army. In 1915, its population was around 6,500. Following the surrender of the garrison on 29 April 1916, the survivors of the siege were marched to imprisonment at Aleppo, during which many died. Historian Christopher Catherwood has called the siege "the worst defeat of the Allies in World War I". Ten months later, the British Indian Army, consisting almost entirely of newly recruited troops from Western India, conquered Kut, Baghdad and other regions in between in the fall of Baghdad.

Obleganje Lakiša je bilo obleganje in zavzetje mesta Lakiš, ki ga je leta 701 pr. n. št. izvedlo Novoasirsko cesarstvo. Obleganje opisuje več virov, med njimi hebrejska Biblija, asirski dokumenti in lakiški relief, dobro ohranjen niz reliefov, ki je nekoč krasil palačo asirskega kralja Senaheriba v Ninivah.

source.title: Siege of Lachish
paragraphs: The siege of Lachish was the Neo-Assyrian Empire's siege and conquest of the town of Lachish in 701 BC. The siege is documented in several sources including the Hebrew Bible, Assyrian documents and in the Lachish relief, a well-preserved series of reliefs which once decorated the Assyrian king Sennacherib's palace at Nineveh.

Siege of Ma'arra.headline: Obleganje Maare
paragraphs: Obleganje Maare je med prvo križarsko vojno potekalo konec leta 1098 v mestu Maarat an Numan na ozemlju današnje Sirije. Razvpito je zaradi kanibalizma, ki so ga zagrešili križarji, morda v velikem obsegu.

source.title: Siege of Ma'arra
paragraphs: The siege of Ma'arra occurred in late 1098 in the city of Ma'arrat Nu'man, in what is modern-day Syria, during the First Crusade. It is infamous for cannibalism committed by the Crusaders, possibly on a widespread scale.

Siege of Masada.headline: Obleganje Masade
paragraphs: Rimske cesarske sile so trdnjavo Masada na vrhu hriba na ozemlju današnjega Izraela oblegale in zavzele med letoma 72 in 73 n. št., v zadnjem obdobju prve judovsko-rimske vojne. Trdnjavo so tedaj držali pripadniki uporniške skupine sikarijev. Obleganje opisuje en sam sodobni pisni vir, Judovska vojna Jožefa Flavija. Po njegovem pričevanju se je dolgo obleganje končalo z množičnim samomorom sikarijev in judovskih družin, ki so živele v trdnjavi.

V sodobnem času je zgodba o obleganju oživela kot mit o Masadi, izbirno sestavljena pripoved, ki temelji na Jožefovem poročilu. Mitska pripoved je v prvih letih izraelske državnosti postala narodni simbol.

source.title: Siege of Masada
paragraphs: The hilltop fortress of Masada, in present-day Israel, was successfully besieged and taken by Roman imperial forces between 72 and 73 AD, during the final period of the First Jewish–Roman War. At the time, the fortress was held by members of the Sicarii rebel group. The siege is recorded by a single contemporary written source, The Jewish War by Josephus. According to Josephus, the long siege ended with the mass suicide of the Sicarii and resident Jewish families.

In modern times, the story of the siege was revived as the Masada myth, a selectively constructed narrative based on Josephus's account. The mythical narrative became a national symbol in the early years of Israel's nationhood.

Siege of Mecca (683).headline: Obleganje Meke (683)
paragraphs: Obleganje Meke septembra–novembra 683 je bilo ena prvih bitk druge fitne. Meka je bila zatočišče Abdulaha ibn al Zubajra, enega najvidnejših nasprotnikov dednega nasledstva kalifata, ki ga je uveljavljal Jazid I. iz omajadske dinastije. Ko se je proti Jazidu uprla tudi bližnja Medina, drugo sveto mesto islama, je omajadski vladar poslal vojsko, da bi pokorila Hedžas. Omajadska vojska je premagala Medinčane in zavzela mesto, Meka pa je zdržala mesec dni dolgo obleganje, med katerim je Kabo poškodoval ogenj. Obleganje se je končalo, ko je prišla novica o Jazidovi nenadni smrti. Omajadski poveljnik Husajn ibn Numajr al Sakuni je skušal Ibn al Zubajra pregovoriti, naj se z njim vrne v Sirijo in tam sprejme priznanje za kalifa, ko pa mu to ni uspelo, se je s svojimi silami umaknil. Ibn al Zubajr je ves čas državljanske vojne ostal v Meki, a so ga kmalu priznali za kalifa v večini muslimanskega sveta. Šele leta 692 so Omajadi lahko poslali novo vojsko, ki je Meko znova oblegala in zavzela ter s tem končala državljansko vojno.

source.title: Siege of Mecca (683)
paragraphs: The siege of Mecca in September–November 683 was one of the early battles of the Second Fitna. The city of Mecca was a sanctuary for Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, who was among the most prominent challengers to the hereditary succession to the Caliphate by Yazid I of the Umayyad dynasty. After nearby Medina, the other holy city of Islam, also rebelled against Yazid, the Umayyad ruler sent an army to subdue the Hejaz. The Umayyad army defeated the Medinans and took the city, but Mecca held out in a month-long siege, during which the Kaaba was damaged by fire. The siege ended when news came of Yazid's sudden death. The Umayyad commander, Husayn ibn Numayr al-Sakuni, after failing to induce Ibn al-Zubayr to return with him to Syria and be recognized as Caliph, departed with his forces. Ibn al-Zubayr remained in Mecca throughout the civil war, but he was nevertheless soon acknowledged as Caliph across most of the Muslim world. It was not until 692 that the Umayyads were able to send another army, which again besieged and captured Mecca, ending the civil war.

Siege of Mecca (692).headline: Obleganje Meke (692)
paragraphs: Obleganje Meke od marca do oktobra ali novembra 692 je bila zadnja bitka druge fitne, v kateri so sile omajadskega kalifa Abd al Malika ibn Marvana oblegale in premagale njegovega tekmeca, kalifa Abdulaha ibn al Zubajra, v središču njegove moči, islamskem svetem mestu Meki. Po smrti kalifa Jazida I. leta 683 so Ibn al Zubajra priznali za kalifa v večini provinc kalifata, Omajadi, ki so kalifatu vladali od konca prve fitne, pa so se morali omejiti na svoje oporišče v Siriji.

source.title: Siege of Mecca (692)
paragraphs: The siege of Mecca in March–October/November 692 was the final battle of the of the Second Fitna, in which the forces of the Umayyad caliph Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan besieged and defeated his rival, the caliph Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr in his center of power, the Islamic holy city of Mecca. Following the death of Caliph Yazid I in 683, Ibn al-Zubayr had been recognized as caliph in most of the provinces of the Caliphate, while the Umayyads, who had ruled the Caliphate since the end of the First Fitna, were confined to their stronghold of Syria.

Siege of Medina.headline: Obleganje Medine
paragraphs: Obleganje Medine je trajalo od 10. junija 1916 do 10. januarja 1919, ko so arabski uporniki iz Hedžasa obkolili islamsko sveto mesto, ki je bilo tedaj pod oblastjo Osmanskega cesarstva.

Osmansko cesarstvo je pod vodstvom sultana Mehmeda V. vstopilo v vojno na strani centralnih sil. Da bi Osmane oslabili, so zavezniki v cesarstvu spodbudili arabski upor, ki ga je vodil mekanski šerif Husein bin Ali.

Šerif Husein je ob podpori britanskih in francoskih agentov zasedel Meko in nato oblegal Medino. Drugo najsvetejše mesto islama je tedaj branil osmanski bataljon pod poveljstvom Fahreddina paše, ki je vztrajal dve leti in sedem mesecev; njegova trdovratna obramba je trajala še potem, ko se je vojna že končala.

source.title: Siege of Medina
paragraphs: The siege of Medina lasted from 10 June 1916 to 10 January 1919, when Hejazi Arab rebels surrounded the Islamic holy city, which was then under the control of the Ottoman Empire.

The Ottoman Empire joined the war on the side of the Central Powers under the leadership of the Ottoman Sultan, Mehmed V. In an attempt to weaken the Ottomans, the Allies provoked an Arab Revolt within the empire led by Sharif Hussein bin Ali of Mecca.

Sharif Hussein, supported by British and French agents, occupied Mecca and later besieged Medina. The second holiest city in Islam was then guarded by an Ottoman battalion led by Fahreddin Pasha, who resisted for two years and seven months, a persistent defense that lasted even after the war had ended.

Siege of Shaizar (1138).headline: Obleganje Šajzarja (1138)
paragraphs: Mesto Šajzar so oblegali od 28. aprila do 21. maja 1138. Zavezniške sile Bizantinskega cesarstva, Antiohijske kneževine in Edeške grofije so vdrle v muslimansko Sirijo. Ko so jih odbili od glavnega cilja, mesta Alep, so združene krščanske vojske z naskokom zavzele več utrjenih naselij in nazadnje oblegale Šajzar, prestolnico emirata Munkiditov. Mesto so zavzeli, citadele pa ne; šajzarski emir je moral plačati odškodnino in postal vazal bizantinskega cesarja. Sile Zengija, najmočnejšega muslimanskega kneza v regiji, so se z zavezniško vojsko spopadale v praskah, a je bila ta premočna, da bi tvegale bitko. Pohod je pokazal, kako omejena je bila bizantinska nadoblast nad severnimi križarskimi državami in kako malo skupnih ciljev so imeli latinski knezi in bizantinski cesar.

source.title: Siege of Shaizar (1138)
paragraphs: The city of Shaizar was besieged from April 28 to May 21, 1138. The allied forces of the Byzantine Empire, Principality of Antioch and County of Edessa invaded Muslim Syria. Having been repulsed from their main objective, the city of Aleppo, the combined Christian armies took a number of fortified settlements by assault and finally besieged Shaizar, the capital of the Munqidhite Emirate. The siege captured the city, but failed to take the citadel; it resulted in the Emir of Shaizar paying an indemnity and becoming the vassal of the Byzantine Emperor. The forces of Zengi, the greatest Muslim prince of the region, skirmished with the allied army, but it was too strong for them to risk battle. The campaign underlined the limited nature of Byzantine suzerainty over the northern Crusader states and the lack of common purpose between the Latin princes and the Byzantine Emperor.

Siege of Sidon.headline: Obleganje Sidona
paragraphs: Obleganje Sidona je potekalo leta 1110, po prvi križarski vojni. Obalno mesto Sidon so zavzele sile jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina I. in norveškega kralja Sigurda I. s pomočjo beneškega doža Ordelafa Faliera.

source.title: Siege of Sidon
paragraphs: The siege of Sidon occurred in 1110 in the aftermath of the First Crusade. The coastal city of Sidon was captured by the forces of Baldwin I of Jerusalem and Sigurd I of Norway, with assistance from the Ordelafo Faliero, Doge of Venice.

Obleganje Taifa je potekalo leta 630 n. št., kmalu po muslimanski zmagi v bitkah pri Hunajnu in Avtasu, ki sta sledili osvojitvi Meke. Mohamed je hotel utrditi nadzor nad Hedžasom, zato se je s svojimi silami odpravil nad utrjeno mesto Taif, oporišče plemena Sakif in dolgoletnega trgovskega tekmeca Meke. Tja se je po porazu pri Hunajnu zateklo veliko preživelih havazinskih bojevnikov z družinami, zato je bil Taif naslednji cilj muslimanskega pohoda. Mesto pa je bilo močno utrjeno, obdano z mogočnim obzidjem in dobro založeno z živili, zato je bilo veliko težji izziv kot spopadi na odprtem polju pri Hunajnu in Avtasu.

source.title: Siege of Ta'if
paragraphs: The Siege of Ta'if took place in 630 CE, shortly after the Muslim victory at the battles of Hunayn and Autas that followed the conquest of Mecca. Seeking to consolidate control over the Hijaz, Muhammad marched with his forces to the fortified city of Ta'if, stronghold of the Thaqif tribe and a long-standing commercial rival of Mecca. Many of the surviving Hawazin warriors and their families had taken refuge there after their defeat at Hunayn, making Ta'if the next target of the Muslim campaign. The city, however, was heavily fortified, surrounded by strong walls and well supplied with provisions, and thus presented a far more difficult challenge than the open-field encounters at Hunayn and Autas.

Siege of Tripoli.headline: Obleganje Tripolija
paragraphs: Obleganje Tripolija je trajalo od leta 1102 do 12. julija 1109. Potekalo je na kraju današnjega libanonskega mesta Tripoli, po prvi križarski vojni, in pripeljalo do ustanovitve četrte križarske države, Tripolitanske grofije.

source.title: Siege of Tripoli
paragraphs: The siege of Tripoli lasted from 1102 until 12 July 1109. It took place on the site of the present day Lebanese city of Tripoli, in the aftermath of the First Crusade. It led to the establishment of the fourth Crusader state, the County of Tripoli.

Siege of Tyre (1187).headline: Obleganje Tira (1187)
paragraphs: Obleganje Tira je potekalo od 12. novembra 1187 do 1. januarja 1188. Ajubidska vojska pod Saladinovim poveljstvom je s kopnega in morja napadla mesto, ki ga je branil Konrad Montferraški. Po dveh mesecih nenehnih bojev je Saladin vojsko razpustil in se umaknil v Akro.

source.title: Siege of Tyre (1187)
paragraphs: The siege of Tyre took place from 12 November 1187 to 1 January 1188. An Ayyubid army commanded by Saladin made an amphibious assault on the city, defended by Conrad of Montferrat. After two months of continuous struggle, Saladin dismissed his army and retreated to Acre.

Siege of Tyre (332 BC).headline: Obleganje Tira (332 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Obleganje Tira je izvedel Aleksander Veliki leta 332 pr. n. št. med pohodi proti Perzijcem. Makedonska vojska mesta Tir, strateškega obalnega oporišča ob Sredozemskem morju, sprva ni mogla zavzeti na običajen način, saj je stalo na otoku 1 kilometer od obale današnjega Libanona (tedaj Fenicije) in je imelo obzidje vse do morja. Aleksander je Tir najprej sedem mesecev blokiral in oblegal ter gradil nasip. Ko so vojaki ugotovili, da ga zaradi strmega padca morskega dna ne morejo več podaljšati, je ukazal, naj na konec nasipa pripeljejo oblegovalne stolpe s katapulti na vrhu. Tako mu je uspelo prebiti utrdbe.

source.title: Siege of Tyre (332 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Tyre was carried out by Alexander the Great in 332 BC during his campaigns against the Persians. At first, the Macedonian army was unable to capture the city of Tyre, which was a strategic coastal base on the Mediterranean Sea, through conventional means because it was on an island that was 1 kilometer off the coast of modern-day Lebanon (at the time Phoenicia) and had walls right up to the sea. Alexander responded by first blockading and besieging Tyre for seven months and building a causeway. When his soldiers discovered that they could not extend it any further due to a steep drop under the surface of the water, he ordered siege towers with catapults at the top to be moved to the end. This allowed him to breach the fortifications.

Siege of Yodfat.headline: Obleganje Jodfata
paragraphs: Obleganje Jodfata (hebrejsko: יוֹדְפַת, tudi Jotapata, Iotapata, Yodefat) je bilo 47-dnevno obleganje judovskega mesta Jodfat, ki so ga rimske sile izvedle leta 67 n. št. med veliko judovsko vstajo. Vodila sta ga rimski vojskovodja Vespazijan in njegov sin Tit, oba poznejša cesarja, končalo pa se je z izropanjem mesta, smrtjo večine prebivalcev in zasužnjenjem preostalih. To je bila druga najbolj krvava bitka vstaje, takoj za obleganjem Jeruzalema, za Jeruzalemom in Masado pa tudi najdaljša. Obleganje je opisal Jožef Flavij, ki je v Jodfatu osebno poveljeval judovskim silam in so ga nato Rimljani ujeli.

source.title: Siege of Yodfat
paragraphs: The siege of Yodfat (Hebrew: יוֹדְפַת, also Jotapata, Iotapata, Yodefat) was a 47-day siege by Roman forces of the Jewish town of Yodfat which took place in 67 CE, during the Great Revolt. Led by Roman General Vespasian and his son Titus, both future emperors, the siege ended with the sacking of the town, the deaths of most of its inhabitants and the enslavement of the rest. It was the second bloodiest battle of the revolt, surpassed only by the Siege of Jerusalem, and the longest except for Jerusalem and Masada. The siege was chronicled by Josephus, who had personally commanded the Jewish forces at Yodfat and was subsequently captured by the Romans.

Južnolibanonski konflikt je bil oborožen spopad, ki je od leta 1982 ali 1985 do izraelskega umika leta 2000 potekal v južnem Libanonu pod izraelsko zasedbo. Hezbolah se je skupaj z drugimi šiitskimi muslimanskimi in levičarskimi gverilci bojeval proti Izraelu in njegovi zaveznici, Južnolibanonski vojski (SLA), v kateri so prevladovali katoliški kristjani. SLA so vojaško in logistično podpirale Izraelske obrambne sile (IDF), delovala pa je pod okriljem začasne uprave Južnega Libanona, ki jo je podpiral Izrael in je nasledila prav tako od Izraela podprto Državo svobodnega Libanona. Izrael spopad uradno imenuje kampanja v varnostnem pasu v Libanonu in šteje, da se je začel 30. septembra 1982, po koncu njegove »operacije Mir za Galilejo«. Lahko ga razumemo tudi kot nadaljevanje libanonske državljanske vojne (1975–1990).

source.title: South Lebanon conflict (1985–2000)
paragraphs: The South Lebanon conflict was an armed conflict that took place in Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon from 1982 or 1985 until Israel's withdrawal in 2000. Hezbollah, along with other Shia Muslim and left-wing guerrillas, fought against Israel and its ally, the Catholic Christian-dominated South Lebanon Army (SLA). The SLA was supported militarily and logistically by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and operated under the jurisdiction of the Israeli-backed South Lebanon provisional administration, which succeeded the earlier Israeli-backed Free Lebanon State. Israel officially names the conflict the Security Zone in Lebanon Campaign and deems it to have begun on 30 September 1982, after the end of its "Operation Peace for Galilee". It can also be seen as an extension of the Lebanese Civil War (1975–1990).

Južni Jemen, uradno Ljudska demokratična republika Jemen (LDRJ), skrajšano Demokratični Jemen, je bila država v južni Arabiji, ki je na območju današnjega jugovzhodnega Jemna obstajala od leta 1967 do združitve z Jemensko arabsko republiko leta 1990. Bila je edina komunistična država na Bližnjem vzhodu in v arabskem svetu in je obsegala južne in vzhodne guvernorate današnje Republike Jemen, vključno z otoki Perim in Kamaran ter otočjem Sokotra. Z Jemensko arabsko republiko na severozahodu, Savdsko Arabijo na severu in Omanom na vzhodu je imela slabo določene in pogosto sporne meje. Prestolnica in največje mesto je bil Aden.

source.title: South Yemen
paragraphs: South Yemen, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Yemen (PDRY), abbreviated to Democratic Yemen, was a country in South Arabia that existed in what is now southeast Yemen from 1967 until its unification with the Yemen Arab Republic in 1990. The sole communist state in the Middle East and the Arab world, it comprised the southern and eastern governorates of the present-day Republic of Yemen, including the islands of Perim, Kamaran, and the Socotra Archipelago. It shared ill-defined and often disputed borders with the Yemen Arab Republic to the northwest, Saudi Arabia to the north, Oman to the east. Its capital and largest city was Aden.

South Yemen insurgency.headline: Upor v Južnem Jemnu
paragraphs: Upor v Južnem Jemnu je vrsta protestov in napadov na vladne sile na jugu Jemna, ki trajajo od 27. aprila 2009. Upor poteka hkrati s šiitskim uporom na severu države, ki ga vodijo hutijske skupnosti. Južni voditelji so leta 1994, po združitvi, izvedli kratko in neuspešno odcepitev, mnogi med njimi pa sodelujejo tudi v sedanjem odcepitvenem gibanju. Južni separatistični uporniki delujejo predvsem na območju nekdanjega Južnega Jemna, pa tudi v guvernoratu Dale, ki ni bil del samostojne južne države.

source.title: South Yemen insurgency
paragraphs: The South Yemen insurgency is a series of protests and attacks on government forces in southern Yemen since 27 April 2009. The insurgency comes amid the Shia insurgency in the country's north as led by the Houthi communities. Southern leaders led a brief, unsuccessful secession in 1994 following unification. Many of them are involved in the present secession movement. Southern separatist insurgents are active mainly in the area of former South Yemen, and also in Dhale Governorate which was not a part of the independent southern state.

Sulayhid dynasty.headline: Sulajhidi
paragraphs: Sulajhidi (arabsko: Banū Ṣulayḥ, dobesedno »Sulajhovi otroci«) so bili ismailitska šiitska arabska dinastija, ki jo je leta 1047 ustanovil Ali ibn Mohamed al Sulajhi in je na vrhuncu vladala večjemu delu zgodovinskega Jemna. Jemnu so prinesli mir in blaginjo, kakršne ni poznal od himjaritskih časov. Bili so zavezniki Fatimidskega kalifata s sedežem v Kairu in ves čas nasprotniki Rasidov, zajdijskih šiitskih vladarjev Jemna. Dinastija se je končala, ko se je Arva al Sulajhi pridružila tajjibitski veji ismailitov, za razliko od hafizitske veje, ki so se je držale druge ismailitske dinastije, kot so Zurajidi in Hamdanidi.

source.title: Sulayhid dynasty
paragraphs: The Sulayhid dynasty (Arabic: بَنُو صُلَيْح, romanized: Banū Ṣulayḥ, lit. 'Children of Sulayh') was an Ismaili Shi'ite Arab dynasty established in 1047 by Ali ibn Muhammad al-Sulayhi that ruled most of historical Yemen at its peak. The Sulayhids brought to Yemen peace and a prosperity unknown since Himyaritic times. The regime was confederate with the Cairo-based Fatimid Caliphate, and was a constant enemy of the Rassids - the Zaidi Shi'ite rulers of Yemen throughout its existence. The dynasty ended with Arwa al-Sulayhi affiliating to the Taiyabi Ismaili sect, as opposed to the Hafizi Ismaili sect that the other Ismaili dynasties such as the Zurayids and the Hamdanids adhered to.

Syrian revolution.headline: Sirska revolucija
paragraphs: Sirska revolucija je bila vrsta množičnih protestov in civilnih vstaj po vsej Siriji – na katere se je baatistični režim odzval z nasiljem –, ki je v okviru širše arabske pomladi v arabskem svetu trajala od leta 2011 do 2024. Revolucija, ki je zahtevala konec desetletja dolge vladavine družine Asad, se je začela z manjšimi demonstracijami januarja 2011 in marca prerasla v velike vsedržavne proteste. Zaznamovali so jo množični protesti proti baatistični diktaturi predsednika Bašarja al Asada, na katere so policija in vojska odgovorile z nasiljem, množičnimi aretacijami in surovim zatiranjem; umrlo je več sto tisoč ljudi, ranjenih pa je bilo več deset tisoč. Asadov režim je leta 2024, 13 let po začetku revolucije, po vrsti uporniških ofenziv padel.

source.title: Syrian revolution
paragraphs: The Syrian revolution was a series of mass protests and civilian uprisings throughout Syria – with a subsequent violent reaction by the Ba'athist regime – lasting from 2011 to 2024 as part of the greater Arab Spring in the Arab world. The revolution, which demanded the end of the decades-long Assad family rule, began as minor demonstrations during January 2011 and transformed into large nationwide protests in March. The uprising was marked by mass protests against the Ba'athist dictatorship of president Bashar al-Assad meeting police and military violence, massive arrests and a brutal crackdown, resulting in hundreds of thousands of deaths and tens of thousands wounded. 13 years after the start of the revolution, the Assad regime fell in 2024 after a series of rebel offensives.

Syro-Ephraimite War.headline: Sirsko-efraimska vojna
paragraphs: Sirsko-efraimska vojna je bil spopad, ki je v 8. stoletju pr. n. št. potekal med Judejskim kraljestvom ter zavezništvom Aram-Damaska in Izraelskega kraljestva s središčem v Samariji. Po eni od teorij je bil edini cilj vojne prisiliti Judejo, da se pridruži protiasirski koaliciji. Leta 735 pr. n. št. sta kralja Recin iz Aram-Damaska in Pekah iz Izraela z vdorom skušala odstaviti judejskega kralja Ahaza. Judeja je bila poražena in je po 2 Krn 28 v enem samem dnevu izgubila 120.000 vojakov. Padlo je veliko visokih dostojanstvenikov, med njimi kraljev sin Maaseja, mnoge druge pa so odpeljali v suženjstvo. Ista vojna je opisana v 2 Kr 16,5, kjer piše, da sta Recin in Pekah oblegala Jeruzalem, a ga nista zavzela. Med vdorom so razmere izkoristili Filistejci in Edomci, ki so ropali judejska mesta in vasi. Ahaz je zato za pomoč prosil asirskega kralja Tiglat-Pileserja III.

source.title: Syro-Ephraimite War
paragraphs: The Syro-Ephraimite War was a conflict which took place in the 8th century BCE between the Kingdom of Judah and an alliance of Aram-Damascus and the Kingdom of Israel based in Samaria. One theory states that the war's sole goal was to force Judah to join the anti-Assyrian coalition. In 735 BCE, kings Rezin of Aram-Damascus and Pekah of Israel, attempted to depose king Ahaz of Judah through an invasion. Judah was defeated and, according to 2 Chronicles 28, lost 120,000 troops in just one day. Many significant officials were killed, including the king's son Maaseiah. Many others were taken away as slaves. Telling of the same war, 2 Kings 16:5 states that Rezin and Pekah besieged Jerusalem but failed to capture it. During the invasion the Philistines and Edomites took advantage of the situation, raiding towns and villages in Judah. In turn, Ahaz asked Tiglath-Pileser III of Assyria for help.

Tabal (state).headline: Tabal
paragraphs: Tabal (novoasirsko akadsko: 𒆳𒋫𒁄 in 𒌷𒋫𒁄), pozneje preoblikovan v Bīt-Burutaš (novoasirsko akadsko: 𒆳𒂍𒁹𒁍𒊒𒋫𒀾) ali Bīt-Paruta (novoasirsko akadsko: 𒂍𒁹𒉺𒊒𒋫), je bil novohetitska država z luvijskim jezikom, ki je v železni dobi obstajala na jugovzhodu Anatolije.

source.title: Tabal (state)
paragraphs: Tabal (Neo-Assyrian Akkadian: 𒆳𒋫𒁄 and 𒌷𒋫𒁄), later reorganised into Bīt-Burutaš (Neo-Assyrian Akkadian: 𒆳𒂍𒁹𒁍𒊒𒋫𒀾) or Bīt-Paruta (Neo-Assyrian Akkadian: 𒂍𒁹𒉺𒊒𒋫), was a Luwian-speaking Neo-Hittite state which existed in southeastern Anatolia in the Iron Age.

Taifa of Ceuta.headline: Taifa Ceuta
paragraphs: Taifa Ceuta (arabsko: طائفة سبتة) je bila ena od taif, držav, ki so nastale po razpadu Kordovskega kalifata v začetku 11. stoletja. Mesti Ceuta (arabsko Sabta) in Tanger sta od leta 1026 spadali v taifo Malaga dinastije Hamudidov. Od leta 1036 (427 po hidžri) so jima v imenu Hamudidov vladali Bargavati, berbersko pleme z neislamsko vero. Malo pred letom 1061 (453 po hidžri) so Bargavati pod vodstvom nepismenega Sakuta prevzeli oblast od Hamudidov. Lahko so zbrali veliko vojsko z 12.000 konjeniki, a jih je v letih 1078–1079 premagala in podjarmila vzpenjajoča se sila Almoravidov.

source.title: Taifa of Ceuta
paragraphs: The Taifa of Ceuta (Arabic: طائفة سبتة) was one of the taifa states formed after the breakup of the Caliphate of Córdoba in the early 11th century. The cities of Ceuta (Arabic: Sabta) and Tangiers were a part of the Ḥammūdid dynasty taifa of Málaga from 1026. From 1036 (427 AH) it was governed on behalf of the Ḥammūdids by the Barghawāṭa, a Berber tribe with a non-Islamic religion. Shortly before 1061 (453 AH), the Barghawāṭa, led by the illiterate Saqqūt, took power from the Ḥammūdids. They could field a large army of 12,000 cavalry, but were defeated and conquered by the rising power of the Almoravids in 1078–79.

Tangier International Zone.headline: Mednarodna cona Tanger
paragraphs: Mednarodna cona Tanger (arabsko: منطقة طنجة الدولية, Minṭaqat Ṭanja ad-Duwaliyya; francosko: Zone internationale de Tanger; špansko: Zona Internacional de Tánger) je bila 382 km² velika mednarodna cona s središčem v mestu Tanger v Maroku, ki je obstajala od leta 1925 do ponovne vključitve v neodvisni Maroko leta 1956, s prekinitvijo med špansko zasedbo Tangerja (1940–1945), poseben gospodarski status pa je ohranila do začetka leta 1960. S kopnega jo je obdajal španski protektorat v Maroku, upravljali pa so jo po edinstvenem in zapletenem sistemu, v katerega so bile vključene različne evropske države, Združene države Amerike (predvsem po letu 1945) in maroški sultan, ki je bil sam pod francoskim protektoratom. Zaradi statusa mednarodne cone je imel Tanger ključno vlogo za maroške nacionaliste, ki so si prizadevali za neodvisnost: tu so navezovali mednarodne stike, pridobivali zaveznike ter prirejali srečanja in dogodke.
notes: The square-mile conversion (147 sq mi) is dropped.

source.title: Tangier International Zone
paragraphs: The Tangier International Zone (Arabic: منطقة طنجة الدولية, romanized: Minṭaqat Ṭanja ad-Duwaliyya; French: Zone internationale de Tanger; Spanish: Zona Internacional de Tánger) was a 382 km2 (147 sq mi) international zone centered on the city of Tangier, Morocco, which existed from 1925 until its reintegration into independent Morocco in 1956, with interruption during the Spanish occupation of Tangier (1940–1945), and special economic status extended until early 1960. Surrounded on the land side by the Spanish protectorate in Morocco, it was governed under a unique and complex system that involved several European nations, the United States (mainly after 1945), and the Sultan of Morocco, himself under a French protectorate. Due to its status as an international zone, Tangier played a crucial role for Moroccan nationalists, who wanted independence, to establish international contacts and recruit allies as well as organising gatherings and events.

Tretja bitka za Faludžo, ki jo je iraška vlada poimenovala operacija Zlom terorizma (arabsko: عملية كسر الإرهاب), je bila vojaška operacija proti ISIL, s katero so hoteli zavzeti mesto Faludža in njegova predmestja približno 69 kilometrov zahodno od iraške prestolnice Bagdad. Operacija se je začela 22. maja 2016, tri mesece potem, ko so iraške sile popolnoma obkolile Faludžo. Iraške sile so mesto Faludža znova zavzele 26. junija, dva dni pozneje pa še zadnji žep odpora ISIL na zahodnem obrobju mesta.
notes: The miles conversion (43 mi) is dropped.
The glossary named this record Četrta bitka za Faludžo; it is corrected to Tretja bitka za Faludžo, as in the English source and the text.

source.title: Third Battle of Fallujah
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Fallujah, code-named Operation Breaking Terrorism (Arabic: عملية كسر الإرهاب) by the Iraqi government, was a military operation against ISIL launched to capture the city of Fallujah and its suburbs, located about 69 kilometres (43 mi) west of Baghdad, the capital of Iraq. The operation began on 22 May 2016, three months after the Iraqi forces had started the total siege of Fallujah. On 26 June, Iraqi forces recaptured the city of Fallujah, before recapturing the remaining pocket of ISIL resistance in Fallujah's western outskirts two days later.

Third Battle of Gaza.headline: Tretja bitka za Gazo
paragraphs: Tretja bitka za Gazo je potekala v noči s 1. na 2. november 1917 med britanskimi in osmanskimi silami v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji prve svetovne vojne, potem ko je zmaga britanskih egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) v bitki pri Beršebi končala zastoj v južni Palestini. Boji so potekali na začetku ofenzive v južni Palestini in so skupaj z napadi na Hareiro in Šerijo 6. in 7. novembra ter z bitko pri Tel el Huvejlfi, ki jo je general Edmund Allenby sprožil 1. novembra, nazadnje prebili črto od Gaze do Beršebe, ki jo je branila armadna skupina Jildirim. Osmanska vojska je to črto držala od marca 1917, a je morala Gazo in Tel el Huvejlfe v noči s 6. na 7. november izprazniti. Le Šerija se je držala večino 7. novembra, nato pa so zavzeli tudi njo.

source.title: Third Battle of Gaza
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Gaza was fought on the night of 1–2 November 1917 between British and Ottoman forces during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I and came after the British Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory at the Battle of Beersheba had ended the Stalemate in Southern Palestine. The fighting occurred at the beginning of the Southern Palestine Offensive, and, together with attacks on Hareira and Sheria on 6–7 November and the continuing Battle of Tel el Khuweilfe, which had been launched by General Edmund Allenby on 1 November, it eventually broke the Gaza-to-Beersheba line defended by the Yildirim Army Group. Despite having held this line since March 1917, the Ottoman Army was forced to evacuate Gaza and Tel el Khuweilfe during the night of 6–7 November. Only Sheria held out for most of 7 November before it too was captured.

Third Intermediate Period of Egypt.headline: Tretje vmesno obdobje starega Egipta
paragraphs: Tretje vmesno obdobje starega Egipta se je začelo s smrtjo faraona Ramzesa XI. leta 1077 pr. n. št., ki je končala Novo kraljestvo, nazadnje pa mu je sledilo pozno obdobje. Za začetek poznega obdobja navajajo različne mejnike, najpogosteje pa ga štejejo od leta 664 pr. n. št., ko je Psametik I. ustanovil 26. dinastijo, potem ko so Asirci pod kraljem Asurbanipalom pregnali nubijske kušitske vladarje 25. dinastije. Izraz »tretje vmesno obdobje«, ki se zgleduje po dobro znanih prvem in drugem vmesnem obdobju, je bil razširjen že leta 1978, ko ga je britanski egiptolog Kenneth Kitchen uporabil v naslovu svoje knjige o tem obdobju. Kitchen je sicer trdil, da obdobje »še zdaleč ni bilo kaotično«, in upal, da bo njegovo delo pripomoglo k opustitvi izraza, sam pa je imel raje izraz »poimperialna doba«; z uporabo izraza v naslovu ga je očitno le še utrdil.

source.title: Third Intermediate Period of Egypt
paragraphs: The Third Intermediate Period of ancient Egypt began with the death of Pharaoh Ramesses XI in 1077 BC, which ended the New Kingdom, and was eventually followed by the Late Period. Various points are offered as the beginning for the latter era, though it is most often regarded as dating from the foundation of the Twenty-Sixth Dynasty by Psamtik I in 664 BC, following the departure of the Nubian Kushite rulers of the Twenty-fifth Dynasty after they were driven out by the Assyrians under King Ashurbanipal. The use of the term "Third Intermediate Period", based on the analogy of the well-known First and Second Intermediate Periods, was popular by 1978, when British Egyptologist Kenneth Kitchen used the term for the title of his book on the period. While Kitchen argued that the period was 'far from being chaotic' and hoped that his work would lead to the abolishment of the term, with his own preference being the 'Post-Imperial epoch', his use of the term as a title seems only to have entrenched its use.

Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt.headline: Trideseta egipčanska dinastija
paragraphs: Trideseta egipčanska dinastija (zapisano tudi XXX. dinastija ali 30. dinastija) velja običajno za peto dinastijo poznega obdobja starega Egipta. Ustanovil jo je Nektanebo I., potem ko je leta 380 pr. n. št. strmoglavil Neferita II., prenehala pa je obstajati, ko je ahemenidski kralj Artakserks III. leta 343 pr. n. št. vdrl v Egipt. Bila je zadnja domača dinastija starega Egipta.

source.title: Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt
paragraphs: The Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt (notated Dynasty XXX, alternatively 30th Dynasty or Dynasty 30) is usually classified as the fifth Dynasty of the Late Period of ancient Egypt. It was founded after the overthrow of Nepherites II in 380 BC by Nectanebo I, and was disestablished upon the invasion of Egypt by the Achaemenid king Artaxerxes III in 343 BC. This is the final native dynasty of ancient Egypt.

Tobacco Protest.headline: Tobačni protest
paragraphs: Perzijski tobačni protest (perzijsko: نهضت تنباکو, nehzat-e tanbāku) je bil upor dvanajstniških šiitskih muslimanov v kadžarskem Iranu proti tobačni koncesiji iz leta 1890, s katero je Naser al Din šah Kadžar Britanskemu imperiju podelil nadzor nad gojenjem, prodajo in izvozom tobaka, prepustil pa ga je Angležu, majorju G. F. Talbotu. Protestirali so trgovci v velikih mestih, kot so Teheran, Širaz, Mašhad in Isfahan, v solidarnosti z duhovščino. Vrhunec je dosegel decembra 1891 s fatvo proti uživanju tobaka, ki jo je izdal veliki ajatola Mirza Širazi in so se je ljudje množično držali.

source.title: Tobacco Protest
paragraphs: The Persian Tobacco Protest (Persian: نهضت تنباکو, romanized: nehzat-e tanbāku) was a Twelver Shia Muslim revolt in Qajar Iran against an 1890 tobacco concession granted by Naser al-Din Shah Qajar to the British Empire, granting control over growth, sale, and export of tobacco to an Englishman, Major G. F. Talbot. The protest was held by merchants in major cities such as Tehran, Shiraz, Mashhad, and Isfahan in solidarity with the clerical establishment. It climaxed in a widely obeyed December 1891 fatwa against tobacco use issued by Grand Ayatollah Mirza Shirazi.

Treaty of Darin.headline: Pogodba iz Darina
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Darina ali Darinski pakt so leta 1915 sklenili Združeno kraljestvo in Abdulaziz Al Saud (včasih imenovan Ibn Saud), vladar emirata Nedžd in Hasa, ki je leta 1932 ustanovil Kraljevino Savdsko Arabijo.

source.title: Treaty of Darin
paragraphs: The Treaty of Darin, or the Darin Pact, of 1915 was made between the United Kingdom and Abdulaziz Al Saud (sometimes called Ibn Saud), ruler of the Emirate of Nejd and Hasa, who founded the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932.

Treaty of Hamedan.headline: Pogodba iz Hamadana
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Hamadana je bila pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in dinastijo Hotakijev, podpisana oktobra 1727 v Hamadanu, s katero se je končala osmansko-hotaška vojna (1726–1727).

source.title: Treaty of Hamedan
paragraphs: The Treaty of Hamedan was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and the Hotak dynasty signed in October 1727 in Hamedan, ending the Ottoman–Hotaki War (1726–1727).

Treaty of Jaffa (1192).headline: Pogodba iz Jafe (1192)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Jafe, redkeje imenovana tudi pogodba iz Ramle ali pogodba iz leta 1192, je bilo premirje, sklenjeno med križarskimi vojnami. Podpisala sta jo 1. ali 2. septembra 1192 n. št. (20. šabana 588 po hidžri) egiptovski sultan Saladin in angleški kralj Rihard Levjesrčni, kmalu po bitki pri Jafi julija in avgusta 1192. Pogodba, o kateri so se pogajali s pomočjo Baliana Ibelinskega, je obema vojskama zagotovila triletno premirje in končala tretjo križarsko vojno.

source.title: Treaty of Jaffa (1192)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Jaffa, less commonly referred to as the Treaty of Ramla or the treaty of 1192, was a truce agreed to during the Crusades. It was signed on 1 or 2 September 1192 A.D. (20th of Sha'ban 588 AH) between Saladin, Sultan of Egypt and Richard the Lionheart, King of England, shortly after the July–August 1192 Battle of Jaffa. The treaty, negotiated with the help of Balian of Ibelin, guaranteed a three-year truce between the two armies. This treaty ended the Third Crusade.

Treaty of Jaffa (1229).headline: Pogodba iz Jafe (1229)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Jafe, včasih imenovana pogodba iz Jafe in Tal al Adžula, je bil sporazum, ki sta ga 18. februarja 1229 podpisala Friderik II., cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva in sicilski kralj, ter Al Kamil, ajubidski sultan Egipta. Končala je šesto križarsko vojno, ki jo je vodil Friderik, saj je Jeruzalem in nekaj drugih ozemelj vrnila Jeruzalemskemu kraljestvu, ki mu je tedaj vladal Friderikov sin Konrad, še otrok.

Pogajanja so trajala od septembra 1228 do februarja 1229. Vladarja se nista srečala osebno, temveč sta si izmenjevala odposlance v svojih taborih, sprva v Akri za Friderika in Nablusu za Al Kamila, pozneje v Jafi in Tal al Adžulu. Pogajanja so večinoma potekala na skrivaj, da bi se izognili slabemu odmevu v javnosti, spremljali pa so jih izmenjava daril, zabava in učene razprave. Al Kamil se je hkrati z bratom Al Ašrafom pogajal o novi razdelitvi ajubidskih dežel v Aziji.

source.title: Treaty of Jaffa (1229)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Jaffa, sometimes the Treaty of Jaffa and Tall al-ʿAjūl, was an agreement signed on 18 February 1229 between Frederick II, Holy Roman emperor and king of Sicily, and al-Kāmil, Ayyubid sultan of Egypt. It brought an end to the Sixth Crusade, led by Frederick, by restoring the city of Jerusalem and a few other territories to the Kingdom of Jerusalem, whose king at the time was Frederick's infant son Conrad.

Negotiations lasted from September 1228 to February 1229. The two sovereigns did not meet in person, but exchanged envoys in their respective camps, at first Acre for Frederick and Nablus for al-Kāmil, later Jaffa and Tall al-ʿAjūl. The negotiations were conducted mostly in secret to avoid bad publicity. They were accompanied by the exchange of gifts, entertainment and scholarship. Simultaneously, al-Kāmil negotiated with his brother al-Ashraf for a redistribution of Ayyubid lands in Asia.

Treaty of Jeddah (1927).headline: Pogodba iz Džede (1927)
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Džede iz leta 1927, uradno Pogodbo med njegovim veličanstvom in njegovim veličanstvom kraljem Hedžasa in Nedžda ter pripadajočih ozemelj, sta podpisala Združeno kraljestvo in Ibn Saud.

V imenu Združenega kraljestva jo je 20. maja 1927 podpisal sir Gilbert Clayton, v imenu Kraljevine Hedžas in Nedžd pa princ Fajsal bin Abdulaziz. Pogodba je priznala neodvisnost Ibn Sauda in njegovo suverenost nad tedanjo Kraljevino Hedžas in Nedžd. Pokrajini sta se leta 1932 združili v Kraljevino Savdsko Arabijo. Ibn Saud se je v zameno zavezal, da njegove sile ne bodo več napadale in nadlegovale sosednjih britanskih protektoratov.

source.title: Treaty of Jeddah (1927)
paragraphs: The 1927 Treaty of Jeddah, formally the Treaty between His Majesty and His Majesty the King of the Hejaz and of Nejd and Its Dependencies was signed between the United Kingdom and Ibn Saud.

It was signed by Sir Gilbert Clayton on behalf of the United Kingdom and Prince Faisal bin Abdulaziz on behalf of Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd on 20 May 1927. The treaty recognized the independence of Ibn Saud and sovereignty over what was then known as the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd. The two regions were unified into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932. In return, Ibn Saud agreed to stop his forces from attacking and harassing neighbouring British protectorates.

Treaty of Resht.headline: Pogodba iz Rašta
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Rašta sta Rusko cesarstvo in Safavidski imperij podpisala v Raštu 21. januarja 1732. Rusija se je z njo odpovedala zahtevam po vseh ozemljih južno od reke Kure, med drugim je vrnila pokrajine Gilan, Mazandaran in Astarabad, ki jih je v zgodnjih 1720. letih osvojil Peter I. Iranska mesta severno od Kure, kot so Derbent, Tarki in Gandža, naj bi vrnila tri leta pozneje. Iranci, ki jim je tedaj dejansko vladal vojaško uspešni Nader, so v zameno ruskim trgovcem podelili trgovske ugodnosti in obljubili, da bodo gruzijskega kralja Vahtanga VI., ki je tedaj živel v izgnanstvu v Rusiji, vrnili na prestol Kartlija, takoj ko bodo iz te dežele pregnali osmanske čete. Določbe je potrdila pogodba iz Gandže leta 1735, s katero so Iranu vrnili tudi vse pokrajine severno od Kure.

source.title: Treaty of Resht
paragraphs: The Treaty of Resht was signed between the Russian Empire and Safavid Empire in Rasht on 21 January 1732. According to this treaty Russia waived its claim to any territory south of the Kura River. This included return of the provinces of Gilan, Mazandaran, and Astarabad, conquered by Peter I in the early 1720s. The Iranian cities of Derbent, Tarki, Ganja, etc. north of the Kura river would be returned three years later. In return, the Iranians, now de facto ruled by the militarily successful Nader, granted trade privileges to Russian merchants and promised to restore the Georgian king Vakhtang VI, then residing in exile in Russia, on the throne of Kartli as soon as the Ottoman troops could be expelled from that country. The provisions were confirmed by the 1735 Treaty of Ganja, according which treaty all the regions north of the Kura river were returned as well.

Treaty of Saadabad.headline: Saadabadska pogodba
paragraphs: Saadabadska pogodba (ali Saadabadski pakt) je bil pakt o nenapadanju, ki so ga 8. julija 1937 podpisale Turčija, Iran, Irak in Afganistan in je veljal pet let. Podpisali so ga v teheranski palači Saadabad, del pa je bil pobude za tesnejše odnose med državami Bližnjega vzhoda, ki jo je vodil afganistanski kralj Mohamed Zahir šah. Listine o ratifikaciji so izmenjali v Teheranu 25. junija 1938 in pogodba je istega dne začela veljati. V zbirko pogodb Društva narodov so jo vpisali 19. julija 1938.

V Iraku je bila levo usmerjena vojaška vlada Bakra Sidkija v letih 1936–1937 manj arabsko nacionalistična od drugih iraških vlad. Sidki je bil Kurd, njegov predsednik vlade Hikmat Sulejman pa Turkmen, zato ju je zanimala diplomacija z vzhodnimi, nearabskimi sosednjimi državami Iraka. Turčija si je prizadevala za prijateljske odnose s sosednjimi državami in je še vedno okrevala po porazu v prvi svetovni vojni in drago plačani zmagi v turški osamosvojitveni vojni.

source.title: Treaty of Saadabad
paragraphs: The Treaty of Saadabad (or the Saadabad Pact) was a non-aggression pact signed by Turkey, Iran, Iraq, and Afghanistan on 8 July 1937, and lasted for five years. The treaty was signed in Tehran's Saadabad Palace and was part of an initiative for greater Middle Eastern-oriental relations spearheaded by King Mohammed Zahir Shah of Afghanistan. Ratifications were exchanged in Tehran on 25 June 1938, and the treaty became effective on the same day. It was registered in the League of Nations Treaty Series on 19 July 1938.

In Iraq, the left-leaning Bakr Sidqi military government of 1936–1937 was less Arab nationalist than other Iraqi governments. Sidqi was a Kurd and his prime minister, Hikmat Sulayman, was a Turkmen. They were therefore interested in diplomacy with Iraq's eastern, non-Arab neighbours. Turkey sought friendly relations with its neighbours and was still recovering from its defeat in World War I and the costly victory in the Turkish War of Independence.

Pogodbeni Oman, znan tudi kot Pogodbene države, Pogodbena obala ali Pogodbeni šejkati, je bil skupina plemenskih zvez na jugovzhodu Arabije ob Perzijskem zalivu, katerih voditelji so med letoma 1820 in 1892 z Britanskim imperijem podpisali zaščitne pogodbe.

Pogodbene države so ostale neformalni britanski protektorat, dokler pogodb 1. decembra 1971 niso preklicali. Naslednji dan je šest šejkatov – Dubaj, Abu Dabi, Šardža, Adžman, Um al Kajvajn in Fudžajra – ustanovilo Združene arabske emirate, sedmi, Ras al Hajma, pa se jim je pridružil 10. februarja 1972.

source.title: Trucial States
paragraphs: The Trucial States, also known as the Trucial Coast, or the Trucial Sheikhdoms, or Trucial Oman, were a group of tribal confederations in southeastern Arabia along the Persian Gulf whose leaders had signed protective treaties with the British Empire between 1820 and 1892.

The Trucial States remained an informal British protectorate until the treaties were revoked on 1 December 1971. The following day, six of the sheikhdoms—Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah—formed the United Arab Emirates; the seventh, Ras Al Khaimah, joined on 10 February 1972.

Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt.headline: Dvaindvajseta egipčanska dinastija
paragraphs: Dvaindvajseta dinastija je bila staroegipčanska dinastija, ki je vladala v letih 947–713 pr. n. št., v tretjem vmesnem obdobju. Ustanovil jo je Šešonk I., ki je bil starolibijskega izvora. Znana je tudi kot bubastidska dinastija, saj so faraoni sprva vladali iz mesta Bubastis.

source.title: Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt
paragraphs: The Twenty-second Dynasty was an Ancient Egyptian dynasty of 947–713 BC, during the Third Intermediate Period. The dynasty was founded by Shoshenq I, who was of ancient Libyan origin. It is also known as the Bubastite Dynasty as the pharaohs originally ruled from the city of Bubastis.

Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt.headline: Triindvajseta egipčanska dinastija
paragraphs: Triindvajseta dinastija je bila staroegipčanska dinastija starolibijskega izvora, ki jo sodobna periodizacija običajno uvršča kot tretjo dinastijo tretjega vmesnega obdobja starega Egipta. Sestavljalo jo je več kraljev, ki so izhajali iz plemena Ma in so v 9. in 8. stoletju pr. n. št. vladali delom Egipta. Raziskovalci so si glede opredelitve in sestave tega, kar imenujejo 23. dinastija, različnega mnenja.

source.title: Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt
paragraphs: The Twenty-third Dynasty was an Ancient Egyptian dynasty of ancient Libyan origin which is usually classified as the third dynasty of the ancient Egyptian Third Intermediate Period in modern periodization. This dynasty consisted of a number of kings descended from the Ma tribe and ruling over parts of Egypt in the 9th and 8th centuries BC. Scholars are divided on the definition and composition of what they label the 23rd Dynasty.

United States–Taliban deal.headline: Sporazum med ZDA in talibani
paragraphs: Sporazum med ZDA in talibani, uradno Sporazum o vzpostavitvi miru v Afganistanu med Združenimi državami Amerike in Islamskim emiratom Afganistan (ki ga ZDA ne priznavajo kot državo in je znan kot talibani), splošno znan kot sporazum iz Dohe, je bil mirovni sporazum, ki so ga ZDA in talibani podpisali 29. februarja 2020 v Dohi v Katarju, da bi končali vojno v Afganistanu v letih 2001–2021. Za ZDA se je o njem v imenu prve Trumpove administracije pogajal Zalmaj Halilzad, Islamska republika Afganistan, tedanja afganistanska vlada, pa pri pogajanjih ni sodelovala. Sporazum, ki je imel tudi tajne priloge, je bil eden od ključnih dogodkov, ki so povzročili razpad afganistanskih nacionalnih obrambnih in varnostnih sil (ANDSF). ZDA so se držale pogojev sporazuma in korenito zmanjšale število zračnih napadov, s čimer so ANDSF ostale brez ključne prednosti pri zadrževanju talibanov. Po poročilu posebnega generalnega inšpektorja za obnovo Afganistana (SIGAR) je to povzročilo »občutek zapuščenosti v ANDSF in med afganistanskim prebivalstvom«. ANDSF so bile slabo pripravljene, da bi po umiku ZDA same skrbele za varnost, kar je omogočilo talibanski upor in nazadnje talibanski prevzem Kabula 15. avgusta 2021.

source.title: United States–Taliban deal
paragraphs: The United States–Taliban deal, officially known as the Agreement for Bringing Peace to Afghanistan between the United States and the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (which is not recognized by the United States as a state and is known as the Taliban) and commonly known as the Doha Accords, was a peace agreement signed by the United States and the Taliban on 29 February 2020 in Doha, Qatar, with intent to bring an end to the 2001–2021 war in Afghanistan. Negotiated for the U.S. by Zalmay Khalilzad for the first Trump administration, the negotiations for the agreement did not involve the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan, the Afghan government at the time. The deal, which also had secret annexes, was one of the critical events that caused the collapse of the Afghan National Defense and Security Forces (ANDSF). Adhering to the conditions of the deal, the U.S. dramatically reduced the number of U.S. air raids, leaving the ANDSF without a key advantage in keeping the Taliban at bay. This resulted in "a sense of abandonment within the ANDSF and the Afghan population" according to a report by the Special Inspector General for Afghanistan Reconstruction (SIGAR). ANDSF was ill-prepared to sustain security following a U.S. withdrawal, which allowed for the Taliban insurgency, ultimately leading to the Taliban takeover of Kabul on 15 August 2021.

Ukairski protokol ali Ukairska konvencija je bil sporazum, sklenjen 2. decembra 1922 v Ukairju, ki je določil meje med mandatnim Irakom, Sultanatom Nedžd in Šejkovino Kuvajt. Sklenil ga je britanski visoki komisar za Irak Percy Cox, potem ko so ihvanski napadalci iz Nedžda pod vodstvom Ibn Sauda napadli Kuvajt. Cox se je sestal z Ibn Saudom in majorjem Johnom Morom, britanskim političnim agentom v Kuvajtu. Določene meje so vključevale savdsko-iraško in savdsko-kuvajtsko nevtralno območje.

Ko so Savdijci in Britanci določali sodobne meje Kuvajta, ta pri izidu ukairskega sporazuma ni smel sodelovati. Kuvajt je zaradi sporazuma izgubil več kot dve tretjini ozemlja in svoje drugo največje mesto, pristanišče Manifa. Izguba ozemlja je v Kuvajtu okrepila protibritansko razpoloženje.

source.title: Uqair Protocol of 1922
paragraphs: The Uqair Protocol or Uqair Convention was an agreement at Uqair on 2 December 1922 that defined the boundaries between Mandatory Iraq, the Sultanate of Nejd and Sheikhdom of Kuwait. It was made by Percy Cox, the British High Commissioner to Iraq, in response to Ikhwan raiders from Nejd under Ibn Saud attacking Kuwait. Cox met ibn Saud and Major John More, the British Political Agent to Kuwait. The boundaries included a Saudi–Iraqi neutral zone and a Saudi–Kuwaiti neutral zone.

Kuwait was not permitted any role in the outcome of the Uqair agreement when the Saudis and British decided Kuwait's modern boundaries. Kuwait lost more than two thirds of its territory as a result of the agreement, as well as its second largest town, the port of Manifa. The loss of territory made anti-British sentiment grow in Kuwait.

Ujunidi (arabsko: al-ʿUyūnīyūn) so bili arabska dinastija, ki je vzhodni Arabiji vladala 163 let, od 11. do 13. stoletja. Kot večina prebivalcev vzhodne Arabije so izhajali iz plemena Banu Abdul Kajs. Deželo so v letih 1077–1078 n. št. z vojaško pomočjo Velikega seldžuškega imperija iztrgali Karmatom, leta 651 po hidžri (1253 n. št.) pa je prešla v roke Usfuridov iz plemena Banu Ukajl. Ujunid je bil slavni pesnik Ali bin al Mugrab Al Ujuni.

source.title: Uyunid dynasty
paragraphs: The Uyunid dynasty (Arabic: العيونيون, romanized: al-ʿUyūnīyūn) were an Arab dynasty that ruled Eastern Arabia for 163 years, from the 11th to the 13th centuries. They were, like the majority of the people of Eastern Arabia, from the Banu Abdul Qays tribe. They seized the country from the Qarmatians with the military assistance of Great Seljuq Empire in the year 1077–1078 CE. It then fell to the Usfurids of Banu Uqayl in 651 AH (1253 CE). The famous poet Ali bin al Mugrab Al Uyuni is a Uyunid.

Vojna v Iraku (2013–2017), v Iraku znana tudi kot »حرب داعش«, kar pomeni »vojna proti Islamski državi«, je bil oborožen spopad med Irakom z zavezniki in Islamsko državo. Po decembru 2013 je upor po spopadih v delih zahodnega Iraka prerasel v vojno v polnem obsegu, ki je dosegla vrhunec z ofenzivo Islamske države v Iraku junija 2014, ko je Islamska država zavzela mesti Mosul in Tikrit ter druga mesta na zahodu in severu Iraka. Mosul so napadli med 4. in 9. junijem 2014 in mesto je padlo; nato je predsednik vlade Nuri al Maliki 10. junija pozval k razglasitvi izrednih razmer v vsej državi. Kljub varnostni krizi pa iraški parlament Malikiju ni dovolil razglasiti izrednih razmer: mnogi poslanci so sejo bojkotirali, ker so nasprotovali širitvi pristojnosti predsednika vlade. Ali Gajdan, nekdanji vojaški poveljnik v Mosulu, je Al Malikija obtožil, da je prav on ukazal umik iz Mosula. Na vrhuncu je ISIL držal 56.000 kvadratnih kilometrov iraškega ozemlja s 4,5 milijona prebivalci.
notes: The glossary headline is Iraška državljanska vojna; the text keeps the English article's name, Vojna v Iraku (2013–2017).

source.title: War in Iraq (2013–2017)
paragraphs: The War in Iraq (2013–2017) also known in Iraq as “حرب داعش" translating to “the war against The islamic state” was an armed conflict between Iraq and its allies and the Islamic State. Following December 2013, the insurgency escalated into a full-scale war following clashes in parts of western Iraq, which culminated in the Islamic State offensive into Iraq in June 2014, leading to the capture of the cities of Mosul, Tikrit and other cities in western and northern Iraq by the Islamic State. Between 4–9 June 2014, the city of Mosul was attacked and later fell; following this, Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki called for a national state of emergency on 10 June. However, despite the security crisis, Iraq's parliament did not allow Maliki to declare a state of emergency; many legislators boycotted the session because they opposed expanding the prime minister's powers. Ali Ghaidan, a former military commander in Mosul, accused al-Maliki of being the one who issued the order to withdraw from the city of Mosul. At its height, ISIL held 56,000 square kilometers of Iraqi territory, containing 4.5 million citizens.

Vojna za sveti Sabas (1256–1270; italijansko: Guerra di San Saba) je bil spopad med tekmicama, italijanskima pomorskima republikama Genovo (ki so ji pomagali Filip Montfortski, gospod Tira, Ivan iz Arsufa in vitezi hospitalci) in Benetkami (ki so jim pomagali grof Jafe in Aškelona Ivan Ibelinski in vitezi templjarji), za nadzor nad Akro v Jeruzalemskem kraljestvu.

source.title: War of Saint Sabas
paragraphs: The War of Saint Sabas (1256–1270; Italian: Guerra di San Saba) was a conflict between the rival Italian maritime republics of Genoa (aided by Philip of Montfort, Lord of Tyre, John of Arsuf, and the Knights Hospitaller) and Venice (aided by the Count of Jaffa and Ascalon, John of Ibelin, and the Knights Templar) over control of Acre, in the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

Vatasidi (arabsko: الوطاسيون, al-waṭṭāsīyūn) so bili vladarska dinastija Maroka. Tako kot Marinidi so bili tudi vatasidski vladarji berberskega izvora iz plemena Zenata. Družini sta bili sorodni in Marinidi so med Vatasidi izbrali veliko vezirjev. Ti vezirji so si postopno prisvojili velik del sultanove oblasti. Leta 1458 ali 1459 je Abd al Hak II. znova uveljavil neposredno marinidsko oblast in zatrl družino Vatasidov, pri čemer naj bi ubil veliko njenih članov. Leta 1465 je bil Abd al Hak ubit v uporu v Fesu, nato pa so Vatasidi nazadnje prevzeli nadzor nad nekdanjim marinidskim kraljestvom.

Prvi vatasidski sultan je bil Abu Abdulah al Šejk Mohamed ibn Jahja. Nadzoroval je le sever Maroka, jug pa je bil razdeljen na več kneževin. Vatasidi so bili dokončno izpodrinjeni leta 1554, po bitki pri Tadli, ko so jih nadomestili saadijski knezi iz Tagmaderta, ki so od leta 1511 vladali vsemu južnemu Maroku.

source.title: Wattasid dynasty
paragraphs: The Wattasid dynasty (Arabic: الوطاسيون, al-waṭṭāsīyūn) was a ruling dynasty of Morocco. Like the Marinid dynasty, its rulers were of Zenata Berber descent. The two families were related, and the Marinids recruited many viziers from the Wattasids. These viziers gradually assumed many of the powers of the sultans. In 1458 or 1459, Abd al-Haqq II reasserted direct Marinid authority and suppressed the Wattasid family, reportedly killing many of its members. In 1465, Abd al-Haqq was killed during a revolt in Fez, after which the Wattasids eventually established control over the former Marinid realm.

Abu Abd Allah al-Sheikh Muhammad ibn Yahya was the first Sultan of the Wattasid Dynasty. He controlled only the northern part of Morocco, the south being divided into several principalities. The Wattasids were finally supplanted in 1554, after the Battle of Tadla, by the Saadi dynasty princes of Tagmadert who had ruled all of southern Morocco since 1511.

White Revolution.headline: Bela revolucija
paragraphs: Bela revolucija (perzijsko: انقلاب سفید, Enqelâb-e Sefid) ali revolucija šaha in ljudstva (perzijsko: انقلاب شاه و مردم, Enqelâb-e Šâh o Mardom) je bila vrsta reform za posodobitev Cesarske države Iran, ki jih je 26. januarja 1963 sprožil šah Mohamed Reza Pahlavi in so se končale z njegovim strmoglavljenjem leta 1979. Revolucija je obsegala zemljiško reformo, v kateri so zemljiški posestniki za svojo zemljo dobili odškodnino v delnicah privatiziranih državnih tovarn, širitev cestnega, železniškega in letalskega omrežja, gradnjo jezov in namakalnih sistemov, odpravljanje bolezni, kot je malarija, spodbujanje industrijske rasti in delitev dobička z delavci, volilno pravico za ženske, podržavljenje gozdov in pašnikov ter opismenjevalne in zdravstvene enote za odmaknjena podeželska območja.

Večina programa je bila namenjena iranskemu kmečkemu prebivalstvu, hkrati pa je program bogastvo aristokratskih zemljiških posestnikov prerazporejal iranskemu delavskemu razredu. Šah je z zemljiško reformo upal, da se bo povezal s kmeti na podeželju in pretrgal njihove vezi z aristokracijo v mestih.

source.title: White Revolution
paragraphs: The White Revolution (Persian: انقلاب سفید, romanized: Enqelâb-e Sefid) or the Shah and People Revolution (Persian: انقلاب شاه و مردم, romanized: Enqelâb-e Šâh o Mardom) was a series of reforms to modernize the Imperial State of Iran launched on 26 January 1963 by the Shah, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, and ended with his overthrow in 1979. Among the elements of the revolution were land reform where landlords were compensated for their land by shares of privatized state-owned factories, expanded road, rail, and air network, dam and irrigation projects, work to eradicate diseases such as malaria, promotion of industrial growth and profit-sharing schemes for workers, enfranchisement of women, nationalization of forests and pastures, literacy and health corps for isolated rural areas.

The bulk of the program was aimed at Iran's peasantry while redistributing the aristocrat landlord class wealth down to working class Iranians. Through land reform, the Shah hoped to ally himself with the peasantry in the countryside, and to sever their ties with the aristocracy in the city.

Ya'rubids.headline: Jarubidi
paragraphs: Jarubidi (tudi Jaariba ali Jaarubi; arabsko: أسرة آل يعرب) so bili vladarji Omana med letoma 1624 in 1742 z nazivom imama. Portugalce so pregnali iz obalnih utrdb v Muškatu in deželo združili. Izboljšali so kmetijstvo, razširili trgovino in Oman razvili v veliko pomorsko silo. Njihove sile so Portugalce pregnale iz vzhodne Afrike in ustanovile trajna naselja na Zanzibarju, v Mombasi in drugod ob obali. Dinastija je izgubila oblast v boju za nasledstvo, ki se je začel leta 1712, in propadla po dolgotrajni državljanski vojni.

source.title: Ya'rubids
paragraphs: The Yarubid dynasty (also Ya'ariba or Ya'arubi; Arabic: أسرة آل يعرب) were rulers of Oman between 1624 and 1742, holding the title of Imam. They expelled the Portuguese from coastal strongholds in Muscat and united the country. They improved agriculture, expanded trade and built up Oman into a major maritime power. Their forces expelled the Portuguese from East Africa and established long-lasting settlements on Zanzibar, Mombasa and other parts of the coast. The dynasty lost power during a succession struggle that started in 1712 and fell after a prolonged period of civil war.

Državljanska vojna v Jemnu (arabsko: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية), znana tudi kot poletna vojna leta 1994 (arabsko: حرب صيف ١٩٩٤), je bila državljanska vojna med silami severne jemenske države, ki je podpirala združitev, in socialistične separatistične južne države ter njunimi podporniki. Vojna se je končala s porazom južnih separatistov in ponovno združitvijo Jemna, mnogi voditelji Jemenske socialistične stranke (YSP) in drugi separatisti pa so pobegnili v izgnanstvo.

source.title: Yemeni civil war (1994)
paragraphs: The Yemeni civil war (Arabic: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية), also known as the Summer War of 1994 (Arabic: حرب صيف ١٩٩٤), was a civil war fought between the two Yemeni forces of the pro-union northern and the socialist separatist southern Yemeni states and their supporters. The war resulted in the defeat of the southern separatists and the reunification of Yemen, and the flight into exile of many leaders of the Yemeni Socialist Party (YSP) and other separatists.

Jemenska državljanska vojna (arabsko: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية, al-ḥarb al-ʾahlīyah al-yamanīyah) je večstranska državljanska vojna, ki se je začela konec leta 2014 in še traja, predvsem med Predsedniškim vodstvenim svetom pod vodstvom Rašada al Alimija in Vrhovnim političnim svetom pod vodstvom Mahdija al Mašata ter njunimi podporniki in zavezniki. Obe strani trdita, da sta uradna vlada Jemna, Združeni narodi pa za uradno vlado priznavajo Predsedniški vodstveni svet.

source.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
paragraphs: The Yemeni civil war (Arabic: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية, romanized: al-ḥarb al-ʾahlīyah al-yamanīyah) is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.

Jemenska revolucija, znana tudi kot jemenska intifada, je bila vrsta velikih protivladnih protestov in oboroženih vstaj, ki so od januarja 2011 do februarja 2012 divjali po Jemnu. Potekala je hkrati z arabsko pomladjo, ki je leta 2011 izbruhnila po vsem Bližnjem vzhodu in severni Afriki. Na začetku so protesti v Jemnu nasprotovali brezposelnosti, gospodarskim razmeram, korupciji in avtoritarnemu režimu predsednika Alija Abdulaha Saleha, pa tudi vladnim predlogom za spremembo jemenske ustave. Zahteve protestnikov so se nato stopnjevale v pozive k Salehovemu odstopu. Zaradi množičnih prebegov iz vojske in Salehove vlade je velik del države dejansko ušel vladnemu nadzoru, protestniki pa so se zaobljubili, da se njeni oblasti ne bodo uklonili.

source.title: Yemeni revolution
